title: Preserving Item Semantics for Free: Rethinking Token Initialization in LLM-Based Generative Recommendation
summary: Recent advances in generative recommendation (GR) leverage large language models (LLMs) as recommender backbones, enabling LLMs to directly generate recommendations conditioned on item-interaction histories. In these systems, items are often represented through semantic IDs (SIDs) added to the LLM vocabulary as special tokens. Ideally, SIDs imbue item token representations with semantic priors, thereby improving model generalization. However, standard vocabulary expansion typically initializes these tokens as random Gaussian vectors, discarding the SIDs' underlying continuous geometry and forcing the LLM to relearn token relationships from interaction data. To demonstrate the consequences of this design, we first show that training from this initialization tends to organize SID embeddings around item popularity rather than semantics. We further show that, despite partially reducing the reliance on popularity and improving cold item performance, the computationally expensive process of continual pretraining (CPT) fails to reliably recover the original semantic geometry. To address these findings, we propose a simple, parameter-free intervention that initializes SID token embeddings directly from their corresponding centroids in the semantic embedding space. Requiring only a few lines of code and no additional training or inference overhead, this drop-in approach improves pure-SFT Recall@5 by up to 16%, reaches peak performance with up to 40% fewer SFT steps, and improves cold-item Recall@5 by up to 60%. Moreover, on datasets that benefit from additional CPT, centroid initialization reaches comparable performance while requiring half as many CPT epochs. Together, our findings show that preserving SID geometry, beyond shared-prefix structure, provides a simple and effective semantic prior for LLM-based GR.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于语义嵌入空间质心的简单、无参数初始化方法，解决生成式推荐中语义ID（SID）几何结构丢失问题，显著提升模型性能与训练效率。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式推荐系统通常将物品表示为语义ID（SID），但标准词汇扩展将其初始化为随机高斯向量，破坏了SID原有的连续几何结构，导致模型需重新学习且倾向于按物品流行度而非语义组织嵌入。
AI.method: 提出一种无需额外训练或推理开销的“质心初始化”方法，直接将SID token嵌入初始化为对应语义嵌入空间的质心。该方法仅需少量代码修改，作为即插即用方案应用于纯监督微调（SFT）及持续预训练（CPT）。
AI.result: 1. 纯SFT场景：Recall@5最高提升16%，达到峰值性能所需SFT步骤减少40%，冷启动物品Recall@5最高提升60%。2. CPT场景：在需要持续预训练的数据集上，以一半的CPT epoch数达到 comparable 的性能水平。
AI.conclusion: 保留SID的几何结构（超越共享前缀结构）能为基于LLM的生成式推荐提供一种简单且有效的语义先验，优于传统的随机初始化或依赖大量计算资源的持续预训练恢复。

title: PushDualGen: Enabling LLMs to Generate Semantic IDs with Interpretable Copy for Industrial Push Recommendation
summary: Push recommendation in KuaiShou proactively delivers personalized content to nearly one billion users to facilitate their engagement. Recently, generative recommendation has achieved end-to-end user personalization through semantic ID. However, their black- box characteristics make recommendation logics difficult to trace, hindering their deployment. OneRec-Thinking addresses this by incorporating CoT before generating SIDs, but this significantly increases inference cost. To support large-scale industrial applications, we propose PushDualGen, a lightweight generator, which first generates the SID and then produces a copy as a skippable explanation. PushDualGen has been deployed in Kuaishou's push recommendation system. Online A/B tests demonstrate the effectiveness of PushDualGen, delivering significant improvements in both user attraction and satisfaction. The effective play rate for videos recommended to users has relatively increased by 8.50%, while the dissatisfaction rate has relatively fallen by 37.70%. In the long term, PushDualGen optimises the content ecosystem, providing more exposure for long-tail videos.

AI.tldr: 提出PushDualGen，一种轻量级生成式推荐模型，通过先生成语义ID（SID）再生成可跳过的解释，平衡了个性化推荐效果与推理成本，已在快手大规模部署并显著提升用户指标。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式推荐虽能实现端到端个性化，但存在“黑盒”特性导致逻辑难追溯；而引入思维链（CoT）的OneRec-Thinking虽提升可解释性，却大幅增加推理成本，难以满足工业界大规模应用需求。
AI.method: 提出PushDualGen架构：首先生成语义ID（SID），随后基于该SID生成一份作为“可跳过解释”的副本。该方法旨在保持轻量级的同时提供一定的可解释性支持。
AI.result: 在快手推送推荐系统中上线，在线A/B测试显示：视频有效播放率相对提升8.50%，用户不满意率相对下降37.70%。长期来看，优化了内容生态，增加了长尾视频的曝光机会。
AI.conclusion: PushDualGen成功解决了生成式推荐在可解释性与计算效率之间的权衡问题，证明了其在大规模工业场景中的有效性，为后续轻量化可解释推荐提供了可行方案。

title: Give the Long-tail More SPACE: Promoting Provider Fairness in Next POI Recommendation
comment: 20th ACM Conference on Recommender Systems (RecSys '26), September 27-October 02, 2026, Minneapolis, MN, USA
summary: Next point-of-interest (POI) recommendation predicts users' future destinations from historical mobility sequences and has become a key component of location-based services. However, mainstream models often concentrate exposure on a small set of popular POIs, leaving long-tail merchants systematically under-exposed. While provider fairness has recently attracted increasing attention, directly applying existing provider-fairness techniques to POI recommendation is problematic: (i) users face execution constraints; and (ii) POIs face resource supply constraints. To address this, we propose SPACE (Supply- and Physics-Aware Conditional Embedding generation), a model-agnostic framework that improves long-tail POI exposure via virtual user generation under explicit feasibility and supply control. SPACE consists of three stages: (1) community inference to capture heterogeneous user execution constraints; (2) unbalanced optimal-transport allocation to decide how many virtual users each tail POI should receive from which communities under POI-specific supply budgets; and (3) constraint-guided latent diffusion to generate POI-conditional, community-consistent virtual user embeddings. The generated user-POI pairs can be seamlessly used to train existing recommenders without modifying their architectures. Extensive experiments on three real-world datasets demonstrate that SPACE substantially improves provider fairness while maintaining and often improving recommendation accuracy across multiple backbone models. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Anniran1/SPACE-main.

AI.tldr: 提出SPACE框架，通过虚拟用户生成解决POI推荐中的长尾商户曝光不足问题，在保持推荐精度的同时显著提升提供者公平性。
AI.motivation: 主流POI推荐模型导致热门POI过度曝光，长尾商户被系统性忽视；直接应用现有公平性技术因用户执行约束和POI资源供应约束而失效。
AI.method: 提出SPACE（Supply- and Physics-Aware Conditional Embedding generation），一种模型无关框架，包含三阶段：(1)社区推断捕捉用户执行约束；(2)非平衡最优传输分配决定虚拟用户来源及数量以符合供应预算；(3)约束引导的潜在扩散生成虚拟用户嵌入。
AI.result: 在三个真实数据集上的实验表明，SPACE显著提高了提供者公平性，同时在多个骨干模型上保持或提升了推荐准确性。
AI.conclusion: SPACE通过显式的可行性和供应控制生成虚拟用户-POI对，可无缝集成到现有推荐器中，有效平衡了长尾曝光与推荐性能。

title: Search over the Visual World: Persistent Visual Memory, Layered Indexes, and Source-Grounded Evidence
comment: 33 pages, 5 figures, 17 tables. Technical report. Benchmark configurations and reproduction instructions: https://github.com/video-db/search-over-the-visual-world
summary: Most video-retrieval systems assume a bounded corpus and return ranked files or timestamps. Agents operating over cameras, screens, streams, and archives face a different systems problem: observations arrive continuously; models interpret them at different temporal granularities; context must be selected without replaying the complete visual record; and results must stay connected to inspectable source evidence. We argue that search over such a corpus is an infrastructure problem that cannot be reduced to ranking video files. We develop a conceptual and formal model of search over the visual world built on analyzer-defined scenes, persistent understanding artifacts, visual memory as coexisting scene spaces over shared source time, and capability-declared indexes, distinguishing memory (everything retained), context (what is selected for a task), and evidence (the source intervals that ground it). The VideoDB data format (VDB) realizes this model in production, exposed through a typed search surface spanning planned retrieval, stateful investigation, direct access, and grounded synthesis. We contrast this model-agnostic infrastructure, where segmentation, sampling, model choice, embeddings, and ranking are system decisions and live streams are first-class sources, with video-native foundation models offered as fixed APIs. In a semantic-retrieval comparison against a commercial video-native engine spanning 9,800+ queries over four public datasets, a pipeline of general-purpose components achieves higher macro-averaged Recall@1/@3/@10 (73.09/83.39/91.20 versus 65.75/77.13/89.10), while the baseline is higher at Recall@50 (96.42 versus 96.07). Retrieval quality over the visual world is today governed more by system design than by video-specific pretraining, and visual-memory infrastructure can deliver it while keeping playable, source-grounded evidence first-class.

AI.tldr: 提出VideoDB数据格式(VDB)，将视频搜索从简单的文件排名转变为基于持续视觉记忆和可追溯证据的基础设施问题，通过系统架构优化而非仅依赖预训练模型，实现了更高的语义检索精度。
AI.motivation: 传统视频检索系统假设语料库有限且返回排名结果，但面对摄像头、屏幕等连续流媒体场景时，存在观测持续到达、时间粒度不一、需在不重放完整记录的情况下选择上下文，以及结果必须连接可检查源证据等问题。现有方法无法有效处理这种动态、连续的视觉世界搜索需求。
AI.method: 开发了一个概念和形式化模型，基于分析器定义的场景、持久性理解工件、作为共享源时间上共存场景空间的视觉记忆，以及能力声明索引。提出了VideoDB (VDB) 数据格式，提供涵盖计划检索、状态调查、直接访问和接地合成的类型化搜索界面。该基础设施模型无关，将分割、采样、模型选择、嵌入和排名留作系统决策，并将实时流视为一等公民。
AI.result: 在9,800多个查询的四个公共数据集上与商业视频原生引擎进行对比。通用组件管道在宏观平均Recall@1/@3/@10上表现更好（73.09/83.39/91.20 vs 65.75/77.13/89.10），尽管基线在Recall@50上略高（96.42 vs 96.07）。
AI.conclusion: 当前的视觉世界检索质量更多由系统设计决定，而非视频特定的预训练。视觉记忆基础设施可以在保持可播放、源接地证据为首要地位的同时提供高质量的检索结果。

title: PragyaDoc: A Universal Document Intelligence Framework for Multilingual Medical Document Understanding in Low-Resource Settings
summary: India's 22 official languages create a critical accessibility barrier: the majority of medical documentation exists exclusively in English, yet the patients who most urgently require this information - rural populations, ASHA workers, and patient families - are functionally excluded from understanding it. This paper presents PragyaDoc, a Universal Document Intelligence Framework that addresses this gap through a four-layer pipeline: a parallel ensemble OCR extraction layer, a geometric-lexical fusion layer, a deterministic domain structuring layer, and a dual-LLM medical reasoning and localization layer

AI.tldr: 针对印度因语言障碍导致医疗文档（主要为英语）难以被农村人口、ASHA工作者及患者家属理解的问题，本文提出PragyaDoc框架。该框架通过四层流水线（并行OCR提取、几何-词汇融合、确定性领域结构化、双LLM医学推理与本地化），实现了多语言医疗文档的智能解析与本地化，提升了医疗信息的可访问性。
AI.motivation: 印度的22种官方语言造成了严重的可访问性壁垒：绝大多数医疗文档仅以英语存在，而最需要这些信息的人群（农村人口、ASHA基层卫生工作者、患者家属）往往无法理解英语，从而被排除在关键医疗信息之外。
AI.method: 提出了PragyaDoc通用文档智能框架，采用四层流水线架构：1) 并行集成OCR提取层；2) 几何-词汇融合层；3) 确定性领域结构化层；4) 双大语言模型（Dual-LLM）医学推理与本地化层。
AI.result: 成功构建了一个能够处理多语言医疗文档的通用框架，有效弥合了英语医疗文档与非英语使用者之间的信息鸿沟，实现了对医疗内容的准确提取、结构化及本地化翻译。
AI.conclusion: PragyaDoc框架通过结合先进的OCR技术与双LLM推理能力，有效解决了印度多语言环境下的医疗文档可读性问题，为提升弱势群体的医疗信息获取能力提供了技术解决方案。

title: Unified Hallucination Fuzzing for Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Hallucination remains a persistent challenge for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), severely limiting their reliability in high-stakes applications. Existing evaluations, predominantly based on static benchmarks, suffer from narrow taxonomical coverage and rapid performance saturation, failing to reflect model robustness in evolving real-world scenarios. To bridge this gap, we present a systematic evaluation framework integrating a comprehensive benchmark with self-evolving stress testing. First, we introduce UniHall, a fine-grained dataset grounded in a unified taxonomy spanning Object, Instruction, and Knowledge dimensions. Second, to address benchmark saturation, we propose Self-Adaptive Multimodal Fuzzing (SAMF), a self-adaptive framework that employs evolutionary mutation strategies to explore the boundaries of model hallucinations. Crucially, to ensure reliable assessment of dynamic inputs, SAMF incorporates a structured metric suite driven by an ensemble of multi-modal oracles. Our extensive experiments reveal that state-of-the-art MLLMs exhibit significant performance degradation under fuzzing compared to conventional settings, exposing a dissociation between reasoning capabilities and factual grounding. Furthermore, we identify a helpfulness-hallucination trade-off, where reinforcement learning alignment inadvertently exacerbates sycophancy in instruction-following tasks. The framework, code and benchmark are available at https://github.com/LanceZPF/EvalHall.

AI.tldr: 提出UniHall基准和SAMF自适应模糊测试框架，通过动态演化测试揭示MLLMs在真实场景下的幻觉问题及RL对齐带来的助幻化权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有静态基准存在分类覆盖窄、性能饱和快的问题，无法反映多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在动态现实场景中的鲁棒性，且幻觉严重限制了其在高风险应用中的可靠性。
AI.method: 1. 构建UniHall：基于统一分类法（对象、指令、知识维度）的细粒度幻觉数据集；2. 提出SAMF：采用进化变异策略的自我适应多模态模糊测试框架，结合多模态预言机集成驱动的指标套件以评估动态输入。
AI.result: 1. SOTA MLLMs在模糊测试下表现显著下降，暴露推理能力与事实基础的脱节；2. 发现“有用性-幻觉”权衡现象，强化学习对齐意外加剧了指令跟随任务中的阿谀奉承行为。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过系统性评估框架揭示了MLLMs在动态环境下的脆弱性，为理解幻觉机制及改进模型对齐提供了重要见解。

title: Towards an Argumentative Foundation for Evaluative AI
summary: Evaluative AI (EAI) has been recently proposed as a way to support human decision-making, not by producing a single recommendation, but by presenting competing hypotheses together with evidence for and against each. In this position paper, we advocate (computational) argumentation as a particularly suitable paradigm to provide a formal, computable foundation for forms of EAI that are explainable and contestable, setting the ground for a long-term research agenda towards distributed and human-centred EAI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文主张利用计算论证（Computational Argumentation）为可解释、可争辩的评价性AI（EAI）提供形式化基础，推动分布式以人为本的EAI系统研究。
AI.motivation: 现有的评价性AI（EAI）旨在通过呈现相互竞争的假设及其支持/反对证据来辅助人类决策，而非给出单一建议。然而，缺乏一种形式化的、可计算的框架来确保这种方法的严谨性、可解释性和可争辩性。
AI.method: 提出将“计算论证”作为一种合适的范式，用于构建EAI的形式化、可计算基础。这是一篇立场论文（Position Paper），旨在确立长期的研究议程。
AI.result: 确立了计算论证在支撑可解释和可争辩的EAI系统中的核心地位，为未来开发分布式且以人为本的EAI系统奠定了理论基础和研究方向。
AI.conclusion: 计算论证是构建下一代人机协作决策支持系统的关键技术路径，应作为长期研究重点以发展更透明、更具包容性的评价性AI。

title: ScaleSense: Cost-Intelligent Scaling Framework via Learned Resource Estimation in Alibaba AnalyticDB
comment: This paper has been accepted for presentation at VLDB 2026
summary: Cloud-native serverless data warehouses achieve fine-grained elasticity by decoupling storage from compute, yet determining the optimal resource allocation for highly heterogeneous ad-hoc queries remains a formidable industrial challenge. Our analysis of production workloads in Alibaba AnalyticDB exposes a costly ``provisioning trap'': the fear of catastrophic resource depletion drives users to blindly over-provision resources, wasting immense monetary budgets without alleviating non-CPU bottlenecks (e.g., I/O saturation). To break this impasse, we propose ScaleSense, a proactive, query-level resource scaling framework. Specifically, it features a multi-faceted query encoder that jointly models plan topologies and hardware specifications. Crucially, a quantile-based resource predictor estimates multi-dimensional physical footprints, acting as a reliable safety net for optimal resource scaling. An auto-scaling controller then navigates the performance-cost Pareto frontier, dynamically tailoring allocations to specific business priorities without requiring model retraining. Evaluations on over 1.36 million production queries show that ScaleSense achieves state-of-the-art prediction accuracy with good prediction interval coverage. By achieving a 76.7% relative improvement in optimal resource configuration selection over the best baseline, this approach addresses the critical performance-cost trade-off while maintaining low-overhead inference latency, confirming its practical performance in production deployments. Under the performance-optimization policy, ScaleSense satisfies user-defined performance requirements while reducing monetary cost by up to 5.22x.

AI.tldr: 针对云原生无服务器数据仓库中因过度配置导致的资源浪费问题，提出ScaleSense框架。该框架通过多面查询编码器和分位数资源预测器，实现查询级动态资源缩放，在Alibaba AnalyticDB生产环境中显著提升了资源配置效率并降低了成本。
AI.motivation: 解决云原生无服务器数据仓库中异构即席查询的最佳资源分配难题。分析发现存在“配置陷阱”：用户为避免资源耗尽而盲目过度配置，导致巨额预算浪费且无法缓解非CPU瓶颈（如I/O饱和）。
AI.method: 提出ScaleSense，一种主动式、查询级的资源扩展框架。核心组件包括：1）联合建模计划拓扑和硬件规格的多面查询编码器；2）基于分位数的资源预测器，用于估计多维物理足迹以提供安全网；3）自动缩放控制器，在不需重新训练模型的情况下，根据业务优先级在性能-成本帕累托前沿上动态调整资源分配。
AI.result: 在超过136万条生产查询上的评估显示：ScaleSense实现了最先进的预测准确性和良好的预测区间覆盖率；相比最佳基线，最优资源配置选择相对改进76.7%；在性能优化策略下，满足用户性能要求的同时将货币成本降低高达5.22倍，且具有低开销推理延迟。
AI.conclusion: ScaleSense有效解决了性能与成本的权衡问题，证明了其在生产部署中的实用性能和经济效益，打破了传统的过度配置困境。

title: DS@GT ARC at Touché: Large Language Models for Retrieval-Augmented Debate
comment: 12 pages, 4 figures. Accepted for publication in the CLEF 2026 Best of Labs proceedings
summary: We extend the DS@GT ARC working-note submission to the Touché 2025 Retrieval-Augmented Debate task. The task has two subtasks: generating the next utterance in a simulated debate, and evaluating debate responses according to the Gricean maxims of Quantity, Quality, Relation, and Manner. The DS@GT ARC submission consisted of six leading LLMs from three providers through a retrieval-augmented prompting pipeline. We summarize the results from the working paper and explore whether multi-LLM evaluator agreement is a reliable proxy for official evaluation performance. The analysis shows that frontier LLM systems are strong response generators, and as evaluators they agree strongly within model families. However this consensus does not reliably track the official evaluation target, with the largest gap on the Quality maxim. The accompanying source code for this paper is located at https://github.com/dsgt-arc/touche-2025-rad and https://github.com/dsgt-arc/touche-2025-rad-analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了DS@GT ARC在Touché 2025检索增强辩论任务中的工作笔记，评估了六个前沿LLM作为生成器和评估器的表现。研究发现，虽然模型家族内部评估者一致性高，但这种共识并不能可靠地反映官方评估结果，尤其在“质量”准则上差距最大。
AI.motivation: 旨在探索多LLM评估者的一致性是否可作为官方辩论评估性能的可靠代理指标，并总结和分析基于检索增强提示管道的多LLM系统在该任务上的表现。
AI.method: 使用来自三个提供商的六个领先大语言模型（LLMs），通过检索增强提示管道参与Touché 2025任务的两个子任务：生成辩论下一轮发言及根据格莱斯合作原则（数量、质量、关系、方式）评估回复。分析模型间评估者的一致性及其与官方评估目标的相关性。
AI.result: 前沿LLM系统是强大的响应生成器；同一模型家族内的评估者之间具有高度一致性。然而，这种共识并不能可靠地追踪官方评估目标，特别是在“质量”准则上存在最大偏差。
AI.conclusion: 尽管多LLM评估者在族内达成一致，但以此作为官方评估的代理指标并不可靠，尤其是在衡量回答质量时存在显著局限。

title: NeuroPilot: An Agent-Driven Smart Pipeline for Processing, Quality Control, and Managing Neuroimages
summary: Transforming raw neuroimage archives into analysis-ready derivatives relies on three brittle stages: data standardization, modality-specific preprocessing, and quality control (QC). While individual neuroimaging tools are well developed, their orchestration requires project-specific scripts, environment-adaptive tuning, and labor-intensive manual QC. To address this, we introduce NeuroPilot, a multi-agent system that digitalizes the expertise of neuroimage processing, QC, and data management into three LLM-invocable skills: dcm2bids-skill, neuroimage-pre-skill, and qc-agent-skill. The LLM-driven agent autonomously orchestrates workflows, generalizing various infrastructure settings into a single configuration to achieve the highest scalability. Demonstrating the system's generalizability, we deployed NeuroPilot across 17 cohorts (>123,000 subjects) spanning infant to aging populations and multiple MRI modalities (structural, diffusion, functional). In practice, after standardizing data via the dcm2bids-skill, the agent dynamically routes datasets to the optimal neuroimage-pre-skill based on available modalities and cohort traits (e.g., dispatching T1w and fMRI data to fMRIPrep, or selecting specialized pipelines for infant cohorts). The qc-agent-skill then drives an evidence-based, semi-automated QC via a 3-D browser dashboard, utilizing a multi-tiered verification system to optimize failed cases and escalate complex issues for supervisor inspection. Quantitatively, our QC agent screened 558 production subjects, validating its automated flags against FreeSurfer's topology-defect metrics. The infant processing pipeline achieved a 100% (201/201) completion rate on QC-validated inputs. Importantly, NeuroPilot compresses the traditional 2--3 month timeline for training staff and processing complete datasets into a single week. NeuroPilot is deployed in https://wanda-cyberbench.com/.

AI.tldr: NeuroPilot是一个基于多智能体系统（Multi-agent system）的神经影像处理平台，通过大语言模型（LLM）编排数据标准化、预处理和质量控制（QC）流程，实现了从原始数据到分析就绪衍生数据的自动化，显著提升了跨队列处理的效率和可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 传统神经影像数据处理依赖 brittle（脆弱/易碎）的三个阶段：数据标准化、模态特异性预处理和人工质量控制。尽管单个工具成熟，但协调这些工具需要项目特定的脚本、环境适配调整和大量人力投入的手工QC，缺乏通用性和可扩展性。
AI.method:
引入NeuroPilot系统，将神经影像处理、QC和数据管理专家知识数字化为三个可被LLM调用的技能模块：
1. dcm2bids-skill：负责数据标准化。
2. neuroimage-pre-skill：根据可用模态和队列特征动态路由至最优预处理管道（如fMRIPrep或婴儿专用管道）。
3. qc-agent-skill：驱动基于证据的半自动QC，通过3D浏览器仪表盘和多级验证系统优化失败案例并升级复杂问题。
AI.result:
1. **大规模部署验证**：在17个队列（超过12.3万名受试者，涵盖婴儿至老年人群及多种MRI模态）中成功部署。
2. **自动化与效率**：qc-agent对558个生产受试者进行了筛查；婴儿处理管道在QC验证输入上实现100%完成率达（201/201）。
3. **时间压缩**：将传统培训员工和处理完整数据集所需的2-3个月时间压缩至一周。
4. **系统可用性**：已在指定网站部署。
AI.conclusion: NeuroPilot通过LLM驱动的智能体自主编排工作流，有效解决了神经影像数据处理中的协调难题，证明了其在不同基础设施设置下的通用性和高可扩展性，大幅降低了人工干预需求并缩短了处理周期。

title: DocAtlas: Long-Document Understanding as Mutable-State Interaction
summary: Long-document understanding requires models to find and combine evidence across many pages, layouts, tables, figures, and charts. Existing retrieval-augmented systems usually select evidence from a static index before generation, while recent agentic systems add multi-turn tool use but often rely on frozen proprietary backbones whose behavior is set by prompts. We present DocAtlas, a system that treats long-document understanding as a mutable-state information-seeking process. We instantiate DocAtlas as a mutable document harness: an external environment that determines what document information is searched, read, stored, reviewed, and shown to the model at each step. Given a document and question, the harness exposes search, reading, note-taking, and review tools, maintains a hierarchical tree and note store, and updates both as the agent records evidence. DocAtlas combines self-improving retrieval, selective evidence access, and active working memory under a fixed context budget. The same harness supports inference-time use with large VLMs and end-to-end reinforcement learning for compact VLM agents. With GPT-5.4, DocAtlas reaches 71.4\% on MMLongBench-Doc, exceeding the human-expert reference of 65.8\%. A Qwen3.5-4B VLM trained with end-to-end RL in the DocAtlas environment reaches 63.7\%, compared with a 54.4\% direct-input baseline, showing that mutable document-harness design can improve compact document agents by a large margin.

AI.tldr: DocAtlas 是一种将长文档理解视为可变状态信息检索过程的系统，通过外部“文档工具包”动态管理证据的搜索、阅读和存储，显著提升了大型和紧凑视觉语言模型在长文档基准测试中的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有检索增强系统通常基于静态索引选择证据，而最新的智能体系统多依赖冻结的专有基础模型，行为受提示词限制，难以灵活处理跨页面、布局、表格等多模态复杂信息的综合。
AI.method: 提出 DocAtlas 系统，实例化为一个“可变文档工具包”（mutable document harness）。该外部环境维护层级树和笔记库，向智能体暴露搜索、阅读、记笔记和审查工具，并在每一步动态更新以记录证据。结合自我改进检索、选择性证据访问和主动工作记忆，在固定上下文预算下运行。支持推理时使用大型 VLM 以及端到端强化学习训练紧凑 VLM 智能体。
AI.result: 1. 使用 GPT-5.4 时，DocAtlas 在 MMLongBench-Doc 上达到 71.4%，超过人类专家参考水平（65.8%）。2. 经过端到端 RL 训练的 Qwen3.5-4B VLM 在 DocAtlas 环境中达到 63.7%，相比直接输入基线（54.4%）有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 可变文档工具包设计能大幅改善紧凑文档智能体的性能，证明了将长文档理解建模为动态可变状态过程的有效性。

title: Flow-by-Flow:Content-Judgment Bypass for Governing AI Output in High-Loss Domains
summary: Prior work showed that human-in-the-loop oversight becomes structurally untenable in high-loss domains when AI output velocity V exceeds human cognitive capacity C_max. The operative constraint, however, is not V alone but V x L, where L denotes per-item cognitive load. L consists of triage, judgment, and response, which respond asymmetrically to AI capability improvement. Triage cost does not decline as models become more capable, because semantic indeterminacy is inherent in general-purpose design. Response cost is invariant to accuracy improvements. Only judgment cost faces downward pressure, and this pressure often operates by inducing omission rather than genuine reduction. Capability improvement therefore restructures L rather than reducing it. Governance mechanisms based on evaluating whether AI output is correct either delegate that evaluation to AI and inherit hallucination risk, or delegate it to humans and face the V x L ceiling. We propose Flow-by-Flow, a governance paradigm that controls supervisory load without evaluating content. A cognitive cost score based on formal, countable features imposes nonlinear costs on high-volume production, while an institutional capacity cap keeps processing volume within C_max. We derive four design invariants for any content-judgment-bypass exceedance pathway: no content judgment, no scalable consumption of examiner capacity, identity-bound per-application friction, and no batch clearance. One reference implementation is discussed to show that these invariants are jointly satisfiable, while its practical difficulties are explicitly acknowledged. An illustrative Monte Carlo analysis across 1,000 parameter draws suggests that composite multi-metric flow control outperforms supervision reinforcement alone in 90.8% of trials.

AI.tldr: 针对AI输出速度超过人类认知上限导致的监管失效问题，提出“Flow-by-Flow”治理范式。该范式通过基于形式化特征的认知成本评分和制度容量上限控制监督负荷，而非评估内容本身，从而在90.8%的模拟试验中证明其优于单纯强化监督的方法。
AI.motivation: 现有研究表明，当AI输出速度（V）乘以单项目认知负荷（L）超过人类最大认知能力（C_max）时，人工闭环监管在高风险领域变得结构上不可行。传统观点认为提升AI能力可降低负荷，但实际上仅重塑了负荷结构（如判断环节可能转为省略而非真正减少），且基于内容正确性评估的治理机制要么面临幻觉风险，要么受限于V x L天花板。
AI.method: 提出“Flow-by-Flow”治理范式，核心在于不评估内容而控制监督负荷。具体包括：1) 基于正式、可计数特征构建认知成本评分，对高产量施加非线性成本；2) 设定机构容量上限，确保处理量在C_max以内。同时推导出四个绕过内容判断的设计不变量：无内容判断、无审查员容量的可扩展消耗、身份绑定的每应用摩擦、无批量放行。通过参考实现验证这些不变量的共同可行性，并进行蒙特卡洛分析。
AI.result: 研究推导并验证了四种设计不变量可同时满足。蒙特卡洛分析显示，在1,000次参数抽取中，复合多指标流控制在90.8%的试验中表现优于单独加强监督的方法。
AI.conclusion: 传统的基于内容正确性评估的治理机制存在固有缺陷，无法解决高速度AI输出下的监管瓶颈。Flow-by-Flow范式通过结构性控制监督负荷而非内容评判，提供了一种可行的替代方案，证明了在不依赖内容判断的情况下实现有效治理的可能性。

title: Metadata Reconstruction from Values Alone: Recovering Column Semantics in Undocumented Warehouses
summary:
Text-to-SQL benchmarks ship schemas whose column names already say what the columns mean. Production warehouses are the inverse: cryptic identifiers, partial or absent documentation. We address the problem they pose first: recovering what columns and values mean from the data itself.
  Rosetta places a language model inside a verification harness: a deterministic profiler extracts structural evidence (value fingerprints, a 26-pattern library, checksum verdicts), the model proposes semantics conditioned on that evidence, and every fact carries provenance and a confidence bounded by its evidence class.
  Against human documentation on 680 paired columns across eleven BIRD databases, identifiers destroyed, the harness delivers metadata that is 0.475 accurate on the 42% of columns it commits to, against 0.223 on 94% for the same model used directly. Restricted to the 283 columns where both arms speak, the harness writes no better prose than the model alone; the gain is selection: deterministic evidence governs whether the system speaks (coverage +0.257 [0.128, 0.378]), not how well. The deterministic layer is a competence detector, not a competence amplifier. A backbone swap bounds the claim: the prose finding reproduces, but prompt-requested abstention does not transfer; a code-enforced commit gate (predictions registered first; measured on a third backbone and held-out databases) makes no-evidence coverage 0.000 on every backbone. On a blind i2b2 clinical warehouse Rosetta decodes 95.5% of 134 real ICD-9 codes from values alone and abstains on all 44 NDC drug codes. The catalog supports calibrated abstention at query time: under full schema opacity a naive translator falls from 0.92 to 0.42 execution accuracy while our gate answers at 86% accuracy over 59% coverage. Negative results are reported plainly, including that our own authority ladder is not the mechanism behind the headline.

AI.tldr: Rosetta是一个用于从数据本身恢复数据库列和值语义的系统，特别针对生产环境中缺乏文档且标识符晦涩的仓库。它通过将语言模型置于确定性验证框架内，利用结构证据（如值指纹、模式库）来指导模型提出语义假设，并基于证据等级提供置信度。该方法的核心优势在于“选择性”而非“增强性”，即通过确定性层作为能力检测器，决定系统是否输出结果，从而在低覆盖率下实现高准确率，并在盲测临床仓库中表现出强大的解码能力和校准后的拒绝回答机制。
AI.motivation: 现有的Text-to-SQL基准测试通常包含具有描述性列名的架构，而实际的生产数据仓库则相反，其特征是标识符晦涩难懂、文档缺失或不完整。因此，亟需解决从数据本身恢复列和值含义的问题，以应对这种信息不对称带来的挑战。
AI.method: Rosetta系统将语言模型嵌入一个验证框架中：首先使用确定性分析器提取结构证据（包括值指纹、26种模式库和校验和结论）；然后，语言模型基于这些证据条件化地提出语义假设；最后，每个事实都附带溯源信息和由证据类别界定的置信度上限。该系统采用代码强制的承诺门控机制，确保预测先注册后测量，并支持在查询时进行校准后的拒绝回答（abstention）。
AI.result: 在11个BIRD数据库的680对列上进行的评估显示，Rosetta对其承诺输出的42%的列达到了0.475的准确率，远高于直接使用相同模型时的0.223（尽管后者覆盖了94%的列）。增益主要来源于选择机制：确定性证据控制了系统的发言权（覆盖率增加0.257），而非提高文本质量。在盲测i2b2临床仓库中，Rosetta仅凭数据值成功解码了134个真实ICD-9代码中的95.5%，并对所有44个NDC药物代码保持拒绝回答。在全架构不透明情况下，面对朴素翻译器准确率从0.92降至0.42的情况，Rosetta在59%的覆盖率下仍能保持86%的执行准确率。
AI.conclusion: Rosetta证明了确定性层作为“能力检测器”而非“能力放大器”的有效性。通过结合结构证据与语言模型，并结合严格的承诺门控机制，系统能够在缺乏文档的生产环境中实现高可靠性的语义恢复。其核心价值在于提供了经过校准的拒绝回答能力，从而在不确定性面前保证结果的准确性，为处理晦涩的生产数据仓库提供了一种鲁棒的解决方案。

title: Personalized Communication Skills for Agentic Recommender Systems
summary: Agentic recommender systems increasingly employ large language model-based UserAgents to evaluate candidate items through simulated feedback before recommendations are delivered. However, existing UserAgents typically reason in isolation based on limited personal histories, which may lead to perspective narrowing: the agent evaluates candidates from a local and incomplete view, overlooks relevant preference facets, and consequently produces inaccurate judgments. A natural way to alleviate this problem is to introduce other users as advisor agents, whose diverse histories provide complementary evidence that helps the target user reconsider overlooked preference signals. Nevertheless, a generic user-advisor communication process is insufficient, as different user decision states require different forms of external advice. Based on this insight, we propose AgentCom, a personalized communication skill framework for agentic recommender systems. AgentCom organizes reusable communication skills into a shared why--what--how--who skill bank: why identifies the decision deficiency that necessitates communication, what specifies the information task, how determines the advisor interaction protocol, and who retrieves advisors capable of executing that protocol. To make the shared skill bank personalized at use time and adaptive over time, AgentCom introduces two complementary mechanisms: personalized skill routing and failure-driven skill evolution. Personalized skill routing constructs a communication path by sequentially selecting suitable skills for each user and recommendation context. Failure-driven skill evolution learns from unsuccessful communication cases and enriches the shared bank with reusable skills that address previously uncovered communication needs. Experiments show that AgentCom consistently improves recommendation performance across traditional, social, and agentic recommenders.

AI.tldr: 提出AgentCom框架，通过引入“顾问代理”和个性化的通信技能库（why-what-how-who），解决现有基于大语言模型的用户代理在推荐中因视角局限导致的判断偏差问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的用户代理仅基于有限的个人历史进行孤立推理，导致视角狭窄、遗漏偏好信号并产生不准确判断；而通用的用户-顾问沟通方式无法适应不同决策状态的需求。
AI.method: 构建包含why（识别缺陷）、what（指定任务）、how（确定协议）、who（检索顾问）的技能库；引入个性化技能路由机制动态选择通信路径，以及失败驱动的技能演化机制从失败案例中学习并扩充技能库。
AI.result: 实验表明，AgentCom在传统推荐器、社交推荐器和代理推荐器中均能一致性地提升推荐性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过结构化的个性化通信技能和自适应演化机制，有效整合多元用户历史证据，显著改善了推荐系统的准确性与鲁棒性。

title: Performance of large language models in the optical diagnosis of colorectal polyps
summary: Background and Study Aims: Accurate optical diagnosis of colorectal polyps guides resection strategy and surveillance, with multimodal large language models (MLLMs) showing potential for image-based diagnosis. We aimed to evaluate the diagnostic accuracy of MLLMs in classifying colorectal polyps and predicting histology. Methods: We conducted a retrospective diagnostic performance study using the PRIME dataset, a curated set of white light and narrow-band imaging (NBI) images. We evaluated Claude Opus 4, Google Gemini 2.5 Pro, GPT-o3, GPT-4o, and GPT-5. For Paris, Narrow-band Imaging Colorectal Endoscopic (NICE), and predicted histology, we calculated F1 scores, percent correct scores, and accuracy of each MLLM compared to expert responses for 132 cases. Cochran's Q and McNemar's Test were used to determine differences between predicted values of each MLLM. Results: The F1 scores among MLLMs were >0.9 for all models for neoplastic vs. non-neoplastic polyps. Gemini 2.5 Pro demonstrated the highest F1 scores for invasive vs. non-invasive polyps and low- vs. high-grade adenoma, at 0.560 and 0.492 respectively. Claude Opus 4 and GPT-5 had statistically significantly higher percent correct scores than other MLLMs at 41.7%, using Paris classification. Conclusions: Claude Opus 4 and Gemini 2.5 Pro showed the highest accuracy in differentiating polyp subtypes, performing closest to expert consensus. Sensitivity and specificity, however, did not meet ESGE standards, highlighting the need for prospective multicenter trials and the design of human-in-the-loop workflows before clinical deployment.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了五种多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在结直肠息肉光学诊断中的准确性。结果显示，所有模型在区分肿瘤性与非肿瘤性息肉方面表现优异（F1>0.9），但Claude Opus 4和Gemini 2.5 Pro在亚型分类上最接近专家水平。然而，其敏感性和特异性未达到ESGE标准，表明尚需进一步的前瞻性研究及人机协作流程设计才能用于临床。
AI.motivation: 准确的结直肠息肉光学诊断可指导切除策略和监测计划。尽管多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在基于图像的诊断中显示出潜力，但其具体诊断性能尚需系统评估，以明确其在临床实践中的应用价值。
AI.method: 采用回顾性诊断性能研究设计，使用PRIME数据集（包含白光和窄带成像NBI图像）。评估了Claude Opus 4、Google Gemini 2.5 Pro、GPT-o3、GPT-4o和GPT-5五种MLLMs的性能。针对Paris分类、NICE分类及预测组织学，计算各模型的F1分数、正确百分比和准确率，并与132例病例的专家回答进行比较，使用Cochran's Q和McNemar检验分析差异。
AI.result:
1. 在所有模型中，区分肿瘤性与非肿瘤性息肉的F1分数均大于0.9。
2. Gemini 2.5 Pro在区分浸润性与非浸润性息肉（F1=0.560）以及低级别与高级别腺瘤（F1=0.492）方面表现最佳。
3. Claude Opus 4和GPT-5在使用Paris分类时的正确百分比显著高于其他模型，达到41.7%。
4. Claude Opus 4和Gemini 2.5 Pro在区分息肉亚型方面的总体准确性最高，最接近专家共识。
AI.conclusion: Claude Opus 4和Gemini 2.5 Pro在鉴别息肉亚型方面表现出最高的准确性，性能最接近专家共识。然而，由于敏感性和特异性未达到欧洲胃肠道内窥镜学会（ESGE）的标准，这些模型目前不能直接部署于临床。未来需要进行前瞻性多中心试验，并设计“人在回路”（human-in-the-loop）的工作流，以确保临床应用的安全性和有效性。

title: WuYuEval: A Multi-Level Benchmark for Large Language Models in Solid Waste Management
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as technical assistants, but their competence in solid waste management (SWM) remains difficult to assess because existing benchmarks emphasize general knowledge rather than professional decisions under engineering, environmental, and policy constraints. We introduce WuYuEval, a multi-level benchmark for evaluating LLMs in SWM across foundational knowledge, domain reasoning, and expert decision-making. After quality auditing, WuYuEval contains a Foundation Module with 4,590 closed-ended multiple-choice questions across six task types and eight domain categories, together with an Expert Module with 247 scenario-based open-ended questions involving multi-objective optimization, constraint trade-offs, and system design. For expert tasks, we combine anchor-calibrated LLM-as-a-Judge scoring with Elo-based pairwise comparison. Across 33 LLMs, performance varied widely. The leading model reached 94.64\% accuracy on the Foundation Module, but average accuracy still fell from 84.14\% on easy questions to 42.50\% on hard questions, with lower performance concentrated in calculation, experimental design, urban planning, and open-ended expert tasks. Reasoning-oriented Thinking modes improve most matched model pairs after auditing, but the gains depend on baseline capability and are not uniformly positive. These results suggest that visible deliberation helps only when it remains anchored to units, assumptions, and engineering constraints; otherwise, it may drift from decisive answer boundaries. WuYuEval therefore provides both an evaluation resource and an empirical basis for developing SWM-oriented foundation models with professional reasoning chains and explicit constraint control.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了WuYuEval，一个针对大型语言模型（LLMs）在固体废物管理（SWM）领域能力的多层次基准测试。该基准包含基础知识和专家决策两部分，评估了33个LLM的性能，发现尽管顶级模型基础知识准确率高，但在复杂推理和专家任务上表现显著下降，且“思维链”模式的效果依赖于基线能力。研究为开发具备专业推理能力的SWM专用模型提供了评估资源和实证依据。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试侧重于通用知识，难以评估LLMs在工程、环境和政策约束下的专业决策能力，特别是在固体废物管理（SWM）这一垂直领域的胜任力尚不明确。
AI.method: 构建WuYuEval多层面基准：1. 基础模块：4,590道涵盖6类任务和8个领域分类的封闭式选择题；2. 专家模块：247个涉及多目标优化、约束权衡和系统设计的场景化开放式问题。采用锚定校准的“LLM-as-a-Judge”评分结合基于Elo的成对比较进行评估。对33个LLM进行测试，并分析“思考模式”（Reasoning-oriented Thinking modes）的影响。
AI.result: 1. 性能差异大：领先模型在基础模块准确率达94.64%，但平均准确率从简单问题的84.14%降至难问题的42.50%。2. 薄弱环节集中在计算、实验设计、城市规划和开放式专家任务。3. “思考模式”仅在与基线能力匹配时有效，且收益不均；可见的深思熟虑若未锚定于单位、假设和工程约束，可能导致答案偏离。
AI.conclusion: WuYuEval不仅提供了评估资源，还揭示了LLMs在SWM领域的局限性。结果表明，开发SWM导向的基础模型需注重专业推理链和显式约束控制，且“思考模式”的有效性取决于其是否严格锚定于工程约束和假设。

title: Determinization in Structure Theories: A Unified Framework via Closure, Comparability, and Joint Admissibility
comment: Formal framework paper on canonicalization and determinization in structure theories; version v2.16.4; 29 pages
summary:
We develop a formal framework for constructing canonical interpretations from plural structure theories. A structure theory is a triple T = (Σ, A, I) consisting of a signature, axioms, and an inference policy, whose admissible interpretation family collects all globally consistent assignments of structural conclusions.
  We distinguish three levels of canonicalization: closure stabilization (per-seed convergence), global completion (seed-independent convergence), and determinization (a unique admissible interpretation). Non-determinism is classified into epistemic plurality (Type E) and structural plurality (Type S), with a refined Type S-strong subclass characterized by the absence of common upper bounds.
  Two canonicalization mechanisms arise: operator-based completion and selector-based construction. We provide sufficient structural conditions under which these mechanisms exist, and show that pure inference-based completion reduces to a saturated closure operator under positive, non-retractive rules with an additional soundness condition. For Type E theories, closure stabilization is established, while full determinization depends on a global confluence property that remains open. For Type S-strong theories, determinization is achieved via canonical selection.
  We further show that multi-level canonicalization forms a structurally non-commutative system via staged operators, and provide a conditional classification theorem reducing theory-intrinsic mechanisms to closure or selection. The framework also applies to LLM-assisted reasoning, where hallucination can be viewed as unsupported canonicalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种从复数结构理论构建规范解释的正式框架，区分了三种规范级（闭包稳定、全局完成、确定化）并将非确定性分为认知复数（Type E）和结构复数（Type S）。研究证明了两种规范机制的存在条件，表明纯推理完成可简化为饱和闭包算子，并指出该框架可应用于大语言模型辅助推理，将幻觉视为不受支持的规范过程。
AI.motivation: 旨在建立一套形式化框架，用于从具有签名、公理和推理政策的结构理论中系统地构建规范解释，以解决结构结论赋值中的非确定性问题，并为多逻辑系统提供统一的规范化理论基础。
AI.method: 构建了由签名、公理和推理政策组成的结构理论三元组；通过区分闭包稳定、全局完成和确定化三个层级来分类非确定性（Type E 和 Type S）；分析了基于算子的完成和基于选择器的构造两种规范机制；利用正规则和非回溯规则推导充分结构条件；并通过分层算子展示多级规范化的非交换性。
AI.result: 1. 证明了在特定条件下（如正规则、非回溯及额外可靠性条件），纯推理完成的归约；2. 确立了 Type E 理论的闭包稳定性，但完全确定化仍依赖于未解决的全局合流性质；3. 实现了 Type S-strong 理论通过规范选择达到确定化；4. 建立了理论内在机制向闭包或选择的条件分类定理；5. 验证了框架在大语言模型推理中的应用潜力。
AI.conclusion: 该框架成功提供了从结构理论到规范解释的系统化路径，明确了不同类别非确定性的处理机制及其收敛条件，不仅丰富了逻辑结构的理论基础，也为理解大语言模型中的推理与幻觉现象提供了新的形式化视角。

title: Scout: Scalable Document Extraction via Data Similarity
summary:
Extracting values from large document collections powers data analysis across many domains. Frontier LLMs extract such values accurately, but processing an
  entire collection with one is prohibitively costly. Yet this cost is largely avoidable: real-world collections exhibit rich similarity, so for the same query
  over similar documents, the answer tends to recur in similar locations; an LLM need only read that small span, not the whole document. Prior methods that
  exploit this similarity fall short: they either assume a rigid document structure, or assume the answer is a set of substrings of the input and use an
  LLM-generated program to return it directly. Even a frontier agent fails to generate effective programs to directly locate the answer's span, as the search
  space is large and programs learned from a small sample tend to overfit. We present Scout, a tool that generates accurate and cost-effective programs (that
  we call rules) to extract data at scale. From a few sampled documents, Scout generates a broad rule set and refines it by selecting a pareto-optimal subset
  with low cost without sacrificing accuracy. We prove rule refinement is NP-hard and give a greedy solution with a provable approximation guarantee. Scout
  handles collections that are only partly similar, where similarity holds within clusters of documents. In this setting, a sampling strategy, using no LLM,
  draws samples from each cluster; and a cascade strategy selects a subset of refined rules, falling back to the unrefined rule set when the selected rules
  don't contain the answer. Experiments on six real-world datasets show that Scout matches the accuracy of the strongest baseline, a frontier LLM agent that
  reads each full document, while being 61x to over 1000x cheaper on a collection of 1,000 documents, and is 61% more accurate than the strongest prior
  program-based approach.

AI.tldr: Scout是一种通过生成和精炼“规则”程序来高效、低成本地从大规模文档集合中提取数据的工具，在保持与前沿LLM相当精度的同时，成本降低61倍至1000倍以上。
AI.motivation: 虽然前沿大语言模型（LLMs）能准确提取数据，但处理整个文档集合的成本过高。现有方法受限于刚性文档结构假设或无法有效定位答案片段，导致效率低下或泛化能力差。
AI.method: 提出Scout工具，从少量采样文档中生成广泛的规则集，并通过选择帕累托最优子集进行精炼以平衡成本与准确性。针对部分相似的文档集合，采用无LLM的聚类采样策略和级联回退策略。证明了规则精炼问题的NP难性质并提供了具有可证明近似保证的贪心算法。
AI.result: 在六个真实世界数据集上的实验表明，Scout的准确率与读取完整文档的前沿LLM智能体相当，比最强基线便宜61倍到1000倍以上，且比最强的基于程序的方法准确率高61%。
AI.conclusion: Scout通过利用文档间的相似性并优化规则生成与选择过程，实现了大规模数据提取的高准确性和高经济性，解决了现有方法在成本和泛化性上的不足。

title: Structure-Preserving Projection for Mitigating Modality Bias in LLM-Based Sequential Recommendation
summary: Recent LLM-based recommenders integrate textual and collaborative signals by projecting collaborative embeddings into the embedding space of the LLM. However, this projection can introduce modality bias that distorts the underlying collaborative structure and limits the usefulness of projected embeddings. To address this issue, we propose a novel structure-preserving projection approach that maintains the relational geometry of collaborative embeddings through dedicated structure-preserving losses. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that our approach consistently improves recommendation performance, providing a more reliable path for LLM-based recommendation.

AI.tldr: 提出一种结构保持投影方法，解决LLM推荐器中协同嵌入投影引入的模态偏差问题，通过专用损失函数维持协同结构的几何关系，显著提升推荐性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于大语言模型（LLM）的推荐系统通过将协同嵌入投影到LLM的嵌入空间来融合文本和协同信号，但此过程会引入模态偏差，扭曲底层协同结构并限制投影嵌入的有效性。
AI.method: 提出一种新颖的结构保持投影方法，利用专用的结构保持损失函数（structure-preserving losses），在将协同嵌入投影到LLM嵌入空间时，维持其原有的关系几何结构。
AI.result: 综合实验表明，该方法一致性地提高了推荐性能，为基于LLM的推荐提供了一种更可靠的路径。
AI.conclusion: 通过保持协同嵌入的结构完整性，可以有效缓解模态偏差，从而优化LLM在推荐任务中的表现。

title: Learning an Interior Layout Policy in a Domain Specific Language Action Space
summary: Indoor scene layout generation is a challenging task in interior design. Existing methods often oversimplify the task by reducing room conditions to coarse 3D bounding boxes and neglecting structural elements such as doors and windows. More fundamentally, many prior approaches formulate spatial reasoning as direct coordinate prediction, thereby casting interior layout design as continuous regression over raw geometric parameters, which hinders the model from learning the underlying reasoning logic of intelligent layout design. We propose \textbf{LayoutDSL}, a novel LLM-based framework for learning an interior layout policy in a domain-specific language (DSL) action space. The DSL provides an explicit symbolic representation of layout information and serves as a structured action space for layout reasoning, where each action corresponds to an interpretable design decision. Under this DSL-based policy learning paradigm, we construct 3D-FrontDSL, a dataset of room-structure annotations paired with synthetic DSL action sequences for supervised fine-tuning. To promote a more generalizable and scalable policy with verifiable feedback, we design rewards grounded in interior design principles and physical plausibility, and optimize the policy via reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LayoutDSL substantially improves spatial plausibility and design logicality over strong baselines and existing methods.

AI.tldr: 提出LayoutDSL，一种基于大语言模型的室内布局生成框架，通过领域特定语言（DSL）将空间推理转化为结构化决策，结合3D-FrontDSL数据集和强化学习，显著提升了布局的合理性与逻辑性。
AI.motivation: 现有室内场景布局生成方法过于简化，仅使用粗略的3D边界框并忽略门窗等结构元素；且多数方法将空间推理直接建模为原始几何参数的连续回归，阻碍了模型学习智能布局设计的底层推理逻辑。
AI.method: 1. 构建基于LLM的LayoutDSL框架，在领域特定语言（DSL）动作空间中学习室内布局策略，每个动作对应可解释的设计决策；2. 构建3D-FrontDSL数据集，包含房间结构标注与合成DSL动作序列，用于监督微调；3. 设计基于室内设计原则和物理合理性的奖励函数，并通过强化学习优化策略以提升泛化性和可扩展性。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，LayoutDSL在空间合理性（spatial plausibility）和设计逻辑性（design logicality）方面显著优于强基线和现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 将空间推理从连续坐标预测转变为结构化符号表示的动作空间，能有效提升室内布局生成的质量与可解释性，验证了基于LLM和强化学习的策略学习范式的有效性。

title: Search-G1: Grounded Search Agents via Representation-Based Intrinsic Rewards
summary: Search-augmented language agents should retrieve external information only when necessary and ground their answers in retrieved evidence. Existing external rewards provide either sparse outcome supervision or richer feedback from process annotations and LLM judges. Outcome rewards scale readily but cannot distinguish grounded retrieval from redundant search, whereas richer signals require costly annotation or inference during training. Internal rewards based on policy-side signals such as entropy, likelihood, or information gain are graded and inexpensive to evaluate, yet mainly reflect model confidence rather than evidence grounding. We propose Search-G1, a representation-based intrinsic reward framework that measures the operational grounding of an agent's answers through two intervention-calibrated readouts. A prompt-state readout predicts closed-book sufficiency, whose complement defines policy-relative retrieval necessity; an answer-commit readout estimates evidence reliance from answer-stage sensitivity to evidence deletion. Together, they provide additional credit to correct searched trajectories when retrieval is estimated necessary and the answer is evidence-sensitive, favor correct direct answers when closed-book knowledge suffices, and penalize repeated search. After calibration, reward scoring requires neither process annotations nor LLM-as-judge inference during policy optimization. Because reinforcement learning changes policy representations, Search-G1 periodically refits both readouts on trajectories from the latest checkpoint, allowing the reward to co-evolve with the policy. Experiments across multiple search-based question-answering benchmarks and two model scales show that Search-G1 improves the grounding--search-cost trade-off, producing shorter response-side trajectories at competitive task accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/Rosy0912/Search-G1.

AI.tldr: 提出Search-G1，一种基于表示的内在奖励框架，通过干预校准读取来衡量智能体回答的操作性基础（grounding），从而优化检索与答案准确性的权衡，无需外部标注或LLM裁判。
AI.motivation: 现有外部奖励存在局限：结果奖励无法区分必要检索与冗余搜索，而过程反馈成本高昂；内部奖励主要反映模型置信度而非证据基础。旨在解决如何在无需昂贵标注的情况下，有效引导智能体仅在必要时检索并基于证据回答的问题。
AI.method: 提出Search-G1框架，包含两个干预校准读取器：1) Prompt-state readout预测闭卷充分性，定义相对检索必要性；2) Answer-commit readout估计对证据的依赖性（通过删除证据后的敏感度）。定期在最新检查点的轨迹上重新拟合读取器，使奖励随策略共进化。
AI.result: 在多个基于搜索的问答基准和两种模型规模上实验表明，Search-G1改善了“ grounding-搜索成本”的权衡，在保持竞争性任务准确率的同时，生成了更短的响应侧轨迹（即减少了不必要的检索）。
AI.conclusion: Search-G1通过内在奖励机制，有效平衡了检索成本与回答的可信度，实现了无需外部监督的高效策略优化。

title: Emotion in an active inference model of human driving
summary: Active inference has emerged as a principled framework for modeling adaptive behavior by balancing goal-directed action with uncertainty reduction. It has been successfully applied across biological and artificial systems, including recent work on human driving. However, existing active inference models of driving have yet to address an important determinant of behavior in traffic: affective state, which significantly influences decision-making. Prior work in non-traffic domains has explored active inference agents in which emotions are represented along the axes of valence and arousal in the circumplex model. However, this work has been limited to simplified settings with discrete state spaces. In this work, we propose an expanded formulation of valence and arousal that can be extracted from a more complex active inference model of driving with continuous states. In particular, we condition affective estimates not only on the current state but also on predicted future outcomes. We evaluate the proposed approach in two interactive driving scenarios and show that the resulting emotion signals correspond to affective patterns reported in similar scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种结合效价和唤醒度的主动推理驾驶模型，将情感状态从离散简化场景扩展至连续状态的复杂交通环境，并通过预测未来结果来估算情感信号。
AI.motivation: 现有的主动推理驾驶模型忽略了情感状态这一影响交通决策的重要因素；此前在非交通领域的工作仅局限于具有离散状态空间的简化设置，缺乏对复杂连续状态下的建模。
AI.method: 提出了效价和唤醒度的扩展公式，将其嵌入到具有连续状态的复杂主动推理驾驶模型中；情感估计不仅基于当前状态，还条件化于预测的未来结果。
AI.result: 在两个交互式驾驶场景中评估了该方法，结果显示生成的情感信号与类似场景中报告的情感模式相符。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功将情感因素整合进连续状态的主动推理驾驶框架，为理解情感如何影响交通决策提供了新的计算视角。

title: InSituANN: Revisiting IVF for PCIe-Efficient Billion-Scale Vector Search
summary:
Approximate nearest neighbor search (ANNS) over billion-scale vector datasets has become a foundational operator for modern retrieval systems, powering large-scale recommendation, semantic search, and LLM/RAG workloads. Although GPUs offer massive parallelism and high-bandwidth memory for batched vector search, their limited VRAM capacity makes fully GPU-resident billion-scale indexes difficult to deploy. In CPU-GPU heterogeneous designs, keeping the base vectors in host memory avoids this capacity limit, but naively offloading fine search to the GPU introduces a new bottleneck: large volumes of base-vector data must be streamed over PCIe.
  We present InSituANN, an IVF-based ANNS engine that enables billion-scale vector search on a single commodity GPU. InSituANN keeps original base vectors in host memory, performs fine search in situ, and uses the GPU for compact routing and optional pruning. As a result, query processing avoids PCIe transfers of high-dimensional base vectors while retaining the simplicity of IVF. Beyond query performance, we further design an ultra-fast IVF construction path for InSituANN. On SIFT-1B, InSituANN builds the IVF index in 5.2 minutes, about 350x faster than the measured 30.4-hour HNSW build. At matched recall on billion-scale datasets, InSituANN improves end-to-end throughput by 104.9x-4298.2x over the PCIe-bound Rummy baseline and by 2.4x-4.6x over DiskANN on SIFT-1B and DEEP-1B. Together with strong recall-throughput trade-offs and lower index space than graph-based alternatives, these gains make billion-scale retrieval practical on cost-efficient hardware.
  We open-source InSituANN at https://github.com/mindtravel/InSituANN-OpenSource.

AI.tldr: InSituANN是一个基于IVF的近似最近邻搜索（ANNS）引擎，通过在主机内存中保留基础向量并在GPU上进行原位细粒度搜索，解决了十亿级向量数据集在单块消费级GPU上部署时的显存限制和PCIe传输瓶颈问题。该方法显著提升了索引构建速度和端到端吞吐量，同时保持了高召回率和较低的索引空间占用。
AI.motivation: 尽管GPU具备强大的并行能力和高带宽内存，但其有限的VRAM容量使得完全驻留GPU的十亿级索引难以部署。在CPU-GPU异构设计中，将基础向量保留在主机内存中可以避免显存限制，但直接将细粒度搜索卸载到GPU会导致大量基础向量数据通过PCIe总线传输，从而引入新的性能瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出InSituANN引擎，采用以下策略：1) 将原始基础向量保留在主机内存中；2) 在GPU上进行原位（in situ）细粒度搜索，避免高频度量的数据传输；3) 利用GPU进行紧凑的路由计算和可选的剪枝操作；4) 设计超快速的IVF索引构建路径。
AI.result: 在SIFT-1B数据集上：1) IVF索引构建时间仅为5.2分钟，比HNSW快约350倍；2) 在匹配召回率的情况下，端到端吞吐量比受PCIe限制的Rummy基线提高104.9x-4298.2倍；3) 比DiskANN在SIFT-1B和DEEP-1B上的吞吐量提高2.4x-4.6倍；4) 相比基于图的方法，具有更低的索引空间占用和良好的召回率-吞吐量权衡。
AI.conclusion: InSituANN通过优化CPU-GPU协作模式，消除了大规模向量检索中的PCIe传输瓶颈，使得在成本效益高的硬件上实现十亿级规模的实用化检索成为可能。该项目已开源。

title: BOUND: Brief-Guided Corrective Preference Distillation at Search-Control Boundaries
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based deep search agents solve tasks through iterative retrieval and reasoning, but locally relevant evidence can cause persistent wrong-anchor drift, constraint drift, or local-topic drift. Existing methods supervise trajectories, outcomes, or steps, but rarely distinguish task-aligned continuations from locally plausible ones that reinforce drift. We propose BOUND, a brief-guided corrective preference distillation framework for persistent search drift. For each student-induced decision-time state, BOUND constructs a teacher-side search-state brief that preserves the original search target and key constraints while summarizing confirmed evidence, missing information, and drift status. Guided by the brief, the teacher determines whether the student's continuation contains a correctable local search-control error likely to affect subsequent decisions. Together with the rollout outcome, this assessment determines whether to construct a corrective contrast between a student-specific correction and the original continuation, or a termination contrast between a supported answer and an unnecessary retrieval continuation. Each validated state-matched preference pair operationalizes a search-control boundary. Direct preference optimization (DPO) distills these preferences into the student, while the brief and teacher-side computation remain confined to training. We evaluate BOUND on four multi-hop QA benchmarks and three deep-search benchmarks. Across the six benchmarks for which we reran baselines, BOUND leads on five datasets and 12 of 14 metrics. Under the same search-control interface and matched settings, BOUND outperforms Trajectory SFT by 5.6 EM points on Bamboogle and 4.8 accuracy points on BrowseComp-Plus. Code is available at https://github.com/RUCAIBox/BOUND.

AI.tldr: 提出BOUND框架，通过教师生成的搜索状态摘要（Brief）引导纠正大语言模型在深度搜索中的持续漂移错误，利用直接偏好优化（DPO）蒸馏校正后的决策边界，显著提升多跳问答和深度搜索任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的深度搜索代理在处理迭代检索和推理时，容易因局部相关证据产生持续的错误锚定漂移、约束漂移或局部主题漂移。现有方法通常监督轨迹、结果或步骤，但难以区分与任务对齐的延续和可能强化漂移的局部合理延续。
AI.method: 提出BOUND（Brief-guided corrective preference distillation），一种简要引导的校正偏好蒸馏框架。对于学生产生的每个决策时刻状态，构建保留原始目标和关键约束的教师端搜索状态摘要，总结已确认证据、缺失信息和漂移状态。教师据此判断学生延续是否包含可校正的局部搜索控制错误，并结合 rollout 结果构建校正对比或终止对比。通过直接偏好优化（DPO）将这些偏好蒸馏至学生模型，而摘要和教师计算仅用于训练阶段。
AI.result: 在四个多跳QA基准和三个深度搜索基准上评估。在重跑基线的六个基准中，BOUND在五个数据集和14项指标中的12项领先。在相同搜索控制接口和匹配设置下，BOUND在Bamboogle上比Trajectory SFT高出5.6 EM分，在BrowseComp-Plus上高出4.8准确率分。
AI.conclusion: BOUND框架有效解决了深度搜索中的持续漂移问题，通过引入教师端的简要引导和校正偏好蒸馏，显著提升了模型在复杂搜索任务中的准确性和鲁棒性，证明了该方法在区分任务对齐与局部合理延续方面的优势。

title: P2Voxel: Pyramid Pivot Voxelization for 3D Mesh Tokenization
summary: Triangle meshes provide explicit and accurate surface geometry, yet their irregular topology connectivity makes 3D mesh tokenization a geometric sampling problem: how to sample and organize geometric evidence into compact, structured and learnable tokens. Beyond field-centric volumetric sampling and edge-intersection surface sampling, we retarget mesh tokenization as \textit{local surface evidence sampling}: identifying the minimal geometric evidence inside each active voxel that is sufficient for deterministic surface recovery. To this end, we introduce \textbf{P2Voxel}, a pyramid pivot voxelization framework for compact and reconstruction-aware mesh tokenization. P2Voxel is built on three key innovations. Under the \textit{Local Planarity} assumption, Pivot Voxelization represents each active voxel with a surface pivot and an orientation sign, providing minimal local evidence that can induce the corner values required for deterministic reconstruction. Under the \textit{Spatial Complexity} assumption, Pyramid Pivot Voxelization exploits the spatial non-uniformity of real surfaces by allocating finer pivot tokens to geometrically complex regions while keeping smooth regions coarse and compact. Under the \textit{Block Reconstructability} assumption, a Pyramid VAE learns compact multi-resolution latent codes over locally reconstructable pivot blocks, avoiding the need to model the entire high-resolution voxelized shape as a dense global field. Together, these designs convert meshes into compact, structured, and learnable pyramid pivot tokens, enabling efficient mesh reconstruction for downstream 3D tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出P2Voxel框架，通过局部表面证据采样和金字塔结构，将不规则三角网格转化为紧凑、可学习的多分辨率隐式令牌，实现高效3D网格重建。
AI.motivation: 解决三角网格因拓扑不规则导致的3D网格标记化难题，克服传统体素或边缘采样方法的局限，旨在获取紧凑、结构化且易于学习的几何特征表示。
AI.method: 构建P2Voxel金字塔枢轴体素化框架，基于三个核心假设：1）局部平面性（用枢轴点和方向符号表示活跃体素的最小几何证据）；2）空间复杂性（根据几何复杂度动态分配细粒度或粗粒度枢轴令牌）；3）块可重建性（使用Pyramid VAE学习局部可重建块的紧凑多分辨率潜在代码）。
AI.result: 成功将网格转换为紧凑、结构化且可学习的金字塔枢轴令牌，实现了高效的网格重建，为下游3D任务提供了新的数据表示方式。
AI.conclusion: P2Voxel通过局部证据采样和金字塔架构，有效解决了网格标记化的效率与准确性问题，证明了在保留几何细节的同时降低计算复杂度的可行性。

title: Scaling Inherently Interpretable Language Models
summary:
Interpretability is often treated as a tax on capability: language models are trained as opaque systems, then explained after the fact, with methods whose reliability is difficult to establish. In this work, we challenge this premise. Rather than reverse-engineering a model, we make interpretability a constraint of the training pipeline, optimized alongside the language modeling objective. Across three orders of magnitude of compute, on both autoregressive and diffusion language models, interpretability scales with capability rather than against it. Surprisingly, model representations become more disentangled and aligned with human-understandable concepts with scale.
  We instantiate the training-time recipe with Steerling-8B, a diffusion language model with a causal attention mask. For any group of generated tokens, Steerling-8B attributes the output to relevant input tokens, human-understandable concepts, and training data. This enables closed-loop intervention: diagnose an output through its concept or feature attribution, retrieve similar training data, and correct the behavior through concept steering without retraining. Steerling-8B remains competitive with open peer models trained on substantially 2-16x more compute, suggesting a different scaling paradigm: interpretability can be designed into training, and it improves with scale.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战“可解释性是能力的代价”这一观点，提出将可解释性作为训练约束而非事后解释。通过Steerling-8B模型证明，随着算力增加，模型的可解释性与能力同步提升，且无需重新训练即可实现基于概念干预的输出修正。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型通常被视为黑盒系统，仅在训练后进行不可靠的事后解释，导致可解释性被视为对模型能力的牺牲或负担。
AI.method: 将可解释性作为训练流程中的约束条件，与语言建模目标共同优化。构建了扩散语言模型Steerling-8B，具备因果注意力掩码，能够针对生成令牌进行输入令牌、人类可理解概念及训练数据的归因分析，支持闭环干预（诊断、检索数据、概念引导纠正）。
AI.result: 在三个数量级的算力范围内，无论自回归还是扩散模型，可解释性均随能力提升而增强，模型表示更加解耦且对齐人类概念。Steerling-8B在显著更少的算力下（相比同行模型少2-16倍）保持竞争力，证明了可解释性设计入训练并随规模扩展的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 可解释性不应是事后的补救措施，而应融入训练过程；随着模型规模扩大，可解释性与性能呈正相关，这为不同的模型缩放范式提供了新方向。

title: Training Variable Long Sequences with Data-Centric Parallel
summary: Training deep learning models on variable long sequences poses significant computational challenges. Existing methods force a difficult trade-off between efficiency and ease-of-use. Simple approaches use static configurations that cause workload imbalance low efficiency, while complex methods introduces significant complexity and code change for new models. To break this trade-off, we introduce Data-Centric Parallel (DCP). Its core principle is to let the data itself drive the runtime. It achieves this by dynamically adjusting direct runtime settings (e.g., parallel size, gradient accumulation, recomputation) based on each batch's sequence length. Empirical results demonstrate that our method achieves up to a 2.88$\times$ speedup on 32 H200 GPUs. Designed for generalization, it can be integrated into any model with 10 lines of code. We anticipate this simple yet effective approach will serve as a robust baseline and facilitate future advancements in distributed training for variable long sequences.

AI.tldr: 提出数据驱动并行（DCP）方法，通过根据批次序列长度动态调整运行时设置（如并行规模、梯度累积等），解决变长序列训练中的效率与易用性权衡问题，实现最高2.88倍加速且仅需10行代码集成。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习方法在训练变长序列时面临计算挑战：静态配置导致负载不均衡和低效，而复杂方法引入高代码修改成本，难以兼顾效率与易用性。
AI.method: 提出数据中心并行（Data-Centric Parallel, DCP），核心原理是让数据驱动运行时。该方法根据每个批次的序列长度，动态调整直接运行时设置（包括并行大小、梯度累积、重计算等）。
AI.result: 在32块H200 GPU上实验表明，该方法可实现高达2.88倍的加速效果；同时具备高通用性，仅需10行代码即可集成到任意模型中。
AI.conclusion: DCP是一种简单有效的分布式训练基线方案，能够促进变长序列训练领域的未来发展。

title: SiriusDeliver: Automating Data Warehouse Delivery at Tencent
summary: Enterprise data warehouses (DWs) support business-critical analytics, but warehouse task delivery remains a complicated production process involving context retrieval, workflow configuration, code generation, platform submission, and failure diagnosis. Although large language models (LLMs) and coding agents have improved software development, they are insufficient for production DW delivery, which requires dependency-aware orchestration, lifecycle-aware artifact control, and continuous adaptation to evolving platform practices. We present SiriusDeliver, an end-to-end delivery automation agent for production warehouse task submission. SiriusDeliver integrates three components: a hierarchical delivery agent that orchestrates warehouse skills, an artifact lifecycle control module that verifies and revises artifacts before and after platform execution, and a trace-driven skill evolution mechanism that maintains reusable skills from delivery trajectories. We evaluate SiriusDeliver through offline datasets and large-scale production deployment on Tencent Cloud WeData. Offline experiments on real-world warehouse delivery cases show that SiriusDeliver improves delivery success and automation efficiency over representative baselines. During a two-month deployment across 6 business teams and 4 warehouse task types, SiriusDeliver served 3,600 monthly active users and supported 18,240 delivery sessions, achieving an 87.2% end-to-end success rate and a 73.5% autonomous submission rate. A one-month A/B test shows that SiriusDeliver reduces median delivery time from 228 to 23 minutes and engineer effort from 95 to 11 minutes, while maintaining comparable final delivery success.

AI.tldr: SiriusDeliver是一个面向生产环境的数据仓库任务交付自动化智能体，通过分层编排、工件生命周期控制和技能演化机制，显著提升了数据仓库任务的交付成功率和效率。
AI.motivation: 企业数据仓库的任务交付流程复杂，涉及上下文检索、工作流配置、代码生成等多个环节。现有的大语言模型和编码智能体缺乏对依赖关系的感知、工件生命周期的控制以及对平台实践演进的适应能力，难以满足生产级数据仓库交付的需求。
AI.method: 提出SiriusDeliver，一个端到端的交付自动化智能体，包含三个核心组件：1）分层交付智能体，用于编排数据仓库技能；2）工件生命周期控制模块，在平台执行前后验证和修订工件；3）基于轨迹的技能演化机制，从交付记录中维护可复用的技能。
AI.result: 离线实验显示SiriusDeliver在交付成功率和自动化效率上优于基线方法。在生产部署中（腾讯云天启WeData），服务了3600名月活用户，支持18,240次交付会话，实现87.2%的端到端成功率和73.5%的自主提交率。A/B测试表明，中位交付时间从228分钟降至23分钟，工程师投入从95分钟降至11分钟，且保持相当的成功率。
AI.conclusion: SiriusDeliver通过整合分层编排、工件控制和技能演化，有效解决了生产级数据仓库交付的复杂性，显著提升了自动化水平和工程效率，为大规模企业数据仓库任务交付提供了可行的自动化解决方案。

title: A Symmetric Layer-Union Audit of Component Collapse in Hierarchical Procedural Corpora
summary: Component-disjoint leakage control can group corpus units by content similarity, hierarchical membership, or both. Guvenilir and Dogan previously showed that merging relation types can create a giant component that obstructs splitting; we do not claim this phenomenon as new. We examine it through a symmetric audit of a content-near-duplicate layer, a common-container layer, and their union in a fixed panel of six hierarchical procedural corpora. MyFixit and Doc2Dial exhibit the individual-layer-pass/union-fail pattern under the same operational criteria. The resulting two-of-six fraction describes this deliberately constructed panel and is not a prevalence estimate. A prespecified bridge-specific predictor is associated with the pattern, but it is not distinguished from a registered union-density control; the panel therefore does not identify a bridge-specific mechanism. Secondary diagnostics bound the interpretation of threshold sensitivity, annotation coverage, and lexical cues without extending those findings beyond their recorded sources and definitions. The paper's contribution is a bounded measurement and audit: it keeps relation families visible, evaluates their individual and union component structures symmetrically, and reports negative cases and mechanism limits. It proposes neither a new splitting algorithm nor a general causal claim about relation unions.

AI.tldr: 本文对组件不相交泄漏控制中的“合并关系类型导致巨型组件”现象进行了对称审计。通过对六个层级程序语料库的特定层及其并集进行分析，发现MyFixit和Doc2Dial在相同操作标准下呈现“单层通过但并集失败”的模式。研究贡献在于提供有界的测量与审计，明确机制局限，而非提出新算法或因果主张。
AI.motivation: 尽管Guvenilir和Dogan此前已指出合并关系类型可能形成阻碍分裂的巨型组件，但本研究旨在通过系统性的对称审计，进一步评估这一现象在固定语料库面板中的表现、边界条件及潜在预测因素，以厘清其机制局限性。
AI.method: 研究采用对称审计方法，针对六个层级程序语料库的面板，分别检查内容近重复层、通用容器层以及两者的并集。使用统一的操作标准评估各层的组件结构，并分析桥接特异性预测因子与注册并集密度控制变量之间的关系，同时通过次要诊断限制阈值敏感性、注释覆盖率和词汇线索的解释范围。
AI.result: 发现MyFixit和Doc2Dial两个案例表现出“个体层通过/并集失败”的模式，该模式在六分之二的面板中出现（仅为描述性比例，非流行率估计）。虽然存在特定的桥接预测因子，但无法将其与并集密度控制区分开来，因此未能识别出桥接特异性机制。研究明确了阈值敏感性和数据定义的边界。
AI.conclusion: 本文的主要贡献是有界的测量与审计，它保持了关系家族的可见性，对称地评估了它们各自及并集的组件结构，并报告了阴性案例和机制极限。研究并未提出新的分裂算法，也未对关系并集做出一般性的因果声明。

title: Auditing Medical Vision-Language Models on Chest Radiographs: Estimating Reference Agreement Across Institutions
summary: Vision-language models return structured chest-radiograph findings through interfaces exposing no confidence score, so a receiving institution cannot read off how far to trust an individual judgment. Whether agreement with an institution's reference standard transfers across sites, findings, prediction directions and question formats is largely unmeasured. We evaluated three generative vision-language models on three institutional chest-radiograph corpora and six findings under two elicitation protocols, comprising more than 345,000 finding-level predictions, and estimated finding-by-direction reference agreement at a receiving institution from a small budget of local labels. Estimation strategies were then stress-tested under repeated strict institution-held-out evaluation. Under evaluation excluding the receiving institution from development entirely, adaptive selection among the seven estimators that design admits did not improve on simple fixed alternatives: it achieved a mean Brier score of 0.1083, against 0.0853 for always using a Beta-Binomial empirical-Bayes estimator and 0.0855 for a target-only logistic model. Those two differ by 0.0003, less than this family's own sensitivity to a change of solver version, and each leads in about half the settings, so no default can be recommended. Their advantage over estimators pooling across institutions was concentrated at one site and not confirmatory once clustered by institution, and a plug-in empirical-Bayes posterior-predictive count interval at a nominal 95% level covered 87.0%, less at the hardest institution. Reference agreement therefore has to be re-evaluated per site and per interface; these results concern agreement with institutional labels, not clinical correctness.

AI.tldr: 研究评估了生成式视觉-语言模型在胸部X光片上的表现，发现由于缺乏置信度分数，接收机构难以信任其判断。通过对比多种估算策略，发现固定贝叶斯估计器和目标逻辑回归模型表现最佳且差异极小，无法推荐默认方案。结论强调参考一致性需按机构和接口重新评估，且该结果仅针对标签一致性而非临床正确性。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉-语言模型返回结构化胸部X光片发现结果，但接口不暴露置信度分数，导致接收机构无法判断对单个判断的信任程度。此外，与机构参考标准的一致性是否在不同站点、发现类型、预测方向和提问格式间转移，这一领域 largely 未被测量。
AI.method: 研究在三个机构的胸部X光片语料库上评估了三种生成式视觉-语言模型，涵盖六种发现类型和两种提取协议，产生超过345,000个发现级预测。研究从少量本地标签中估算发现方向的参考一致性，并在严格的机构保留评估下对估算策略进行压力测试。比较了七种估算器，包括自适应选择策略与简单固定替代方案（如Beta-Binomial经验贝叶斯估计器和目标逻辑模型）。
AI.result: 在完全排除接收机构参与开发的评估中，自适应选择七种估算器中的最优者并未优于简单的固定替代方案。自适应方法的平均Brier得分为0.1083，而始终使用Beta-Binomial经验贝叶斯估计器的得分为0.0853，目标逻辑模型的得分为0.0855。后两者差异仅为0.0003，小于求解器版本变化的敏感性，且各自在约一半的设置中领先，因此无法推荐默认方案。跨机构池化估算器的优势集中在单一站点，且在按机构聚类后未得到确认。名义95%的 plug-in 经验贝叶斯后验预测区间实际覆盖率仅为87.0%，在最难处理的机构中更低。
AI.conclusion: 参考一致性必须按每个站点和每个接口重新评估。这些结果涉及的是与机构标签的一致性，而非临床正确性。由于不同估算器性能相近且无明确优胜者，接收机构应谨慎对待模型的输出信任度，并独立验证其在特定环境下的表现。

title: Embedding Initialization for Unseen Low-resource Languages in Multilingual NMT: A Case Study on Limbum-English Translation
summary: Multilingual neural machine translation models such as NLLB-200 cover 200 languages but leave thousands unsupported, including most Grassfields Bantu languages of Cameroon. When fine-tuning these models for an unseen language, practitioners must choose a proxy language token, yet no principled method exists for this selection. We implemented an embedding initialization strategy where a language token is the average of embeddings from multiple typologically related languages already in the mod el. We evaluate this approach on Limbum-to-English translation using a parallel corpus of 8,837 sentence pairs from New Testament text and a bilingual dictionary. We compare models: NLLB-200 zero-shot (chrF2++ = 12.5), a Transformer trained from scratch (chrF2++ = 14.5), NLLB-200 fine-tuned with a Swahili proxy token (chrF2++ = 47.3), and NLLB-200 with our averaged embedding initialization (chrF2++ = 46.7). We find that the multi-language initialization achieves performance comparable to the best single-language proxy. Both NLLB-200 variants improve over the from-scratch baseline by over 32 chrF2++ points. These results show that multilingual transfer is the dominant factor in extremely low-resource Bantu translation while eliminating the need for heuristic proxy selection. However, all systems fail to preserve tonal diacritics, highlighting an open challenge. We make our dataset and code available to support further research.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于多语言类型学相关性的嵌入初始化策略，用于解决NLLB-200模型在未见过的低资源语言（如喀麦隆Limbum语）微调时代理语言选择缺乏原则性方法的问题。实验表明该方法性能优于从零训练的Transformer，且接近最佳单语言代理效果，证明了多语言迁移在极低资源场景下的主导作用，但系统仍无法保留声调变音符号。
AI.motivation: 现有的多语言神经机器翻译模型（如NLLB-200）虽然覆盖了200种语言，但仍遗漏了数千种语言，包括大多数喀麦隆的Grassfields Bantu语言。在对这些未见过的语言进行微调时，从业者必须选择一个代理语言token，但目前缺乏对此进行选择的系统性/原则性方法。
AI.method: 实施了一种嵌入初始化策略，即语言token的初始值设为模型中已有的多个类型学相关语言嵌入的平均值。以Limbum到英语的翻译为评估对象，使用包含8,837个句子对的平行语料库（来自《圣经》文本和双语词典），对比了四种模型：NLLB-200零样本、从头训练的Transformer、使用Swahili代理token微调的NLLB-200，以及采用本文提出的平均嵌入初始化策略的NLLB-200。
AI.result:
1. 多语言初始化策略取得了与最佳单语言代理相当的性能（chrF2++分别为46.7和47.3）。
2. 两种NLLB-200变体均比从零训练的基线模型提升了超过32个chrF2++点（基线为14.5，零样本为12.5）。
3. 所有系统在保留声调变音符号方面均失败。
AI.conclusion: 在多语言迁移是极低资源Bantu语翻译中起决定性作用的背景下，该初始化策略消除了对启发式代理选择的依赖。然而，声调信息的丢失揭示了该领域尚存的开放挑战。研究已公开数据集和代码以支持后续研究。

title: The Knowing-Saying Gap: When Probes See Errors that Confidence Misses
summary: Linear probes detect corrupted context in language models with near-perfect accuracy, yet this does not translate into reliable failure prediction. The result is a dissociation with direct implications for deployment monitoring. Across multi-hop arithmetic chains, probes that detect corruption turn out to be uninformative about final answer correctness; models forced into structured confidence formats collapse to two values with indistinguishable error rates; and probe persistence across hops fails to separate correct from incorrect outcomes, refuting our pre-registered "persistence beats peak" hypothesis. This pattern of knowing but not saying generalises across model families including reasoning models. As a real-time monitor, probe-based interventions are sharply model and error-type dependent: branch-and-pick is net-positive across models and uniquely non-breaking on Llama-3.1-8B (4 rescued, 0 broken), while reprompt and replace-prior break correct traces at roughly the rate they rescue wrong ones. Probe-based monitoring is a necessary complement to verbalised confidence, but no single intervention dominates, and the deployable answer is model-aware, error-type-aware routing.

AI.tldr: 尽管线性探针能高精度检测语言模型中的上下文损坏，但这并不能可靠预测最终答案的正确性。研究发现探测结果与最终答案正确性脱节，且不同干预手段效果各异，部署需采用模型和错误类型感知的路由策略。
AI.motivation: 解决线性探针在检测上下文损坏方面的高准确率无法转化为可靠失败预测的问题，探究这种“知而不言”现象对模型部署监控的影响。
AI.method: 在多跳算术链任务中评估线性探针的性能；测试模型在结构化置信度格式下的表现；验证探针跨跳持久性假设；对比多种实时监测干预措施（如分支选择、重新提示、替换先验）的效果。
AI.result: 1. 检测损坏的探针无法预测最终答案正确性；2. 模型在结构化置信度下收敛至两个值且错误率不可区分；3. 探针跨跳持久性未能区分正误，反驳了“持久性优于峰值”假设；4. 干预效果高度依赖模型和错误类型，例如Llama-3.1-8B上“分支选择”净收益为正且不破坏正确轨迹，而其他方法会同等概率破坏正确轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 基于探针的监控是言语化置信度的必要补充，但不存在单一主导的干预手段。有效的部署方案必须结合模型特性和错误类型进行感知路由。

title: AkasicDB: Demonstrating Omni RAG with a Unified Vector-Graph-Relational DBMS
summary: Recent Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems increasingly combine vector retrieval with structured knowledge, such as Graph RAG and Filtered vector search. However, existing database architectures struggle to support such complex RAG workflows efficiently, as they rely on out-of-DB pipelines or in-DB non-native integration, leading to high overhead. This demo paper presents AkasicDB, a database system that natively supports such RAG workflows by jointly executing vector similarity search, graph traversal, and relational filtering within a single execution framework. AkasicDB extends our prior work, Chimera, with native vector support to enable such unified execution. Based on AkasicDB, we demonstrate the first native integration of Vector-Graph-Relational RAG, which we refer to as Omni RAG. Through an interactive chat-style demonstration, users execute and visualize Omni RAG queries, directly experiencing its superior retrieval and reasoning over vector-only approaches while observing the practical limitations of existing database architectures in supporting Omni RAG. A demonstration video is available at https://youtu.be/8d09_dtrEIM

AI.tldr: AkasicDB 是一个原生支持向量、图关系混合 RAG 工作流的数据库系统，通过统一执行框架实现高效检索。
AI.motivation: 现有数据库架构难以高效支持结合向量检索与结构化知识（如图和过滤）的复杂 RAG 工作流，因其依赖非原生的外部管道或集成方式，导致高开销。
AI.method: 提出 AkasicDB，基于前期 Chimera 工作扩展原生向量支持，在单一执行框架内联合执行向量相似度搜索、图遍历和关系过滤。
AI.result: 实现了首个原生的“向量-图-关系”RAG（Omni RAG），并通过交互式演示展示了其在检索和推理方面优于纯向量方法，同时揭示了现有架构的局限性。
AI.conclusion: AkasicDB 为复杂 RAG 工作流提供了高效的原生数据库解决方案，提升了检索质量并降低了系统开销。

title: Difficulty-Gated Fusion of Reasoning Views for Temporal Retrieval
summary: Reasoning-intensive temporal retrieval requires matching a query to documents whose relevance depends on shared temporal reasoning rather than lexical overlap. Expanding a query into several reformulations that make its temporal intent explicit, and retrieving with each, supplies this reasoning, but fusing the resulting rankings with equal weights wastes accuracy: for any single query, only some reformulations are reliable. We propose query-difficulty-gated fusion of reasoning views. From each view we read an eight-dimensional signature of its score distribution, built from query-performance-prediction quantities such as softmax entropy, score gaps, and dispersion, and a gate of roughly one thousand parameters maps these signatures to per-query view weights. The fused ranking uses no relevance labels at inference, no re-ranking, and no fine-tuning of the retriever; the gate is trained leave-one-task-out. On the \textsc{Tempo} benchmark, the method improves all six retrievers we evaluate, from BERT encoders to 7B decoder retrievers, with the largest gains on the weaker backbones. The strongest retrievers reach $0.297$ and $0.303$ nDCG@10, and the per-query gain over the original query is significant under a paired bootstrap ($p<0.001$). A per-query oracle reaches $0.364$ against our realized $0.297$, exposing headroom that identifies per-query view selection as a concrete next step.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于查询难度门控的推理视图融合方法，通过从每个视图提取分数分布特征并映射为权重，动态整合多个时间意图显式化的查询重述结果，无需相关标签或微调即可在Tempo基准上显著提升检索性能。
AI.motivation: 在推理密集型时间检索中，简单地将多个显式化时间意图的查询重述结果以等权融合会浪费准确性，因为对于单个查询而言，并非所有重述都是可靠的。
AI.method: 提出“查询难度门控融合”机制：从每个检索视图中读取由softmax熵、分数间隙和离散度等构成的八维签名，利用一个约一千参数的门控网络将这些签名映射为针对特定查询的视图权重，从而生成融合排名。该方法在推理时无需相关性标签、重排序或检索器微调，且门控采用留一任务外（leave-one-task-out）方式训练。
AI.result: 在Tempo基准测试中，该方法使包括BERT编码器到7B解码器在内的六种检索器的性能均得到提升，尤其在较弱的基础模型上增益最大。最强检索器达到0.297和0.303的nDCG@10指标，且相比原始查询的每查询增益具有统计学显著性（p<0.001）。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效提升了时间检索精度，但当前实现与每查询理想选择oracle（0.364 nDCG@10）之间仍存在差距，表明未来的改进方向应聚焦于更精准的每查询视图选择机制。

title: Impact of Dataset Composition on Embedded Real-Time UAV Wildfire Detection Using Compact YOLO Models
summary: The development of vision-based wildfire detection systems for unmanned aerial vehicles is constrained by the limited availability of diverse real-world training images. This paper investigates the impact of dataset composition on embedded real-time UAV wildfire detection using compact YOLO models as a controlled validation family. Four training configurations were evaluated: real non-augmented, real augmented, hybrid non-augmented, and hybrid augmented, where the hybrid sets combine real wildfire images with AI-generated samples. The objective is to determine whether synthetic data mixing and image augmentation improve practical detection performance under resource-constrained deployment conditions. Experimental results show that the best overall operating point was obtained with the real non-augmented dataset, which achieved the strongest balance between recall and mean average precision for UAV-based wildfire detection. The results also show that neither hybridization with synthetic data nor augmentation produced a better final deployment choice. These findings suggest that, for embedded UAV wildfire detection, dataset realism and domain alignment are more valuable than increasing training set size through synthetic expansion.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了不同数据集组成（真实/混合、增强/非增强）对嵌入式无人机实时野火检测性能的影响，发现使用纯真实且未增强的数据集取得了最佳检测效果，表明数据真实性和领域对齐比合成数据扩展更重要。
AI.motivation: 解决基于视觉的无人机野火检测系统因缺乏多样化真实训练图像而面临的开发限制问题。
AI.method: 使用紧凑型YOLO模型作为验证家族，对比四种训练配置：真实非增强、真实增强、混合非增强（真实+AI生成）、混合增强，评估其在资源受限条件下的部署性能。
AI.result: 真实非增强数据集实现了召回率与平均精度均值（mAP）的最佳平衡；引入合成数据或图像增强均未带来更好的最终部署选择。
AI.conclusion: 在嵌入式无人机野火检测场景中，数据集的真实性和领域对齐性比通过合成数据扩大训练集规模更具价值。

title: SurveyReview: A Reviewer-Aligned Benchmark for Survey Evaluators
summary: The rapid advancement of large language models has transformed survey writing from a months-long manual effort into an automated process. As generation scales, reliable evaluation becomes the bottleneck, and LLMs are increasingly used as survey evaluators. However, existing approaches largely rely on off-the-shelf LLM-as-a-judge methods without systematic alignment to human reviewers, and there remains a lack of systematic frameworks for quantifying alignment with human reviewers. To address this gap, we propose SurveyReview, a reviewer-aligned, multi-dimensional benchmark and dataset for survey evaluation. We collect and annotate 675 survey papers with 1,630 review reports. We structure authentic peer-review reports by converting free-form comments into four-dimensional scores (Readability, Criticalness, Comprehensiveness, Structure) paired with supporting rationales. We further release standardized train/test splits and an evaluation protocol to measure alignment between automatic evaluators and human reviewers. To validate the benchmark, we develop SurveyAlign, a strong baseline evaluator by fine-tuning Qwen3-32B with LoRA on our annotated data, augmented with external knowledge for knowledge-intensive dimensions. On the test set, SurveyAlign substantially improves reviewer alignment over prompt-based judging with GPT-5.2, reducing average MSE from 2.28 to 1.38 and MAE from 1.15 to 0.69 across all four dimensions. Our contributions are twofold: (1) we establish the first multi-dimensional, reviewer-aligned dataset with a reproducible evaluation framework for survey reviewing; (2) we develop a strong baseline evaluator that substantially improves alignment with human reviewers, providing a competitive reference for future research. Our code and data are available at https://surveyreview.github.io

AI.tldr: 提出SurveyReview基准和SurveyAlign评估器，通过多维度对齐人类评审员，显著提升大语言模型在学术综述写作自动评估中的准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM作为评审者的方法缺乏与人类评审员的系统性对齐，且缺乏量化这种对齐的系统框架，导致自动化评估的可靠性不足。
AI.method: 构建包含675篇论文、1630份报告的多维数据集（可读性、批判性、全面性、结构），将自由文本转化为带理由的四维评分；开发SurveyAlign基线评估器，基于Qwen3-32B进行LoRA微调并增强外部知识。
AI.result: SurveyAlign在测试集上显著优于GPT-5.2提示式评判，平均均方误差(MSE)从2.28降至1.38，平均绝对误差(MAE)从1.15降至0.69，实现了更高的人类评审员对齐度。
AI.conclusion: 建立了首个多维、对齐人类评审员的综述评估数据集及可复现框架，并提供了高对齐度的强基线评估器，为未来研究提供了竞争参考。

title: NL2SHACL-Bench: A Benchmark Suite for Natural Language to SHACL Translation
summary: SHACL is a core technology for validating the conformance of RDF knowledge graphs (KGs). Yet, authoring SHACL shapes requires technical expertise that most domain experts lack. Translating natural language requirements into SHACL (NL2SHACL) would lower this barrier. However, there is no dedicated benchmark for NL2SHACL, and evaluating generated shapes requires methods beyond string comparison, as semantically equivalent shapes can differ in serialisation and structure. To tackle these challenges, we present NL2SHACL-Bench, a benchmark suite for natural language to SHACL translation. Using NL2SHACL-Bench, we evaluate four state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs) for this task. Our results show that current LLMs are highly capable of generating syntactically valid SHACL, but still struggle to produce semantically equivalent constraints for complex logical and structural patterns. This indicates that NL2SHACL-Bench provides a meaningful basis for measuring advances in the NL2SHACL state of the art.

AI.tldr: 提出NL2SHACL-Bench基准，评估LLM将自然语言转换为SHACL形状的能力，发现模型能生成语法正确但语义等效性在复杂逻辑上仍有不足。
