AI.motivation: SHACL验证RDF知识图谱需专业技术，领域专家难以编写；缺乏NL2SHACL专用基准及超越字符串比较的语义评估方法。
AI.method: 构建NL2SHACL-Bench基准套件，包含自然语言到SHACL翻译任务；采用非字符串比较的语义等价评估方法；评估四种主流大语言模型（LLMs）。
AI.result: 当前LLM能高概率生成语法有效的SHACL形状，但在处理复杂逻辑和结构模式时，难以保证生成的约束与需求语义完全等效。
AI.conclusion: NL2SHACL-Bench为衡量NL2SHACL领域技术进步提供了有意义的评估基础，揭示了现有LLM在该任务中的能力边界。

title: SafeQL: Search-based Refinement for Safe and Efficient LLM-based Text-to-SQL
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have advanced Text-to-SQL by enabling natural language interfaces to databases without task-specific fine-tuning. However, existing LLM-based systems remain unreliable, often generating SQL queries that are invalid under the database schema, referencing non-existent tables, attributes, functions, or values. Such errors persist because interactions with the database management system (DBMS) are typically limited to error messages, leaving it in a largely passive role during query refinement. This paper proposes SafeQL, \textit{a search-based refinement paradigm that redefines the role of the DBMS as an active guide in the refinement process}. Instead of regenerating entire queries after execution failure, SafeQL interprets DBMS feedback to incrementally repair only the erroneous components. Each refinement step is formulated as a guided search within a \textit{safe query space}, where candidate queries are progressively validated through DBMS execution, thereby converging to an executable query and preventing repeated regeneration of errors. Experiments on the Bird and Spider benchmarks show that SafeQL significantly improves execution accuracy and efficiency compared to regeneration-based methods.

AI.tldr: 提出SafeQL，一种基于搜索的SQL生成优化范式，利用DBMS作为主动引导者，通过增量修复错误组件而非整体重生成，显著提升Text-to-SQL的执行准确率与效率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于大语言模型（LLMs）的Text-to-SQL系统可靠性不足，常生成违反数据库架构、引用不存在表/属性等的无效SQL查询。由于DBMS在查询细化过程中仅被动提供错误信息，导致此类错误反复出现且难以纠正。
AI.method: 提出SafeQL框架，将DBMS角色从被动反馈者转变为主动引导者。该方法不依赖失败后的整体查询重生成，而是解析DBMS反馈，在“安全查询空间”内进行逐步搜索，仅对出错组件进行增量修复，并通过DBMS执行逐步验证候选查询，直至收敛至可执行结果。
AI.result: 在Bird和Spider基准测试上的实验表明，相较于基于重生成的方法，SafeQL显著提高了执行准确率（execution accuracy）和效率（efficiency）。
AI.conclusion: 通过将DBMS纳入主动搜索流程并进行增量式错误修复，SafeQL有效解决了LLM生成SQL时的架构一致性问题，为提升Text-to-SQL系统的鲁棒性提供了新范式。

title: What Would Fix This RAG Failure? Auditing Counterfactual Response with Paired Evidence Interventions
summary: A failed retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) answer can be consistent with several unseen responses to evidence repair. We introduce Pair-ID, an offline audit that holds one query, retrieval state, and reader constant, then crosses two operations, adding missing support and deleting verified nonsupport, to measure a same-failure counterfactual response vector. A complete funnel over 19,981 benchmark queries identifies 11,105 eligible Qwen failures, from which a prospectively fixed SHA-256 ordering selects 1,200 before generating any sampled response. Among 1,190 regenerated-valid failures, support addition repairs 197/600 JOINT cases (0.328, 95% CI [0.292, 0.367]), and deletion repairs 162/1,190 cases (0.136, 95% CI [0.117, 0.155]); length- and position-matched shams retain semantic contrasts of 0.223 and 0.101. The original view carries partial predictive signal for individual response cells (macro AUROC 0.678; Brier 0.152 versus 0.160 for a marginal baseline), but exact-vector accuracy, 0.637, does not exceed the 0.646 majority-vector baseline, and vector macro-F1 is 0.170. Across four readers, both marginal sensitivities recur, while pooled exact-vector agreement is 0.675-0.765 and JOINT-only agreement falls to 0.538-0.691. These results show that evidence sensitivity occurs at meaningful rates in the hash-selected eligible-failure sample, is only partially predictable from the observed failure, and is conditional on the reader. The evidence supports a frame-scoped offline response audit, not an information-theoretic impossibility result, reader-independent taxonomy, or runtime repair policy.

AI.tldr: 提出Pair-ID离线审计方法，通过固定查询、检索状态和阅读器，交叉操作（添加缺失支持/删除已验证非支持）来测量失败RAG回答的潜在修复响应向量。在19,981个基准查询中发现约56%为合格失败案例，其中添加支持修复32.8%的案例，删除非支持修复13.6%。表明证据敏感性显著存在但仅部分可预测，且依赖于具体阅读器，支持基于帧范围的离线审计而非运行时修复策略。
AI.motivation: 针对检索增强生成（RAG）中失败回答的不可预测性和多样性问题，旨在量化在保持其他条件不变的情况下，通过证据修正（添加支持或移除错误信息）可能产生的不同响应结果，从而评估RAG系统的鲁棒性及修复潜力。
AI.method: 引入Pair-ID离线审计框架：1) 从19,981个基准查询中筛选出11,105个Qwen模型的合格失败案例；2) 使用SHA-256哈希顺序前瞻性选择1,200个样本以消除偏差；3) 保持查询、检索状态和阅读器恒定，分别执行“添加缺失支持”和“删除已验证非支持”两种操作；4) 分析再生成响应的语义对比度、预测准确性及阅读器间的一致性。
AI.result: 1) 在1,190个有效重生成失败案例中，添加支持修复了197/600 (32.8%) 的JOINT案例，删除非支持修复了162/1,190 (13.6%) 的案例；2) 原始失败回答对个体响应单元具有部分预测信号（Macro AUROC 0.678），但精确向量准确率(0.637)未超过多数向量基线(0.646)；3) 不同阅读器间的精确向量一致性为0.675-0.765，而仅JOIT案例的一致性较低(0.538-0.691)。
AI.conclusion: 证据敏感性在哈希选择的合格失败样本中以有意义的频率出现，但这种敏感性仅能从观察到的失败中部分预测，且具有阅读器依赖性。研究结果支持采用基于帧范围的离线响应审计方法，而非试图建立信息论上的不可能性结论、阅读器无关的分类法或运行时自动修复策略。

title: MVMD: A Multi-View Approach for Enhanced Mirror Detection
comment: This work has already published at WACV 2025, just want more accessibility
summary:
In 3D reconstruction, mirrors introduce significant challenges by creating distorted and fragmented spaces, resulting in inaccurate and unreliable 3D models. As 3D reconstruction typically relies on multi-view images to capture different perspectives of a scene, detecting and labeling mirrors in multi-view images before reconstruction can effectively address this issue. However, existing methods focus solely on single-image detection, overlooking the rich information provided by multi-view setups. To overcome this limitation, we propose MVMD, a novel Multi-View Mirror Detection method, along with the first database specifically designed for mirror detection in multi-view scenes.
  The design of MVMD is grounded in the inherent associations between objects seen from different views and those reflected inside and outside of mirrors. These relationships are learned through cross- and self-attention mechanisms. MVMD consists of three key blocks: the Inter-Views Block tracks the shifts of objects within mirrors caused by changes in viewpoint; the Intra-View Block detects object reflections inside mirrors; and the Refinement Block sharpens mirror boundaries and enhances detected details.
  Experimental results show that our method improves accuracy by up to 2.6% and IoU by up to 11.1%, compared to single-image mirror detection techniques. This substantial improvement makes MVMD particularly effective for computer vision tasks, especially in enhancing the accuracy of 3D reconstruction in mirror-dense environments.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为MVMD的多视角镜面检测方法，解决了传统单图检测忽略多视角信息的问题。该方法通过跨视图和自注意力机制学习物体在不同视角及镜面内外的关联，包含三个关键模块：Inter-Views（追踪视差）、Intra-View（检测反射）和Refinement（细化边界）。实验显示其精度提升2.6%，IoU提升11.1%，显著改善了镜像密集环境下的3D重建质量。
AI.motivation: 3D重建中镜子会导致空间扭曲和碎片化，影响模型准确性。现有方法仅关注单图像检测，忽略了多视角设置提供的丰富信息，因此需要一种能利用多视角关联的镜面检测方法来克服这一局限。
AI.method: 提出了MVMD（Multi-View Mirror Detection）方法及首个多视角场景镜面检测数据库。核心机制基于跨视图和自注意力网络，包含三个模块：1) Inter-Views Block：跟踪因视角变化引起的镜中物体位移；2) Intra-View Block：检测镜内物体反射；3) Refinement Block：锐化镜面边界并增强细节。
AI.result: 相比单图像镜面检测技术，MVMD将准确率提高了最高2.6%，交并比（IoU）提高了最高11.1%。
AI.conclusion: MVMD通过有效利用多视角信息显著提升了镜面检测性能，特别适用于增强镜像密集环境中3D重建的准确性，对计算机视觉任务具有重要价值。

authors: Venkata Naga Sai Vishnu Rohit Pulipaka
title: Evaluating Dedicated Monolingual and Joint Multilingual Causal Models for Dravidian Languages
summary: Dravidian languages, mainly Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, and Malayalam make up only a small part of the data used to train multilingual language models, so it's not clear how much per-language ability these models actually keep. I have trained five GPT-2 architecture models from scratch to compare four monolingual models (one each for Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, and Malayalam, each with its own 32K-vocabulary subword tokenizer) against one multilingual model sharing a 64K-vocabulary subword tokenizer across all four languages. All the 5 models are trained on cleaned CC-100, Wikipedia, and Samanantar data. I have tested the models on perplexity, bits-per-byte, tokenizer efficiency, and fine-tuning results which are compared against mGPT. The monolingual models outperform mGPT on sentiment classification and named entity recognition, and their tokenizers proved more efficient than the shared multilingual model across all the languages tested.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过从零训练五个GPT-2架构模型，对比了德拉威语系四种语言（泰米尔语、泰卢固语、卡纳达语、马拉雅拉姆语）的单语模型与共享词表的多元语言模型。结果显示，单语模型在情感分类和命名实体识别任务上优于mGPT，且其分词器效率更高。
AI.motivation: 鉴于德拉威语系数据在多语言语言模型训练数据中占比极小，现有模型保留的特定语言能力不明确，需评估单语模型与多语言模型在该语系上的性能差异及分词效率。
AI.method: 使用清理后的CC-100、Wikipedia和Samanantar数据，从零训练五个GPT-2模型：四个单语模型（各拥有32K子词词表）和一个跨四语言共享64K子词词表的多元语言模型。测试指标包括困惑度、每字节比特数、分词器效率以及在情感分类和命名实体识别上的微调结果，并与mGPT进行对比。
AI.result: 单语模型在情感分类和命名实体识别任务上的表现优于mGPT；此外，单语模型的专用分词器在所有测试语言中的效率均高于共享的多语言模型分词器。
AI.conclusion: 对于数据稀缺的德拉威语系，专门训练的单一语言模型不仅在下游NLP任务上表现更佳，而且在处理效率上也优于通用的多语言模型，证明了针对低资源或少数语种构建专用模型的价值。

title: Dynamic Coalition Formation and Communication Pricing in Skill-Based Agentic AI Systems
summary: Modern agentic AI systems combine multiple large language model agents with heterogeneous skills, yet most architectures either fix communication in advance or allow full broadcast. Both can be inefficient because token cost, latency, redundancy, and error propagation increase with the number of active agents and communication links. We model agent selection and communication as a cooperative game with task-conditioned net utility $U(C\mid x)=V(C\mid x)-\sum_{i\in C}c_i$, separating coalition-level costs from agent activation costs. We propose a marginal-value activation rule and greedy router, extend the model to optimize communication edges with per-edge costs, and use estimated Shapley values to predict which agents are worth contacting before and during execution. We connect the problem to submodular maximization and prove two limited guarantees: a curvature-refined bound for a monotone, cardinality-constrained special case, and a tight $1/2$-approximation, with a correction for signed objectives, for an unconstrained non-monotone case via double greedy. Neither guarantee applies directly to the main router, which remains a heuristic. We also prove a Shapley-submodularity sandwich bound linking the error of marginal-value routing to a per-agent diminishing-returns quantity. In synthetic experiments, greedy routing achieves $99.5%$ of brute-force-optimal utility while activating $1.96$ of $8$ agents on average, compared with $38.8%$ for full broadcast. Performance is robust to activation cost and redundancy weight but falls to $66%$ under strong violations of submodularity or noisy value estimates. We distinguish the framework from Shapley pricing, hedonic coalition formation, and communication-graph pruning, and propose evaluation on real multi-agent LLM benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于合作博弈和Shapley值的智能体通信路由框架，通过边际价值激活规则和贪婪路由器优化多LLM智能体系统中的通信效率，在合成实验中达到接近最优效用并显著减少激活智能体数量。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体AI系统架构中，预先固定通信或全广播方式会导致随着活跃智能体和通信链路增加，出现令牌成本、延迟、冗余和错误传播等问题，造成效率低下。
AI.method: 将智能体选择和通信建模为具有任务条件净效用的合作博弈；提出边际价值激活规则和贪婪路由器；扩展模型以优化带有每边成本的通信边；使用估计的Shapley值预测执行前后值得联系智能体；连接至次模最大化问题并进行理论分析。
AI.result: 证明了两个有限保证：单调基数约束特例的曲率细化界限，以及无约束非单调情况下的紧1/2近似（带符号目标修正）；证明Shapley-次模夹逼界限。合成实验显示，贪婪路由实现暴力最优效用的99.5%，平均仅激活8个智能体中的1.96个，而全广播仅为38.8%；性能对激活成本和冗余权重鲁棒，但在强违反次模性或噪声估值下降至66%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架区别于Shapley定价、享乐联盟形成和通信图剪枝，为高效多智能体LLM通信提供了新的启发式方法及理论基础，建议在真实多智能体LLM基准上进行评估。

title: "Will This Data Break My Task?" - Interactive Synthesis of Task-Aware Data Unit Tests
comment: Accepted as a demo paper at CIKM 2026
summary:
Data is a central resource for modern enterprises and institutions, and data errors propagating through data pipelines lead to serious impact in production. Therefore, data validation is essential for ensuring the reliability of downstream applications. This led to the development of data unit tests, executable programs that test data before moving it around through large data pipelines. However, existing frameworks derive data unit tests from observed data alone, ignoring the semantics of the code that consumes the data downstream.
  To this end, we present PrismaDV, a compound AI system that synthesizes task-aware data unit tests for tabular data by jointly analyzing data and downstream task code. PrismaDV decomposes the test generation into multiple LLM-powered steps: data profiling, detection of column accesses, data flow analysis in the task code, and the inference of implicit data assumptions. It subsequently synthesizes code for the data unit test, and maintains an internal ``data-code assumption graph'' that links generated data constraints back to the task's source code.
  We demonstrate PrismaDV through an interactive web-based interface where attendees run the system on five real-world datasets with 60 downstream tasks, synthesize, inspect and refine both natural language assumptions about the data and executable data constraints. The interface allows attendees to navigate the data-code assumption graph, compare task-aware data unit tests against task-agnostic baselines on erroneous data batches, and interactively edit assumptions and data constraints. Furthermore, attendees can observe how a custom prompt optimizer adapts the system to specific datasets over time.

AI.tldr: 提出PrismaDV，一种结合数据和下游任务代码语义的复合AI系统，用于自动生成表格数据的任务感知数据单元测试。
AI.motivation: 现有数据单元测试框架仅基于观测数据生成测试，忽略了下游消费数据的代码语义，导致生成的测试缺乏针对性且无法有效捕捉因代码逻辑变化引发的数据错误传播问题。
AI.method: PrismaDV通过多步LLM驱动流程工作：包括数据画像、列访问检测、任务代码中的数据流分析以及隐式数据假设推断。系统构建“数据-代码假设图”，将生成的数据约束与源代码关联，并支持交互式界面进行假设编辑和约束调整。
AI.result: 在5个真实世界数据集和60个下游任务上演示了该系统。用户可合成、检查并优化自然语言假设及可执行数据约束。实验表明，任务感知的数据单元测试在错误数据批次上的表现优于无任务感知的基线方法。此外，展示了自定义提示优化器如何随时间适应特定数据集。
AI.conclusion: PrismaDV通过联合分析数据和下游任务代码，显著提升了数据单元测试的相关性和有效性，为数据管道中的可靠性保障提供了新的解决方案。

title: Guardian Crawler: Retrieval-First Knowledge Discovery with Bounded LLM Augmentation for Noisy Web Intelligence
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures. Accepted as a Short Paper at KDIR 2026 (International Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Information Retrieval)
summary: Retrieving relevant evidence from noisy web data is challenging, particularly in sensitive domains containing incomplete reports, heterogeneous language, and irrelevant content. We present Guardian Crawler, a reproducible retrieval-first testbed for controlled experiments on knowledge discovery and evidence-grounded summarization over synthetic web-like corpora. The architecture combines BM25 retrieval with risk-aware, embedding-augmented, and hybrid reranking, followed by constrained retrieval-augmented generation with explicit document citations. Experiments on a synthetic 900-document corpus and 10 queries produced the highest descriptive retrieval scores under risk-based reranking, with P@10 = 1.00 and NDCG@10 = 0.94, compared with 0.94 and 0.81 for BM25. The best hybrid and BM25+Semantic configurations reached NDCG@10 values of 0.94 and 0.88, respectively. All 41 evaluable generated bullets passed the lexical coverage threshold; an automated LLM judge classified 36 as supported, one as partially supported, and four as unsupported. These results demonstrate the feasibility of Guardian Crawler as a controlled testbed but do not establish statistical superiority, human-validated faithfulness, or transfer to live-web investigative environments.

AI.tldr: 提出Guardian Crawler，一个结合BM25检索与风险感知重排、用于合成网络数据上证据检索和摘要生成的可复现测试平台。实验显示其在特定指标上表现优异，但尚未验证统计显著性或现实场景迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 从嘈杂的网络数据（包含不完整报告、异构语言和无关内容）中检索相关证据具有挑战性，特别是在敏感领域。需要可控的实验环境来研究知识发现和基于证据的摘要生成。
AI.method: 构建Guardian Crawler测试床，架构包括：1) BM25检索；2) 风险感知、嵌入增强及混合重排；3) 带有显式文档引用的受限检索增强生成（RAG）。在900个文档的合成语料库和10个查询上进行实验评估。
AI.result: 风险基础重排在P@10 (1.00) 和 NDCG@10 (0.94) 上得分最高，优于纯BM25 (0.94, 0.81)。混合配置NDCG@10为0.94，BM25+语义为0.88。所有41个可评估生成要点均通过词汇覆盖阈值；LLM自动裁判判定36个受支持，1个部分支持，4个不支持。
AI.conclusion: Guardian Crawler作为受控测试床是可行的，但当前结果未确立统计优越性、人类验证的真实性，也未证明其能迁移到实时网络调查环境中。

title: XEns-CKD: An Explainable Ensemble-Based Approach for Chronic Kidney Disease Stage Detection
summary: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is a silent disease. Its progression may not significantly hamper a person's daily routine. Human kidney function can be classified as normal or as one of the five stages of CKD. Early detection of the CKD stage can help patients understand the functional status of their kidneys and follow medical advice to slow CKD progression. In this paper, we propose XEns-CKD, a novel ensemble vision transformer-based scheme for CKD stage classification using ultrasound images. Three ViTs were trained on a private ultrasound image dataset using different training parameters. The performance of each ViT was evaluated using macro sensitivity, macro specificity, macro precision, macro F1-score, macro Youden index, the Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC), and macro balanced accuracy. The ensemble model achieved an overall classification accuracy of 86.36%. This work also emphasizes identifying and interpreting kidney regions affected by CKD progression. Explainable artificial intelligence techniques, including LIME, LRP, Attention-Min, and Attention-Max, were used to improve model transparency and clinical trust. An attention map combining the Attention-Min and Attention-Max results effectively identified and interpreted kidney regions affected during CKD progression from one stage to another. The attention map also highlighted the effects of CKD progression in these regions. Compared with existing methods, the proposed method classified the five CKD stages and normal kidney status with a 4% improvement in accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出XEns-CKD模型，利用集成Vision Transformer和可解释AI技术，通过超声图像实现慢性肾病（CKD）五期及正常状态的分类，准确率86.36%，较现有方法提升4%。
AI.motivation: 慢性肾病进展隐匿，早期准确分期有助于患者了解肾脏功能状态并延缓病情发展，但现有方法在精度和可解释性上仍有不足。
AI.method: 构建XEns-CKD框架：1. 使用不同训练参数在私有数据集上训练三个Vision Transformer (ViT)；2. 采用集成策略融合模型输出；3. 应用LIME、LRP、Attention-Min/Max等可解释AI技术生成注意力图以定位受影响的肾区。
AI.result: 集成模型整体分类准确率达到86.36%，相比现有方法提高4%。生成的组合注意力图能有效识别并解释CKD进展中受影响的肾脏区域及其变化。
AI.conclusion: 该方法不仅提高了CKD分期的准确性，还通过可视化技术增强了模型的临床透明度和可信度，为辅助诊断提供了有效工具。

title: The No-Meaning Falsity: The Structural Impossibility of the Arbitrary Sign in Classical Arabic
summary: This paper investigates whether the postmodern claim of unrestricted semantic indeterminacy, and its foundational Saussurean axiom of the arbitrary sign, are compatible with the structural architecture of Classical Arabic. We develop a formal mathematical model of Arabic non concatenative morphology in which lexical meaning is determined by the interaction between an invariant root and a morphosyntactic pattern. Within this framework, we establish a Morphological Correspondence Theorem, demonstrating that every lexical item is uniquely generated by a root pattern pair, and a Semantic Localization Theorem, proving that lexical meaning is determined at the derivational level prior to surface realization. To address Saussurean weaker notion of relative arbitrariness, we formalize it via conditional Kolmogorov complexity, defining arbitrariness algorithmically as the no rule property. We prove that general relative arbitrariness is formally undecidable, while Arabic relative arbitrariness is decidable and provably less than 1 for its motivated signifiers (Levels W and M), establishing a strict system complexity asymmetry over Indo-European languages.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建阿拉伯语非连缀形态的形式数学模型，证明阿拉伯语的词汇意义由不变词根与形态模式的相互作用唯一确定。研究提出“形态对应定理”和“语义定位定理”，并利用条件柯尔莫哥洛夫复杂度形式化索绪尔的相对任意性概念。结果表明，阿拉伯语的相对任意性是可判定的且低于1，证明了其符号系统具有动机性，从而在形式上驳斥了后现代主义关于语义无限不确定性的主张，并揭示了阿拉伯语与印欧语系语言在系统复杂性上的严格不对称性。
AI.motivation: 探究后现代主义主张的“无限制的语义不确定性”及其基础的索绪尔“符号任意性”公理，是否与古典阿拉伯语的结构架构相容。旨在通过形式化方法验证阿拉伯语形态系统的确定性和动机性，以挑战语言学中的相对主义观点。
AI.method:
1. 建立阿拉伯语非连缀形态的形式数学模型，定义词汇意义由“不变词根”与“形态模式”交互决定。
2. 提出并证明两个核心定理：形态对应定理（每个词汇项由唯一的词根-模式对生成）和语义定位定理（词汇意义在表层实现前的派生层面即已确定）。
3. 利用条件柯尔莫哥洛夫复杂度（Conditional Kolmogorov Complexity）将索绪尔的“相对任意性”形式化为算法上的“无规则属性”。
4. 进行可判定性分析，比较一般相对任意性与阿拉伯语特定层级（W级和M级）的任意性。
AI.result:
1. 证明了阿拉伯语的相对任意性是**可判定的**。
2. 对于具有动机性的符号指称（Levels W and M），其相对任意性被证明**严格小于1**。
3. 相比之下，一般的相对任意性是形式上**不可判定的**。
4. 确立了阿拉伯语相对于印欧语系语言在系统复杂性上的严格不对称性。
AI.conclusion: 阿拉伯语的结构架构不支持后现代主义的无限语义不确定性主张。通过形式化证明，阿拉伯语的词汇意义是确定的、可计算的，且其符号系统具有高度的动机性（低任意性）。这不仅在理论上修正了对索绪尔任意性公理的普遍适用性理解，也揭示了阿拉伯语作为一种高度结构化语言，在计算复杂度和语义确定性上与印欧语系存在本质差异。

title: MetaSpace: Metamorphic Testing for Spatial Cognition in Embodied Agents
comment: 30 pages, 17 figures. Published in Proceedings of the ACM on Programming Languages (OOPSLA1)
summary:
An embodied agent is an intelligent entity that interacts with its environment through a physical body. Currently, the evaluation of embodied agents primarily relies on two paradigms: (1) manually annotated Visual Question Answering (VQA) pairs and (2) high-level task completion metrics, such as success in navigation or manipulation. The former is labor-intensive and subject to variability in annotation quality. The latter may obscure critical vulnerabilities, allowing agents to complete tasks through suboptimal means or safety violations, thereby concealing safety risks and inefficiencies. Given that spatial cognition is the cornerstone for executing embodied tasks, there is a pressing need to assess whether embodied agents possess robust spatial cognition during task execution.
  Inspired by metamorphic testing principles in software engineering, we propose MetaSpace, a novel framework designed to evaluate the spatial cognition of agents. By leveraging spatiotemporal multimodal states derived from real execution trajectories, MetaSpace automatically generates test cases based on predefined metamorphic relations (MRs) grounded in logical rules and physical laws. Crucially, we encode these MRs as executable rules in a logic programming language (Prolog). Violations of these relations indicate failures in spatial cognition. Our empirical evaluation across three embodied scenarios demonstrates that MetaSpace successfully detects 90,422 spatial cognition errors in state-of-the-art (SOTA) MLLM-driven agents. We introduce the Spatial Cognition (SC) score to quantify performance. Results indicate that all SOTA agents achieve average scores between 0.44 and 0.52, significantly lower than the human benchmark of 0.96.

AI.tldr: 提出MetaSpace框架，基于变形测试原理和Prolog逻辑规则，自动评估具身智能体的空间认知能力，发现当前SOTA模型表现远逊于人类。
AI.motivation: 现有具身智能体评估方法（VQA配对或高层任务完成度）存在标注成本高、质量不一或掩盖安全隐患与低效行为的问题；鉴于空间认知是执行任务的基础，亟需一种能直接评估其空间认知鲁棒性的新方法。
AI.method: 提出MetaSpace框架，利用真实执行轨迹中的时空多模态状态，基于预定义的符合逻辑规则和物理定律的变形关系（MRs）自动生成测试用例；将MRs编码为Prolog可执行规则，通过检测规则违反情况来判定空间认知失败。
AI.result: 在三个具身场景中，MetaSpace检测到90,422个空间认知错误；引入空间认知（SC）评分，SOTA MLLM驱动智能体的平均得分仅为0.44-0.52，远低于人类基准的0.96。
AI.conclusion: MetaSpace能有效揭示当前先进具身智能体在空间认知方面的显著缺陷，证明了该评估框架在识别潜在风险和效率问题上的有效性。

authors: Wil M. P. van der Aalst
title: Monotonicity-Guided Bottom-Up Petri Net Discovery: The SPECpp Framework
summary: Process discovery is one of the central challenges in process mining. Petri nets are particularly attractive because simple local constructs can express complex behavior, including concurrency. While their global behavior may be difficult to analyze, individual places can be efficiently characterized using monotonic properties, enabling bottom-up discovery. Unlike top-down approaches such as the Inductive Miner, which rely on predefined constructs for sequences, choices, loops, and concurrency, our approach allows such structures to emerge organically and can exploit the full expressive power of Petri nets, including free-choice constructs and long-term dependencies. The main challenge is the exponential number of candidate places and their combinations. We present the SPECpp framework which implements strategies to obtain high-quality models under time and resource constraints. SPECpp supports rapid experimentation and is used to evaluate these strategies using both synthetic and real-life event data.

AI.tldr: 提出SPECpp框架，通过自底向上的方法利用Petri网的单调属性进行过程挖掘，克服了传统自顶向下方法的限制，能在资源约束下高效发现高质量模型。
AI.motivation: 解决过程挖掘中Petri网全局行为分析困难的问题，同时克服Inductive Miner等自顶向下方法依赖预定义结构、无法充分利用Petri网表达能力（如自由选择结构和长期依赖）的局限性。
AI.method: 采用自底向上的发现策略，利用单个位置（places）的单调属性进行高效表征；构建SPECpp框架以实施多种策略，应对候选位置及其组合的指数级增长挑战，并在时间和资源约束下获取高质量模型。
AI.result: SPECpp框架支持快速实验，并通过合成数据和真实事件日志验证了所提策略的有效性，能够有机地涌现出序列、选择、循环和并发等结构。
AI.conclusion: 基于单调属性的自底向上方法能有效利用Petri网的完整表达能力，SPECpp框架为解决过程挖掘中的计算复杂性问题提供了实用解决方案。

title: PreGress: Ranking-Native Pre-training and Prompting for Graph Node Ranking
summary: Node ranking is a fundamental problem in graph information retrieval, measuring the relative importance of nodes and supporting a wide range of applications such as influence analysis, recommendation, and graph-based retrieval augmented generation. However, exact computation of graph-based ranking measures is often computationally prohibitive at scale. Existing GNN-based ranking methods provide scalable approximations, but they are typically tailored to individual ranking criteria and require retraining for each downstream task, which limits their transferability and efficiency. Recent graph pre-training approaches aim to enable knowledge transfer across tasks, yet their learning objectives are largely misaligned with node ranking, resulting in suboptimal adaptability to ranking-oriented applications. To address these limitations, we propose PreGress, the first ranking-native pre-training and prompting framework for supporting a wide range of node ranking tasks. PreGress performs multi-task pre-training using our carefully designed objectives, including degree centrality prediction and attribute reconstruction, to jointly capture structural and attribute information. To support heterogeneous ranking criteria, we design lightweight, task-specific prompt modules that adapt a frozen ranking backbone to downstream tasks without full retraining. Experiments on six public graphs and two real-world query-to-item benchmarks---Yelp2018 and MovieLens-100K---together with a controlled five-criterion graph-access study demonstrate strong ranking quality with low task-specific state overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出PreGress框架，一种针对节点排名的原生预训练和提示方法，通过多任务预训练和轻量级提示模块，解决现有GNN排名方法泛化性差和计算成本高的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于GNN的排名方法通常针对特定标准定制，需重新训练，限制了可转移性和效率；而现有的图预训练方法学习目标与节点排名不匹配，导致适应性不佳。
AI.method: 提出PreGress框架：1）采用精心设计的多任务预训练目标（如度中心性预测和属性重建）联合捕捉结构和属性信息；2）设计轻量级、任务特定的提示模块，适配冻结的排名主干网络至下游任务，无需全量重训。
AI.result: 在六个公共图和两个真实世界基准（Yelp2018, MovieLens-100K）及五项准则的图访问研究中，实验证明该方法具有强大的排名质量和低的任务特定状态开销。
AI.conclusion: PreGress是首个面向节点排名的原生预训练与提示框架，有效解决了现有方法在可扩展性、可转移性和适应性方面的局限。

title: Mechanistic Interpretability-Guided Selective Fine-Tuning of Vision-Language Models for Centimeter-Level Flood Depth Estimation
comment: This Paper is accepted in International Conference on Machine Learning and Application (ICMLA) 2026
summary: Urban flooding poses an escalating threat to transportation infrastructure, yet no operational system provides real-time, street-level flood-depth estimates at centimeter resolution. This paper presents three vision-language models fine-tuned for continuous flood-depth estimation from street-level imagery: FloodLlama-Dense, a fully fine-tuned QLoRA baseline, and FloodLlama-MI5 and FloodLlama-MI6, interpretability-guided sparse variants that fine-tune only the top five and six causally relevant cross-attention layers identified through mechanistic interpretability analysis, respectively. Training uses an approximately 610,000-image subset of a 2.81-million-image synthetic corpus generated in Unreal Engine 5. The dataset combines single-vehicle subsets with 5 cm depth increments and mixed-vehicle subsets with 1 cm depth increments, spanning seven vehicle types, four weather conditions, and flood depths from 0 to 40 cm. FloodLlama-Dense achieves an MAE of 0.40 cm, an RMSE of 1.97 cm, and an Acc@5cm of 97.59%. Mechanistic interpretability analysis combining linear probing, logit lens, centered kernel alignment (CKA), and cross-attention entropy reveals a two-stage adaptation pattern: layers L13-L22 restructure visual representations, while depth first becomes linearly decodable at layer L23. FloodLlama-MI5 and FloodLlama-MI6 leverage this insight by fine-tuning only five or six of the eight cross-attention layers, achieving an 86-88% reduction in trainable parameters (6.55-7.86 million versus 54.4 million) with minimal accuracy loss. On a real-world benchmark, FloodLlama-MI6 achieves 98.62% accuracy, compared with 86.61% for the published STURM-FloodDepth baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了三种用于从街景图像连续估计洪水深度的视觉-语言模型（FloodLlama系列）。通过机制可解释性分析发现关键注意力层，从而构建了仅微调少数层的稀疏变体（FloodLlama-MI5/MI6），在大幅减少参数量（减少86-88%）的同时保持了高精度。在真实世界基准测试中，FloodLlama-MI6达到了98.62%的准确率，显著优于现有基线方法。
AI.motivation: 城市内涝对交通基础设施构成日益严重的威胁，但目前缺乏能够提供厘米级分辨率、实时街道层面洪水深度估算的操作化系统。现有的解决方案无法在细粒度上满足实际需求。
AI.method:
1. **数据构建**：使用虚幻引擎5生成约281万张合成图像库，选取其中约61万张进行训练。数据集包含单车辆子集（5cm增量）和混合车辆子集（1cm增量），涵盖7种车型、4种天气条件及0-40cm的洪水深度。
2. **模型架构**：提出三个基于QLoRA微调的视觉-语言模型：
   - FloodLlama-Dense：全量微调基线模型。
   - FloodLlama-MI5 和 FloodLlama-MI6：基于机制可解释性分析，仅微调前5层和前6个因果相关的交叉注意力层的稀疏变体。
3. **可解释性分析**：结合线性探测、logit lens、中心核对齐（CKA）和交叉注意力熵，揭示了两阶段适应模式：L13-L22层重构视觉表征，L23层开始线性可解码深度信息。
AI.result:
1. **性能指标**：FloodLlama-Dense在合成数据上达到MAE 0.40 cm，RMSE 1.97 cm，Acc@5cm为97.59%。
2. **效率提升**：FloodLlama-MI5和MI6的可训练参数量从5440万减少至655万-786万（减少86-88%），且精度损失极小。
3. **现实验证**：在真实世界基准测试中，FloodLlama-MI6准确率达到98.62%，而发布的STURM-FloodDepth基线仅为86.61%。
AI.conclusion: 利用机制可解释性指导模型微调，可以在保持高精度的同时显著降低计算成本和参数规模。FloodLlama-MI6在真实场景下的优异表现证明了该方法在解决城市内涝实时监测问题上的有效性和实用性，为高分辨率洪水深度估算提供了新的技术路径。

title: Jako Tako or Fluent? Presenting PoVisLE: A Polish Vision-Language Evaluation
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance on tasks such as image captioning, visual question answering, and image-to-text generation. However, they are predominantly trained on English-centric data, which limits their ability to handle culturally grounded visual understanding and leads to failures in interpreting region-specific meanings, symbolic content, and context-dependent visual cues. Existing benchmarks for cultural competence are often template-driven and focused on surface-level recognition, making them insufficient for evaluating deeper linguistic and pragmatic understanding in culturally situated settings. We introduce PoVisLE, a monocultural vision-language benchmark for Polish designed to evaluate culturally grounded multimodal understanding under a grounded evaluation paradigm, where language is interpreted in interaction with visual context. The dataset contains 1,117 images and 2,366 manually annotated VQA pairs. Overall, our dataset provides a controlled and challenging resource for assessing culturally grounded vision-language understanding beyond surface-level recognition.

AI.tldr: 针对现有视觉语言模型(VLMs)因英语数据主导而缺乏文化理解能力的问题，本文提出了面向波兰语的单文化基准PoVisLE。该数据集包含1,117张图像和2,366个手动标注的VQA对，旨在通过结合视觉语境评估深层的语言和语用理解，弥补现有基准仅关注表面识别的不足。
AI.motivation: 现有VLMs主要基于英语中心数据训练，限制了其对文化根基视觉理解、区域特定含义及上下文依赖线索的处理能力。现有的文化能力基准多为模板驱动且侧重于表面识别，不足以评估文化情境下的深层语言和语用理解。
AI.method: 引入PoVisLE，这是一个专为波兰语设计的单文化视觉语言基准。采用“有 grounding 的评估范式”，即在视觉语境交互中解释语言。构建的数据集包含1,117张图像和2,366个手动标注的视觉问答(VQA)对。
AI.result: 提供了一个受控且具有挑战性的资源，用于评估超越表面识别的文化根基视觉语言理解能力。
AI.conclusion: PoVisLE能够有效评估文化情境下的多模态理解，特别是深层语言与语用层面，为克服现有VLMs的文化局限性提供了重要基准。

title: When LLM Agents Negotiate: Private Information and Dynamic Bargaining in Supply Chains
summary: As LLM agents move from decision support to autonomous procurement, firms need to know whether delegated negotiators create value, divide it predictably, and avoid money-losing contracts. We study this in a canonical supply chain bargaining problem: a buyer with private demand information negotiates a quantity-payment contract with an uninformed seller. We benchmark nine LLMs from OpenAI, Google, and Alibaba against a validated Perfect Bayesian Equilibrium across 9,840 LLM-to-LLM negotiations. First, capability governs value creation. Agents agree in 98.9% of negotiations and capture 95.4% of first-best surplus undiscounted, but average 2.98 rounds against the benchmark's 1.25, and this delay erodes 21-34% of surplus. Capability also governs reliability: baseline models accept individually irrational contracts in 19.2% of cases, versus 0.0-0.6% at mid-tier and flagship, making automated profit verification the binding guardrail below that threshold. Second, surplus capture is relational. Provider identity predicts who captures surplus better than capability rank: self-play buyer shares average 40% for OpenAI, 50% for Google, and 70% for Alibaba's Qwen, an ordering that survives restricted communication and no discounting. Reversing which provider sells moves the division by 7-18 percentage points, and the capable Qwen flagship is the weakest cross-family seller: vendor choice is a first-order distributional decision. Third, the prompt is a strategic lever. Delegation separates the principal's economic patience from the agent's prompted strategic patience, a free deployment choice that is the single strongest driver of surplus division (90% of explained variance). Together these establish an equilibrium-referenced audit of AI agents along three dimensions: discounted efficiency, distributional profile, and operational reliability.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过9840次LLM对LLM的谈判实验，评估了大语言模型在供应链采购中的表现。研究发现：1）能力决定价值创造与可靠性，高能力模型能捕获95.4%的最优剩余，但延迟导致21-34%的损失；2）剩余分配具有关系性，提供商身份比能力等级更能预测谁获得更大份额，且提示词是控制分配最强的策略杠杆（解释90%方差）；3）需建立基于均衡参考的审计框架，涵盖效率、分布特征和操作可靠性。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型（LLM）代理从决策支持转向自主采购，企业需要明确委托谈判者是否能创造价值、可预测地分配价值，并避免亏损合同。本研究旨在解决这一现实需求，通过在经典的供应链讨价还价问题中评估LLM的性能，为企业选择和管理AI谈判代理提供实证依据。
AI.method: 研究构建了一个买方拥有私人需求信息、卖方无信息的经典供应链议价场景，涉及数量-支付合同的谈判。研究者选取了来自OpenAI、Google和阿里巴巴的九个主流LLM，进行了9,840次LLM对LLM的谈判模拟。将LLM的表现与经过验证的完全贝叶斯纳什均衡（Perfect Bayesian Equilibrium）进行基准对比，分析维度包括协商轮次、剩余捕获率、合同理性及分配模式。
AI.result:
1. **能力与效率**：LLM在98.9%的情况下达成协议，捕获了95.4%的一阶最优剩余（未折现）。然而，平均需要2.98轮谈判才能达成一致，远高于基准的1.25轮，这种延迟侵蚀了21%-34%的剩余价值。此外，基础模型有19.2%的概率接受非理性合同，而中级和旗舰模型该比例仅为0.0%-0.6%，表明自动化利润验证是中低端模型的必要护栏。
2. **分配的关系性**：提供商身份比能力排名更能预测剩余分配。例如，OpenAI买家分享40%剩余，Google为50%，Alibaba Qwen高达70%。即使限制沟通或不折现，这一顺序依然成立。切换销售方提供商可使分配比例变动7-18个百分点，Qwen旗舰版作为跨家族卖家表现最弱，说明供应商选择是影响分配的一阶决策因素。
3. **提示词的战略作用**：委托机制分离了主体的经济耐心与代理被提示的策略耐心。提示词设计是剩余分配最强的驱动因素，解释了90%的方差。
AI.conclusion: 研究确立了一种基于均衡参考的AI代理审计框架，从折现效率、分配特征分布和操作可靠性三个维度评估LLM代理。结论强调，企业在部署LLM进行自主采购时，不仅需关注其谈判能力以最大化效率，更应重视提供商身份的选择以及提示词工程对价值分配的决定性影响，同时必须实施严格的自动利润验证以防止非理性签约风险。

title: Carnot: Interpretable, Interactive, and Optimized Execution of Deep Research Queries
comment: 4 pages, 2 figures, published as a demo paper in VLDB 2026
summary: Enterprises increasingly seek to query data lakes using natural language via AI-driven tools like semantic operators or deep research agents. However, the latter operates as an opaque black box, hiding its intermediate reasoning and data retrieval steps, and failing to expose controls for managing API costs and execution latency. Meanwhile, the former can be prohibitively expensive for enterprise-scale data lakes. Consequently, analysts using these systems lack the agency to intercept hallucinated premises, verify intermediate results, or correct the system's trajectory. We present Carnot, an interactive execution engine for AI-driven analytics. Carnot compiles natural language requests into physical execution graphs and surfaces them through an interactive notebook interface. Rather than waiting blindly for a final output, users can critique the plan, incrementally execute operators, inspect intermediate data, or directly edit the underlying code or semantic operator instructions. Carnot's query optimizer will optimize the query with respect to cost or latency constraints provided by the user. Our demo will showcase how Carnot helps users achieve efficient and verifiable insights on workloads motivated by real enterprise use cases.

AI.tldr: Carnot是一个交互式执行引擎，将自然语言查询编译为物理执行图，通过笔记本界面展示中间步骤，允许用户干预、验证和优化成本与延迟，解决现有AI分析工具黑盒且昂贵的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的AI驱动数据分析工具（如语义操作符或深度研究智能体）存在两大痛点：一是作为“黑盒”隐藏了中间推理和检索步骤，缺乏对API成本和执行延迟的控制；二是对于企业级数据湖而言，现有方案可能过于昂贵。这导致分析师无法拦截幻觉前提、验证中间结果或纠正系统轨迹。
AI.method: 提出Carnot引擎，具备以下核心功能：1. 将自然语言请求编译为物理执行图；2. 通过交互式笔记本界面暴露执行过程；3. 允许用户批评计划、增量执行算子、检查中间数据或直接编辑代码/指令；4. 集成查询优化器，根据用户提供的成本或延迟约束进行优化。
AI.result: 展示了Carnot如何帮助用户在企业级用例中实现高效且可验证的数据洞察，解决了透明度和成本控制问题。
AI.conclusion: Carnot通过提供透明的、可交互的执行环境，增强了用户对AI驱动分析过程的控制力，实现了效率与可验证性的平衡，适用于真实的企业工作负载。

title: RVANNS: Mixed-Precision Indexing and Locality-Aware Graph Traversal on RISC-V
summary:
Approximate nearest neighbor search (ANNS) on CPUs is increasingly constrained by candidate-vector movement and decoding rather than peak arithmetic throughput. Although the RISC-V Vector Extension (RVV) provides vector-length-agnostic execution and LMUL-based register grouping, generic low-precision decoding still incurs conversion overhead, while irregular graph traversal generates scattered accesses that degrade cache locality and memory-level parallelism.
  We present RVANNS, an RVV-oriented ANNS engine that jointly optimizes vector representation and graph locality. Its Mixed-Precision Multi-Layer Index (MPMI) represents each vector with a dense 8-bit affine base and sparse FP16/FP32 residuals, fusing reconstruction with distance accumulation and aligning widening with LMUL-sized register groups. ROrder co-locates likely co-visited graph nodes and sorts remapped adjacency lists, transforming scattered payload probes into denser, predominantly forward-moving address streams.
  Integrated into Milvus, RVANNS achieves 3.39x and 4.94x speedups over scalar execution on real 128-bit and 256-bit RVV processors, respectively. Under controlled HNSW configurations, it improves throughput by 2.27--2.76x over RVV SIMD+FP32 and by 1.18--1.59x over the corresponding AVX-512 and SVE baselines. On Cohere10M, it further delivers 1.82--2.27x higher QPS/W than the evaluated GPU baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出RVANNS，一种面向RISC-V向量扩展(RVV)的近似最近邻搜索(ANNS)引擎，通过混合精度索引和图结构优化，显著提升了CPU上的搜索性能。
AI.motivation: CPU上的ANNS性能主要受限于候选向量的移动和解码开销，而非算术吞吐量。现有的通用低精度解码存在转换开销，且不规则的图遍历导致缓存局部性差和内存并行度低。
AI.method:
1. 混合精度多层索引(MPMI)：使用密集8位仿射基和稀疏FP16/FP32残差表示向量，将重建与距离累加融合，并与LMUL大小的寄存器组对齐。
2. ROrder技术：共定位可能共同访问的图节点，并重排邻接表，将分散的载荷探测转化为更密集、主要向前移动的地址流，以改善缓存局部性。
AI.result: 在Milvus中集成后，RVANNS在真实的128位和256位RVV处理器上相比标量执行分别实现3.39倍和4.94倍的加速。在受控HNSW配置下，其吞吐量比RVV SIMD+FP32提高2.27-2.76倍，比相应的AVX-512和SVE基线提高1.18-1.59倍。在Cohere10M数据集上，其QPS/W（每秒查询数每瓦特）比评估的GPU基线高出1.82-2.27倍。
AI.conclusion: RVANNS通过联合优化向量表示和图局部性，有效解决了RVV架构下ANNS的性能瓶颈，实现了优于现有SIMD指令集和GPU基线的能效和吞吐量表现。

title: What to Edit Next: Visually Aligned Image-Editing Follow-Up Suggestions in Conversational Systems
summary: Conversational assistants increasingly recommend follow-up edits to help users continue a task. Existing systems primarily target text-only interactions, leaving image-creation conversations underexplored. In image-creation tasks, useful follow-up edit suggestions must reflect user preferences, offer diverse directions, and remain executable on the current image. We collected 100,000 real multi-turn image-creation conversation samples from Qwen App and found that 80.1% are image-dependent, underscoring the need for multimodal recommendation. We address this setting with a three-stage framework. In Stage 1, we use real online data to build a human-reviewed table of appropriate follow-up editing intents, then create SFT targets and fine-tune a multimodal policy. In Stage 2, to align rule-guided SFT suggestions with actual user choices, we use user click feedback to optimize the policy through multi-objective reinforcement learning. In Stage 3, to reduce visual inconsistencies between suggested edits and the current image, we introduce a visual verifier as additional training supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our framework significantly outperforms baselines on both automatic and human evaluations. In a live user-randomized A/B test with millions of users, our final framework reduces visual inconsistency from 3.7% to 0.9%. Furthermore, it significantly improves recommendation CTR by 32.70%, image take-away rate by 16.32%, and average conversation turns per user by 39.90% (all p<0.05).

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对图像创作对话的三阶段框架，用于生成高质量、可执行且符合用户偏好的后续编辑建议。通过结合真实数据微调、多目标强化学习和视觉验证器，显著提升了推荐点击率并降低了视觉不一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有对话助手主要局限于纯文本交互，忽视了图像创作场景下的多模态需求。在图像创作中，有效的后续编辑建议需反映用户偏好、提供多样化方向且具备在当前图像上执行的可行性。基于Qwen App收集的10万条真实多轮对话数据显示80.1%为图像依赖型，凸显了开发多模态推荐系统的必要性。
AI.method: 提出一个三阶段框架：1）利用在线真实数据构建人工审核的适当后续编辑意图表，创建监督微调（SFT）目标并微调多模态策略模型；2）利用用户点击反馈，通过多目标强化学习将规则引导的SFT建议与实际用户选择对齐；3）引入视觉验证器作为额外的训练监督信号，以减少建议编辑与当前图像之间的视觉不一致性。
AI.result: 实验表明该框架在自动和人工评估中均显著优于基线方法。在涉及数百万用户的线上A/B测试中，最终框架将视觉不一致性从3.7%降低至0.9%，推荐点击率（CTR）提升32.70%，图像下载率提升16.32%，用户平均对话轮次增加39.90%（所有指标p<0.05）。
AI.conclusion: 该三阶段框架有效解决了图像创作对话中的多模态推荐难题，通过结合监督微调、强化学习和视觉验证，显著优化了用户体验和系统性能，证明了多模态意图推荐在实际大规模应用中的有效性。

title: On the use of foundation models in cognitive science
summary: A host of recent studies have evaluated the cognitive and developmental alignment of Foundation Models (FMs). These investigations include evaluations of their correspondence to adult performance across a range of cognitive domains, as well as whether aspects of model training track children's cognitive development. However, using FMs as candidate cognitive models poses significant methodological and conceptual challenges. A key question underlies this effort: under what conditions does behavioral alignment justify treating FMs as explanatory models of cognition? In this paper, we articulate a four-stage inferential framework for evaluating FMs as cognitive and developmental models: adapting human experimental tasks to model-compatible formats, specifying linking hypotheses that map model outputs to human measures, evaluating behavioral correspondence, and comparing across candidate models or manipulations. We clarify the role of linking hypotheses in mapping model outputs to human behavioral measures, identify challenges that constrain alignment claims, and propose principles for theory-driven and comparative evaluation. Throughout, we argue that behavioral fit alone is insufficient. Alignment becomes scientifically meaningful only when embedded within explicit theoretical commitments, theory-diagnostic tasks, and systematic contrastive evaluation across candidate models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出评估基础模型（FMs）作为认知和发育模型的四级推断框架，强调仅凭行为拟合不足以证明其解释力，必须结合明确的理论承诺、理论诊断任务和对比评估。
AI.motivation: 尽管近期研究评估了基础模型在认知和发展上与人类的对齐情况，但将其用作候选认知模型面临显著的方法论和概念挑战，核心问题在于何种条件下行为对齐能支持将其视为认知的解释模型。
AI.method: 构建并阐述一个四级推断框架：1) 将人类实验任务调整为模型兼容格式；2) 指定将模型输出映射到人类测量值的链接假设；3) 评估行为对应关系；4) 在不同候选模型或操作之间进行比较。同时澄清链接假设的作用及对齐声明面临的挑战。
AI.result: 明确了行为拟合的局限性，指出单纯的行为一致性不足以确立FMs作为认知模型的地位；只有当对齐嵌入到显式的理论承诺、理论诊断性任务以及跨候选模型的系统性对比评估中时，这种对齐才具有科学意义。
AI.conclusion: 为了将基础模型有效地用作认知和发育的解释模型，研究者必须超越简单的行为匹配，采用基于理论的、具有对比性的评估原则，并重视链接假设在连接模型输出与人类行为数据中的关键作用。

title: TREAT: Evaluating Access to Formal Knowledge across Equivalent Mathematical Representations
comment: Accepted at 28th International Symposium on Symbolic and Numeric Algorithms for Scientific Computing (SYNASC 2026)
summary: AI systems increasingly operate between flexible input representations and formal objects used by downstream tools. A key challenge is recognizing when an unfamiliar formulation denotes a known formal object. We study this challenge through theorem recognition: given an equivalence-preserving transformation of a theorem condition, a model must recover the theorem identity associated with the standard statement. We introduce TREAT, a benchmark for evaluating whether large language models can recover known theorem identities from equivalence-preserving formula-level transformations. Rather than paraphrasing theorem text, TREAT changes the mathematical form of theorem conditions themselves, expressing known results through residual equations, witness statements, optimization identities, set relations, operator forms, and proof-intermediate characterizations. Starting from scraped theorem pages, we filter for entries with usable mathematical expression forms, extract canonical theorem conditions, and generate transformed variants with recorded assumptions and inverse mappings. The final corpus contains 737 theorem identities and 29,480 transformed rows. On a test panel, the best model retrieves the correct theorem identity in only 60.73% of cases. Other systems reveal different failure modes, including abstention, wrong detection, and malformed outputs. These suggest that theorem knowledge can be fragile under equivalent changes in representation. TREAT therefore provides a controlled testbed for evaluating representation-robust access to formal knowledge, with broader relevance to domains that require stable target objects, explicit equivalence relations, validation procedures, and auditable scoring.

AI.tldr: 提出TREAT基准测试，评估大语言模型在定理条件经过等价形式变换后，识别原始定理身份的能力。研究发现模型在此类任务中表现不佳（最佳准确率仅60.73%），揭示了形式知识在表示变化下的脆弱性。
AI.motivation: 解决AI系统在处理灵活输入表示与下游工具使用的正式对象之间的挑战，特别是当面对非标准表述时，如何识别其对应的已知正式对象（如定理）。
AI.method: 构建TREAT基准：从爬取的定理页面筛选具有可用数学表达式的条目，提取规范定理条件，并通过残差方程、见证陈述、优化恒等式、集合关系、算子形式和证明中间特征等方式生成等价变换变体，记录假设和逆映射。最终语料包含737个定理身份和29,480行变换数据。
AI.result: 在测试面板上，最佳模型仅在60.73%的情况下正确检索到定理身份。其他系统表现出拒绝回答、错误检测及输出格式错误等不同失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 定理知识在表示的等价变化下可能非常脆弱。TREAT提供了一个受控测试平台，用于评估对形式知识的表示鲁棒性访问，适用于需要稳定目标对象、显式等价关系、验证程序和可审计评分的领域。

title: DREAM Technical Report
summary: Industrial recommender systems commonly use cascaded retrieval, ranking, and re-ranking pipelines. Although efficient, these pipelines fragment information and objectives across modules, rely on rigid rules, and have limited awareness of real-time intent, leaving session-level shifts among browsing, comparison, and purchase insufficiently addressed. We present DREAM (Developing Recommender Engine with Agentic Methods), an autonomous optimization control architecture that adds a perception-aware, orchestrable, and auditable policy layer atop existing pipelines without replacing them. DREAM has two core components. First, a three-tier Intent Engine fuses on-device signals into structured L0/L1/L2 intent representations; its edge-cloud trigger chain reduces reporting volume to approximately 8.7%. Second, a Meta Engine uses a MetaModel for layered M1-to-M2-to-M3 reasoning: intent summarization, strategy planning informed by Strategy Memory, and parameter translation. It dispatches the resulting parameters through a unified outlet with safety guardrails. A Reward Dual Loop continuously optimizes both components by combining offline simulation for strategy-space exploration with online feedback for outcome calibration, forming a cycle of generation, execution, evaluation, and experience accumulation. Large-scale A/B tests on Taobao's homepage feed show that re-ranking control alone improves IPV by 2.06%, Core IPV by 2.39%, and GMV by 0.88%. Extending control to fine ranking raises these gains to 2.71%, 3.06%, and 1.31%, respectively, while consistently improving PV by more than 1%. These gains require neither replacement of pipeline models nor compromise of serving stability, supporting agentic meta-control as a viable paradigm for industrial recommendation.

AI.tldr: 提出DREAM架构，通过感知意图引擎和元引擎对现有推荐流水线进行自主优化控制，无需替换原有模型即可显著提升淘宝首页的IPV、核心IPV及GMV。
AI.motivation: 解决传统级联推荐系统（检索、排序、重排）中信息碎片化、目标割裂、依赖刚性规则以及对实时用户意图感知不足的问题，特别是难以应对会话内浏览、比较和购买阶段的动态变化。
AI.method: 构建DREAM（Developing Recommender Engine with Agentic Methods），包含两个核心组件：1) 三层意图引擎：融合设备信号生成结构化意图表示，并通过端云触发链将上报量降低至8.7%；2) 元引擎：利用MetaModel进行分层推理（意图总结、策略规划、参数翻译），结合策略记忆和安全护栏分发参数。采用奖励双循环机制，结合离线模拟探索与在线反馈校准，实现持续优化。
AI.result: 在淘宝首页的大规模A/B测试中，仅重排控制使IPV提升2.06%，核心IPV提升2.39%，GMV提升0.88%；扩展至细粒度排序后，各项指标分别提升至2.71%、3.06%和1.31%，且PV持续提升超1%。
AI.conclusion: DREAM架构证明了代理式元控制（agentic meta-control）作为工业推荐系统优化范式的可行性，能够在不替换现有流水线模型且不牺牲服务稳定性的前提下，显著提升业务指标。

title: Temporal Generalization in fNIRS-Based Autism Classification: A Cross-Time-Window Transfer Benchmark
summary: Functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) is a promising modality for autism spectrum disorder (ASD) classification, yet existing approaches assume temporally aligned evaluation. In practice, the optimal observation window varies across subjects due to differences in hemodynamic delay and neurovascular coupling, creating a temporal distribution shift that degrades performance. We formalize this as a \textit{cross-time-window transfer problem}, introducing a protocol that varies window length (2.5--10\,s) and offset within biological motion trials. Using topographic map representations of fNIRS recordings, we benchmark three vision architectures under two zero-shot baselines and eight adaptation strategies under leave-one-subject-out cross-validation ($N{=}124$). Key findings: (1) zero-shot cross-window accuracy is near chance (54--69\%); (2) ${\approx}5\%$ subject-specific fine-tuning recovers 90--96\%, while a subject-specific upper bound reaches 97--100\%, identifying inter-subject variability as the dominant barrier; (3) domain-adversarial and self-supervised strategies achieve 78--90\% without target-subject data; and (4) discriminative information is recoverable from windows as short as 2.5\,s. These findings provide a practical roadmap for deploying fNIRS-based ASD classifiers under realistic temporal variability.

AI.tldr: 针对fNIRS分类ASD时因个体血流动力学差异导致的时间窗口分布偏移问题，提出跨时间窗口迁移方案。研究表明零样本性能接近随机猜测，但通过少量受试者微调或领域对抗/自监督策略可显著提升准确率，且短至2.5秒的窗口即可恢复判别信息，为实际部署提供指导。
AI.motivation: 现有fNIRS自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）分类方法假设时间对齐评估，但在实践中，由于个体间血流动力学延迟和神经血管耦合的差异，最佳观察窗口各不相同，造成时间分布偏移并降低模型性能。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为“跨时间窗口迁移问题”，在生物运动试验中引入变化的窗口长度（2.5--10秒）和偏移量。利用fNIRS记录的地形图表示，在124名受试者的留一法交叉验证下，基准测试三种视觉架构、两种零样本基线及八种适应策略。
AI.result: (1) 零样本跨窗口准确率接近随机水平（54--69%）；(2) 约5%的受试者特定微调可将准确率恢复至90--96%，而受试者特定上限可达97--100%，表明个体间变异性是主要障碍；(3) 无需目标受试者数据，领域对抗和自监督策略可实现78--90%的准确率；(4) 从短至2.5秒的窗口中即可恢复判别信息。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果为在现实时间变异性下部署基于fNIRS的ASD分类器提供了实用路线图，强调了处理个体间差异对于提升模型泛化能力的重要性。

title: "Many Are My Names": The Anatomy of the Assistant and Its Personas via Sparse Autoencoders
summary: How a language model internally represents who is speaking, the Assistant, an assigned roleplay persona, or a narrated story character, remains underexplored. We study speaker representations using a dataset of user-expressed emotional text and corresponding model responses. We decompose three generation settings (Assistant, Roleplay, and Story) into sparse autoencoder features extracted at turn-boundary and pronoun-token positions and selected through a filtering pipeline for different depths. We characterize each surviving feature through its steering effects and activation distribution. Our main finding is that the Assistant and roleplay personas are not independent alternatives: personas retain the Assistant-associated feature core while progressively differentiating from it across layers, starting from operational machinery towards behavioral and stylistic features. Meanwhile, generated story characters lack the Assistant-associated core. Both Story and Roleplay can be distinguished from the Assistant with Immersive Simulation Mode. However, the Assistant can sometimes enter or slowly drift into it even in the default setting.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过稀疏自编码器分析语言模型内部对“助手”、“角色扮演”和“故事叙述”三种生成设置中说话者身份的内部表征。研究发现，角色人格并非独立于助手存在，而是保留助手的特征核心并随层深逐渐分化；而故事角色则缺乏这一核心。此外，“沉浸式模拟模式”可有效区分故事/角色扮演与助手，但默认设置下的助手也可能漂移进入该模式。
AI.motivation: 目前关于语言模型如何在内部表征不同说话者身份（如助手、指定角色扮演人格或叙述性故事角色）的研究尚不充分，需要深入探究其内部机制。
AI.method: 使用包含用户表达情感文本及对应模型响应的数据集，将三种生成设置分解为在回合边界和代词token位置提取的稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征。通过针对不同深度的过滤管道筛选特征，并通过引导效应和激活分布来表征每个保留下来的特征。
AI.result: 1. 助手与角色扮演人格并非独立替代方案：角色人格保留了与助手相关的特征核心，并随着网络层深的增加，从操作机制向行为和风格特征逐渐分化。2. 生成的故事角色缺乏与助手相关的特征核心。3. “沉浸式模拟模式”可将故事和角色扮演与助手区分开来，但在默认设置下，助手有时也会进入或缓慢漂移至该模式。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型在不同生成设置下的说话者表征具有层级性和关联性。助手特征是角色扮演的基础，而故事叙述则采用不同的表征路径。理解这些内部表征有助于更好地控制和优化模型在不同交互场景下的行为表现。

title: An AI Scientist that Doesn't Drift: Taste, Structure, and Falsifiable Findings in a Quadruped Navigation Research Loop
summary: Autonomous research loops driven by large language models can run machine-learning experiments at scale but tend to drift toward local refinements of whichever metric they optimise rather than testing the hypotheses that motivate the experiments. We address this structurally and present an AI Scientist for studying generalisation in quadruped robot navigation policies in simulation. Building on the autoresearch paradigm of Karpathy, our loop adds three components: an immutable experiment card that pairs each iteration's prediction with its outcome under a fixed schema, so a falsified hypothesis cannot be retconned; specialised subagents restricted to mechanical roles; and kkanbu, a preference oracle that holds the user's research taste as a typed knowledge graph and is the only component permitted to make subjective judgements. To isolate the oracle we run the identical loop twice across eleven research streams, with and without kkanbu. Neither arm drifts: both falsify roughly three quarters of their own hypotheses, and the best trained policy comes from the oracle-less arm. What the oracle changes is direction, not score: it alone explores test-time adaptation, it authored the winning designs where its arm led, and it carried lessons across streams that the other arm repeatedly re-derived. The scaffold keeps the loop honest; kkanbu decides where it looks.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为“AI Scientist”的自主研究循环系统，用于四足机器人导航策略的泛化研究。该系统通过引入不可变实验卡片、专用子代理和偏好预言机（kkanbu）来解决大语言模型驱动的实验易陷入局部优化的问题。实验表明，虽然无预言机的循环在最终性能上略优，但预言机能有效引导研究方向，避免重复劳动并促进跨流派的经验迁移。
AI.motivation: 解决由大型语言模型驱动的自主研究循环在大规模运行机器学习实验时，倾向于针对特定指标进行局部优化，而非验证实验背后假设的问题。
AI.method: 基于Karpathy的自动研究范式，构建了包含三个核心组件的研究循环：1) 不可变实验卡（固定模式配对预测与结果，防止假设被事后修改）；2) 受限的专用子代理（仅执行机械角色）；3) kkanbu（作为持有用户研究品味的类型化知识图谱的偏好预言机，唯一拥有主观判断权）。通过在11个研究流中分别运行有和无kkanbu的两个相同循环进行对比实验。
AI.result: 两个循环均未出现漂移，均证伪了约四分之三的自身假设。无预言机的循环产生了最佳训练策略。然而，有预言机的循环在方向上表现出显著差异：它单独探索了测试时适应（test-time adaptation），其主导的设计获得了胜利，并且成功将经验教训跨流派传递，而无预言机的循环则反复重新推导这些教训。
AI.conclusion: 该架构保持了研究循环的严谨性（诚实性），而kkanbu决定了研究的方向。预言机虽未直接提升单一指标分数，但在引导探索方向、避免重复研究和促进知识迁移方面发挥了关键作用。

title: Towards Researcher Agents for Knowledge-Graph Question Answering
comment: Second International TEXT2SPARQL Challenge, co-located with Text2KG at ESWC 2026
summary: Translating a natural-language question into a SPARQL query that can be executed against a large knowledge graph requires resolving lexical ambiguity, grounding surface terms in the target ontology, and producing graph patterns that are both syntactically valid and semantically faithful. We present an agentic text-to-SPARQL system that goes one step beyond static tool-using agents: a researcher agent that, after each round of inference on a validation set, proposes and tests changes to its own prompts, rules, and tool-orchestration code. We instantiate the loop on DBpedia, evolve nine successive versions of the agent driven by a low-cost reasoning model, and deploy the best-performing configuration with two stronger backbone models. The study yields three observations: (i) self-improvement converges quickly and then achieves 0.22 overall accuracy on the 2025 DBpedia validation set; (ii) the bottleneck is consistently in basic-graph-pattern predicate selection, not in SPARQL syntax or modifiers; and (iii) several benchmark items appear to penalise correct queries due to property ambiguity in DBpedia, suggesting that future Text-to-SPARQL benchmarks should be scored using a combination of machine translation and information retrieval metrics.

AI.tldr: 提出一种具备自我进化能力的文本到SPARQL智能体系统，通过迭代优化提示词和工具代码，在DBpedia数据集上实现性能提升，并指出当前基准测试中属性歧义导致的评分偏差问题。
AI.motivation: 解决自然语言问题转换为SPARQL查询时面临的词汇消歧、本体锚定及语法语义一致性挑战，突破传统静态工具使用智能体的局限。
AI.method: 构建一个研究者智能体（researcher agent），在验证集推理后自动提议并测试对提示词、规则及工具编排代码的修改；在DBpedia上经历九次版本迭代，最终部署基于更强骨干模型的最佳配置。
AI.result: 自我改进快速收敛，在2025 DBpedia验证集上达到0.22的整体准确率；主要瓶颈在于基本图模式的谓词选择而非SPARQL语法；发现部分基准项因DBpedia属性歧义而错误惩罚正确查询。
AI.conclusion: Text-to-SPARQL基准测试应结合机器翻译和信息检索指标进行评分，以解决属性歧义带来的评估不公问题。

title: MetaStrategy: Generative Ranking with Executable LLM Strategies
summary: Industrial recommender systems rank heterogeneous content under coupled user, business, commercial, and experience objectives. Existing generative ranking methods typically construct item sequences directly, making them difficult to integrate with mature predictive models, operational rules, and field-level guardrails. We present MetaStrategy, a framework that instead generates a structured, executable ranking strategy. Conditioned on request context, a large language model (LLM) policy emits a typed JSON bundle controlling objective weights, content and category preferences, experience constraints, and position policies. A deterministic validator and compiler instantiate an isolated Generator that competes atomically with incumbents under the list-level Evaluator of the Generator-Evaluator (GE) architecture. We train the policy in a production-path replay environment that re-executes logged requests through the current re-ranking stack without user exposure. The method combines selection, relative-rank, and baseline-lift rewards, a self-competitive curriculum that feeds frequent strategies back as competitors, and Evaluator-routed reward-augmented on-policy distillation that transfers complementary 4B-parameter Teachers into a compact 0.8B-parameter Student. We deploy MetaStrategy in Taobao Homepage Guess You Like through diff-triggered nearline generation; LLM inference remains outside synchronous ranking, with no observable increase in response time (RT). In a seven-day user-randomized online A/B test, MetaStrategy wins 27.93% of treatment-side GE calls and significantly improves click page views (click PV) by 2.11%, item-detail page views (IPV) by 3.12%, and transaction amount by 2.83%.

AI.tldr: MetaStrategy 是一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的工业级推荐排序框架，通过生成结构化的可执行排序策略（JSON格式），解决了传统生成式排序难以集成现有预测模型和业务规则的问题。该方法在淘宝“猜你喜欢”中部署，通过离线训练和在线A/B测试验证，显著提升了点击率、详情页浏览量和交易额。
AI.motivation: 现有的生成式排序方法通常直接构建物品序列，导致难以与成熟的预测模型、运营规则及业务层面的约束条件（guardrails）有效集成。为了克服这一局限性，需要一种能够生成结构化、可执行排序策略的方法，以便更好地融入现有的推荐系统架构。
AI.method:
1. **策略生成**：利用LLM作为策略网络，根据请求上下文生成包含目标权重、内容/类别偏好、体验约束和位置策略的键入JSON束。
2. **评估架构**：采用生成器-评估器（Generator-Evaluator, GE）架构。确定性验证器和编译器实例化一个隔离的生成器，与现有基线系统在列表级别的评估器下进行原子竞争。
3. **训练环境**：在生产路径回放环境中进行训练，重新执行日志中的请求通过当前的重排堆栈，且不暴露给用户。
4. **奖励机制**：结合选择奖励、相对排名奖励和基线提升奖励。
5. **课程学习**：采用自竞争课程学习，将频繁使用的策略反馈作为竞争对手。
6. **知识蒸馏**：使用评估器路由的奖励增强在线策略蒸馏，将互补的40亿参数教师模型迁移至紧凑的8亿参数学生模型。
7. **部署方式**：通过差异触发的近线生成部署于淘宝首页，LLM推理位于同步排序之外，不增加响应时间（RT）。
AI.result: 在七天的用户随机在线A/B测试中，MetaStrategy在27.93%的处理侧GE调用中胜出。关键指标显著提升：点击页面浏览量（Click PV）提升2.11%，商品详情页浏览量（IPV）提升3.12%，交易金额提升2.83%。同时，由于LLM推理异步处理，未观察到响应时间的增加。
AI.conclusion: MetaStrategy成功地将LLM生成的结构化策略应用于工业级推荐排序，既保持了系统的低延迟和高兼容性，又通过复杂的奖励机制和知识蒸馏技术实现了显著的线上效果提升。这证明了生成式策略优于直接生成物品序列的方法，为未来推荐系统提供了新的范式。

title: Latent-Frequency Validity: Fast Spectral Editing with Screened Video-VAE Transfer Operators
summary: Direct spectral editing in video-VAE latents can control noise, flicker, smoothness, and frequency content without a decode--filter--reencode pass. However, video VAEs may redistribute pixel-space frequency bands across latent channels, and latent edits can disrupt VAE round-trip dynamics. We introduce \emph{latent-frequency validity} (LFV), which learns a compact VAE-specific spectral response and deploys it only when it improves decoded-target fidelity without worsening round-trip drift. LFV follows a validation-selected path from a diagonal per-frequency calibrator (C1) to full channel mixing (CM), making cross-channel capacity a controllable per-edit resource. Across 544 VAE--edit cells spanning six spectral families, LFV emits 423 cheap operators: 277 are handled by C1, while 146 (34.5\% of emitted operators) require channel mixing. On the primary 120-cell radial sweep, 99/100 emitted operators pass source-video-grouped held-out evaluation. Across five additional filter families, all 323 emitted operators pass held-out evaluation. Fully frozen OpenVid-fitted operators, including the validation-selected path coefficient, pass all 20 tested CogVideoX and HunyuanVideo generated-domain cells without adaptation. The selected response matches direct latent-filter latency and is about $3\times$ faster than pixel filter--reencode. The resulting maps reveal distinct VAE regimes, including strongly channel-coupled CogVideoX responses and a sharp Open-Sora high-band stability frontier.

AI.tldr: 提出LFV（潜在频率有效性）方法，通过学习VAE特定的频谱响应并动态选择编辑路径，在视频VAE潜空间中实现直接光谱编辑。该方法避免了传统的解码-滤波-重编码循环，显著提升了处理速度（比像素滤波快3倍），同时保持了高保真度，并在多个模型和滤波器家族中验证了其有效性和泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 直接对视频VAE潜空间进行光谱编辑可以控制噪声、闪烁、平滑度和频率内容，无需经过耗时的“解码-滤波-重编码”流程。然而，视频VAE可能会将像素空间的频带重新分配到不同的潜通道中，且潜空间编辑可能破坏VAE的往返重建动力学特性，导致质量下降或漂移。因此，需要一种既能利用潜空间编辑效率，又能保证重建质量和稳定性的方法。
AI.method:
引入“潜在频率有效性”（Latent-Frequency Validity, LFV）机制：
1. 学习紧凑的VAE特定频谱响应。
2. 部署时仅在能提升解码目标保真度且不恶化往返漂移时才应用。
3. 采用验证选择的混合路径：从对角每频率校准器（C1，低成本操作）到全通道混合（CM，高成本但必要）。
4. 将跨通道容量作为每个编辑的可控资源。
5. 使用冻结的OpenVid拟合算子，包括验证选择的路径系数，直接应用于生成域单元格，无需适应。
AI.result:
1. 在涵盖6个光谱家族的544个VAE-编辑单元格上，LFV生成了423个低成本算子：其中277个由C1处理，146个（34.5%）需要通道混合。
2. 在主测试集（120个单元格的径向扫描）上，100个发射算子中有99个通过源视频分组的保留评估。
3. 在另外5个滤波器家族中，所有323个发射算子均通过保留评估。
4. 完全冻结的OpenVid拟合算子（含路径系数）在20个CogVideoX和HunyuanVideo生成的域单元格上无需适应即可通过所有测试。
5. 延迟性能与直接潜空间滤波相当，速度约为像素滤波-重编码方法的3倍。
6. 揭示了对应不同VAE特性的独特模式，如CogVideoX的强通道耦合响应和Open-Sora的高频稳定性前沿。
AI.conclusion: LFV方法有效地解决了视频VAE潜空间直接编辑中的频率重分布和往返漂移问题。通过自适应选择编辑路径，它在保持高保真度和稳定性的同时，实现了接近实时的高效处理。该方法具有强大的泛化能力，无需针对新模型进行调整即可在多种视频生成模型上表现优异，为高效视频后处理提供了新的解决方案。

title: SurakshaEval: An Indic Safety Benchmark for Multilingual LLMs
summary: Existing safety evaluation datasets for large language models (LLMs) predominantly focus on English and Western contexts, often overlooking the linguistic diversity and culturally grounded safety risks present in other languages. To address this gap, we introduce SurakshaEval, a novel safety benchmark composed of human-written prompts spanning real-world scenarios, explicitly designed for ten major Indian languages - Assamese, Bengali, Gujarati, Hindi, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Punjabi, Tamil, and Telugu, along with English. SurakshaEval includes both generic prompts common across India and region- and language-specific prompts that capture localized sociocultural sensitivities. We benchmark a broad range of state-of-the-art LLMs on SurakshaEval, establish baseline safety performance, and identify recurring failure modes, including over-refusal, missed detection of implicit bias, and insufficient contextual awareness in regionally sensitive settings. Our results show that even strong multilingual LLMs struggle to reliably meet nuanced safety requirements when operating in Indic languages, particularly in native scripts. These findings highlight the urgent need for safety evaluation frameworks that incorporate region-specific data and structured assessment protocols, enabling the development and deployment of AI systems that operate securely, ethically, and in alignment with diverse societal values. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/debobanerjee/SurakshaEval. Warning: This paper contains text that may be offensive or unsafe.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SurakshaEval，首个针对十种主要印度语言及英语的大语言模型安全基准测试。该数据集包含通用和区域特定提示，旨在解决现有LLM安全评估过度关注英语和西方语境的问题。实验表明，即使是强大的多语言模型在印度语言（尤其是原生脚本）的安全合规性上仍存在显著不足，暴露出过度拒绝、隐性偏见漏检等问题，强调了建立区域特异性安全评估框架的紧迫性。
AI.motivation: 现有的大语言模型（LLM）安全评估数据集主要集中在英语和西方语境，忽视其他语言的 linguistic diversity 和文化根基的安全风险。为了填补这一空白，需要构建一个专门针对非西方语言环境（特别是印度多语言环境）的安全评估基准。
AI.method: 构建了SurakshaEval基准测试，包含由人工编写的、覆盖真实场景的提示词。数据涵盖十种主要印度语言（阿萨姆语、孟加拉语、古吉拉特语、印地语、卡纳达语、马拉雅拉姆语、马拉地语、旁遮普语、泰米尔语、泰卢固语）以及英语。提示词分为跨印度的通用提示和捕捉本地社会文化敏感性的区域/语言特定提示。在此基础上，对广泛的前沿LLM进行基准测试，建立基线安全性能并识别失败模式。
AI.result:
1. 建立了各主流LLM在SurakshaEval上的基线安全表现。
2. 识别出重复出现的失败模式：过度拒绝（over-refusal）、隐性偏见的漏检（missed detection of implicit bias）以及在区域敏感场景下上下文意识不足。
3. 结果显示，即使是最强的多语言LLM在处理印度语言（特别是原生脚本）时，也难以可靠地满足细微的安全要求。
AI.conclusion: 当前的安全评估框架亟需纳入区域特定数据和结构化的评估协议。这对于开发和安全部署符合多样化社会价值观、具备伦理安全性的人工智能系统至关重要。研究代码和数据已开源。

title: The Field Knows: Cross-Dimensional Geometry from Navigation to Black Holes
summary: We introduce a continuous metric field framework trained by a single causal contrastive loss. The framework encodes a scene into coefficients of a fixed symmetric matrix basis, assembles them into a Lie algebra element, and exponentiates the result to a Riemannian or Lorentzian metric. Across dimensions, this field discovers the full spectrum of geometric structures: from obstacle-avoiding geodesics in robot navigation across planar and manipulator configuration spaces, to event horizons of black holes in Lorentzian spacetime. Extensive zero-shot generalization studies demonstrate that the field captures transferable geometric structure rather than memorizing specific configurations. In the black hole setting, the causal loss spontaneously evolves genuine black-hole-like structures with the correct Lorentzian signature. The same loss, the same architecture, and the same training protocol produce the full range of geometric phenomena across dimensions. The field knows geometry, and geometry knows physics.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于因果对比损失的连续度量场框架，通过李代数和李群指数映射生成黎曼或洛伦兹度量。该框架在不同维度下能自动发现从机器人导航到黑洞事件视界的全谱几何结构，展现出强大的零样本泛化能力和跨领域的几何-物理统一表征能力。
AI.motivation: 旨在构建一个统一的框架，能够仅通过单一的因果对比损失，在不同维度和不同应用场景（如机器人导航、时空物理）中，自动学习并编码复杂的几何结构和物理规律，而非记忆特定配置。
AI.method: 1. 将场景编码为固定对称矩阵基底的系数；2. 将这些系数组装成李代数元素；3. 对李代数元素进行指数映射，生成黎曼或洛伦兹度量场；4. 使用单一的因果对比损失进行端到端训练。
AI.result: 1. 在机器人导航中，成功学习到避开障碍物的测地线；2. 在洛伦兹时空中，自发演化出具有正确度规符号的黑洞-like结构及事件视界；3. 广泛的零样本泛化测试表明，模型捕捉到了可迁移的几何结构而非过拟合；4. 相同的架构、损失和训练协议适用于多种几何现象。
AI.conclusion: 该框架证明了“场知道几何，几何知道物理”，即通过统一的数学形式（李代数/群）和单一的因果约束，可以跨维度、跨领域地涌现出从经典力学到广义相对论的丰富几何与物理结构。

title: Guixu: Valuation-Driven Data Discovery for Autonomous AI Agents with On-Chain Attestation
comment: This paper has been accepted for presentation at VLDB 2026
summary: Autonomous agents increasingly rely on external data to complete downstream tasks such as model training and decision support. However, existing data discovery systems remain largely retrieval-oriented: they surface candidate datasets from heterogeneous sources, but provide limited support for estimating task-specific utility, selecting cost-effective datasets under budget constraints, or incorporating trustworthy feedback from prior usage. This paper presents Guixu, a valuation-driven data discovery system for autonomous agents. Guixu employs a three-phase valuation pipeline with proxy-label propagation and multi-round knapsack optimization for task-aware data valuation. Guixu integrates agentic payment protocol to enable budget-constrained data procurement workflows. Guixu leverages on-chain data market and attestation signals for verifiable data discovery. Our demonstration highlights how Guixu enables an agent to move beyond keyword-based dataset retrieval toward task- and budget-aware, trustworthy data discovery and procurement. Attendees can interactively explore the full workflow, from NL task specification and multi-source search to data valuation and verifiable transaction feedback.

AI.tldr: Guixu是一个面向自主智能体的估值驱动数据发现系统，通过三阶段估值流程和链上验证机制，实现任务感知、预算约束及可信的数据采购。
AI.motivation: 现有数据发现系统主要侧重于检索，缺乏对特定任务效用评估、预算约束下数据集选择以及基于历史使用的可信反馈支持，难以满足自主智能体在模型训练和决策支持中的复杂需求。
AI.method: 提出Guixu系统，采用包含代理标签传播和多轮背包优化的三阶段估值管道进行任务感知数据估值；集成智能体支付协议以支持预算受限的数据采购流程；利用链上数据市场和证明信号实现可验证的数据发现。
AI.result: 展示了Guixu如何使智能体从基于关键字的检索转变为任务与预算感知、可信的数据发现与采购；演示了从自然语言任务指定、多源搜索到数据估值及可验证交易反馈的完整工作流。
AI.conclusion: Guixu通过结合任务感知估值、预算优化和区块链验证，有效解决了自主智能体在数据获取过程中的效用评估、成本控制及信任问题，提升了数据发现的智能化与可靠性。

title: TSPORec: Token Selection via Preference Optimization for LLM-Based Sequential Recommendation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as powerful tools for improving recommendation systems. The effectiveness of LLMs arises from their ability to harness rich textual information and their capacity to model heterogeneous user preferences based on users' interaction history. However, due to the large-scale and deep architectures, LLM-based sequential recommendation approaches generally incur high inference costs, resulting in a low return on investment. To mitigate this cost, many existing approaches resort to using only the first few tokens of item descriptions, which inadvertently discards valuable information contained in the full text, thereby leading to suboptimal recommendation performance. To address this limitation, we propose a novel Token Selection approach for Preference Optimization in LLM-based sequential Recommendation, i.e., TSPORec, which accurately pinpoints informative tokens throughout the entire textual content to improve recommendation performance. Specifically, we design a three-stage pipeline to select informative tokens and introduce a novel proxy reward to facilitate the implementation. TSPORec not only enhances recommendation performance but also improves computational efficiency. Extensive experiments across two models and datasets demonstrate the superb performance (up to 31.25%) and efficiency (up to 63.4%) of our approach compared with six baseline approaches. Code is available at https://github.com/WNQzhu/TSPORec.git.

AI.tldr: 提出TSPORec，一种基于大语言模型的序列推荐方法，通过三阶段管道和代理奖励机制精准选择全文中的信息性Token，在提升推荐性能的同时显著降低推理成本。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM-based序列推荐方法因模型规模大而推理成本高；为降低成本，现有方法常仅使用物品描述的前几个Token，导致丢弃全文中宝贵信息，造成推荐性能次优。
AI.method: 提出TSPORec（Token Selection for Preference Optimization in LLM-based sequential Recommendation），设计三阶段流水线以选择信息性Token，并引入新颖的代理奖励（proxy reward）机制来辅助实现该过程。
AI.result: 在两个模型和数据集上的广泛实验表明，与六种基线方法相比，TSPORec在推荐性能上最高提升31.25%，在计算效率上最高提升63.4%。
AI.conclusion: TSPORec通过精准定位全文中的信息性Token，有效平衡了LLM推荐系统的性能与计算效率，解决了传统截断方法信息丢失的问题。

title: COMEX: A Composition-Grounded Benchmark and Learning Framework for Explainable Aesthetic Image Cropping
summary: Explainable aesthetic image cropping requires not only localizing a visually pleasing crop but also explaining why it is preferred. Existing crop-and-explain methods largely treat explanation as post-hoc text generation and overlook composition, a key aesthetic factor that links crop decisions with interpretable reasoning. In this paper, we reformulate explainable aesthetic image cropping as a structured crop-composition-explanation problem. To support this setting, we introduce COMEX, a new benchmark built through image expansion and an IO-reversal pipeline. COMEX contains 33,161 quadruples, each consisting of an expanded image, a crop box, a composition category, and a composition-grounded explanation, enabling joint learning of crop localization, composition understanding, and explanation generation. We further propose a two-stage SFT+GRPO framework, where supervised fine-tuning establishes the structured output protocol and basic cropping ability, and GRPO further improves crop quality, composition prediction, and explanation faithfulness. We benchmark 15 large vision-language models and existing cropping methods on COMEX, establishing a comprehensive testbed for composition-grounded explainable aesthetic cropping. Experiments on both COMEX and prior benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and transferability of our framework, with strong performance across evaluation metrics.

AI.tldr: 提出COMEX基准和SFT+GRPO框架，将可解释美学图像裁剪重构为结构化的“裁剪-构图-解释”联合学习任务，显著提升裁剪质量与解释的忠实度。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将解释视为后验文本生成，忽视了“构图”这一连接裁剪决策与可解释推理的关键美学因素，导致缺乏对审美偏好的深层结构化理解。
AI.method: 1. 构建COMEX基准：通过图像扩展和IO逆转流水线生成33,161个包含扩展图像、裁剪框、构图类别及构图 grounding 解释的四元组数据。2. 提出两阶段SFT+GRPO框架：监督微调（SFT）建立结构化输出协议和基本裁剪能力；广义奖励策略优化（GRPO）进一步优化裁剪质量、构图预测及解释忠实度。
AI.result: 在COMEX及先前基准上评估了15个大视觉语言模型及现有裁剪方法。实验结果表明，所提框架在各项评估指标上均表现出强大的性能，并具有良好的有效性及跨基准的可迁移性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建立了首个面向构图接地可解释美学裁剪的综合测试床，证明了结构化联合学习在提升图像裁剪审美质量及解释可解释性方面的显著效果。

title: Detection of Self-Introductions in Legislative Testimony
comment: Presented at AAIRC-AI4 conference, Las Vegas, NV, USA August 2026 https://ai4.io/aairc-ai4/
summary: Self-introductions are common in legislative committee testimonies. Successfully detecting them and extracting the speaker's name is enormously helpful in the task of speaker identification in the context of government meetings. In this paper, we present a pipeline for detection of self-introductions in legislative committee testimony using machine learning. We construct a training dataset from 1.54 million utterances spanning five state legislative sessions, apply a name-matching heuristic to generate automatic labels, and train three classifiers: a decision tree, random forest, and XGBoost to find self-introductions and extract the speaker's name. We construct a feature set combining bag-of-words, positional context, structural signals, introductory phrase indicators, and discourse context features. Among the three classifiers, XGBoost achieves the best performance with an F1 score of 0.9747 and the fewest total errors; adding fine-tuned BERT probability features improves this further. As an extension, we score the full candidate dataset with a fine-tuned BERT classifier and add BERT probability outputs as features. This BERT-augmented XGBoost model improves F1 from 0.9747 to 0.9782 and reduces total test errors from 241 to 207. The primary gain over the decision tree baseline (F1 0.9323) is driven by discourse context features and the boosting ensemble strategy; BERT provides a modest complementary signal. Analysis of false positives reveals that a minority are genuine self-introductions mislabeled due to name inconsistencies in the source data, indicating that measured metrics modestly understate true performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合XGBoost与微调BERT的机器学习流水线，用于从立法委员会证词中自动检测自我介绍并提取演讲者姓名。在154万句语料上训练，最终模型F1分数达到0.9782，显著优于基线决策树（0.9323）。
AI.motivation: 在政府会议语境下的说话人识别任务中，准确检测立法委员会证词中的自我介绍并提取演讲者姓名至关重要。
AI.method: 构建了包含词袋、位置上下文、结构信号、引言短语指示器和话语上下文的特征集；使用名称匹配启发式方法生成自动标签；训练了决策树、随机森林和XGBoost三种分类器，并将微调BERT的概率输出作为额外特征加入XGBoost模型。
AI.result: XGBoost表现最佳（F1 0.9747）；引入BERT概率特征后，XGBoost增强模型的F1提升至0.9782，测试错误数从241降至207。主要性能提升源于话语上下文特征和集成策略，BERT提供辅助增益。
AI.conclusion: 该混合模型有效提升了自我介绍检测精度；误报分析显示部分错误源于数据源中的姓名不一致，表明实际性能可能略高于测量指标。

title: TeXFix-Bench: An Empirically Grounded Multi-Format Benchmark for LLM-Based Document Source Repair
summary: Scientific and technical writing depends on markup sources that must compile: LaTeX, Typst, and Markdown pipelines fail on missing delimiters, mismatched environments, broken imports, or package conflicts. Existing document-repair evaluations inject faults with ad-hoc edits that lack an empirical fault model. We present TeXFix-Bench, a multi-format benchmark for LLM-based full-source document repair grounded in a mined fault taxonomy. A Grounded-Theory study of localized hard-crash LaTeX faults from TeX Stack Exchange, GitHub commits, and package documentation (168 verified faults, dual open coding at $κ$=0.34) yields an 18-category taxonomy instantiated as DocMut: 48 AST-aware operators across three formats. A three-model cross-benchmark shows DocMut faults are 5.6-9.2 pp harder to repair than pattern-based mutations on the same seeds, and a real-error case study (88 mined human crashes, 67.0% repair success) brackets both synthetic sets from below. We construct 10,437 instances from 743 openly licensed seeds and evaluate seven LLMs under a fixed zero-shot protocol with provider-pinned routing, collecting 48,651 attempts at about USD 200 total inference cost. A complete 6,613-instance x 7-model balanced matrix confirms all rankings. A pinned engine gate yields a 27.5-point intention-to-treat compile spread (56.7-84.2%). Typst is markedly harder than LaTeX and Markdown. A restoration oracle over 28,129 compiling repairs shows that 13.6-18.5% of compiling repairs materially alter document text, and restoration rank diverges from compile rank: the model with the lowest compile rate restores content best among its successes. Compile success alone overstates repair quality. We release the taxonomy, DocMut, and all campaign artifacts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了TeXFix-Bench，一个基于真实故障分类学的多格式（LaTeX, Typst, Markdown）LLM文档修复基准。研究发现Typst修复难度最大，且编译成功并不等同于内容修复质量高，部分模型在编译率低的情况下反而能更好地保留原文内容。
AI.motivation: 现有的文档修复评估缺乏实证故障模型，主要依赖人为注入的随机错误，无法准确反映真实场景下的修复能力。
AI.method:
1. 通过Grounded-Theory研究从TeX Stack Exchange等来源挖掘168个真实LaTeX故障，构建包含18类故障的分类学及DocMut生成器（48个AST感知操作符）。
2. 构建包含10,437个实例的数据集，对7个LLM进行零样本评估，收集近5万次推理尝试。
3. 设计“恢复预言机”机制，评估编译成功的修复是否改变了原文内容。
AI.result:
1. DocMut生成的真实故障比模式化变异更难修复（高出5.6-9.2个百分点）。
2. Typst格式的修复难度显著高于LaTeX和Markdown。
3. 编译成功率与内容恢复质量存在分歧：编译率最低的模型在其成功案例中往往能最好地恢复原始文本内容。
4. 仅看编译成功率会高估修复质量，因为13.6-18.5%的编译成功修复实际上改变了文档文本。
AI.conclusion: 编译成功并非修复质量的唯一标准，内容保真度同样重要。研究释放了故障分类学、DocMut工具及所有实验数据，为后续LLM文档修复研究提供了更可靠的评估基准。

title: Constraining ontology mappings using metaphysical choices
summary: In this paper we discuss the foundations behind a novel methodology for the validation of semantic mappings between different data sources based upon different foundation ontologies, where the methodology builds a framework based upon the metaphysical commitments of the ontologies. We provide as example the test case of mappings between IES and BFO, and we especially focused on providing cardinality constraints on the mappings between the two ontologies. In order to demonstrate the applicability of our method, we showcased how these principles can be operationalized through SPARQL queries validating the results of a mapping pipeline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于本体形而上学承诺的语义映射验证方法，以IES与BFO本体的映射为例，通过基数约束和SPARQL查询验证映射管道结果。
AI.motivation: 解决不同数据源之间基于不同基础本体的语义映射验证问题，确保映射关系的逻辑一致性和准确性。
AI.method: 构建基于本体形而上学承诺的验证框架，重点提供本体间映射的基数约束（cardinality constraints），并通过SPARQL查询实现映射管道结果的操作性验证。
AI.result: 成功展示了该方法在IES与BFO本体映射测试案例中的适用性，证明了利用基数约束和SPARQL查询进行映射验证的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 基于形而上学承诺的映射验证框架能够有效提升语义映射的质量，为跨本体数据集成提供了可靠的方法论支持。

title: IntHQ: Task-Interactive Hierarchical Query on Dual-Stream Representations for Generative Recommendation
summary: Multi-task learning over heterogeneous data is fundamental to modern recommendation, while generative models are emerging as the backbone of next-generation recommenders. However, the integration of multi-task learning into the generative paradigm remains largely unexplored. Existing multi-task recommenders, in both discriminative and generative paradigms, extract task-relevant features from a single task-agnostic representation and wire tasks into a predefined conversion funnel. We show that this scheme is inherently prone to a threefold collapse. Source collapse, where task-specific signals are injected late and diluted in the shared latent space. Relational collapse, where task dependencies are either implicitly absorbed by the backbone or statically fixed by predefined funnels. Hierarchical collapse, where tasks depend on features at different scales and shift across training stages. We propose IntHQ, a multi-task generative recommender with three components, each alleviating one collapse. Dual-Stream Decoupling (DSD) injects task identity into computation stream early and separates the shared context stream from the task-specific stream, alleviating signal dilution. Task-Interactive Modeling (TIM) replaces the predefined funnel with explicit cross-task interaction, letting each task condition on the realized outcomes of its predecessors with learned, input-adaptive strength. Hierarchical Querying (HQ) lets each task gather multi-scale information across different layers at different training stages. In offline evaluations, IntHQ consistently outperforms competitive encoder backbones under four representative task-head configurations. Deployed in production on Amap, serving hundreds of millions of users for travel recommendation, IntHQ yields a 1.60\% relative UVCTR lift.

AI.tldr: 提出IntHQ，一种多任务生成式推荐模型，通过解耦、交互和分层查询解决现有方法中的三种坍塌问题，在离线实验和生产部署中均取得显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: 多任务学习在现代推荐系统中至关重要，但将其整合到生成式范式的研究尚不充分。现有方法（包括判别式和生成式）从单一任务无关表示中提取特征并依赖预定义漏斗，存在内在缺陷。
AI.method: 提出IntHQ模型，包含三个组件：1) 双流解耦(DSD)，早期注入任务身份并分离共享与特定上下文；2) 任务交互建模(TIM)，用显式跨任务交互替代预定义漏斗，允许任务基于前置任务结果进行条件预测；3) 分层查询(HQ)，让任务在不同训练阶段从不同层级收集多尺度信息。
AI.result: 离线评估显示IntHQ在四种典型任务头配置下均优于竞争性编码器主干。在生产环境（高德地图旅游推荐）部署后，实现UVCTR相对提升1.60%。
AI.conclusion: IntHQ有效解决了多任务生成式推荐中的信号稀释、关系固定和层次静态问题，证明了其在该领域的有效性和实用性。

title: A Review of Vision-Based Vehicle Detection for UAV-Based Traffic Monitoring: Experimental Insights and Future Directions
summary: In Intelligent Transportation System (ITS), unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-based surveillance offers an innovative solution to traffic surveillance with wide coverage and real-time data collection capabilities. In comparison to fixed ground-based infrastructure, UAVs are able to respond to dynamic traffic but present challenges such as vehicle detection at varying altitudes, compensation for motion-induced image variations and efficient processing of high-resolution images.
