We also contribute a set of adversarial prompts designed manually to evaluate identity consistency in LLMs. Our results show that to an extent most models are vulnerable to inconsistencies in self-representations.

AI.tldr: 本文指出知识蒸馏不仅传递功能知识，还导致学生模型学习教师的行为模式（如自我身份表征），引发同质化和偏见问题。为此提出STEMMA框架及对抗性提示，发现多数模型在自我表征上存在不一致性漏洞。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型（LLM）中知识蒸馏规模的扩大，现有研究忽视了蒸馏过程中除了功能性知识外，学生模型是否同时也学习了教师的行为模式（特别是自我身份表征），从而带来输出同质化、模型偏见和责任归属等问题。
AI.method: 1. 提出STEMMA：一种多模态、多智能体框架，通过角色特定的智能体协作探测不同模型的自我识别行为；2. 设计一组人工构建的对抗性提示，用于评估LLMs的身份一致性。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，大多数模型在自我表征方面存在一定程度的不一致性，对这种身份混淆具有脆弱性。
AI.conclusion: 知识蒸馏过程可能导致学生模型继承教师的非功能性行为特征（如身份认同），这不仅影响模型的多样性与公正性，也暴露了当前LLMs在自我认知稳定性方面的潜在缺陷。

title: Protecting patient privacy in clinical foundation models: Technical and legal perspectives
summary: Clinical foundation models trained on large-scale patient data are increasingly used for decision support, screening, and public health. As deployment expands, privacy risk increasingly arises from model-mediated leakage, yet its prevalence and severity remain poorly quantified. Models can disclose sensitive training artifacts, enabling patient re-identification in ways not captured by data-handling controls alone. Existing frameworks, including HIPAA and GDPR, offer limited guidance for such indirect threats. We propose a practical framework for assessing privacy risk in clinical foundation models and illustrate realistic leakage scenarios across deployment settings, map them to legal regimes, and outline complementary technical and legal mitigations. Our analysis provides a context-aware risk assessment grounded in realistic usage to preserve the value of medical foundation models while rigorously safeguarding patient privacy.

AI.tldr: 针对临床基础模型部署中日益严重的隐私泄露风险，本文提出了一套实用的风险评估框架。该框架通过揭示模型介导的敏感训练数据泄露及患者重识别威胁，填补了现有法律框架（如HIPAA、GDPR）在间接隐私威胁方面的指导空白，并结合技术与法律手段提供缓解方案，旨在平衡医疗AI的价值与患者隐私保护。
AI.motivation: 随着基于大规模患者数据训练的临床试验基础模型在决策支持、筛查和公共卫生中的广泛应用，由模型介导的隐私泄露风险日益凸显。然而，此类风险的普遍性和严重性尚未得到充分量化，且现有数据控制措施无法完全捕捉模型披露敏感训练痕迹从而导致的患者重识别威胁。此外，包括HIPAA和GDPR在内的现有法律框架对此类间接威胁的指导有限。
AI.method: 提出了一种评估临床基础模型隐私风险的实用框架。具体方法包括：1) 展示不同部署场景下现实的泄露情景；2) 将这些泄露风险映射到现有的法律监管体系；3) 概述互补的技术和法律缓解措施。分析基于真实的使用情境，以提供具有上下文意识的风险评估。
AI.result: 构建了一个基于现实使用情境的上下文感知风险评估体系。该体系不仅揭示了模型可能披露敏感训练伪影并导致患者重识别的具体机制，还明确了这些威胁与现行法律制度的对应关系，并提出了相应的技术防御和法律合规策略。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为临床基础模型的隐私保护提供了系统性的解决方案。通过结合对模型介导泄露的深入分析与法律技术双重缓解措施，能够在严格保障患者隐私的同时，保留并促进医疗基础模型的应用价值。

title: Enhancing Scientific Named Entity Recognition via Large Language Models: A Type-driven Multi-task Learning Approach
summary: Scientific named entity recognition (SciNER) plays a crucial role in information extraction and knowledge discovery from scientific texts. Recently, large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated the capacity to achieve competitive SciNER performance with minimal human effort. Existing research highlights the importance of incorporating candidate entity type information for accurate entity recognition and classification by LLMs. However, when too many candidate entity types are provided in the prompt, LLMs struggle to accurately recognize and label entities in scientific texts, where entity types are more complex than in general domains. To address this challenge, we propose TdSciNER, a type-driven approach that effectively leverages entity type information to enhance SciNER performance. In TdSciNER, we first design an entity type filter model to identify the most likely entity types present in a given sentence. Subsequently, we introduce an auxiliary multi-class entity typing task within a multi-task learning framework alongside SciNER to obtain richer contextual representations. Then, we develop a novel demonstration selection strategy based on sentence similarity and entity type diversity to activate the in-context learning capabilities of LLMs, thereby improving entity recognition accuracy across diverse scientific domains. Experiments on three datasets demonstrate that our method achieves performance comparable to fully supervised models. Further analysis validates that each entity type-driven component in TdSciNER contributes to the improvement of SciNER performance. This work provides valuable insights for future advancements in SciNER and broader information extraction tasks in scientific text mining.

AI.tldr: 提出TdSciNER，一种通过实体类型驱动增强大语言模型在科学文本中命名实体识别（SciNER）性能的方法。该方法包含实体类型过滤、辅助多分类任务及基于相似性和多样性的演示选择策略，在三个数据集上达到与全监督模型相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有研究指出将候选实体类型信息纳入提示有助于提升大语言模型（LLMs）的SciNER性能，但当候选类型过多时，LLMs难以准确识别和标注复杂的科学实体，导致性能下降。
AI.method: 提出TdSciNER框架：1) 设计实体类型过滤器以识别句子中最可能的实体类型；2) 在多任务学习框架中引入辅助的多类实体类型任务以获取更丰富的上下文表示；3) 开发基于句子相似性和实体类型多样性的新颖演示选择策略，以激活LLMs的上下文学习能力。
AI.result: 在三个数据集上的实验表明，该方法达到了与全监督模型相当的性能水平；进一步分析验证了TdSciNER中每个实体类型驱动组件均对提升SciNER性能有贡献。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为未来科学文本挖掘中的SciNER及更广泛的信息服务提取任务提供了有价值的见解，证明了有效利用实体类型信息可显著提升少样本场景下的实体识别效果。

title: LAVE: Latent Visual Evidence-Enhanced Planning for Video Tool-use Agents
summary: Long-video understanding requires models to efficiently acquire and reuse sparse visual evidence from long and redundant video streams. Recent video tool-use agents address this challenge by iteratively invoking visual Tools at different temporal scales, but their Tool-Planner communication typically relies on textual observations. Such text-only interfaces provide lossy summaries of Tool computations, causing previously computed visual evidence not verbalized to be discarded and unavailable for subsequent planning. We identify this limitation as the Tool observation bottleneck and propose Latent Visual Evidence-Enhanced Planning (LAVE), a training-free framework for reusing latent visual evidence from completed Tool calls. LAVE introduces a dual-channel observation interface: the visible channel preserves the original textual trajectory, while the latent channel stores pre-verbal visual updates with their Tool roles, source-frame timestamps, and visual locations. During planning, LAVE retrieves evidence relevant to the current Planner state but not covered by textual observations, and integrates it through bounded timestamp-aligned latent updates with entropy-constrained frame-time routing. This enables video agents to reuse existing visual computation without additional training, frame replay, or modifications to the original orchestration. Extensive experiments on Video-MME, LongVideoBench, and CG-Bench show that LAVE consistently improves video tool-use agents across backbones. Under a comparable frame budget, LAVE improves the Video-MME overall score by 3.76 points over the strongest baseline, demonstrating the effectiveness of latent visual evidence reuse for multi-step video-agent planning.

AI.tldr: 提出LAVE框架，通过双通道（文本+潜在视觉）解决长视频理解中工具观察瓶颈问题，实现无需训练的视觉证据复用，显著提升多步视频代理规划性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视频工具使用代理依赖纯文本接口进行工具-规划器通信，导致未 verbalized 的视觉证据丢失，形成“工具观察瓶颈”，限制了模型对冗余长视频中稀疏视觉线索的高效获取与复用。
AI.method: 提出Latent Visual Evidence-Enhanced Planning (LAVE) 训练-free框架：1) 设计双通道观察接口（可见文本轨迹+潜在视觉更新存储）；2) 基于当前规划状态检索未被文本覆盖的相关视觉证据；3) 通过有界时间戳对齐的潜在更新和熵约束帧时间路由整合证据。
AI.result: 在Video-MME、LongVideoBench和CG-Bench上广泛实验表明，LAVE在不同骨干网络下均一致提升视频工具使用代理性能；在相当帧预算下，Video-MME总分比最强基线提高3.76分。
AI.conclusion: 潜在视觉证据复用有效解决了长视频代理中的信息丢失问题，无需额外训练或修改原始编排即可增强多步规划能力，为高效长视频理解提供新范式。

title: Thinking vs. NoThinking: Towards Interpreting Reasoning Mechanisms of Large Language Models via Sparse Autoencoders
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) employing Chain-of-Thought (CoT) exhibit superior reasoning capabilities, the neural mechanisms distinguishing this explicit Thinking mode from direct answer generation (NoThinking mode) remain poorly understood. To deconstruct this cognitive process, we apply Top-K Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to the intermediate representations of DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B and examine the model's divergent behaviors across math-solving tasks of three distinct difficulty levels. Observationally, we identify a clear distinction in how the model functions under two reasoning modes: Thinking mode relies on sparse and high-intensity feature activations driving verbal deduction independent of problem complexity, whereas NoThinking mode exhibits an adaptive and diffuse pattern prioritizing symbolic manipulation. Causally, suppressing the three most active sparse features by Total Activation Volume reveals three principles: (i) reasoning and syntactic structure are tightly coupled, as interventions consistently degrade \LaTeX{} and boxed-solution formatting; (ii) Thinking responds to disruption with compensatory over-generation marked by increased metacognitive cues and repetitive, low-information continuations; and (iii) coherent CoT behavior depends on a fragile coordination among specialized features, yielding distinct failure modes under perturbation but a consistently impaired output structure.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用Top-K稀疏自编码器(SAEs)深入解析大语言模型在思维链(CoT)模式与直接回答模式下的神经机制差异。通过对DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B模型的干预实验，发现思维链依赖稀疏且高强度的特征激活进行独立于复杂度的推理，而直接回答则采用适应性扩散模式。抑制关键特征揭示了推理与句法结构的紧密耦合、模型受损后的补偿性过度生成以及相干CoT行为对特征协调的脆弱依赖性。
AI.motivation: 尽管采用思维链(Chain-of-Thought, CoT)的大语言模型展现出卓越的推理能力，但区分这种显式“思考”模式与直接答案生成（无思考模式）的神经机制尚不清楚。旨在解构这一认知过程，理解两种模式下的功能差异。
AI.method: 应用Top-K稀疏自编码器(SAEs)分析DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B模型在三种不同难度数学解题任务中间表示层的响应。通过观察两种模式下的特征激活模式，并利用总激活体积(Total Activation Volume)抑制最活跃的稀疏特征，以因果方式检验其影响。
AI.result: 1. 观察层面：思维模式依赖于稀疏且高强度的特征激活，驱动独立于问题复杂度的言语演绎；无思考模式表现出适应性和扩散性的模式，优先进行符号操作。2. 因果层面：抑制关键特征导致以下结果：(i) 推理与句法结构紧密耦合，干预持续降低LaTeX和框选解决方案的格式质量；(ii) 思维模式在受到干扰时表现为补偿性过度生成，伴随元认知线索增加及重复、低信息量的续写；(iii) 连贯的CoT行为依赖于专门特征间的脆弱协调，扰动下产生不同的故障模式，但输出结构始终受损。
AI.conclusion: 思维链推理与直接回答在神经表征上存在本质区别。思维链不仅涉及内容推理，还深度耦合了特定的句法结构特征。维持高质量的思维链输出需要多种专门特征的精细协调，这种协调具有脆弱性，一旦破坏会导致结构性的输出退化和补偿性行为。

title: QuantumMind: Constraint-Grounded Agentic Reasoning for Speedup Analysis in Quantum Computing
summary: Identifying a meaningful quantum speedup requires more than matching a classical problem to a familiar quantum primitive: the claim must preserve the task, respect access and output models, expose required promises, and remain within a defensible complexity scope. We present QuantumMind, an auditable agentic workflow for generating and conservatively screening quantum-acceleration hypotheses. A fixed sequence of typed, role-specialized actions formalizes the public task, analyzes structure and classical bottlenecks, matches a source-linked registry of quantum primitives and barriers, and constructs a scoped candidate scheme. A deterministic ten-check validator assigns the authoritative verdict; completed states are compiled into a Quantum Acceleration Evidence Graph and passed through a downward-only research screen that cannot strengthen the decision. We evaluate QuantumMind against seven task-adapted prompting and agentic controls on 582 identical open-discovery tasks. Under the frozen Open-Discovery Score (ODS), QuantumMind obtains 53.1 mean ODS, exceeding the strongest baseline by 17.3 points (48.2% relative), and wins 355 of 582 paired tasks against that baseline. It passes the graph audit on 99.8% of tasks, compared with 43.6% for the strongest baseline, and ranks first in all seven task families. The results indicate that typed state transitions and deterministic evidence control contribute beyond fluent generation alone.

AI.tldr: 提出QuantumMind，一种用于生成和保守筛选量子加速假设的可审计智能体工作流，通过结构化验证显著提升发现任务表现。
AI.motivation: 识别有意义的量子加速需要超越简单的任务匹配，必须保留任务、尊重访问/输出模型、暴露必要承诺并保持在可辩护的复杂度范围内。现有方法缺乏严谨的结构化验证机制。
AI.method: 构建QuantumMind系统：1) 使用固定序列的类型化、角色专业化动作形式化公共任务；2) 分析结构与经典瓶颈；3) 匹配量子原语与障碍注册表；4) 构建受限候选方案；5) 采用确定性十项检查验证器得出权威结论；6) 将完成状态编译为量子加速证据图，并通过单向研究筛选流程。
AI.result: 在582个相同开放发现任务上评估，QuantumMind平均ODS得分为53.1，比最强基线高17.3分（相对提升48.2%），并在355/582个配对任务中胜出。其图谱审计通过率达99.8%（基线为43.6%），在所有七个任务家族中排名第一。
AI.conclusion: 类型化状态转移和确定性证据控制机制显著优于单纯的流畅生成能力，为量子加速假设的生成与验证提供了更可靠的方法论。

title: AnchorFold: A Focus-Then-Fold Framework via Recursive Attention Propagation for Efficient Multi-Vector Visual Document Retrieval
summary: Multi-vector vision-language retrievers enable fine-grained Visual Document Retrieval (VDR) through late interaction, but storing and scoring hundreds of visual patch embeddings per page incurs substantial overhead. Existing training-free methods rely on pruning or merging: pruning degrades sharply under aggressive compression, whereas merging does not explicitly prioritize important regions when forming representatives. We introduce AnchorFold, a training-free focus-then-fold framework for document-side index compression. AnchorFold applies Recursive Attention Propagation over visual self-attention graphs, performing multi-step propagation within each attention head and integrating scores across heads and layers. The focus stage selects the highest-centrality tokens as anchors. The fold stage assigns remaining tokens to their most similar anchors in the normalized retrieval space and summarizes each anchor-centered group through centrality-weighted aggregation. This preserves non-anchor contributions while concentrating capacity on structurally important tokens. Across ViDoRe v1/v2 and REAL-MM-RAG with three diverse retrieval backbones, AnchorFold consistently outperforms all evaluated training-free baselines at $γ\leq 0.20$. On ViDoRe v1/v2, it retains 98.3% of full-index NDCG@5 on average at $5\times$ compression, achieving near-lossless compression, and 92.4% at $20\times$ compression.

AI.tldr: 提出AnchorFold，一种免训练的文档端索引压缩框架。通过递归注意力传播聚焦关键token（锚点），并将其他token折叠到锚点上，在保持检索精度的同时实现高达20倍的压缩率。
AI.motivation: 多向量视觉-语言检索器虽能通过晚期交互实现细粒度视觉文档检索(VDR)，但存储和计算大量视觉patch嵌入带来巨大开销。现有免训练方法中，剪枝在激进压缩下性能下降严重，而合并方法未显式优先选择重要区域来构建代表元。
AI.method: 引入AnchorFold框架，包含两个阶段：1. 聚焦阶段(Focus)：对视觉自注意力图应用递归注意力传播，在多步传播中整合各头和各层的分数，选取最高中心性的token作为锚点；2. 折叠阶段(Fold)：在归一化检索空间中，将剩余token分配给最相似的锚点，并通过中心性加权聚合总结每个锚点组，从而保留非锚点贡献并集中容量于结构重要的token。
AI.result: 在ViDoRe v1/v2和REAL-MM-RAG数据集及三种不同检索骨干网上，AnchorFold在压缩率γ≤0.20时 consistently 优于所有评估的免训练基线。在5倍压缩下平均保留98.3%的全索引NDCG@5（近无损），在20倍压缩下保留92.4%。
AI.conclusion: AnchorFold通过“先聚焦后折叠”的策略，有效解决了视觉文档检索中的索引压缩难题，实现了高压缩比下的近无损检索性能，为高效VDR提供了新的免训练解决方案。

title: MAGIC-SSCIL: Manifold Anchoring and Geometric Incremental Calibration for Semi-Supervised Class Incremental Learning
summary: Semi-supervised Class Incremental Learning (SSCIL) is a severe challenge for neural networks, and it is hardest in the exemplar-free setting where no past data may be stored. Existing methods forget catastrophically due to feature drift, and their pseudo-labels become increasingly unreliable as the label space grows. In this paper, we propose MAGIC (Manifold Anchoring and Geometric Incremental Calibration), a framework that stabilizes plasticity without storing exemplars. MAGIC's design centers on two components. The first is Soft-Weighted Geometry Calibration (SWGC), which uses graph-based label propagation on the learner's plastic feature space to weight and calibrate class means and variances computed on the frozen backbone; from these calibrated Gaussians, we sample phantom features that stand in for data from previous tasks. The second is a Geometric Structural Alignment (GSA) objective that preserves representation topology by matching the relational structure of student and teacher heads and aligning feature anchors with the fixed classifier prototypes, locking the orientation of the feature space. Together, these constraints keep the adapter from drifting, so geometric relations between classes remain stable as new classes arrive. We implement MAGIC with a frozen ResNet-18 backbone and a learnable plastic adapter. Across CIFAR-100, CUB-200, and ImageNet-R, at label ratios of 1%, 5%, and 10%, MAGIC improves average incremental accuracy over most of the supervised CIL methods equipped with FixMatch and native SSCIL baselines; the largest gains occur in the fine-grained, low-label setting, where confidence thresholding fails most clearly.

AI.tldr: 提出MAGIC框架，通过流形锚定和几何增量校准解决无示例半监督类增量学习中的灾难性遗忘问题。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在无示例设置下因特征漂移导致灾难性遗忘，且随着标签空间扩大，伪标签可靠性降低。
AI.method: 提出MAGIC框架，包含两个核心组件：1) 软加权几何校准(SWGC)，利用图标签传播在可塑性特征空间上对冻结主干计算的类别均值和方差进行校准，并采样幻影特征以替代旧任务数据；2) 几何结构对齐(GSA)目标，通过匹配师生头部的关系结构和将特征锚点与固定分类器原型对齐，保持表示拓扑结构稳定。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-100、CUB-200和ImageNet-R数据集上，结合不同标签比率（1%、5%、10%），MAGIC的平均增量准确率优于大多数配备FixMatch的监督CIL方法和原生SSCIL基线，尤其在细粒度、低标签设置中提升显著。
AI.conclusion: MAGIC通过约束适配器漂移，保持了类间几何关系的稳定性，有效解决了无示例半监督类增量学习中的挑战。

title: A Grounded and Decomposed Framework for Relation-Level Hallucination Evaluation in Abstractive Summarization
summary:
Abstractive text summarization systems frequently generate fluent yet unfaithful summaries by fabricating or distorting relationships between entities and
  events. Such relation-level hallucinations undermine the reliability of generated summaries, particularly in high-stakes domains. In this work, we present a
  refined and grounded framework for evaluating relation hallucination in abstractive summarization. We present the empirical Relation Hallucination Index (RHI) by
  introducing a dependency-aware relation extraction algorithm that incorporates lemmatization-based normalization, named entity grounded subject resolution,
  passive agent recovery, negation-aware verb modeling, reporting verb filtering, nominal relation fallback, clausal propagation, and systematic deduplication.
  These enhancements improve the structural fidelity of extracted relation triples and reduce spurious matches during evaluation. In addition, we introduce a
  normalized formulation of RHI to ensure scale-invariant comparison between datasets and models. The revised metric decomposes hallucination into interpretable
  components, aggregates relation hallucination metric into a normalized relation faithfulness score. Extensive evaluation across multiple state-of-the-art
  summarization models demonstrates that the grounded extraction process yields more stable and discriminative hallucination measurements. The proposed framework
  advances automated relation-level faithfulness evaluation and supports coherence-aware, hallucination-sensitive model analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出一种改进的框架和指标（RHI），通过依赖感知的关系抽取算法，更准确地评估摘要中的关系级幻觉，提升评估的稳定性和可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有摘要系统常生成流畅但不可靠的内容，特别是存在关系层面的幻觉（捏造或扭曲实体与事件关系），这在高风险领域严重影响可靠性。
AI.method: 引入依赖感知关系提取算法，结合词形还原、命名实体主体解析、被动语态恢复、否定动词建模等技术优化关系三元组提取；构建归一化的关系幻觉指数（RHI）以实现跨数据集/模型的公平比较，并将幻觉分解为可解释组件。
AI.result: 在多个人工智能摘要模型上的广泛评估显示，该 grounded 提取过程能产生更稳定且具有区分度的幻觉测量结果，提升了自动化关系级忠实度评估的能力。
AI.conclusion: 该框架推进了自动化的关系级忠实度评估，支持对模型进行连贯性感知和幻觉敏感的分析。

title: Adaptive Two-Level Allocation of a Conserved Capacity Budget Across Locations and Service Classes
summary: We study how to share a single conserved capacity budget across many locations and two service classes when demand is uneven, time-varying, and can exceed supply. The shape recurs: an origin's request-rate cap split across its edge locations, a licensed throughput cap across premium and standard tenants, or an egress budget between latency-critical and batch workloads. We present a two-level algorithm. The first level redistributes capacity within a class across locations by proportional deficit and excess redistribution; the second lends capacity elastically between classes when one has surplus and the other deficit. We prove it conserves the budget exactly, preserves non-negativity, and reaches a stable allocation in one iteration under stationary demand because it carries no per-cycle state, at O(KN) cost per cycle for K classes and N locations. We evaluate it defending a CDN's per-domain budget under volumetric attack, where the classes are confirmed-legitimate and not-yet-cleared traffic; across 8 contention scenarios on a 22-location topology it serves 66-93% of high-priority demand, competitive with a single-class linear-programming optimum, while never leaving capacity idle or over-committing whenever aggregate demand meets or exceeds the budget (the contention regime these scenarios evaluate). Two findings carry beyond the application. First, a throughput-maximizing objective is wrong under contention: a two-class LP maximizing total served load serves less high-priority load than our demand-proportional, reservation-respecting allocator in most scenarios, because it cannot tell that some load it serves is the contention. Second, inter-class borrowing earns its complexity under bursty load, improving high-priority service by 1.5 points (isolated by ablation), and is neutral under stationary demand. A 5-location prototype with real HTTP traffic validates the pipeline.

AI.tldr: 提出一种两层级算法，用于在需求不均、时变且可能超过供给的情况下，跨多个位置和服务类别共享单一守恒容量预算。该算法通过类内按比例赤字/盈余重分配和类间弹性借贷实现稳定分配，证明其能精确守恒预算并保持非负性，且在平稳需求下仅需O(KN)复杂度的一次迭代即可收敛。实验表明其在CDN防御场景下优于最大化总吞吐量的线性规划方法，并在突发负载下显著提升高优先级服务。
AI.motivation: 研究如何在需求不均匀、随时间变化且可能超过供给的情况下，将单一的守恒容量预算（如边缘位置请求率上限、许可吞吐量或出口预算）有效地共享给多个位置和两个服务类别。
AI.method: 提出一种两层级算法：第一级通过比例的赤字和盈余重分配在类别内的不同位置间重新分配容量；第二级在某一类别有盈余而另一类别有赤字时，在类别间进行弹性的容量借贷。
AI.result: 理论证明该算法精确守恒预算、保持非负性，并在平稳需求下以O(KN)的单周期成本在一次迭代中达到稳定分配。在CDN抵御体积攻击的评估中（8个争用场景，22个位置拓扑），该算法满足了66-93%的高优先级需求，性能与单类别线性规划最优值相当，且从未导致容量闲置或超commitment。
AI.conclusion: 主要发现包括：1. 在争用情况下，以最大化总吞吐量为目标是错误的，因为无法区分“争用负载”，导致高优先级负载服务量低于本算法；2. 类间借贷在突发负载下能显著改善高优先级服务（提升1.5点），而在平稳负载下无影响。5节点原型验证了流程的有效性。

title: GRASP: Granularity-Aware Region Alignment and Semantic Prototype Learning for Fine-Grained Cross-Modal Understanding in Drone Views
comment: Accepted at the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM Multimedia 2026, MM '26). 10 pages, 6 figures
summary: Fine-grained cross-modal understanding in drone views is essential for aerial vision-language navigation. However, the inherent wide field of view and overhead perspective of drone scenarios impose dual challenges on vision-language understanding. At the macro level, overwhelming background clutter in visual representations leads to Cross-Modal Focus Misalignment, where the model prioritizes global environmental similarities over specific object details. At the micro level, Visual Isomorphism creates ambiguity, where candidates share similar geometric structures yet differ only in subtle attributes. To address these challenges, we propose the Granularity-Aware Region Alignment and Semantic Prototype (GRASP) learning framework, enhancing discriminative capability through two synergistic strategies. Specifically, we introduce Region-Focused Alignment (RFA) to promote object-centric cross-modal alignment while suppressing background interference. Concurrently, to tackle visual isomorphism, we propose Semantic Perturbation Enhanced Matching (SPEM), which leverages a foreground-purified Semantic Prototype Codebook (SPC) to construct semantically perturbed negatives for fine-grained semantic discrimination. Extensive experiments on the GeoText-1652 benchmark and the unseen ERA dataset demonstrate that GRASP achieves competitive performance in drone-view fine-grained image-text retrieval, validating its effectiveness for cross-modal understanding in aerial scenarios. Our code implementation is available at https://github.com/UCAS-JC/GRASP.

AI.tldr: 提出GRASP框架，通过区域聚焦对齐(RFA)和语义扰动增强匹配(SPEM)，解决无人机视角下细粒度跨模态理解的背景干扰和视觉同构歧义问题，在GeoText-1652和ERA数据集上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 无人机视角的宽视场和俯视特性给视觉-语言理解带来双重挑战：宏观层面的背景杂乱导致跨模态焦点错位（过度关注全局环境而非具体物体），微观层面的视觉同构性造成候选对象因细微属性差异而难以区分。
AI.method: 提出粒度感知区域对齐与语义原型（GRASP）学习框架，包含两个协同策略：1. 区域聚焦对齐（RFA）：促进以物体为中心的跨模态对齐，抑制背景干扰；2. 语义扰动增强匹配（SPEM）：利用前景净化的语义原型代码本（SPC）构建语义扰动的负样本，以实现细粒度语义判别。
AI.result: 在GeoText-1652基准测试和未见过的ERA数据集上进行的大量实验表明，GRASP在无人机视角的细粒度图像-文本检索任务中取得了具有竞争力的性能，验证了其在空中场景跨模态理解中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: GRASp框架有效解决了无人机场景下细粒度跨模态理解的关键挑战，提升了模型在复杂背景和相似几何结构下的判别能力，为 aerial vision-language navigation 提供了有力的技术支持。

title: NewtonGS: Physics-Structured Object-Level Neural Newtonian Dynamics for Gaussian Scene Animation
summary: Animating objects in a static 3D Gaussian scene requires an explicit object-level dynamic state and a controllable model of object motion. Existing dynamic Gaussian methods primarily reconstruct time-varying scenes or simulate deformation, rather than provide compact object states for direct control. To address this gap, we present NewtonGS, a physics-structured framework for object-level state rollout and Gaussian scene animation. NewtonGS represents each object with a 22-dimensional state covering pose, linear and angular velocity, anisotropic scale and its rate, mass, and contact properties. Its Gaussian Neural Newtonian Dynamics (Gaussian-NND) model combines analytic translation, quaternion kinematics, gravity, damping, and scale-restoration dynamics with learned continuous and contact residuals. A discrete event map handles floor contact. Predicted poses and scales define a shared affine transformation that updates the means and covariances of all Gaussians associated with each object. We construct two procedurally generated datasets: State-32 for state-rollout evaluation and Gaussian-32 for state-to-Gaussian transformation. On both the in-distribution and velocity-range-shift splits of State-32, NewtonGS achieves lower trajectory RMSE, final displacement error, and velocity RMSE than five analytic baselines. Experiments on Gaussian-32 further demonstrate effective conversion from predicted states to animated Gaussian objects.

AI.tldr: 提出NewtonGS，一种基于物理的框架，用于将22维物体状态（位姿、速度、尺度等）转换为3D高斯场景动画，解决了现有方法缺乏可控制对象级动态状态的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的动态高斯方法主要重建时变场景或模拟形变，缺乏紧凑的对象级状态以支持直接控制。旨在填补这一空白，提供可直接控制的对象运动模型。
AI.method:
1. 使用22维状态向量表示每个对象（包含位姿、线/角速度、各向异性尺度及其变化率、质量、接触属性）。
2. 构建高斯神经牛顿动力学（Gaussian-NND）模型，结合解析力学（平移、四元数运动学、重力、阻尼、尺度恢复）与学习到的连续及接触残差。
3. 利用离散事件映射处理地面接触。
4. 通过预测的位姿和尺度定义共享仿射变换，更新关联高斯的均值和协方差。
5. 构建State-32和Gaussian-3两个程序化生成数据集进行评估。
AI.result: 在State-32数据集上，NewtonGS在轨迹RMSE、最终位移误差和速度RMSE方面优于五种解析基线方法；在Gaussian-32实验中也证明了从预测状态到动画高斯对象转换的有效性。
AI.conclusion: NewtonGS成功实现了从紧凑物理状态到高质量3D高斯场景动画的高效、可控转换，为动态场景的精确控制和模拟提供了新范式。

title: Focus particles and scalar inferences across humans and language models
comment: 3 pages, 1 figure, presented at 9th annual Conference on Cognitive Computational Neuroscience
summary: Focus particles such as "even" and "only" are central to formal semantic theories that posit structured representations over sets of alternatives. "Even" highlights unexpected or extreme alternatives, while "only" enforces exclusivity. If such scalar representations are robust and generalizable, they should give rise to consistent judgments across contexts and systems. In this work, we test whether humans and large language models (LLMs) construct stable scalar representations from sentences containing these particles. Using a dataset of approximately 100 items, participants and models were asked to make scalar judgments. Preliminary results suggest that similar outputs across humans and LLMs may arise from different underlying mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过约100个包含“even”和“only”等焦点粒子的语料库，测试人类与大型语言模型（LLMs）是否构建了稳定的标量表征。初步结果表明，尽管两者输出相似，但其背后的认知或计算机制可能不同。
AI.motivation: 形式语义学理论假设存在基于备选方案集合的结构化表征，“even”强调意外或极端选项，“only”强制执行排他性。若此类标量表征具有鲁棒性和泛化能力，应在不同语境和系统中产生一致的判断。因此，研究旨在验证人类和LLMs是否确实构建了这种稳定的标量表征。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含约100个项目的数据集，要求参与者和模型对包含焦点粒子（如“even”和“only”）的句子进行标量判断，以比较两者的表现和潜在机制。
AI.result: 初步结果显示，人类和大型语言模型在标量判断任务中产生了相似的输出结果。
AI.conclusion: 虽然人类和LLMs在处理焦点粒子时表现出相似的输出行为，但这种一致性可能源于不同的底层机制，暗示了二者在理解结构化语义表征上的本质差异。

title: Who Verifies the Benchmark? Decentralizing Trust in Large Language Model Evaluation
comment: Accepted to International Conference on Quantum Enhanced AI and Secure Computing (QASC2026)
summary: LLM benchmarks can build an organization's reputation and attract customers, but only when results are transparent and verifiable. Unverified claims that DeepSeek R1 outperformed OpenAI's o1 contributed to market panic on January 27, 2025, when Nvidia lost USD589 billion in market value. Yet vendor benchmarks often depend on an honor system. Academic reassessments and independent leaderboards have found undisclosed changes to proprietary models, contaminated training data, and selective reporting. LLM-as-a-judge methods scale evaluation by reducing human review. Studies, however, suggest that judges may show identity-aware bias, scoring an answer according to its source model rather than its quality. This bias has not been fully measured or corrected across politically sensitive, reasoning-intensive, and preference-based tasks. We examine this problem using seven verifier models: GPT-OSS 120B, Llama 3.3 70B, GLM 5.1, Qwen3 32B, DeepSeek V4 Pro, Mistral Large3, and Sarvam M. They score anonymous and identity-disclosed responses from three primary models on 58 factual, reasoning, political, and preference-based questions. Identity disclosure slightly raises scores for factual questions, moderately affects stress-reasoning tasks, and causes large changes for geopolitically sensitive topics. Notable results include GLM5.1 (+7.00 points, p = 0.0249) and Llama 3.3 70B (+1.56 points, p = 0.00). We also introduce a blockchain-based commit-reveal protocol using Autonomous Economic Agents on an Ethereum-compatible ledger. In Phase 1, each judge records a one-way hash of its score and a secret salt before candidate identities are revealed. In Phase 2, the identity and raw score are disclosed and verified on-chain. This creates a tamper-evident audit trail that separates blind evaluation from post-hoc claims and reduces the verification burden on independent researchers and leaderboard operators.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了LLM-as-a-judge评估中存在严重的身份认知偏见，并提出了基于区块链的commit-reveal协议以实现透明、可验证的去偏见评估。
AI.motivation: LLM基准测试对商业信誉至关重要，但当前依赖“荣誉制度”导致虚假宣传和市场动荡（如DeepSeek与OpenAI争议）。现有研究指出LLM评委存在身份偏见，但缺乏在政治敏感及推理任务上的全面量化与修正机制。
AI.method:
1. **实证研究**：使用7个验证模型（GPT-OSS 120B, Llama 3.3 70B等）对3个主要模型的匿名与显名回答在58道题目上进行评分，分析身份披露对分数的影响。
2. **系统构建**：引入基于以太坊兼容链路的自主经济代理（AEA）区块链commit-reveal协议。Phase 1记录分数哈希和盐值；Phase 2公开身份和原始分数进行链上验证，建立防篡改审计轨迹。
AI.result: 身份披露显著影响评分：对事实性问题轻微提升，对压力推理任务中度影响，对地缘政治敏感话题造成巨大偏差。具体表现为GLM 5.1 (+7.00分) 和 Llama 3.3 70B (+1.56分) 在特定条件下的显著变化。
AI.conclusion: LLM评委存在显著的身份感知偏见，需通过技术手段校正。提出的区块链commit-reveal协议能有效分离盲评与事后声明，降低独立研究人员和排行榜运营者的验证负担，确保评估结果的透明度和可信度。

title: Temporal Misgrounding in Legal RAG: A Versioned-Corpus Benchmark for French Tax Law
comment: 13 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Accepted at the ICML 2026 Workshop on AI for Law (AI4Law), Seoul. Code and data: https://github.com/rosecymbler/fiscal-fr-bench
summary: We identify and quantify temporal misgrounding: the systematic retrieval and citation of the currently in-force version of a legal article when the applicable version is an earlier or future one. Standard legal RAG treats the corpus as static; we argue legal question answering is a temporally-indexed retrieval problem. We introduce FiscalQA Pro, pairing a versioned corpus of 32,436 article-versions of the French tax code (93 years, 1938-2031) with an all-model-hard temporal-reasoning track: 209 scored, expert-reviewed questions across 33 CGI articles (221 released; twelve flagged out of the answerable scope). At selection time, no evaluated model recovered its date-applicable answer closed-book in any of four sampling draws, and the currently in-force text lacks the gold value for all but one of the scored questions. Answers are scored deterministically via atomic ground-truth "nuggets" (regex and numeric-with-tolerance), never LLM-as-judge: an LLM judge would inherit the temporal bias it is meant to score. Across eleven models (five frontier closed-API systems plus Gemini 2.5 Pro as a substitute entry, and five open-weight), parametric knowledge yields 3.0% mean strict accuracy and RAG over a static current-version corpus 2.7%. Static RAG retrieves the date-applicable version 0% of the time, confidently citing a real but inapplicable version. Our end-to-end retriever over a multi-version index, with no oracle, reaches 98.3% mean strict; an oracle-article ablation reaches 99.1%, locating the residual gap in first-stage recall, not version selection. We additionally release a version-aware jurisprudence dataset of 69,208 citation links, together with the corpus, benchmark, model responses, and pipeline code.

AI.tldr: 本文针对法律问答中的“时间错位”问题（即错误引用当前有效而非适用时期的法律版本），提出了FiscalQA Pro基准。该基准包含法国税法32,436个版本和209道专家审核的时间推理题。实验显示，现有模型在静态语料库上表现极差（准确率约3%），而提出的端到端多版本检索器将准确率提升至98.3%，并开源了相关数据集和代码。
AI.motivation: 标准法律RAG系统通常将语料库视为静态，忽视了法律具有时效性这一关键特征。作者指出法律问答本质上是一个“时间索引检索”问题，存在系统性错误：模型倾向于检索和引用当前生效的法律条文，而非案件发生时实际适用的历史或未来版本。
AI.method:
1. 构建FiscalQA Pro基准：包含法国税法1938-2031年共93年的32,436个文章版本，以及209道经过专家审核的评分问题。
2. 采用确定性评分机制：基于原子化真实答案片段（正则表达式及带容差的数值）进行打分，避免使用LLM作为裁判以消除其固有的时间偏见。
3. 提出端到端检索器：在多版本索引上进行检索，无需Oracle辅助，旨在解决从正确文章定位到正确版本的完整流程。
AI.result:
1. 基线模型表现糟糕：在11个测试模型中，参数化知识严格准确率为3.0%，基于静态当前版本语料库的RAG仅为2.7%。静态RAG完全无法检索到日期适用的版本（0%），且常自信地引用真实但不可用的版本。
2. 新方法显著突破：提出的端到端检索器在多版本索引上达到了98.3%的平均严格准确率。
3. 误差分析：通过Oracle文章消融实验发现，剩余误差主要源于第一阶段的召回率不足，而非版本选择错误。
AI.conclusion: 法律问答必须处理时间维度，静态RAG方法在此任务上失效。引入多版本索引和时间感知的检索策略能极大提升准确性。研究还发布了包含69,208条引用链接的版本感知判例法数据集及相关资源，推动了法律AI向更严谨的时间推理方向发展。

title: HSMLA: Hierarchical Softmax Multi-scale Linear Attention for Efficient Vision Transformers
summary: Vision transformers face significant computational overheads in high-resolution dense prediction due to the quadratic complexity of self-attention. Linear attention offers efficiency but sacrifices local context modeling. We propose \textbf{HSMLA (Hierarchical Softmax Multi-scale Linear Attention)}, which combines ReLU-based linear attention for global context, selective softmax refinement for critical local features, and multi-scale token representations via depthwise convolutions. HSMLA achieves superior accuracy-efficiency trade-offs: up to $4.2\times$ inference-time speedup across dense prediction tasks, $87.3%$ Dice with $3.2\times$ speedup on CT organ segmentation, and $94.2%$ AUC with $4.1\times$ speedup on pathology WSI.

AI.tldr: 提出HSMLA，结合线性注意力、Softmax局部特征和深度卷积多尺度表示，解决高分辨率预测的计算瓶颈。
AI.motivation: Vision transformers在高分辨率密集预测任务中因自注意力的二次复杂度面临显著计算开销；线性注意力虽高效但牺牲了局部上下文建模能力。
AI.method: 提出HSMLA（分层Softmax多尺度线性注意力），结合基于ReLU的线性注意力获取全局上下文、选择性Softmax细化关键局部特征，以及通过深度卷积实现多尺度token表示。
AI.result: 在密集预测任务中实现高达4.2倍的推理加速；CT器官分割Dice系数达87.3%且加速3.2倍；病理WSI AUC达94.2%且加速4.1倍。
AI.conclusion: HSMLA实现了优越的精度-效率权衡，有效平衡了全局上下文与局部特征建模。

title: AraSSM: A bidirectional state-space encoder for Arabic masked language modeling
summary: Pretrained Transformer encoders such as AraBERT, MARBERT, and CAMeLBERT have become the standard backbone for Arabic natural language understanding, but their self-attention mechanism scales quadratically with sequence length, which limits efficiency on long documents. Mamba, a selective state-space model (SSM), offers linear-time sequence modeling as a competitive alternative to attention, yet no dedicated bidirectional Mamba encoder pretrained specifically for Arabic currently exists. We introduce AraSSM, a bidirectional Mamba encoder pretrained via masked language modeling on a corpus combining Arabic Wikipedia and CulturaX text, trained end-to-end on four consumer-grade NVIDIA RTX 2080Ti GPUs (11GB) over approximately ten days. We evaluate AraSSM by fine-tuning on four established Arabic NLU benchmarks covering sentiment classification (HARD), named entity recognition (ANERcorp), extractive question answering (ARCD), and natural language inference (XNLI-ar), following the per-task evaluation protocol introduced by AraBERT, and report results as mean +/- standard deviation across three fine-tuning seeds. AraSSM matches or exceeds published base-sized Transformer baselines on sentiment classification (96.37 +/- 0.03% accuracy on HARD), is competitive on extractive QA (32.19 +/- 1.07 EM, 63.79 +/- 0.25 F1 on ARCD) and named entity recognition (81.54 +/- 0.30 entity-level F1 on ANERcorp), and trails the base-sized Transformer range on natural language inference (72.83 +/- 0.07% accuracy on XNLI-ar), despite being trained entirely from scratch on consumer hardware rather than large-scale accelerator clusters.

AI.tldr: 提出AraSSM，首个专为阿拉伯语预训练的端到端双向Mamba编码器，在消费级硬件上训练，性能媲美或超越Transformer基线模型。
AI.motivation: 现有阿拉伯语NLP标准骨干网络（如AraBERT）基于自注意力机制，计算复杂度随序列长度呈二次方增长，限制了长文档处理的效率；而Mamba作为选择性状态空间模型提供线性时间建模优势，但缺乏专门针对阿拉伯语预训练的双向Mamba编码器。
AI.method: 构建AraSSM，采用双向Mamba架构，通过掩码语言建模在阿拉伯语维基百科和CulturaX文本混合语料上进行预训练。使用四块消费级NVIDIA RTX 2080Ti GPU，耗时约十天完成端到端训练。在四个基准数据集（HARD, ANERcorp, ARCD, XNLI-ar）上进行微调评估。
AI.result: AraSSM在情感分类任务（HARD）上达到96.37%准确率，匹配或超过Transformer基线；在命名实体识别（ANERcorp）和抽取式问答（ARCD）上表现具有竞争力；在自然语言推理（XNLI-ar）上略低于Transformer范围，但考虑到其仅在消费级硬件上从零训练，整体性能优异。
AI.conclusion: AraSSM证明了Mamba架构在阿拉伯语自然语言理解中的可行性与高效性，为长文档处理提供了比传统Transformer更具计算效率的替代方案，且无需依赖大规模加速器集群即可取得竞争性结果。

title: AndroidReality: How Far Are Mobile Agents from the Real World?
summary: Mobile agents have achieved promising results on clean online benchmarks such as AndroidWorld, yet their performance often degrades sharply in real-world deployment due to environmental variations and imperfect interface conditions. In this work, we introduce AndroidReality, a perturbation-based framework for evaluating and improving the robustness of mobile agents. Through a Markov Decision Process (MDP) perspective, we organize real-world interface variability into a principled taxonomy of perturbations along three axes: state, transition, and action. Guided by this taxonomy, we build a perturbed mobile benchmark on top of AndroidWorld with realistic and controllable perturbation injections, enabling systematic robustness evaluation of mobile agents. Our evaluation reveals substantial robustness gaps and four recurring error categories, motivating a simple training-free Test-Time Introspective Recovery (TTIR) mechanism that mitigates these failures on both perturbed and clean settings. Together, these results position robustness as a missing dimension in mobile agent evaluation and establish benchmark perturbation as an effective tool for both stress testing and surfacing latent weaknesses of mobile agents.

AI.tldr: 提出AndroidReality框架，通过引入基于马尔可夫决策过程的扰动分类（状态、转移、动作），在AndroidWorld基准上构建扰动环境，评估并提升移动智能体在真实世界界面变化下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 移动智能体在干净基准测试中表现良好，但在真实部署中因环境变化和界面不完美导致性能显著下降，亟需解决鲁棒性问题。
AI.method: 1. 从MDP视角将现实界面变异性归纳为状态、转移、动作三个维度的扰动分类体系；2. 在AndroidWorld基础上构建可控的扰动基准；3. 提出无需训练的测试时内省恢复机制（TTIR）以缓解失败案例。
AI.result: 揭示了移动智能体存在显著的鲁棒性差距和四类常见错误模式；TTIR机制在扰动和干净设置下均能有效缓解这些故障。
AI.conclusion: 鲁棒性是移动智能体评估中被忽视的关键维度，基准扰动注入是压力测试和发现智能体潜在弱点的有效工具。

title: FlowErase-OPD: Multi-Concept Erasure via Anchored On-Policy Distillation in Flow Matching Models
summary: Recent advances in flow matching models have substantially improved the quality of text-to-image generation, but have also raised increasing safety concerns due to their potential to generate harmful or undesirable content. Existing concept erasure methods for flow matching models predominantly focus on removing individual concepts, while effectively erasing multiple concepts simultaneously remains challenging. We propose FlowErase-OPD, a framework for multi-concept erasure based on on-policy distillation (OPD). Our approach first distills multiple single-concept erased models into a unified LoRA module and introduces Anchored Multi-Teacher Distillation (AMTD), which incorporates a retention teacher to mitigate the trade-off between concept erasure and preservation of generative capabilities. To further improve the coordination of multiple erasure objectives, we develop Adaptive Retention Control (ARC), which dynamically adjusts the sampling frequency and loss weight of each erasure teacher, together with the relative contribution of erasure and retention teachers throughout training. Extensive experiments on nudity, object, and artistic-style erasure demonstrate that FlowErase-OPD consistently improves the trade-off between erasure effectiveness, image quality, and semantic alignment, achieving state-of-the-art performance across diverse multi-concept erasure settings. Furthermore, the resulting models exhibit strong robustness against adversarial attacks. These results highlight the potential of on-policy distillation as a principled framework for safe and controllable generation in flow matching models.

AI.tldr: 提出FlowErase-OPD框架，通过基于策略的蒸馏（OPD）解决流匹配模型中多概念擦除难题，在保持生成能力的同时有效移除多个有害概念，达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 尽管流匹配模型提升了文本到图像生成的质量，但也引发了生成有害内容的安全隐患。现有方法主要关注单一概念擦除，难以有效同时擦除多个概念，且存在擦除效果与保留生成能力之间的权衡挑战。
AI.method: 1. 将多个单概念擦除模型蒸馏到一个统一的LoRA模块中；2. 引入锚定多教师蒸馏（AMTD），利用保留教师缓解擦除与保留之间的权衡；3. 开发自适应保留控制（ARC），动态调整采样频率、损失权重及擦除/保留教师的相对贡献。
AI.result: 在裸露、物体和艺术风格擦除任务上，FlowErase-OPD在擦除有效性、图像质量和语义对齐之间取得了最佳权衡，实现了多概念擦除设置下的最先进（SOTA）性能，并对抗攻击表现出强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 基于策略的蒸馏为流匹配模型中的安全和可控生成提供了一个原则性的框架，证明了其在多概念擦除场景下的有效性。

title: Do Evaluation Metrics Detect Errors in Classical Chinese to English Translations?
summary: Although large language models can translate some historical languages surprisingly well, their usefulness in digital humanities workflows is limited by the lack of reliable evaluation. We investigate whether existing automatic evaluation metrics developed for modern languages are reliable in this setting, using translation from Classical Chinese to English as a test case. We introduce a diagnostic framework based on minimal pairs capturing error types salient in scholarly use, probing both reference-based and reference-free metrics for error sensitivity and tolerance to valid variation. We find that all metrics exhibit blind spots, however MetricX24 performs best overall. Our findings highlight the need for more robust and interpretable metrics for historically and culturally distinct translation settings.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过古典中文到英文的翻译案例，评估了现有自动评估指标在历史语言翻译中的可靠性。虽然MetricX24表现最佳，但所有指标均存在盲点，表明需要更稳健、可解释的评估方法以适应数字人文工作流。
AI.motivation: 尽管大语言模型在翻译某些历史语言方面表现出色，但由于缺乏可靠的评估手段，其在数字人文工作流中的应用受到限制。研究旨在验证为现代语言开发的自动评估指标是否适用于此类场景。
AI.method: 以古典中文到英文的翻译为测试用例，引入基于“最小对”（minimal pairs）的诊断框架。该框架捕捉学术使用中显著的错误类型，并探测参考型（reference-based）和免参考型（reference-free）指标对错误的敏感度及对有效变异的容忍度。
AI.result: 发现所有现有指标均存在盲点（blind spots），但在整体表现上，MetricX24优于其他被评估的指标。
AI.conclusion: 现有的自动评估指标在处理具有历史和文化的独特性翻译任务时存在不足，亟需开发更稳健且可解释的评估指标，以支持历史及文化差异显著的翻译设置。

title: The Capability Ladder: A Curriculum-Modernization Framework for Workforce Readiness in the AI Era
summary: Artificial intelligence is changing the task composition of computing work faster than curricula and training typically adapt. This is a curriculum-framework paper, grounded in a structured narrative review of labor-market and software-engineering evidence and illustrated through an exploratory pilot course: the review supports the framework, and the pilot illustrates it rather than serving as primary evidence. The central claim is that near-term change is task reallocation rather than full replacement: routine implementation is increasingly automated while verification, systems thinking, security, and the ability to supervise and orchestrate AI (keeping a human in the loop) gain value. We organize the response as a capability-assurance framework anchored by a Capability Ladder: a five-level progression (trigger, automation, workflow, AI agent, agent team) that classifies the operational autonomy of AI-augmented work and the human supervision it requires. We map the ladder to course-level updates, workload-aware assessment, and stackable workforce credentials, and illustrate it through a two-semester pilot of a team-based, no-code course enrolling computing and business students. We argue for targeted modernization around durable capabilities rather than wholesale curriculum replacement, and we are explicit about evidence limits: labor signals are confounded by non-AI forces, industry reports are directional, and the pilot is exploratory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于“能力阶梯”的AI时代计算课程框架，主张通过任务重新分配（自动化常规实现，强化验证、系统思维及AI监督能力）而非完全替代来应对AI对工作的影响，并通过试点课程进行演示。
AI.motivation: 人工智能正迅速改变计算工作任务的构成，而现有的课程体系和培训往往难以跟上这一变化速度。
AI.method: 采用结构化叙事综述劳动市场和软件工程证据构建理论框架；设计并实施了一个为期两学期的团队制无代码试点课程（面向计算和商业专业学生），以演示该框架的应用。
AI.result: 提出了一个以“能力阶梯”为核心的能力保障框架，将AI增强型工作的操作自主性分为五个层级（触发、自动化、工作流、AI智能体、智能体团队）。研究证实了短期内的主要变化是任务重新分配而非完全替代，并展示了如何将此框架映射到课程更新、工作量评估和可堆叠的职业证书中。
AI.conclusion: 应围绕持久性的核心能力进行有针对性的现代化改造，而非彻底替换整个课程体系。同时明确指出当前证据存在局限性：劳动力信号受非AI因素干扰，行业报告仅具方向性指导意义，且试点研究属于探索性质。

title: HeatCast: A Benchmark for Neighborhood-Scale LST Forecasting across 124 U.S. Cities
summary: Land Surface Temperature (LST) is a widely used satellite-derived measure of urban surface heat, but there is no shared benchmark for forecasting it at 30 m. Prior studies usually cover one to three cities, use kilometer-scale products, or do not release data and code. We introduce HeatCast, a Landsat-based benchmark for monthly LST forecasting across 124 U.S. cities from 2013 through June 2025. HeatCast contains 30 m monthly tiles with LST, elevation, surfacereflectance RGB, three spectral indices, broadband albedo, quality masks, and Local Climate Zone (LCZ) labels, together with a fixed temporal split, LCZ-stratified metrics, and a reference evaluation harness. We evaluate a CNN+LSTM and Earthformer on next-month forecasting, where Earthformer reaches 7.74 K RMSE against 10.42 K for the CNN+LSTM. Forecasting from the eight nonLST channels alone reaches 7.72 K, against 8.15 K from LST history and 8.68 K from RGB. The data, code, and weights are released under MIT at https://doi.org/10.57967/hf/9889.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了HeatCast，一个基于Landsat数据的30米分辨率月度地表温度（LST）预测基准数据集，涵盖美国124个城市。研究对比了CNN+LSTM和Earthformer模型，发现Earthformer性能更优，且仅使用非LST通道即可达到接近全通道的预测精度。数据、代码及权重已开源。
AI.motivation: 解决当前LST预测研究中缺乏共享基准的问题，克服以往研究通常仅覆盖少数城市、使用千米级产品或不公开数据与代码的局限性，旨在推动高精度（30米）城市表面热预测的发展。
AI.method: 构建HeatCast基准数据集，包含2013年至2025年6月间124个美国城市的30米月度LST数据及相关辅助特征（高程、RGB反射率、光谱指数、反照率、质量掩码、LCZ标签）。采用固定的时间划分、LCZ分层指标和参考评估工具。评估了CNN+LSTM和Earthformer两种模型在次月LST预测任务中的表现。
AI.result: Earthformer模型的均方根误差（RMSE）为7.74 K，优于CNN+LSTM的10.42 K。仅使用八个非LST通道进行预测的RMSE为7.72 K，略优于使用LST历史数据的8.15 K和仅使用RGB数据的8.68 K。
AI.conclusion: HeatCast提供了一个高质量、高分辨率的LST预测基准，证实了Transformer架构（Earthformer）在该任务上的优越性，并表明利用多源遥感特征而非仅依赖历史LST数据可实现更精准的短期预测。所有资源已开源以促进后续研究。

title: Safety Cost of Steering Vectors Is Separable and Reducible
summary: Steering vectors are a lightweight tool for controlling LLM behavior. However, emerging evidence shows that steering vectors can unintentionally compromise a model's safety mechanisms and increase compliance with harmful requests, while no effective mitigation yet exists. In this work, we show that this safety degradation arises from a separable component in the vector that disrupts the model's safety mechanisms but contributes little to the steering objective. We identify and remove this safety-degrading component, formulating the task as a constrained optimization problem solved through primal-dual updates, subject to preserving the intended steering effect and bounding false refusal. The resulting solution is both interpretable and surgical: the optimization recovers a single direction whose ablation from the steering vector restores model safety with minimal utility cost. Across models, steering behaviors, and attack suites, including unseen attacks types, our method substantially reduces steering-induced safety degradation while preserving the original steering effect with minimal impact on false refusal. Our method offers a post-hoc correction to steering vectors that mitigates their safety cost, and more broadly, it provides a general recipe for applying activation-level model interventions without paying a safety tax.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对大语言模型（LLM）控制向量（Steering Vectors）的安全修复方法。研究发现现有的控制向量会无意中破坏模型的安全机制，导致对有害请求的顺从度增加。作者通过识别并移除向量中专门损害安全性的可分离组件，将其建模为约束优化问题，成功在保持原有控制效果的同时恢复了模型安全性，且几乎不影响误拒率。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM控制向量虽然轻量高效，但 emerging evidence 显示它们会意外削弱模型的安全防御机制，增加对有害请求的顺从性，且目前缺乏有效的缓解措施。
AI.method: 将任务形式化为约束优化问题，通过原始-对偶更新（primal-dual updates）求解。该方法旨在保留预期的控制效果并限制误拒（false refusal），同时识别并移除向量中破坏安全机制但对控制目标贡献微小的成分。
AI.result: 该方法具有可解释性和精准性（surgical），恢复出的单一方向被证明是造成安全退化的根源。消融该方向即可恢复模型安全性，同时带来极小的效用成本。在多种模型、控制行为和攻击套件（包括未见过的攻击类型）上，该方法显著降低了由控制向量引发的安全退化，同时保持了原有的控制效果和对误拒率的微小影响。
AI.conclusion: 该方法提供了一种后验修正（post-hoc correction）方案，有效缓解了控制向量的安全代价。更广泛地看，它为在不支付“安全税”的前提下应用激活层面（activation-level）的模型干预提供了一套通用范式。

title: Who Built This Model? Tracing LLM Lineage via Spectral Fingerprints in Weight Space
summary: Open-weight large language models (LLMs) are increasingly developed through complex, multi-stage pipelines, leading to intricate lineage relationships that reflect model origin, ownership, and evolution. Understanding these relationships is important for model provenance, governance, and supply-chain integrity. In this work, we investigate the notion of LLM "biometrics" (analogous to human biometrics) to ask whether LLMs exhibit intrinsic fingerprints in weight space alone, without access to input data, that reveal their origin and lineage. We formulate this as a lineage discrimination problem, distinguishing among independent-origin, same-series, and shared-base models. To characterize these relationships, we propose a unified geometric fingerprinting framework that analyzes weight matrices from two complementary perspectives: (i) spectral energy, captured by singular value distributions to encode global magnitude patterns, and (ii) subspace alignment, quantified via subspace deviations to capture directional geometry. Our analysis uncovers a clear hierarchy of structural similarity in weight space: spectral energy reliably distinguishes independently trained models and different model families, while subspace alignment enables fine-grained discrimination among closely related models, including variations in dataset scale and post-training procedures. Extensive experiments on over 110 diverse open-weight LLM pairs demonstrate that weight-space geometry provides a robust and interpretable signal for model lineage, enabling coarse-grained regime separation and fine-grained discrimination within shared-base models.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于权重空间几何特征的“LLM生物识别”框架，通过分析奇异值分布（谱能量）和子空间对齐（方向几何），在无需输入数据的情况下，有效区分开源大语言模型的来源、系列关系及共享基础模型的血统。
AI.motivation: 开源大语言模型（LLMs）通过复杂的多阶段流水线开发，形成了错综复杂的血统关系。理解这些关系对于模型溯源、治理和供应链完整性至关重要，但目前缺乏仅凭权重即可揭示模型起源和血统的内在指纹机制。
AI.method: 提出了一个统一的几何指纹识别框架，从两个互补视角分析权重矩阵：(i) 谱能量，通过奇异值分布编码全局幅度模式；(ii) 子空间对齐，通过量化子空间偏差捕捉方向几何结构。将问题建模为血统判别任务，区分独立起源、同系列和共享基础模型。
AI.result: 在110多个多样化的开源LLM对上进行了广泛实验，发现权重空间的几何结构提供了鲁棒且可解释的血统信号：谱能量可靠地区分独立训练的模型和不同模型家族，而子空间对齐能够细粒度地区分密切相关的模型（包括数据集规模和后训练程序的差异）。
AI.conclusion: 权重空间的几何特征构成了LLM血统的有效生物识别信号，能够实现粗粒度的分类分离以及共享基础模型内部的细粒度歧视，为模型溯源和治理提供了新的技术路径。

title: Data collection from highways: a geometric, class-agnostic approach to embedded vehicle counting
summary: Traffic data collection is dominated today by deep object detectors followed by tracking-by-detection, a pipeline that presupposes what is often missing in practice: a detector already trained on the class one wants to count. We revisit a purely geometric traffic-sensing pipeline for Single Board Computers in which detection is class-agnostic: moving objects come from background subtraction and thresholding, and counting is decided by a geometric rule on an imaginary line across the road, a software inductive loop detector. With no object model, training set or per-object trajectory, it runs faster than real time on Raspberry Pi class hardware. Two counting rules are described: a constant average speed rule, whose expected accuracy is derived analytically as about 86% under a Gaussian speed distribution, and a self-calibrating pre-calibration rule that recovers the lane geometry from blob statistics and counts edges of lane occupancy, additionally yielding per-vehicle average speed at no extra cost. Over four videos the latter counts with 83.3%-100% accuracy; in a field deployment it reaches 91% against 37.5% for a blob-tracking baseline under the same compute budget. We report the observations of that period in detail: the resolution floor below which accuracy collapses, the frame rate floor at which vehicles alias past the counting line, the gap between short curated clips and long uncontrolled footage, and the trade-off between Python (easier to tune, 100% CPU) and C++ (40% CPU, thermally viable). These are properties of the sampling geometry, not of the hardware of the time, and still constrain edge deployments. We close by arguing where motion-based, class-agnostic detection remains the right tool: open-set classes with no annotated data, tight power budgets, privacy-constrained installations, and the cold start of mining training crops to bootstrap a learned detector.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种无需预训练模型、纯几何规则的轻量级交通计数方法，在树莓派等低功耗硬件上实现实时处理，解决了传统深度学习检测器依赖标注数据和计算资源的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于深度学习的交通数据收集通常依赖“检测-跟踪”流水线，这需要预先针对特定类别进行训练的检测器，而这一前提在实际应用中往往缺失（如缺乏标注数据或特定类别样本）。
AI.method: 采用纯几何感知的无类属（class-agnostic）检测管线：通过背景减除和阈值分割获取移动物体，利用虚拟感应线圈的几何规则进行计数。提出了两种计数规则：恒定平均速度规则和分析推导出的自校准预校准规则（从blob统计中恢复车道几何并计数车道占用边缘）。
AI.result: 自校准规则在四个视频测试中准确率达到83.3%-100%；在现场部署中，该方法准确率达91%，显著优于同等计算预算下基于blob跟踪基线的37.5%。同时分析了分辨率下限、帧率下限、数据剪辑差异及Python与C++的性能权衡等约束条件。
AI.conclusion: 基于运动的无类属检测在开放集类别（无标注数据）、严格功耗预算、隐私敏感场景以及为学习检测器启动提供初始训练样本时，仍是理想的技术选型。其性能受限于采样几何而非当时硬件，这些约束对边缘部署仍具指导意义。

title: Hidden Language Consistency Phenomena in Reasoning LLMs
summary: Multilingual reasoning models are commonly evaluated by whether they arrive at the correct answer, but not by whether they preserve the intended language while reasoning and responding. This omission conceals important multilingual behaviors that emerge as tasks become harder. In this paper, we study task difficulty, task accuracy, thinking-language consistency (TC), and answer-language consistency (AC) across reasoning models using PolyMath benchmark in eight languages and four difficulty levels. We uncover four findings: (1) language consistency exhibits four difficulty-dependent behaviors: output-language consistency remains aligned with input, remains misaligned, degrades gradually, or collapses abruptly. (2) We identify the language consistency breakdown effect, where increasing difficulty can cause a sudden drop in output-language consistency, especially in less strongly represented and non-Latin-script languages. (3) Due to this breakdown effect, accuracy can be preserved or even improved at a harder difficulty level as the model shifts to its internal dominant language. (4) Quantization can improve or degrade output-language consistency independently of its effect on accuracy, with GPTQ and AWQ often outperforming AutoRound under tolerance-based voting with ε = 1.0. These results show that multilingual capability cannot be characterized by accuracy alone; reliable evaluation should jointly consider task accuracy, language consistency, and task difficulty for multilingual benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文指出仅凭准确率评估多语言推理模型存在缺陷，忽视了语言一致性。通过PolyMath基准测试发现，任务难度会导致输出语言一致性出现四种行为模式及“崩溃效应”，且量化技术对语言一致性的影响独立于准确率。结论是可靠的多语言评估需同时考量准确率、语言一致性和任务难度。
AI.motivation: 现有的多语言推理模型评估主要关注答案是否正确，而忽略了模型在推理和回答过程中是否保持了预期的语言。这种遗漏掩盖了随着任务难度增加而出现的多种多语言行为特征。
AI.method: 使用PolyMath基准测试，在八种语言和四个难度等级下，研究不同推理模型的任务难度、任务准确率、思维语言一致性（TC）和答案语言一致性（AC）。
AI.result: 1. 语言一致性随难度呈现四种行为：与输入对齐、保持错位、逐渐退化或突然崩溃。2. 识别出“语言一致性崩溃效应”，即难度增加导致输出语言一致性骤降，尤其在非拉丁字母和代表性较弱的语言中。3. 因该效应，模型可能转向其内部主导语言，从而在更高难度下保持甚至提升准确率。4. 量化（如GPTQ、AWQ优于AutoRound）对语言一致性的影响独立于准确率，取决于容差投票机制。
AI.conclusion: 多语言能力不能仅由准确率表征；针对多语言基准的可靠评估应联合考虑任务准确率、语言一致性和任务难度。

title: CliniCARE-Bench: Clinical Calibrated Audit of Medical Reasoning in EHR
summary: Large language models perform strongly on medical knowledge benchmarks, but reliable clinical deployment requires agents to conduct defensible investigations over heterogeneous, longitudinal records: determining what evidence is needed, retrieving and reconciling structured and free-text data, grounding conclusions in verifiable evidence, and deferring cases that cannot be resolved reliably. We introduce CliniCARE-Bench (Clinical Calibrated Audit of Medical Reasoning in EHR), a benchmark for retrospective clinical audit: 25 clinician-validated scenarios instantiated as 750 patient-specific cases over real-patient-derived MIMIC-IV data. Systems investigate each case through a governed, logged tool environment for record retrieval, computation, and policy access, and return one of four verdicts---Yes, No, Indeterminate: Lack of Data, or Indeterminate: Medically Ambiguous---the last two separating missing evidence from residual medical ambiguity. Beyond verdict accuracy, we score patient-evidence and policy grounding, process adherence, calibrated abstention, reliability, and efficiency against case-level reference verdicts produced by independent multi-model adjudication and calibrated against Clinical Board review. Every retrieval, computation, and report is replayable, so the investigation trace is inspectable and scorable. To our knowledge, CliniCARE-Bench is the first deployment-oriented clinical-agent benchmark to jointly evaluate real longitudinal EHR investigation, claim-level evidence grounding, governing-policy use, process adherence, and calibrated abstention within a common patient-level adjudication framework. Across 16 agentic systems, four-way accuracy spans 65.3-76.1%, but raw accuracy overstates investigation quality. Defect-free accuracy, which credits a verdict only when correct and free of prohibited shortcuts, is 4.8-14.8 points lower and reorders the leaderboard.

AI.tldr: 提出ClincARE-Bench，首个面向部署的临床智能体基准测试，基于MIMIC-IV数据评估模型在真实电子健康记录（EHR）中的证据检索、政策遵循及校准性弃权能力。
AI.motivation: 尽管大语言模型在医学知识基准上表现优异，但可靠的临床部署要求智能体能对异构、纵向病历进行可辩护的调查，包括确定所需证据、检索并协调结构化与非结构化数据、基于可验证证据得出结论，以及在无法可靠解决时适当弃权。
AI.method: 构建了包含25个经临床医生验证的场景和750个具体病例的基准测试系统。智能体通过受控的工具环境进行调查，返回四种裁决之一。评估指标涵盖裁决准确性、患者证据与政策 grounding、流程合规性、校准性弃权、可靠性及效率，所有操作均可回放和评分。
AI.result: 在16个智能体系统中，四分法准确率介于65.3%-76.1%之间。然而，“无缺陷准确率”（仅当裁决正确且未使用禁止捷径时才计分）比原始准确率低4.8-14.8个百分点，并重新排列了排行榜顺序，表明原始准确率高估了调查质量。
AI.conclusion: ClincARE-Bench是首个联合评估真实纵向EHR调查、证据 grounding、政策使用、流程合规性及校准性弃权的部署导向型临床智能体基准测试，揭示了单纯追求准确率可能掩盖智能体在合规性和可靠性方面的缺陷。

title: Keep It Simple: Multi-Key Episodic Memory Retrieval for Ultra-Long Video Understanding
comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026 (Oral). Project Page: https://choi-yeeun.github.io/MERIT/
summary: When videos extend from hours to days, directly processing them end-to-end becomes impractical for current Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs). This ultra-long setting necessitates a two-stage paradigm: query-agnostic memory construction followed by retrieval-based inference. Prior work invests in complex memory construction to pre-model high-level relations in videos, despite not knowing the downstream query at build time. We instead prioritize high-recall retrievability during memory building, and defer query-specific, high-level relation composition to inference time. To this end, we propose MERIT(Multi-key Episodic Retrieval with Inference-time Temporal expansion), a simple yet effective agentic framework for ultra-long video understanding. First, we formulate an episodic multi-key representation that enables precise retrieval of fine-grained memories through a simple key-matching mechanism. Second, we introduce a neighbor filtering mechanism to capture broader semantic context without the massive computational overhead of global memory construction. This is achieved by expanding the temporal scope exclusively around the retrieved segments at inference time. By leveraging simple key-matching with this on-demand temporal expansion, MERIT achieves state-of-the-art performance across three long-video benchmarks: EgoLifeQA, LVBench, and Video-MME (Long).

AI.tldr: 提出MERIT框架，通过构建高召回率的片段记忆并在推理时进行按需时间扩展，解决超长视频理解中端到端处理不可行的问题，在多个基准测试中达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）难以直接端到端处理长达数小时至数天的视频。现有方法倾向于在查询未知时构建复杂的记忆以预建模高层关系，效率低下且计算开销大。
AI.method: 提出MERIT（Multi-key Episodic Retrieval with Inference-time Temporal expansion），一种基于代理的框架：1. 使用episodic multi-key表示和简单的键匹配机制实现细粒度记忆的精确检索；2. 引入邻居过滤机制，仅在推理时围绕检索到的片段扩展时间范围，以捕获更广泛的语义上下文，避免全局记忆构建的巨大计算开销。
AI.result: 在EgoLifeQA、LVBench和Video-MME (Long)三个长视频基准测试中实现了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过在记忆构建阶段优先考虑高召回率，并将特定于查询的高层关系组合推迟到推理阶段，MERIT提供了一种简单有效的超长视频理解方案。

title: Calling the Bluff: Detecting Ever-Shifting Harmful Chat Dialogue via Ordered Reasoning Chain Regularization
summary: Harmful chat dialogues are ever-shifting through type-shifting and lexical evasion, yet we find they share invariant principles, i.e., an Ordered Reasoning Chain (ORC) of recurring topics, harm language indicators, severity hierarchies, and type characteristics, which can help us capture the key information in the frequently changing lexical expressions. We propose BRACE, which encodes the ORC as four differentiable stages (Topic -> Indicator -> Severity -> Type) with intermediate supervision, serving as a structured regularizer blended with direct heads, and supported by prototype-based feature augmentation and feature path disentanglement. The evaluation results show that, across 4 domains and 5 harm categories, BRACE achieves harm-type macro F1 of 0.934 (RoBERTa-wwm-ext, 3-seed mean), with decoder backbones (Qwen3-1.7B LoRA) reaching 0.949. Ablation studies show that all components contribute to BRACE, and the structural decomposition of ORC enables BRACE to distinguish harmful types with semantic ambiguity. Disclaimer: This paper may contain content that is disturbing to some readers.

AI.tldr: 提出BRACE模型，通过编码有害对话的有序推理链（ORC）作为结构化正则化器，显著提升跨领域和类别的危害类型检测性能。
AI.motivation: 针对有害聊天对话中存在的类型转换和词汇规避导致的表达多变性问题，旨在捕捉其不变的内在原则以准确提取关键信息。
AI.method: 提出BRACE模型，将有序推理链（ORC）编码为四个可微阶段（主题->指标->严重性->类型），结合中间监督、原型特征增强及特征路径解耦技术，并与直接头结构融合。
AI.result: 在4个领域和5类危害上，基于RoBERTa-wwm-ext的宏观F1达到0.934；基于Qwen3-1.7B LoRA解码器的表现达到0.949。消融实验证实各组件均有效，且结构化分解有助于解决语义歧义下的危害类型区分。
AI.conclusion: BRCE通过结构化分解有害对话的有序推理链，能有效应对词汇变化，显著提升危害类型检测的准确性和鲁棒性。

title: CausalNav: Reliability-Certified Causal World Models for Control under Physical-Parameter Shift
summary: A world model is only useful for physical AI if it changes what the agent does, and only safe if it declines to do so when it is wrong. We study both halves of that requirement with CausalNav, a controller built around a signed, action-conditioned transition graph over identified state coordinates. At deployment CausalNav simulates a small library of intervention sequences, converts their objective error into policy-logit advice, and admits that advice only when a scale-free predictive-reliability certificate, a policy-margin gate, and an argmax-agreement gate all pass; otherwise it falls back exactly to its own model-based base controller. We evaluate against nine controlled baselines (transformer, recurrent, split-latent, graph, causal-induction, and three recent model-based reasoning modules) on CartPole-v1 and discretized Pendulum-v1 with physical-parameter shifts, under one shared PPO trainer, one interaction budget, and ten held-out seeds (200 runs). CausalNav attains the best average rank (1.25 of ten). The diagnostic result is more informative than the ranking: the learned graph recovers structure well above chance (CartPole F1 = 0.59 +/- 0.09), yet per-seed structural fidelity is uncorrelated with per-seed control benefit (r = -0.15, p = 0.67), and the certificate abstains on 10/10 Pendulum seeds, where forcing the planner on costs return. Model fidelity did not predict downstream control utility in our setting; certified abstention, not better prediction, is what made the world model safe to deploy.

AI.tldr: CausalNav通过结合因果图、预测可靠性证书和策略门控机制，确保世界模型在物理AI任务中既有效又安全。实验表明，模型的“拒绝执行”能力（即在不确信时回退到基础控制器）比单纯提高预测精度更能提升控制性能和安全性。
AI.motivation: 验证世界模型是否仅在改变智能体行为时才具有实用性，以及是否在预测错误时能安全地拒绝执行。旨在解决世界模型在物理AI部署中的安全性和有效性问题。
AI.method: 提出CausalNav控制器，基于有符号的动作条件转换图。部署时模拟干预序列，将目标误差转化为策略建议，并通过无尺度预测可靠性证书、策略边际门限和argmax一致性门限进行验证；若未通过则回退至基于模型的基础控制器。在CartPole-v1和离散化Pendulum-v1上进行评估，对比9种基线方法。
AI.result: CausalNav在平均排名中表现最佳（1.25/10）。学习到的图结构恢复效果优于随机猜测（CartPole F1 = 0.59），但结构保真度与控制收益无显著相关性（r = -0.15）。在Pendulum任务中，证书在所有种子样本上均触发拒绝执行，强制规划反而降低回报。
AI.conclusion: 在该设定下，模型保真度并未预测下游控制效用；真正使世界模型可安全部署的关键在于“认证式拒绝执行”（certified abstention），而非更精准的预测。

title: CosmosAlign: Adapting a World Foundation Model for Generative Traffic Video Forecasting
summary: Generative traffic video forecasting aims to synthesize long-horizon, temporally coherent future videos of traffic scenes from a short observation history and textual descriptions. In this paper, we present CosmosAlign, a generative traffic video forecasting framework built upon the pretrained Cosmos3-Nano world foundation model. Our approach is motivated by the observation that successfully adapting large pretrained world models to downstream forecasting tasks depends primarily on distribution alignment rather than increased model capacity. To this end, we propose a two-stage LoRA adaptation strategy that first aligns the conditioning-mode distribution with the target forecasting task, and then aligns the training captions with the model's native structured prompting interface through an LLM-based re-captioning pipeline. During inference, we further improve prediction quality using a fully training-free procedure consisting of consensus-based medoid sample selection and motion-adaptive blending of static scene regions. CosmosAlign achieves a final score of 76.49 on the AI City Challenge 2026 Track 5 benchmark, ranking first on the final leaderboard. Our code is publicly available at https://quangminhdinh.github.io/CosmosAlign/.

AI.tldr: 提出CosmosAlign框架，基于预训练世界模型进行生成式交通视频预测。核心在于通过两阶段LoRA适配和LLM重标注实现分布对齐，无需增加模型容量即可提升性能，并在AI City Challenge 2026中获得第一名。
AI.motivation: 观察到将大型预训练世界模型适应到下游预测任务的关键主要取决于分布对齐（distribution alignment），而非单纯增加模型容量。
AI.method: 1. 构建基于Cosmos3-Nano的生成式框架；2. 提出两阶段LoRA适配策略：首先使条件模式分布与目标预测任务对齐，其次通过基于LLM的重标注管道使训练标题与模型的原始结构化提示接口对齐；3. 推理阶段采用无训练过程，结合共识介体样本选择和运动自适应静态场景区域混合来提升质量。
AI.result: 在AI City Challenge 2026 Track 5基准测试中取得76.49的最终得分，排名最终排行榜第一。代码已公开。
AI.conclusion: 通过分布对齐策略（特别是条件模式和文本提示的对齐）可以有效利用预训练世界模型进行长时序、时间连贯的交通视频生成预测，证明了该方法在效率和效果上的优越性。

title: When the Judge Should Not Decide: Evidence-Locked, Non-Compensatory Selection Bounds LLM-Judge Failure in Reasoning Pipelines
summary: An LLM judge deployed inside a reasoning pipeline does not merely measure quality, it decides which answer ships. We show that the cost of that decision depends less on judge accuracy than on the decision rule the judge is embedded in. On frozen candidate pools from four GRPO policies, an unconstrained scalar DeepSeek-R1-7B judge buys almost nothing over answer-level majority vote (+1.0 pp on 500 GSM8K questions, +0.34 EM on 300 HotpotQA questions), and on a frozen-rule 30-question confirmation split it is 10 points worse than majority, a judge that destroys accuracy while scoring candidates confidently. We then subordinate the same judge to Evidence-Locked Derive-Gate-Repair (EL-DGR), a task-adaptive non-compensatory rule under which a judge preference may override evidence-supported consensus only with an extractive evidence certificate, and a repair only when neither alternative is certified and the repair is. With no change to the judge, the candidates, or the budget, EL-DGR reaches 58.2% on GSM8K (vs. 56.8% judge, 55.8% majority, 55.4% first candidate) and 17.33 EM / 25.46 F1 on HotpotQA (vs. 15.67/23.49, 15.33/23.19, 15.33/22.97), improving on first-candidate GRPO by +2.8 pp (exact McNemar p=0.0026) and +2.00 EM (p=0.070, borderline). A decision audit shows why: EL-DGR overturns consensus on only 8 of 30 pilot questions and never converts a correct consensus into an incorrect answer. We also report what did not work: the same seven-channel decomposition used as a step-level gated training reward is null, and corrected channel-drop ablations show no channel is individually necessary (p=1.0 throughout). The practitioner-facing finding is negative about judges and positive about admissibility, bound the judge's blast radius rather than trying to make it accurate.

AI.tldr: 研究发现LLM裁判的性能更多取决于其嵌入的决策规则而非裁判本身的准确性。提出EL-DGR规则，通过证据锁定限制裁判权限，在不改变模型和预算的情况下显著优于多数投票和直接采用裁判结果。
AI.motivation: 探究在推理管道中部署LLM裁判时，决定最终答案质量的真正关键因素是裁判的准确率还是其所处的决策规则。
AI.method: 使用四个GRPO策略的冻结候选池，对比无约束DeepSeek-R1-7B裁判、多数投票法与提出的任务自适应非补偿性规则EL-DGR（Evidence-Locked Derive-Gate-Repair）。EL-DGR要求裁判偏好必须附带提取式证据证书才能覆盖共识，且仅在无认证替代方案时允许修复。
AI.result: EL-DGR在GSM8K上达到58.2%准确率（优于裁判的56.8%和多数投票的55.8%），在HotpotQA上也取得更高EM/F1分数。审计显示EL-DGR极少推翻共识且从不将正确共识转为错误。相比之下，七通道分解作为训练奖励无效，且无单一通道具有必要性。
AI.conclusion: 实践启示在于：应通过“可采性”规则（如证据绑定）来限制裁判的影响范围（blast radius），而不是单纯追求提高裁判模型的准确率。

title: SpikeWorld: Fast-State Adaptation for Frozen Spiking World Models
summary: A predictive model receives a self-supervised signal whenever the consequence of an action is observed. Using that signal after deployment is difficult when dynamics and semantics share parameters: freezing prevents adaptation, whereas weight updates require optimizer state and may alter the learned representation. Here we introduce SpikeWorld, a 1.45M-parameter sparse spiking model jointly trained for heterogeneous sensory prediction, semantics, image-text binding and action-conditioned dynamics. At deployment, all trained parameters are frozen. Delayed next-state residuals update two external paths: cumulative fixed-bank losses select the bounded action correction, while route-specific residual matrices refine next-state prediction. Neither path uses labels, teacher outputs, rewards, success signals or the true shift value. Joint optimization improves action next-state MSE by 17.10\% while also improving multimodal prediction, semantic accuracy and image-text retrieval. On held-out shear and attenuation streams, the combined external state improves aggregate prediction by 5.48\% and 30.01\%; its fixed-bank action path improves tracking by 24.20\% and 3.94\%, respectively. In a six-arm study comprising 450 new Meta-World trajectories (75 per arm), SpikeWorld raises frozen-policy reward by 7.90 (95\% CI [2.48, 14.06]); the 13.33-point success difference is descriptive (CI [0, 40]). For identical sensory inputs, model parameters and inherited semantic outputs remain bitwise unchanged. A 16-byte RLS estimator obtains the highest non-oracle reward on linear attenuation, showing that the contribution is not superior linear identification, but its integration with a frozen multimodal spiking checkpoint. Reference code is publicly available at https://github.com/Oooorca/SpikeWorld.

AI.tldr: 提出SpikeWorld，一种1.45M参数的稀疏脉冲模型，在部署时冻结所有参数。通过两个外部路径（累积固定库损失选择动作修正、路由特定残差矩阵细化状态预测）利用延迟的下一状态残差进行无标签自适应，显著提升了多模态预测、语义准确性和机器人控制奖励，同时保持内部参数位级不变。
AI.motivation: 解决在动态和语义共享参数的情况下，部署后难以利用自监督信号的问题：冻结参数会阻止适应，而权重更新需要优化器状态并可能改变已学习的表示。
AI.method: 引入SpikeWorld模型，联合训练异构感官预测、语义、图像-文本绑定和动作条件动力学。部署时冻结所有训练参数，使用延迟的下一状态残差更新两个外部路径：一个用于选择有界动作修正，另一个用于细化下一状态预测。这些路径不使用标签、教师输出、奖励或真实偏移值。
AI.result: 联合优化使动作下一状态均方误差（MSE）降低17.10%，并改善多模态预测、语义准确性和图像-文本检索。在保留的剪切和衰减流上，组合外部状态将聚合预测提高5.48%和30.01%；固定库动作路径将跟踪性能分别提高24.20%和3.94%。在包含450条新Meta-World轨迹的六臂研究中，SpikeWorld使冻结策略的奖励提高7.90（95% CI [2.48, 14.06]）。对于相同的感官输入，模型参数和继承的语义输出保持位级不变。
AI.conclusion: SpikeWorld通过结合冻结的多模态脉冲检查点与轻量级外部自适应机制（如16字节RLS估计器），在不修改内部参数的情况下实现了有效的在线适应和性能提升，证明了其集成优势优于单纯的线性识别方法。

title: VectraYX-Vision-1B: A Sub-2B Spanish/LATAM Cybersecurity Vision-Language Model with Structured Visual Reasoning and Native Tool Use
summary: We present VectraYX-Vision-1B, a sub-2B vision-language model (VLM) for Spanish/LATAM cybersecurity imagery, coupling a frozen SigLIP-so400m encoder to a 1.04B Spanish/LATAM security decoder via an MLP. To our knowledge, it is the first sub-2B VLM specialized for cyber UI (IDA, Ghidra, Wireshark, Nmap, Metasploit, Volatility) that answers in Spanish, emits structured reasoning via native <|think|> tokens, invokes tools via Model Context Protocol (<|tool_call|>), and exports to llama.cpp's LLaVA mmproj format for air-gapped deployment. We report a negative preliminary visual-grounding result: despite fully functional pipelines, the current vision SFT (400-1900 steps, ~16M tokens) yields near-zero B6 scores (0.08 tool-identification), ignoring image content. We specify remediation (longer SFT, >=60% replay, lower LR) and expose a checkpoint-loader bug (unstripped llm. prefix) masquerading as training collapse. Crucially, we introduce a 3-variant ablation matrix (V0: NoPE-every-4, V1: all-RoPE, V2: NoPE+learned 2D) to study if periodic no-positional-encoding (NoPE) layers help or hurt attention over the 729-token visual block. Code, configs, and weights are released to establish priority on this architectural question. We provide B1-B5 for the text backbone, text controls, preliminary B6/B7 scores, wall times, GGUF efficiency on CPU, and a corpus of 14,596 QA pairs across 10 domains. We open-source all models and trajectories: jsantillana/vectrayx-1b, jsantillana/vectrayx-vision-1b, and jsantillana/vectrayx-vision-1b-checks.

AI.tldr: 介绍了VectraYX-Vision-1B，一个面向西班牙语/拉美网络安全图像的子2B视觉语言模型。尽管在工具调用和推理格式上具有创新功能，但初步视觉定位结果显示性能接近于零（B6分数0.08）。文章揭示了训练中的检查点加载bug及位置编码变体的消融实验，并开源了所有代码、配置和权重以确立该架构问题的优先权。
AI.motivation: 旨在开发首个专门针对网络安全用户界面（如IDA, Ghidra, Wireshark等）且能用西班牙语回答的子2B视觉语言模型，支持结构化推理、工具调用及离线部署，同时通过消融研究探索不同位置编码策略对注意力机制的影响。
AI.method: 采用冻结的SigLIP-so400m编码器连接1.04B西班牙语/安全解码器，通过MLP耦合。引入原生<think>令牌进行结构化推理，使用Model Context Protocol进行工具调用，并导出至llama.cpp格式。进行了3种位置编码变体（V0: 每4层无PE, V1: 全部RoPE, V2: 无PE+学习式2D）的消融实验，并对视觉监督微调（SFT）过程进行诊断和修复。
AI.result: 实现了具备特定领域功能的模型管道，但初步视觉定位结果不佳（B6分数仅0.08），主要归因于SFT步骤不足、回放比例低及学习率问题，以及一个未剥离llm前缀的检查点加载bug。提供了文本骨干网B1-B5评分、CPU效率分析及包含14,596个问答对的语料库数据。
AI.conclusion: 虽然当前版本在视觉定位上存在显著缺陷，但研究成功识别了导致训练崩溃的技术原因（bug与超参数问题），并通过开源完整的模型、轨迹及消融实验数据，为后续改进位置编码策略及小参数网络安全VLM的发展奠定了基础。

title: Counterfactual Benchmarking and Training for Factuality Consistency and Order-Robust Grounded Reasoning in LLMs over Heterogeneous Knowledge
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have increasingly supported response generation grounded in user-provided knowledge spanning heterogeneous structures. However, existing benchmarks provide limited assessment of whether LLMs can faithfully perform multi-hop reasoning chains across such knowledge contexts while remaining robust to variations in their input order. We introduce TKFQA, a factuality consistency benchmark comprising 10,130 question-answering (QA) pairs grounded in tables, texts, and knowledge graphs (KGs). Each example is constructed from an explicit counterfactual reasoning chain, enabling the joint evaluation of answer correctness, reasoning-chain accuracy, and robustness to different input-order. An extensive evaluation of 14 open- and closed-source LLMs reveals that state-of-the-art models exhibit limited reasoning-chain accuracy and remain sensitive to variations in the input order of heterogeneous knowledge contexts. To address these limitations, we propose ORLF, an LLM-agnostic training framework that models cross-context topological relations through knowledge-specific latent vectors. ORLF integrates context-wise position encoding, a latent-bridge attention mask, and topological knowledge bias to preserve knowledge-specific bias and encode topological semantics. Experiments across four LLM backbones show that ORLF outperforms competitive training-free and LoRA-based baselines, improving average Exact Match and Reasoning-Chain Accuracy by 2.15% and 4.29%, respectively, while reducing order-induced performance standard deviation by 0.04% to 3.01%.

AI.tldr: 本文针对大语言模型（LLM）在异构知识（表格、文本、知识图谱）上进行多跳推理时，存在推理链准确性低且对输入顺序敏感的问题。作者提出了TKFQA基准测试以评估事实一致性和鲁棒性，并设计了ORLF训练框架，通过建模跨上下文拓扑关系显著提升了模型的推理准确性和顺序鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有的基准测试无法充分评估LLM在异构知识背景下执行多跳推理链条的忠实度，以及其对输入顺序变化的鲁棒性。需要一种机制来联合评估答案正确性、推理链准确性和顺序鲁棒性。
AI.method:
1. 构建TKFQA基准：包含10,130个基于表格、文本和知识图谱的问答对，每个示例均基于显式的反事实推理链构建。
2. 提出ORLF框架：一种与LLM无关的训练框架，通过知识特定的潜在向量建模跨上下文拓扑关系。
3. ORLF核心技术：整合上下文感知位置编码、潜在桥接注意力掩码（latent-bridge attention mask）和拓扑知识偏差，以保留知识特定偏差并编码拓扑语义。
AI.result:
1. 基准评估显示，当前最先进的LLM在多跳推理链准确性上表现有限，且对异构知识上下文的输入顺序变化敏感。
2. ORLF在四种LLM骨干网络上优于无训练基线和LoRA基线。
3. 具体提升：平均精确匹配率（Exact Match）提高2.15%，推理链准确性（Reasoning-Chain Accuracy）提高4.29%。
4. 顺序诱导的性能标准差降低0.04%至3.01%，表明鲁棒性增强。
AI.conclusion: LLM在处理异构知识的多跳推理中仍存在准确性不足和对输入顺序敏感的问题。提出的ORLF框架通过有效建模拓扑关系，显著改善了推理准确性和鲁棒性，为后续研究提供了新的方向和基准。

title: Tokenizer Generator Coupling in Medical Image Generation
summary: Latent medical image generators usually treat the tokenizer as fixed preprocessing. We test whether this separation is valid in a controlled ChestMNIST study at 64x64, crossing discrete tokenizers, generator families, and sampler settings under a shared latent grid, with continuous-latent reference cells. In this controlled setting, rankings depend jointly on the tokenizer, generator, and sampler: the best quantizer changes with the generator, and validation-based sampler selection changes the apparent generator ranking. We retrain the vocabulary-1024 interaction block at three seeds and the interaction survives (6 of 9 pairwise quantizer comparisons exceed three seed standard deviations), and we scope the wider single-seed grid accordingly. Reconstruction PSNR alone is not a reliable selection criterion; we instead introduce a generator-free statistic, neighbour-conditional predictive gain, that separates the quantizer families by downstream generation quality (rank-AUC 1.00) where reconstruction PSNR and marginal token entropy do not. On LFQ-1024, retuning D3PM and SE-D3PM (selected on a held-out validation split) moves them from default FID-192 0.44/0.41 to 0.09/0.10 at lower NFE, replicated across seeds; the continuous references were not given an equivalent sampler sweep. We report FID-192 as an internal ranking metric; it ranks consistently with standard FID-2048 (Spearman 0.80) and with a label-free classifier two-sample test (0.78). We interpret these results through a rate-distortion-modelability framing, where modelability is conditional on the generator, sampler, and inference budget. All experiments are at 64x64 on low-resolution medical-style images, unconditional, and evaluated with non-clinical FID-based metrics, and we scope every claim to that setting. Code: https://github.com/liamchalcroft/medtokenizers and https://github.com/liamchalcroft/medlatents.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过受控实验挑战了潜在医学图像生成器中固定使用分词器的假设。研究发现，最佳量化器、生成器和采样器之间存在紧密耦合关系，单纯依赖重建PSNR无法有效评估性能。作者提出了“邻居条件预测增益”这一无生成器统计量来分离量化器家族，并通过微调D3PM和SE-D3PM显著降低了FID分数。结论强调模型能力取决于生成器、采样器和推理预算的综合考量，且所有结论仅限于64x64低分辨率非临床指标下的测试环境。
AI.motivation: 潜在医学图像生成器通常将分词器（tokenizer）视为固定的预处理步骤。本研究旨在验证这种分离是否有效，特别是在离散分词器、不同生成器家族和采样器设置交叉的情况下，探索它们共享潜在网格时的相互作用及影响。
AI.method:
1. 在ChestMNIST数据集（64x64分辨率）上进行受控研究，交叉测试离散分词器、生成器家族和采样器设置。
2. 重新训练词汇量为1024的交互块，并在三个随机种子下进行验证。
3. 引入“邻居条件预测增益”（neighbour-conditional predictive gain）作为无生成器的统计指标，用于评估下游生成质量，替代传统的重建PSNR。
4. 对LFQ-1024进行微调，调整D3PM和SE-D3PM参数，降低非函数评估次数（NFE），并使用FID-192作为内部排名指标。
5. 通过速率-失真-可建模性（rate-distortion-modelability）框架解释结果。
AI.result:
1. 排名依赖于分词器、生成器和采样器的联合选择：最佳量化器随生成器变化，基于验证集的采样器选择会改变生成器的表观排名。
2. 交互效应在三个种子下依然显著（9对量化器比较中有6对超过三个标准差）。
3. “邻居条件预测增益”能有效区分量化器家族的下游生成质量（rank-AUC为1.00），而重建PSNR和边际token熵则不能。
4. 在LFQ-1024上，微调后的D3PM和SE-D3PM FID-192从默认的0.44/0.41显著降至0.09/0.10，且在较低NFE下实现，结果在多个种子间复现。
5. FID-192与标准FID-2048（Spearman相关系数0.80）及无标签分类器双样本测试（0.78）排名一致。
AI.conclusion: 潜在医学图像生成器的性能并非仅由单一组件决定，而是受到分词器、生成器、采样器和推理预算的共同影响。建议不要单独依赖重建PSNR来选择组件，而应采用更能反映下游生成质量的指标。研究结果需在特定的低分辨率、无条件、非临床评估背景下谨慎解读。代码已开源。

title: From Speech to Interaction: Analyzing Multimodal Systems in Cocktail-Party Scenarios
summary: Humans have the remarkable ability to engage in spontaneous informal conversations and selectively attend to individual speakers while filtering out competing speech from nearby conversations. This "cocktail party" scenario still presents severe challenges to speech recognition systems. The CHiME-9 MCoRec task provides a testbed where systems must recognize groups of speakers and transcribe each of their conversations from audio-visual input. In this work, we analyze a diverse set of systems, representing different design directions for addressing the cocktail-party scenario, where the best system achieves up to 57% relative error reduction. We identify three main strategies: (1) explicit or implicit audio-visual target speech separation, (2) improved audio-visual speech recognition for each target speaker, and (3) the use of large language models to group speakers into conversations and enhance conversational consistency. Our analysis shows that these directions address complementary failure modes of the cocktail-party problem, and that high speech overlap alone does not explain performance differences, challenging the common assumption that overlap is the primary source of difficulty in cocktail-party recognition.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了针对“鸡尾酒会”场景（多说话人音频-视觉识别）的多种系统，发现最佳系统实现了57%的相对错误率降低。研究识别出三种主要策略：音视频目标语音分离、改进的单说话人识别以及利用大语言模型增强对话一致性。结果表明这些策略互补，且高语音重叠并非性能差异的主要原因。
AI.motivation: 解决人类在嘈杂环境中选择性听取特定说话人的能力对当前语音识别系统构成的严峻挑战，特别是CHiME-9 MCoRec任务中从音视频输入中识别多组说话人并转录其对话的需求。
AI.method: 分析代表不同设计方向的多样化系统，重点评估三种策略的效果：(1) 显式或隐式的音视频目标语音分离；(2) 针对每个目标说话人的改进型音视频语音识别；(3) 使用大语言模型将说话人分组并提升对话连贯性。
