1. 在未校准的流程下，概念可操控性看似随模型规模增加而增强，但这是一种假象；校正任一因素（原始单位、读出指标或操作点）即可消除该趋势。
2. 在使用残差范数可比干预和保留测试集操作点选择的严格条件下，概念引导在所有规模上均显著，但在Qwen3系列中未发现显著的跨规模趋势（尽管置信区间不排除中等正斜率）。
3. 其他结果混合：线性地理世界地图在直至72B的所有检查点中均可解码；数字幅度编码强烈，但单个神经元的分布形态取决于选择标准；语言特异性结构可定位，但跨语言不对称的方向会因归因方法不同而反转。
AI.conclusion: 当前AI神经科学面临的主要约束并非缺乏相关现象，而是缺乏可比性的测量方法和充分的对照实验。研究者发布了相应的协议、刺激材料和代码以促进更严谨的研究。

title: Staying True to the Origin: Continuous Image Stylization with Smooth Transitions
summary: Recent advances in generative models have achieved remarkable performance in text- and image-conditioned editing. However, preserving the content of a given image while referencing style patterns from another remains challenging, often leading to uncontrollable stylization results. In this paper, we approach image stylization from the perspective of continuous control, aiming to enable modern Diffusion Transformer (DiT)-based multi-reference editing models to (1) faithfully preserve the semantic structure of the content image, (2) render strong stylization effects, and (3) smoothly transition between the two. To this end, we propose a simple yet effective two-stage training strategy along with a style-strength-aware spline formulation. Specifically, in the first stage, the model is trained to produce strongly stylized outputs while preserving the content semantics as much as possible. In the second stage, with the base model frozen, we learn a set of anchor projectors that map various stylization strengths into the model parameter space. During inference, by performing style-strength-aware spline interpolation in a low-rank space, our method enables continuous control over stylization strength, even though the model is trained with only a few discrete strength levels. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method supports precise and continuous manipulation of stylization strength while generating high-fidelity results with modern DiT models. Project page: https://reychiaro.github.io/StyleController.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于DiT的两阶段训练策略和样条插值方法，实现图像风格化中内容保持与风格强度的连续、可控控制。
AI.motivation: 解决现有生成模型在多参考图像编辑中难以在保留原始图像内容的同时，有效引用另一图像的风格模式的问题，避免风格化结果不可控。
AI.method: 提出两阶段训练策略：第一阶段训练模型在尽可能保留内容语义的同时产生强风格化输出；第二阶段冻结基础模型，学习一组锚点投影器将不同风格强度映射到模型参数空间。推理时，通过低秩空间中的风格强度感知样条插值，实现对风格强度的连续控制。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法支持对风格强度的精确且连续的操控，同时利用现代DiT模型生成高保真结果。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能有效平衡内容保留与风格化效果，并通过连续控制提升多参考图像编辑的可控性和质量。

title: EmoS: A Theory-Grounded Framework for Evaluating and Aligning Emotional Intelligence in Spoken Language Models
summary: Despite significant advances in instruction-following and auditory comprehension, the evaluation of Emotional Intelligence (EI) in Spoken Language Models (SLMs) remains confined to rudimentary paralinguistic perception, lacking a systematic, theory-driven cognitive framework. We introduce EmoSBench, the first comprehensive EI evaluation benchmark for SLMs constructed upon the four-branch theoretical model, covering Perceiving, Understanding, Using, and Managing Emotion across ten sub-tasks. Preliminary assessments on EmoSBench reveal a substantial gap: even leading proprietary models like GPT-4o-Audio achieve only 52.6%, significantly trailing human baselines. To bridge this gap, we develop EmoS, a specialized evaluator model optimized via Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). To facilitate its effective training, we curate EmoDialogue, a bilingual dataset providing necessary fine-grained supervision through response pairs with rigorously defined EI gradations. Concurrently, we introduce a reward mechanism integrating a Steep Exponential Accuracy Reward (SEAR) and a Rationale Fidelity Reward (RFR) to enforce precise ordinal scoring and valid reasoning. Experiments demonstrate that EmoS reaches 83.8% accuracy, approaching human-level performance. Furthermore, evaluations on authentic, unconstrained spoken interactions validate its robust real-world generalization, establishing a foundational framework for advancing emotionally intelligent dialogue systems.

AI.tldr: 提出EmoSBench基准和EmoS模型，解决语音语言模型情感智力评估不足问题，通过定制数据集和奖励机制实现接近人类水平的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有语音语言模型（SLMs）的情感智力（EI）评估局限于简单的副语言感知，缺乏基于认知理论的系统性框架，且主流模型表现远逊于人类水平。
AI.method: 1. 构建EmoSBench：基于四分支情感理论模型（感知、理解、使用、管理），涵盖10个子任务。2. 开发EmoS评估器：通过监督微调（SFT）和群体相对策略优化（GRPO）进行优化。3. 创建EmoDialogue数据集：提供双语、细粒度的响应对以支持训练。4. 设计混合奖励机制：结合陡峭指数准确性奖励（SEAR）和理由保真度奖励（RFR）。
AI.result: EmoS在EmoSBench上达到83.8%的准确率，显著优于基线模型（如GPT-4o-Audio的52.6%），并接近人类水平；在真实非约束语音交互中展现出强大的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: EmoS为提升具有情感智力的对话系统提供了基础框架，证明了系统化评估与针对性训练在弥合AI与人类情感理解差距方面的有效性。

title: Agentic AI-driven Immersive Simulation: A Knowledge-Aware Virtual Training Platform forHigh Dose Rate (HDR) Brachytherapy
summary: The convergence of the Metaverse and Large Language Model (LLM)-based AI agent is catalyzing a shift toward autonomous, immersive, and personalized pedagogical frameworks in medical education. This paper presents a novel agentic AI-driven immersive simulation specifically designed for High Dose Rate (HDR) vaginal cylinder (VC) brachytherapy in cancer care. By integrating Virtual Reality (VR) and mobile computing, the system establishes a high-fidelity, risk-free environment that allows trainees to master complex procedural skills without the facility or safety constraints posed by physical anatomy or live radioactive sources. A core contribution of this work is the seamless integration of a knowledge-aware assistant leveraging Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to ground agent interactions in authoritative clinical guidelines. This architecture also enables an interactive agent to provide natural language interfaces and hands-free, real-time guidance during intricate medical maneuvers. We validate the proposed system through a prototype deployment comprising a Meta Quest 3 interface linked to a local GPU-accelerated AI backend, demonstrating a feasible architecture for HDR brachytherapy simulation. Experimental results indicate that the system maintains suitable end-to-end latency and high context precision, answer completeness, and relevance in the RAG-enhanced pedagogical support.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于智能体AI的沉浸式VR模拟系统，用于HDR阴道近距离治疗培训。通过整合RAG技术与权威临床指南，该系统为医学生提供了高保真、无风险且具备实时自然语言指导的学习环境，并在原型验证中展现了低延迟和高语境精度。
AI.motivation: 医疗教育需要向自主、沉浸和个性化的框架转变；传统的HDR阴道近距离治疗培训受限于物理解剖结构的安全约束和放射性源的使用限制，缺乏安全且高保真的训练环境。
AI.method: 构建了一个结合虚拟现实（VR）和移动计算的智能体AI驱动模拟系统。核心创新在于集成基于检索增强生成（RAG）的知识感知助手，将代理交互锚定在权威临床指南上，并通过Meta Quest 3接口与本地GPU加速后端连接，提供自然语言界面和免提实时指导。
AI.result: 原型部署验证了架构的可行性。实验结果显示，系统保持了合适的端到端延迟，并在RAG增强的教学支持中实现了高语境精度、答案完整性和相关性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证实了将Metaverse与LLM智能体结合在复杂医疗程序（如HDR近距离治疗）培训中的可行性，为未来建立安全、高效且个性化的沉浸式医学教育平台提供了可行的技术路径。

title: When Does An Extra View Help? Adapting Single-View 3D Reconstruction with Extra Imagery
summary: Reconstruction of 3D objects from a single image is a challenging research problem in computer vision. The key challenge is the lack of critical information from viewpoints to complete 3D structures. Using an additional view may help to resolve the issue. However, there is no mechanism that can integrate the extra view into the single-view 3D reconstruction principle. We address this challenge by proposing ASV3D, a framework for adapting single-view 3D object reconstruction to test-time data with support from one additional image. We introduce two adaptation strategies: (i) a zero-shot adaptation scheme that leverages the auxiliary image to improve the reconstruction quality of an object without retraining, and (ii) an optimised adaptation scheme that further enhances visual fidelity and cross-view consistency via contrastive learning. We apply our ASV3D to improve two state-of-the-art single-view 3D reconstruction pipelines on both benchmark and real-world datasets. Results demonstrate that our approach consistently improves reconstruction accuracy and robustness under unconstrained multi-view inputs, outperforming the baselines in both quantitative metrics and human preference. We publish our code and the real-world object dataset in our project page at https://github.com/YNhuHuynh/ASV3D/tree/main.

AI.tldr: 提出ASV3D框架，通过引入单张额外图像，以零样本和优化两种适应策略，显著提升单视图3D重建在测试时的精度与一致性。
AI.motivation: 解决单视图3D重建因视角信息缺失导致结构不完整的问题；现有方法缺乏将额外视角有效整合进单视图重建机制的手段。
AI.method: 提出ASV3D框架，包含两种适应策略：(i) 零样本适应方案，利用辅助图像在不重训练情况下提升重建质量；(ii) 优化适应方案，通过对比学习进一步增强视觉保真度和跨视图一致性。
AI.result: 在基准和真实世界数据集上应用该框架改进两个SOTA单视图3D重建管线，实验表明该方法在非约束多视角输入下 consistently 提升了重建精度和鲁棒性，在定量指标和人类偏好评估中均优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: ASV3D有效解决了单视图3D重建中额外视角整合难题，显著提升了重建性能，并开源了代码与真实物体数据集。

title: UNMASK: Discovering and Causally Verifying Spurious Shortcuts in Text Classifiers
summary: Neural language models trained on large crowdsourced corpora frequently exploit spurious surface patterns tied to target labels without true linguistic or causal relevance, boosting benchmark performance while failing on adversarial or out-of-distribution inputs. Existing approaches either require manual specification of the feature vocabulary or automate discovery only partially, leaving the gap between dataset-level correlation and model-level exploitation unaddressed. We present U N M ASK, a fully automated pipeline that discovers, causally verifies, and mitigates spurious correlations in text classifiers without additional human annotation. Given unlabeled training examples, U N M ASK generates candidate surface patterns as executable boolean expressions, filters them through a statistical validation protocol with independent replication, and establishes causal model dependence via verified counterfactual interventions. Causally confirmed features then serve as annotation-free group definitions for Deep Feature Reweighting, eliminating the group labels that standard DFR requires. Applied to BERT and RoBERTa trained on MNLI, our pipeline independently rediscovers established lexical-overlap and negation biases, verifying 9 of 10 features on BERT and 6 on RoBERTa, and improving HANS accuracy by up to 12.58 pp. On CivilComments-WILDS, programmatic groups match the 70.1% worst- group accuracy of hand-labeled DFR (Kirichenko et al., 2023) without demographic annotation. We further demonstrate that the discovery and validation stages generalize to reward model preference data, surfacing interpretable spurious correlations in RewardBench2.

AI.tldr: UNMASK是一个全自动管道，用于发现、因果验证和缓解文本分类器中的虚假相关性，无需额外人工标注。它通过生成布尔表达式候选模式、统计验证和反事实干预，成功重发现已知偏见并提升模型在对抗性输入上的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 神经语言模型常利用与目标标签相关的虚假表面模式（spurious surface patterns）来提升基准性能，但在对抗性或分布外输入上表现不佳。现有方法要么需要手动指定特征词汇，要么只能部分自动化发现，未能解决数据集层面的相关性与模型层面利用之间的差距。
AI.method: 提出UNMASK全自动流程：1) 针对无标签训练样本生成可执行的布尔表达式作为候选表面模式；2) 通过具有独立复制的统计验证协议进行过滤；3) 通过已验证的反事实干预建立因果模型依赖性。随后，使用因果确认的特征作为无标注的组定义，应用于深度特征重加权（Deep Feature Reweighting, DFR），从而消除标准DFR所需的人工组标签。
AI.result: 在MNLI数据集上训练的BERT和RoBERTa中，该管道独立重发现了既有的词法重叠和否定偏见，分别验证了BERT上9/10和RoBERTa上6/10的特征，并将HANS准确率提高了最高12.58个百分点。在CivilComments-WILDS数据集上，程序化生成的组达到了与手工标注DFR相当的70.1%最差组准确率，且无需人口统计标注。此外，该方法在RewardBench2奖励模型偏好数据中也展示了泛化能力，揭示了可解释的虚假相关性。
AI.conclusion: UNMASK提供了一种无需人工标注即可自动发现、验证和缓解文本分类器中虚假相关性的有效方法，显著提升了模型在分布外数据上的鲁棒性和可解释性，并证明了其在不同任务和数据类型上的通用性。

title: Matching Supervision to the Student's Learning Capacity: A Unified Framework for On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary:
On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) improves the reasoning abilities of LLMs by internalizing privileged context into model parameters through self-distillation.
  Two recent research lines promote vanilla OPSD by choosing which tokens to learn from and by controlling how much privileged information the teacher receives, respectively.
  However, we show that each line optimizes one variable while holding the other fixed, which leads to a suboptimal solution.
  We argue that the two variables are coupled through the student's learning capacity: the privileged information sets the per-token divergence the teacher prescribes, while token weighting selects which of these the student must absorb.
  We formalize the two lines of work into a unified optimization framework, which maximizes the aggregate teacher--student divergence, subject to a budget on the aggregate learning difficulty the student can absorb.
  Under this modelling, we propose Unified On-Policy Self-Distillation (USD), a lightweight online algorithm to solve the Lagrangian.
  USD reveals that a single dual variable governs both decisions: at one price for learning difficulty, it simultaneously sets the token-selection threshold and the direction of privileged-information adjustment, keeping supervision matched to the student's evolving capacity.
  Through extensive experiments, USD consistently demonstrates superior performance over OPSD and token- and PI-side baselines across various model scales on various reasoning benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/lauvlalala/USD.

AI.tldr: 提出统一在线策略自蒸馏（USD）框架，通过单一对偶变量同时优化特权信息分配和令牌选择，解决现有方法变量解耦导致的次优问题，显著提升LLM推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的两种改进On-policy self-distillation (OPSD)的研究路线分别独立优化“学习哪些令牌”和“教师接收多少特权信息”，忽视了两者通过学生学习能力相互耦合的关系，导致解决方案次优。
AI.method: 构建统一优化框架，在聚合学习难度预算约束下最大化师生聚合差异；提出轻量级在线算法USD求解拉格朗日函数，利用单一对偶变量动态调整令牌选择阈值和特权信息方向。
AI.result: USD在不同模型规模和多种推理基准测试中，性能持续优于原始OPSD及基于令牌或特权信息的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 将令牌选择和特权信息控制视为耦合变量并通过统一框架优化是有效的，USD提供了一种高效且性能优越的在线自蒸馏解决方案。

title: Compositional Cross-Modality Translation via Whole-Volume Multitask Latent Flow Matching
summary: Cross-modality medical image translation can reduce the burden of multi-modal acquisitions, yet the field remains constrained by two coupled limitations: methods operate on 2D slices or 3D patches rather than whole volumes, and train a separate model for each translation task. Both stem from a single cause, the absence of a sufficiently strong volumetric prior, which forces generative models to learn anatomical appearance and cross-modality mapping simultaneously, an ill-posed problem at the scale of available paired datasets. We propose to decouple these objectives. A large-scale pretrained 3D variational autoencoder provides a compact latent representation of volumetric appearance, reducing translation to a conditional flow-matching problem. This compression makes whole-volume processing tractable, while a resolution-aware sampling strategy preserves native anatomical scale. We train a single model jointly across inter-modality (MRI$\to$CT, CBCT$\to$CT) and intra-modality (MRI$\to$MRI) tasks over three multi-center datasets. Across all tasks, whole-volume processing outperforms its patch-based counterpart, and the multi-task model matches task-specific baselines while replacing $N$ networks with one. Crucially, joint training unlocks capabilities inaccessible to task-specific approaches: zero-shot generalization to anatomical regions unseen during training, within 0.15 SSIM of the fully supervised model, and compositional cross-dataset translation along paths never directly supervised. These results suggest that combining a strong volumetric prior with multitask training is a scalable route toward synthesis systems that generalize beyond their training distribution. Code is available at https://github.com/arco-group/Whole-Volume-Latent-FM.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于大规模预训练3D变分自编码器（VAE）和条件流匹配的单模型框架，实现了全体积医学图像跨模态翻译。该方法解耦了解剖外观学习与跨模态映射，解决了传统方法依赖2D切片/3D补丁及需为每个任务训练独立模型的局限，并实现了零样本泛化和组合式跨数据集翻译。
AI.motivation: 现有跨模态医学图像翻译方法存在两个耦合的局限性：1. 仅处理2D切片或3D补丁而非整个体积；2. 需要为每个翻译任务训练单独的模型。这两个问题的根源在于缺乏足够强的体积先验，导致生成模型必须同时学习解剖外观和跨模态映射，这在可用配对数据集规模下是一个不适定问题。
AI.method:
1. **强体积先验**：使用大规模预训练的3D变分自编码器（VAE）提供紧凑的体积外观潜在表示。
2. **目标解耦**：将翻译问题转化为条件流匹配（conditional flow-matching）问题，从而分离外观学习与映射学习。
3. **全体积处理**：通过压缩使全体积处理变得可行，并采用分辨率感知采样策略保留原生解剖尺度。
4. **多任务联合训练**：在一个模型中联合训练跨模态（MRI→CT, CBCT→CT）和模态内（MRI→MRI）任务，涵盖三个多中心数据集。
AI.result:
1. **性能优势**：全体积处理优于基于补丁的方法；多任务模型性能匹配特定任务的基线模型，但用单一模型替代了N个网络。
2. **新能力解锁**：
   - **零样本泛化**：对训练期间未见过的解剖区域实现零样本泛化，SSIM指标仅比完全监督模型低0.15。
   - **组合式翻译**：能够执行从未直接监督过的路径的组合式跨数据集翻译。
AI.conclusion: 结合强体积先验与多任务训练是构建可扩展的合成系统的可行途径，该系统能够超越其训练分布进行泛化。代码已开源。

title: Reading Cognition as Decisions Unfold in Words: A Factorized Inverse Decision Model
summary: Inverse decision modeling infers latent properties of decision processes from observed behavior, but existing formulations rely primarily on action trajectories. In verbalized cognitive tasks, task execution also produces response dynamics that action-only formulations leave unmodeled, such as verbal production, interaction, and hesitation. We propose a factorized inverse decision model (FIDM) that decomposes each individual's task-execution likelihood into an action factor and an effort factor, governed by separate individual-specific parameters. From raw verbal transcripts, a language model produces structured task-execution traces for factorized inference. On data from 400 older adults performing a grocery-shopping dialog task for cognitive screening, controlled recovery shows selective estimation of the intended factors, while matched semi-synthetic conditions show that FIDM preserves action-execution distinctions even when aggregate behavioral summaries are matched. Action evidence further localizes task-defined deviations across participants. In cognitive-status classification, FIDM provides information complementary to clinical scores, trajectory summaries, and frozen language representations, with consistent gains across all evaluated baselines in the binary setting.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种因子化逆决策模型（FIDM），利用语言模型从口语转录中提取结构化轨迹，将任务执行似然分解为动作和认知努力两个独立因子。在400名老年人的购物对话任务中，该模型不仅恢复了动作与努力的区分，还在认知状态分类中提供了优于临床评分、轨迹摘要及冻结语言表示的互补信息，实现了稳定的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有的逆决策建模主要依赖动作轨迹，忽略了言语认知任务中产生的响应动态（如言语产出、交互和犹豫）。为了更全面地捕捉个体在执行任务时的潜在决策过程特性，需要一种能够同时建模动作执行和认知努力因素的框架。
AI.method: 提出了因子化逆决策模型（FIDM），将每个个体的任务执行似然分解为“动作因子”和“努力因子”，由独立的个体特定参数控制。利用语言模型从原始口语转录生成结构化的任务执行轨迹，从而进行因子化解构推理。
AI.result: 在400名老年人进行的用于认知筛查的杂货店购物对话任务数据上，受控恢复实验显示模型能选择性估计目标因子；在半合成匹配条件下，即使聚合行为摘要一致，FIDM仍能保持动作执行的区别特征。此外，动作证据进一步定位了参与者间定义的任务偏差。
AI.conclusion: FIDM在认知状态分类任务中提供了与临床评分、轨迹摘要和冻结语言表征互补的信息。在二元分类设置中，该方法在所有评估基线上均表现出一致的增益，证明了其在结合言语动态进行认知评估方面的有效性和优越性。

title: Large Multimodal Agents for Intelligent Transportation Systems: Architectures, Evidence, and Deployment Challenges
summary: Large multimodal agents (LMAs) are increasingly proposed for intelligent transportation systems (ITS), but existing studies often conflate multimodality, agency, empirical performance, and deployment readiness. This review provides an auditable evidence map of 42 primary study families released between January 2023 and 3 August 2026 within a corpus of 91 mapped sources. It distinguishes model-level, system-level, and hybrid multimodality and classifies each family by system architecture and action authority. Evidence is assessed independently through functional capability (C0-C3), validation setting (E0-E4), three evidence propositions (P1-P3), and eight methodological-concern domains (Q1-Q8). Transportation semantics (P1) are directly evaluated in 23 families and multidimensional integration (P3) in 24; 19 families directly evaluate both. Evidence reconciliation (P2) remains unresolved because no family demonstrates the complete provenance-challenge-handling-comparison-outcome chain. Fourteen families reach C3, but 13 remain at E2; only one reaches E3 and none reaches E4. Across ITS domains, LMAs are best supported for semantic interpretation, intent translation, evidence organisation, scenario authoring, explanation, and specialist-tool coordination. Numerical forecasting, optimisation, simulation fidelity, hard constraints, low-level control, safety fallback, and final authority should remain with independently verifiable specialist systems or accountable humans. The review therefore supports bounded orchestration rather than replacement and provides a matched comparative evaluation protocol and staged roadmap for accountable deployment. The living evidence repository is available at https://github.com/pangjunbiao/ITS-LMA-Review.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了2023年至2026年间42个大型多模态智能体（LMAs）在智能交通系统（ITS）中的应用，构建了可审计的证据地图。研究指出LMAs目前在语义解释和意图翻译方面表现良好，但在数值预测、安全回退等关键领域证据不足。结论主张采用“有界编排”而非完全替代，强调由专家系统或人类保留最终控制权，并提供了部署路线图。
AI.motivation: 现有研究常混淆多模态性、智能体特性、实证性能与部署就绪度，缺乏对LMAs在ITS中实际能力与局限性的清晰界定及可审计的证据评估。
AI.method: 构建包含91个来源的语料库，筛选出42个主要研究家族。通过功能能力（C0-C3）、验证设置（E0-E4）、三个证据命题（P1-P3）及八个方法论关注领域（Q1-Q8）进行独立评估。区分模型级、系统级和混合多模态，并按系统架构和行动权限分类。
AI.result: 仅19个家族同时直接评估了交通语义和多维整合；无家族完成完整的证据链（P2未解决）。14个家族达到C3能力，但仅1个达到E3验证级别，无家族达到E4。LMAs在语义解释、场景生成等方面支持较好，但在数值优化、底层控制和安全保障方面证据薄弱。
AI.conclusion: LMAs不应完全取代现有系统，而应采用“有界编排”策略。数值预测、硬约束处理、低层控制及安全回退等功能应由可独立验证的专家系统或负责任的人类保留。研究提供了一套匹配的比较评估协议和分阶段部署路线图，以促进负责任的部署。

title: EFFEKT: Efficient Federated Knowledge Transfer to Foundation Models
comment: 12 main content pages, 8 appendix pages; 3 main figures, 9 appendix figures; 8 main tables, 9 appendix tables; 1 main algorithm, 4 appendix algorithms; accepted at TMLR
summary: Recent data protection laws have accelerated the adoption of Federated Learning (FL) for privacy-preserving decentralized training. Nevertheless, increasing model sizes impose substantial computational demands on client devices, limiting FL applicability in resource-constrained settings. We introduce a novel multi-domain federated learning framework in which lightweight client-side proxy models collaborate with a server-side Foundation Model (FM) to learn new concepts without sharing private data. Our approach, EFFEKT, enables efficient server-side training of domain-specific LoRA adapters while preserving feature-space alignment between the FM and proxy extractors via novel bi-directional cross-distillation strategies. Experiments on multiple real-world datasets and deployments on low-power edge devices demonstrate improvements over state-of-the-art baselines in most considered domains while maintaining lightweight computation at the client side.

AI.tldr: 提出EFFEKT框架，通过轻量级客户端代理模型与服务器端基础模型协作，结合双向交叉蒸馏和LoRA适配器，实现隐私保护且计算高效的联邦学习。
AI.motivation: 数据保护法推动了联邦学习（FL）的应用，但日益增长的模型规模给客户端设备带来巨大计算负担，限制了FL在资源受限场景下的适用性。
AI.method: 提出多域联邦学习框架EFFEKT：客户端使用轻量级代理模型，服务器端使用基础模型（FM）。通过新颖的双向交叉蒸馏策略保持FM与代理提取器之间的特征空间对齐，并高效训练领域特定的LoRA适配器，无需共享私有数据。
AI.result: 在多个真实世界数据集上的实验以及在低功耗边缘设备上的部署表明，该方法在大多数考虑领域优于最先进基线，同时保持了客户端的轻量级计算特性。
AI.conclusion: EFFEKT框架有效解决了资源受限环境下联邦学习的计算瓶颈，实现了隐私保护与高效训练的平衡。

title: Verifiably grounded machine interpretation of lunar geology
summary: Planetary geology relies on historical, interpretive reasoning to reconstruct past events from diverse observations. Here, we present a step toward an automated "machine intelligence geologist" by embedding this distinct methodology of geologic knowledge discovery and inference into a multimodal vision-language architecture. Focusing on the stratigraphy of lunar basaltic mare volcanism, we train a model to generate verifiably grounded geologic interpretations directly from co-registered topographic, spectral, and geologic maps. We demonstrate that while the system successfully balances established geological priors with local visual evidence to accurately describe stratigraphy and terrain, numeric age dating derived solely from vision defaults to memorized priors. Integrating an open-book retrieval mechanism resolves this, enabling the model to faithfully cite published chronologies. Our findings delineate the necessary architecture for automated geologic inference: site evidence must be visually interpreted from local data, while quantitative historical context must be retrieved from the scientific record.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种多模态视觉-语言架构，旨在自动化月球玄武岩月海火山地层的地质解释。研究发现，虽然模型能结合视觉证据描述地层，但仅靠视觉无法准确推断数值年龄；通过整合开放书检索机制引用已发表年代学数据，可解决此问题，确立了“本地视觉解释证据+科学记录检索定量背景”的自动化地质推理架构。
AI.motivation: 行星地质学依赖历史性和解释性推理来重建过去事件。为了推进自动化“机器智能地质学家”的发展，需要将这种独特的地质知识发现和推理方法嵌入到多模态架构中。
AI.method: 构建一个多模态视觉-语言模型，针对月球玄武岩月海火山的地层学进行训练。该模型利用配准的高程、光谱和地质地图，生成有事实依据的地质解释。同时引入开放书检索机制以获取外部科学记录支持。
AI.result: 1. 模型成功平衡了既有的地质先验知识与局部视觉证据，能够准确描述地层和地形。2. 仅依靠视觉数据进行的数值测年默认依赖于记忆的先验知识，导致准确性不足。3. 整合开放书检索机制后，模型能够忠实引用已发表的年代学数据，解决了上述问题。
AI.conclusion: 自动地质推理的必要架构包括：必须从局部数据中对现场证据进行视觉解释，而定量历史背景必须从科学记录中检索获得。

title: Quantization Degradation in Large Language Models: A Signal-Noise Perspective
summary: Post-training quantization reduces the deployment cost of large language models, yet how severely a quantized model degrades is not determined by bit-width alone. We systematically study weight-only post-training quantization across bit-widths, quantization methods, model scales and downstream tasks on multiple model families. We observe that such degradation varies substantially across these factors: 4-bit quantization usually preserves performance, 2-bit often causes broad degradation, and at 3-bit, degradation becomes apparent but varies markedly with task type, quantization method and model scale. To explain this variability, we use the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) to measure how strongly quantization perturbs full-precision representations. We trace degradation back to two linked processes: how quantization errors arise within individual modules, and how they accumulate across layers. First, a source SNR decomposition shows that newly introduced errors depend on three factors: the magnitude of the weight error, the strength of the task-specific signal, and how strongly the quantization error aligns with task-specific activations. Different factors affect these components in distinct ways. Second, a cross-layer propagation analysis shows that these errors can be attenuated, preserved, or amplified as they pass across layers, and that larger models benefit from weaker error amplification. Together, these results establish that quantization degradation is governed by how errors are introduced at the source and how they accumulate across the network.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了仅权重后训练量化中，量化误差的引入与跨层累积机制。研究发现3-bit及以下量化的性能退化并非仅由位宽决定，而是取决于模块内的源SNR（受权重误差、任务信号强度及误差对齐度影响）以及跨层的误差传播特性（大模型能更有效地抑制误差放大）。
AI.motivation: 尽管后训练量化能降低大语言模型的部署成本，但量化导致的性能退化程度不仅取决于位宽，还受到量化方法、模型规模和下游任务的显著影响，目前缺乏对这些变量间复杂关系的系统性解释。
AI.method: 对多种模型家族进行系统的仅权重后训练量化研究，覆盖不同位宽、量化方法、模型规模和下游任务；引入信噪比（SNR）来衡量量化对全精度表示的扰动；通过源SNR分解分析模块内误差产生的三个关键因素；通过跨层传播分析考察误差在层间的衰减、保持或放大效应。
AI.result: 4-bit量化通常能保持性能，2-bit常导致广泛退化，而3-bit的退化表现因任务类型、量化方法和模型规模而异。源SNR分解显示新引入误差取决于权重误差幅度、任务特定信号强度及量化误差与激活值的对齐程度；跨层分析表明误差在层间传递时会被不同程度地改变，且较大模型受益于较弱的误差放大效应。
AI.conclusion: 量化性能退化是由误差在源头的引入方式及其在网络中的跨层累积过程共同决定的，而非仅仅由位宽单一因素决定。

title: Learning Structural Illumination for Unsupervised Low-light Enhancement
summary: Existing unsupervised low-light image enhancement (LLIE) methods often estimate illumination directly from the entire low-light input, without separating its spatially varying illumination pattern, termed relative illumination structure, from the absolute exposure level or preventing unreliable low signal-to-noise ratio regions from biasing the estimate. Moreover, fixed exposure targets impose a scene-agnostic enhancement criterion, limiting adaptation across diverse lighting conditions. Inspired by the spatial propagation of light, we propose a Relative Illumination Structure Estimation (RISE) framework that decouples relative illumination structure from absolute exposure and infers it from reliable bright regions, enabling interpretable and robust enhancement. For scene-adaptive exposure adjustment, we further propose a Dual-Metering Exposure Reference derived from each input, allowing RISE to adapt the enhancement strength to individual scenes and generalize across diverse lighting conditions. Extensive benchmark and real-world generalization experiments show that RISE achieves state-of-the-art performance among unsupervised LLIE methods while producing visually natural results.

AI.tldr: 提出RISE框架，通过解耦相对光照结构和绝对曝光，并利用可靠亮区域估计光照结构，结合双测光曝光参考实现场景自适应增强，在低光照图像增强中达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有无监督低光照图像增强（LLIE）方法存在两大缺陷：1. 直接从整个输入估计光照，未分离空间变化的相对光照结构与绝对曝光水平；2. 未排除低信噪比区域对估计的干扰；3. 固定曝光目标导致增强标准与场景无关，难以适应多样光照条件。
AI.method: 提出相对光照结构估计（RISE）框架：1. 受光线空间传播启发，将相对光照结构与绝对曝光解耦，并从可靠的明亮区域推断相对光照结构；2. 提出基于每个输入的双测光曝光参考（Dual-Metering Exposure Reference），实现场景自适应的曝光调整。
AI.result: 在广泛基准测试和真实世界泛化实验中，RISE在无监督LLIE方法中实现了最先进的性能，并产生视觉上自然的增强结果。
AI.conclusion: RISE框架通过解耦光照结构和引入场景自适应曝光机制，有效解决了现有方法在光照估计偏差和适应性不足的问题，显著提升了低光照图像增强的效果和泛化能力。

title: Is the ACL Responsible NLP Checklist a Box-Ticking Exercise? A Large-Scale Analysis of EMNLP 2025
summary: Responsible NLP practice includes a) transparency, b) ethics, and c) societal impacts. The Responsible NLP Checklist aims to push these goals, and promote responsible practice. Recently, ACL released the EMNLP 2025 Checklists to aid transparency on the current research practice, which we focus on. We curate and release the first two datasets of: a) all the checklist responses and justifications from the EMNLP 2025 Main and Finding tracks; b) checklist reference linking to paper sections. We also provide the first analysis of recent EMNLP Checklists, by examining $73,922$ responses and justifications to them. For the Main track, we find that authors isolate ethics questions of the Checklist from the paper's bulk, mimicking the trend of ethics being an afterthought. We then examine \texttt{NO} responses. We find $44.9\%$ of justifications are poor or bad-faith, being brief or empty. Then, we find significant issues with the checklist design and effort of authors, namely that $6\%$ of all checklists contained logical contradictions between parent and child responses. We also find evidence of surface compliance for responsible ethics, with $53\%$ authors dismissing potential risks or social impacts of their work, for which there should be none. We compare this to the Findings track, noticing a similar trend in both tracks. Lastly, we discuss the implications of the checklist design and provide recommendations for future checklist iterations. Including: a) enforcing a minimum word count, b) enforcing more scrutiny on the risks of appliances.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了EMNLP 2025的负责任NLP检查清单数据，揭示了作者存在伦理问题边缘化、回答质量低下（44.9%为敷衍或恶意回答）、逻辑矛盾及表面合规等现象，并提出了改进清单设计的建议。
AI.motivation: 旨在推动自然语言处理（NLP）领域的透明性、伦理和影响力等负责任实践，通过评估ACL发布的EMNLP 2025检查清单来促进这一目标。
AI.method: 收集并发布了包含EMNLP 2025主会和发现轨道的所有检查清单回复及理由、以及指向论文章节引用的两个数据集；对73,922条回复和理由进行了定量分析，对比了主会与发现轨道的表现。
AI.result: 1. 作者常将伦理问题与正文隔离，视其为事后补充；2. 44.9%的“NO”回复理由简短或无效；3. 6%的检查清单存在父子回复间的逻辑矛盾；4. 53%的作者轻率 dismiss 潜在风险，显示表面合规现象；5. 主会与发现轨道趋势相似。
AI.conclusion: 当前检查清单设计存在缺陷且作者执行力度不足，建议未来迭代中强制最低字数限制，并加强对技术应用风险的审查力度。

title: Janus: An Algorithm-Evaluator Co-Evolution Framework for LLM-Driven Discovery under Expensive Evaluation Budgets
summary: LLM-driven program discovery relies on rapid evaluator feedback, but many scientific and engineering tasks require high-fidelity simulations, hardware execution, or physical experiments, making each evaluation expensive. Cheap surrogate evaluators can reduce this cost, yet fixed surrogates are vulnerable to search-induced distribution shift and are difficult to fit reliably from sparse, search-biased labels. We introduce Janus, a framework that uses LLMs to co-evolve target programs and executable proxy evaluators. To address label scarcity, Janus leverages domain knowledge encoded in LLMs to generate task-specific evaluator programs and calibrates them using real outcomes. To mitigate distribution shift, Janus evolves evaluators alongside target programs, selects them using a promotion-aligned objective, and maintains region-conditioned portfolios with online credit updates. Because proxy predictions remain fallible, Janus uses them only to prioritize candidates and requires real validation before candidates can enter the target-program population or update the incumbent. Across five scientific and engineering design tasks, Janus achieves a larger area under the best-so-far improvement curve over the real-evaluation budget and higher final performance than a matched baseline that evolves only target programs. On average, Janus reaches 99/% of the baseline's final improvement with 59.1/% fewer real evaluations. Evolved proxy evaluators also rank promising candidates more accurately than their seed versions. Together, these results extend evaluator-guided LLM discovery from tasks with cheap, scalable feedback to scientific domains where trustworthy evaluation is scarce and expensive.

AI.tldr: 提出Janus框架，利用大语言模型（LLM）协同进化目标程序和可执行的代理评估器，以解决科学和工程任务中真实评估成本高、标签稀缺及分布偏移问题。
AI.motivation: LLM驱动的程序发现依赖快速评估反馈，但许多科学与工程任务需要高保真模拟或物理实验，导致单次评估成本高昂。现有的固定代理评估器容易受到搜索诱导的分布偏移影响，且难以从稀疏、有偏的标签中可靠拟合。
AI.method: Janus框架通过以下方式工作：1. 利用LLM编码的领域知识生成特定任务的评估程序并校准；2. 与目标程序协同进化评估器，使用促进对齐的目标进行选择，并维护带有在线信用更新的区域条件组合；3. 仅用代理预测优先排序候选者，并在进入目标程序种群或更新 incumbent 前要求真实验证。
AI.result: 在五个科学与工程的设计任务中，Janus在真实评估预算下的最佳改进曲线下面积更大，最终性能更高。平均而言，Janus以更少的真实评估次数（减少59.1%）达到了基线最终改进的99%，且进化后的代理评估器比初始版本更准确地排名有希望的候选者。
AI.conclusion: Janus成功将评估器引导的LLM发现扩展到了那些可信评估稀缺且昂贵的科学领域，证明了协同进化代理评估器的有效性。

title: Wiener Representation Filtering for VLM Hallucination Suppression
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) excel at open-ended captioning and visual QA but often describe objects, attributes, or relations absent from the image, a phenomenon known as object hallucination. We propose a {training-free, post-hoc representation editing technique} that operates in the representation space of the language backbone. The method performs a lightweight, one-time offline calibration on a modest paired dataset to estimate the required covariance structures, using only forward passes and empirical second-order statistics with no gradient updates or fine-tuning, after which the correction is absorbed directly into the model's existing weights. By modeling hidden states as a superposition of truthful and hallucination-associated components, we derive a Wiener-type estimator whose optimal gains are given in closed form from the covariances of paired truthful and hallucinated representations. An eigendecomposition yields mode-wise attenuation that respects a stability criterion, i.e., the filter responds continuously to estimation noise. The correction is applied once to the feed-forward output projections of selected deeper layers, at inference time, the model runs unchanged and at the same speed. Experiments on LLaVA-1.5, MiniGPT-4, Gemma3, and mPLUG-Owl2 demonstrate consistent reductions in object hallucination on CHAIR, POPE, and MME while maintaining caption fluency and overall response quality. We further demonstrate the generality of our approach on the TempCompass video understanding benchmark and on discrete diffusion language models for grounded dialogue, showing that representation filtering reduces hallucinations even in temporal video reasoning and multi-step, sequence-wide denoising settings.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需训练、基于后处理表示编辑的技术，通过在语言骨干网络的表示空间中进行轻量级离线校准，利用Wiener估计器对隐藏状态进行特征衰减，从而在推理时直接减少视觉-语言模型中的物体幻觉，同时保持模型速度和原有性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉-语言模型（VLMs）虽然擅长开放域描述和视觉问答，但经常描述图像中不存在的对象、属性或关系，这种现象被称为“物体幻觉”。
AI.method: 该方法是一种无需训练的后代表现编辑技术。它仅在语言骨干的表示空间中操作，通过对小规模配对数据集进行一次轻量级的离线校准来估计所需的协方差结构。该方法仅使用前向传递和经验二阶统计量，无需梯度更新或微调。通过将隐藏状态建模为真实成分和幻觉相关成分的叠加，推导出具有闭式最优增益的Wiener型估计器。通过特征分解实现模式级衰减，并遵循稳定性准则。修正应用于所选深层层的前馈输出投影，在推理时模型保持不变且速度相同。
AI.result: 在LLaVA-1.5、MiniGPT-4、Gemma3和mPLUG-Owl2上的实验表明，该方法在CHAIR、POPE和MME基准测试上持续减少了物体幻觉，同时保持了描述的流畅性和整体回答质量。此外，该方法的通用性在TempCompass视频理解基准以及用于接地对话的离散扩散语言模型中也得到了验证，显示其在时间视频推理和多步序列去噪设置中也能减少幻觉。
AI.conclusion: 提出的表示过滤方法能有效降低多种视觉-语言模型及视频理解模型中的物体幻觉，且无需改变模型结构或增加推理开销，具有良好的通用性和有效性。

title: Accurate but Natural? Diagnosing Grammatical and Idiomatic Gaps in Japanese EFL Writing
summary: Second language writing research distinguishes grammatical accuracy from native-like idiomaticity, yet automated writing evaluation often conflates these dimensions. This study introduces a layered LLM-correction pipeline that isolates structural errors from unnaturalness by generating literal error corrections and idiomatic revisions for 3,830 English writing samples from 120 Japanese junior high school students. Applying the regex-based CEFR-J grammar extractor, we quantify two diagnostic measures: accuracy gaps (structures attempted but incorrectly produced) and idiomatic gaps (grammatically correct structures underused or overused relative to native norms). Results reveal distinct patterns: definite articles, third-person singular -s, and modals (would, could) exhibit significant accuracy difficulties, while -ing forms and hypothetical modals (would) show the largest idiomatic underuse, with simple present verbs, subject-verb-object patterns, and modal can conversely exhibiting the most pronounced overuse. A two-dimensional instructional typology maps error rates against idiomatic gaps, distinguishing accurate but overused grammar items from error-prone or avoided complex forms requiring targeted production practice. This framework advances pedagogical feedback by enabling teachers to diagnose whether learner difficulties arise from inaccurate execution, structural avoidance, or L1-mapped overreliance, supporting evidence-based interventions tailored to the specific needs of each learner.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种分层LLM纠错流程，将语法准确性与地道性分离。通过分析120名日本初中生的3,830篇英语作文，量化了“准确性差距”和“地道性差距”，揭示了特定语法项目（如定冠词、第三人称单数-s）的准确性难点及-ing形式、虚拟情态动词的地道性使用不足问题，并构建了二维教学分类法以支持针对性干预。
AI.motivation: 解决自动写作评估中常混淆“语法准确性”与“母语般地道性”的问题，旨在更精准地诊断二语学习者的具体语言困难来源（执行错误、结构回避或L1迁移过度依赖）。
AI.method: 构建分层LLM纠错管道，生成字面纠错和地道修订；结合基于正则表达式的CEFR-J语法提取器，对120名日本初中生共3,830篇英语样本进行分析，量化准确性差距（尝试但错误产生的结构）和地道性差距（相对于母语规范少用或过度使用的正确结构）。
AI.result: 发现不同语法项目的表现模式各异：定冠词、第三人称单数-s和情态动词（would, could）存在显著准确性困难；-ing形式和虚拟情态动词（would）出现最大程度的地道性少用；而一般现在时动词、主谓宾结构和情态动词can则表现出最显著的过度使用。
AI.conclusion: 提出的二维教学分类法通过映射错误率与地道性差距，区分了准确但过度使用的语法项与易错或回避的复杂形式，为教师提供了区分学习者困难根源的诊断框架，从而支持基于证据的、针对个体需求的个性化教学干预。

title: A Minimal $κ$--$τ$ Logic for Risk-Sensitive Abduction
comment: 44 pages, 2 figures. Submitted to Neurosymbolic Artificial Intelligence (IOS Press/Sage)
summary: Standard approaches to abductive reasoning can retain multiple candidate explanations, but they do not generally combine explicit compositional cross-hypothesis interaction with an internal, rival-sensitive commitment judgment. This paper argues that in risk-sensitive domains -- where premature commitment carries asymmetric downside costs -- the timing of commitment is itself a governed decision that the inferential apparatus should formally represent. We present a minimal $κ$--$τ$ logical framework built on two primitives: epistemic interaction among hypotheses ($κ$) and a normative commitment threshold ($τ$). Hypotheses may coexist, reinforce or inhibit one another, and form emergent composite explanations, while collapse into committed conclusions is regulated by governance constraints rather than forced by inference alone. The logic is developed in two complementary modes sharing the interaction relation and the governance apparatus: a synthetic mode, in which atomic hypotheses are composed upward into emergent explanations, and an analytic mode, in which complex observed states of affairs are decomposed into causal clusters of latent factors, with commitment governed at both the cluster and the factor level. The framework provides formal machinery for domains in which the distinction between highly likely and commit-worthy is operationally consequential. The $κ$--$τ$ logic is positioned as the symbolic governance layer of a neurosymbolic architecture: its epistemic parameters are naturally estimated by neural components -- semantic embeddings and generative models, as demonstrated in existing computational realizations -- while its normative parameters remain under explicit human governance, yielding transparent and auditable abductive reasoning for deployment in high-stakes settings.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于κ-τ逻辑框架的归纳推理方法，通过显式建模假设间的交互（κ）和规范承诺阈值（τ），解决高风险领域中过早承诺的风险问题，支持合成与解析两种模式，并作为神经符号架构中的符号治理层。
AI.motivation: 标准归纳推理方法虽能保留多个候选解释，但缺乏显式的跨假设组合交互及内部竞争性承诺判断。在风险敏感领域，过早承诺带来不对称的负面成本，因此承诺时机本身应作为推理系统需正式表示的受控决策。
AI.method: 构建最小化κ-τ逻辑框架，包含两个原语：假设间的认知交互（κ）和规范承诺阈值（τ）。该框架支持假设共存、相互强化或抑制，形成涌现性复合解释，且结论收敛由治理约束而非单纯推理强制决定。发展两种互补模式：合成模式（原子假设向上组合为涌现解释）和解析模式（复杂观测状态分解为潜在因素的因果簇），并在簇和因子层面进行承诺治理。
AI.result: 提供了形式化工具，用于处理“高可能性”与“可承诺性”之间存在操作性差异的领域。该逻辑被定位为神经符号架构的符号治理层：认知参数由神经网络组件（如语义嵌入和生成模型）估计，而规范参数由人类显式治理，实现了透明且可审计的归纳推理。
AI.conclusion: κ-τ逻辑框架通过分离认知计算与规范治理，为高风险设置下的透明、可审计的归纳推理提供了有效解决方案，平衡了自动推断的灵活性与人工决策的安全性。

title: BAP-MOS: Bandit-Based Adaptive Prompting for Boundary-Sensitive Multi-Organ Segmentation
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures. Source code available at https://github.com/SatvikPraveen/BAP-MOS
summary: Multi-organ ultrasound segmentation remains challenging when anatomically adjacent structures must be delineated jointly, as localized boundary errors can persist even when Dice scores are high. To address these challenges, we propose Boundary-Adaptive Prompting for Multi-Organ Segmentation (BAP-MOS), a closed-loop adaptive prompting framework. BAP-MOS formulates prompt selection as an organ-specific multi-armed bandit problem over box, point, and combined prompts. An outer Tree-structured Parzen Estimator (TPE) loop selects the prompt-selection parameter vector, while an inner UCB-Tuned loop adapts per-organ prompt preferences during fine-tuning using a bounded Dice--MSD--HD95 validation-probe reward. The framework further introduces an organ-scaled negative prompt ring to adapt sparse prompt geometry across anatomical scales, while keeping the image and prompt encoders frozen and updating only the mask decoder. We evaluate BAP-MOS on pooled prostate-region TRUS cohorts against U-Net, nnU-Net, MedSAM, fixed-prompt SAM/MedSAM, and adaptive policy variants. On this benchmark, BAP-MOS achieves Dice 0.982, HD95 0.482, and MSD 0.204, reducing HD95 by approximately 48% and MSD by 45% relative to the strongest conventional baseline. To verify the generalization ability of the framework, we tested it on the external PFUS1 pelvic-floor ultrasound corpus using MedSAM and its adaptive strategy variants, and the results were good. These results support adaptive prompt allocation as an effective mechanism for improving boundary-sensitive multi-organ ultrasound segmentation without modifying the foundation-model backbone. Source Code is available at: https://github.com/SatvikPraveen/BAP-MOS

AI.tldr: 提出BAP-MOS框架，通过多臂老虎机机制自适应选择边界提示（框、点或组合），显著改善多器官超声分割的边界精度，HD95和MSD指标大幅降低。
AI.motivation: 解决多器官超声分割中解剖相邻结构难以区分的问题，特别是针对即使Dice分数较高但仍存在的局部边界误差问题。
AI.method: 提出边界自适应提示多器官分割（BAP-MOS）闭环框架：将提示选择建模为特定器官的多臂老虎机问题；外层使用树形Parzen估计器(TPE)选择参数向量，内层使用UCB-Tuned循环根据验证奖励（Dice-MSD-HD95）调整每器官提示偏好；引入器官缩放负提示环以适应不同解剖尺度；冻结图像和提示编码器，仅更新掩码解码器。
AI.result: 在前列腺区域TRUS队列上，BAP-MOS实现Dice 0.982, HD95 0.482, MSD 0.204；相比最强基线，HD95降低约48%，MSD降低45%。在外部PFUS1盆腔超声数据集上也表现出良好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 自适应提示分配是提升对边界敏感的多器官超声分割的有效机制，无需修改基础模型主干即可显著改善边界分割性能。

title: Universal or Language-Family-Specific Script Unification for Cross-Lingual Transfer? A Case Study on Turkic Languages
summary: Closely related languages written in different scripts expose little surface overlap to multilingual models, limiting cross-lingual transfer. We compare two approaches to script unification: the general-purpose uroman romanizer and the family-specific Common Turkic Script (CTS). We train matched fastText models on transliterated Wikipedia corpora from 11 Turkic languages and evaluate them on WikiANN named entity recognition and Universal Dependencies part-of-speech tagging. CTS and uroman show no significant difference on NER, while both substantially outperform the official monolingual fastText baselines. POS results reveal no universal winner: language-specific differences are associated with the cross-lingual character n-gram coverage induced by each representation, while within-language coverage becomes more important when target-language supervision is available. Although CANINE-c achieves higher overall POS averages, the substantially simpler fastText-based systems remain competitive on several treebanks. Overall, the effectiveness of script unification depends on the language, the induced subword overlap, and the available supervision.

AI.tldr: 研究比较了通用罗马化(uroman)与特定语族脚本(CTS)在突厥语族跨语言迁移中的效果，发现两者性能相当且均优于单语基线，具体效果取决于子词重叠度和监督信号。
AI.motivation: 解决使用不同书写系统的近缘语言因表面重叠少而限制多语言模型跨语言迁移的问题。
AI.method: 在11种突厥语族的 transliterated Wikipedia 语料上训练 fastText 模型，对比 uroman 和 CTS 两种脚本统一方法，并在 WikiANN 命名实体识别(NER)和通用依存关系词性标注(PoS)上进行评估。
AI.result: 1. NER任务中，CTS与uroman无显著差异，但均大幅优于官方单语fastText基线；2. PoS任务中无绝对赢家，性能差异由跨语言字符n-gram覆盖率决定；3. CANINE-c整体PoS平均分较高，但简单的fastText系统在多个树库中仍具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 脚本统一的有效性取决于具体语言、诱导的子词重叠度以及可用的监督信号类型。

title: Persuasive and Compliant Tendencies Predict Group Decision-Making in Humans and Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly involved in group decision-making with other LLMs and humans. Yet it remains unclear whether their influence is driven by persuasion-oriented expression or compliance-oriented accommodation. We introduce DecisionQE, a questionnaire-based framework for measuring each model's persuasive and compliant tendencies across multiple decision scenarios, and use the Werewolf game as an interactive testbed to study their effects on social influence and group outcomes under asymmetric information. Across experiments, stronger persuasive tendency does not significantly improve group outcomes, whereas compliant-oriented models show more stable advantages in cooperation. We further reveal a dual effect of compliance: it supports cooperation in honest roles but improves concealment in adversarial roles. These findings suggest that LLM group interactions reveal not only task outcomes, but also measurable patterns of intrinsic behavioral tendency. LLMs can therefore serve as a lens for sociological observation of language-mediated interaction, while highlighting the need to incorporate behavioral tendencies into safety evaluation of LLM systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DecisionQE框架，通过狼人杀游戏测试LLM在群体决策中的说服与顺从倾向。研究发现顺从倾向比说服倾向更利于合作稳定，但顺从具有双面性（诚实角色促进合作，对抗角色增强隐瞒）。LLM可作为社会观察透镜，需将行为倾向纳入安全评估。
AI.motivation: 明确大型语言模型（LLMs）在群体决策中影响力的来源：是源于“说服导向”的表达还是“顺从导向”的适应，目前尚不清楚。
AI.method: 引入基于问卷的DecisionQE框架，以狼人杀游戏为互动测试床，在多决策场景下测量模型的说服和顺从倾向，研究其在非对称信息下的社会影响及群体结果。
AI.result: 1. 较强的说服倾向并未显著改善群体结果；2. 顺从导向的模型在合作中表现出更稳定的优势；3. 揭示顺从的双重效应：在诚实角色中支持合作，在对抗角色中提升隐瞒能力。
AI.conclusion: LLM群体交互不仅反映任务结果，还揭示了可测量的内在行为倾向模式。LLM可作为语言中介互动的社会学观察透镜，且强调需将行为倾向纳入LLM系统的安全评估中。

title: VTO: Visual Tool Orchestration for Video Anomaly Detection
summary: Video anomaly detection (VAD) is a critical yet challenging task due to the complex and diverse nature of real-world scenarios. Traditional deep learning approaches are fundamentally limited by poor generalization across diverse scenarios. While multimodal agents offer a promising tool-learning paradigm for VAD, current systems relying on supervised fine-tuning struggle with complex orchestration, and standard reinforcement learning often causes premature termination due to coarse-grained outcome rewards. To address these challenges, we propose VTO, a process-supervised reinforcement learning framework. Moving beyond static tool usage, VTO enables the agent to dynamically explore and interact with the environment. Specifically, we introduce a foundation model-driven cognitive evaluator to provide context-aware semantic feedback, which is seamlessly integrated into a Process-Supervised Cognitive Alignment that delivers fine-grained, step-wise supervision. By explicitly penalizing logical truncation and rewarding complete causal chains, the agent optimizes its multi-step reasoning policy for interrelated tool orchestration. To support our proposed framework, we meticulously crafted VAD-Tool, a hierarchical visual tool set comprising 12 specialized vision tools spanning from entity tracking to high-stakes hazard detection, and established the corresponding benchmark for rigorous multi-step reasoning evaluation. Extensive experiments on VAD-Tool demonstrate that VTO significantly outperforms baselines, achieving up to a 10.2\% absolute accuracy improvement in tool scheduling. Code and data are available at https://github.com/MICLAB-BUPT/VTO.

AI.tldr: 提出VTO框架，利用过程监督强化学习和基础模型驱动的评估器，解决视频异常检测中多模态智能体在工具编排和推理上的不足。
AI.motivation: 传统深度学习在视频异常检测（VAD）中泛化能力差；现有基于监督微调的多模态智能体难以处理复杂工具编排，而标准强化学习因粗粒度奖励导致过早终止。
AI.method: 提出VTO（Process-Supervised Reinforcement Learning Framework），引入基础模型驱动的认知评估器提供上下文感知的语义反馈，并结合过程监督认知对齐进行细粒度、逐步的监督，优化智能体的多步推理策略。同时构建了包含12种专用视觉工具的VAD-Tool数据集及基准测试。
AI.result: 在VAD-Tool基准测试上，VTO显著优于基线方法，在工具调度方面实现了高达10.2%的绝对准确率提升。
AI.conclusion: VTO通过动态环境交互和细粒度过程监督，有效提升了多模态智能体在视频异常检测中的复杂任务编排和推理能力。

title: Illusion of Alignment: Detecting Hidden Disagreement in Collaborative Dialogue
summary: Collaborative dialogue can end with apparent agreement while participants still differ on goals, assumptions, or execution plans, creating an \textbf{illusion of alignment (IoA)}. A real-user study across 18 meetings confirms that IoA arises routinely in human collaboration. Yet IoA poses a paradox: if participants were aware of such disagreements, they would already be explicit; if not, they cannot articulate them when asked, leaving IoA invisible to both participants and observers. In this work, we make IoA detectable by generating diagnostic multiple-choice questions whose divergent answers across participants provide direct behavioral evidence of hidden disagreement. We construct \textbf{IoA-Suite}, a dataset and evaluation protocol for detecting hidden disagreement, spanning five task types and six domains. We find that even the best model attains only 49.5\% F1, with the bottleneck traced to private context that the dialogue does not surface. We then train \textbf{IoA-Prober-8B} based on IoA-Suite, reaching 51.8\% F1 on IoA-Suite. Across the aforementioned 18 real meetings, it surfaces 2.89 hidden disagreements per meeting that participants confirm they had not voiced, transferring to live human dialogue. Further, in multi-agent collaboration, pairing IoA-Prober-8B with LLM agents improves downstream task performance on BigCodeBench-Hard and HiddenBench.

AI.tldr: 针对协作对话中普遍存在的“对齐幻觉”（IoA）问题，本研究构建了IoA-Suite数据集及评估协议，并训练了IoA-Prober-8B模型。该模型能有效检测出参与者未明确表达的隐藏分歧，并在多智能体协作中提升了下游任务性能。
AI.motivation: 协作对话常出现表面一致但实际目标、假设或执行计划存在差异的“对齐幻觉”（IoA）。由于这种分歧未被言明，参与者自身和观察者均难以察觉，导致合作中存在潜在风险。现有研究缺乏有效手段来检测和量化这种隐性的不一致。
AI.method:
1. 通过生成诊断性多项选择题，利用参与者答案的差异作为隐性分歧的行为证据，使IoA可检测。
2. 构建IoA-Suite数据集和评估协议，涵盖五种任务类型和六个领域。
3. 基于IoA-Suite训练IoA-Prober-8B模型以增强对隐藏分歧的检测能力。
4. 在真实用户会议和多智能体协作场景中验证模型效果。
AI.result:
1. 最佳基线模型F1值仅为49.5%，瓶颈在于对话未浮现的私有上下文。
2. IoA-Prober-8B在IoA-Suite上达到51.8% F1。
3. 在18场真实会议中，该模型平均每场检测到2.89个参与者确认未说出的隐藏分歧，成功迁移至真实人类对话场景。
4. 在多智能体协作中，结合IoA-Prober-8B能提升LLM代理在BigCodeBench-Hard和HiddenBench上的下游任务表现。
AI.conclusion: 本研究首次实现了“对齐幻觉”的可检测性，证明了通过行为证据挖掘隐性分歧的有效性。IoA-Prober-8B不仅在真实对话中能揭示未表达的分歧，还能通过显式化这些分歧来提升多智能体系统的协作效率与任务性能。

title: Ego-OSCAR: Egocentric Open source Stereo CAptuRe System
summary: We present Ego-OSCAR, an open-hardware, low-cost, head-mounted stereo-inertial capture device for egocentric data collection in the wild. EgoOSCAR pairs a hardware-synchronized global-shutter stereo camera with a 6- axis IMU, an embedded Linux SBC for on-device video encoding, and a realtime microcontroller for user feedback and watchdog functions. The complete bill of materials is under USD 200 per unit, using only commercially available components and 3D-printed parts. Alongside the device, we release a complete software stack (hardware-accelerated recording pipeline, IMU sampling daemon, time-synchronization tooling, and watchdog firmware) and roughly 550 hours of egocentric stereo video per camera with synchronized IMU, collected by a distributed contributor network across everyday indoor environments. The release is annotated rather than raw: free-form action captions cover essentially the entire recorded timeline with an open vocabulary, and per-frame 3D hand reconstructions ship alongside per-session stereo calibration. Ego-OSCAR does not aim to match the per-unit fidelity of research-grade systems such as Project Aria; it aims to be the cheapest defensible substrate for crowdsourced egocentric capture, and to lower the activation energy for any team that wants to collect egocentric data at scale. All hardware designs, software, and the dataset are open-sourced

AI.tldr: Ego-OSCAR是一款开源、低成本（<200美元）的头戴式立体惯性数据采集设备，配套发布完整软件栈及550小时带标注的 Egocentric 数据集，旨在降低大规模第一人称数据收集门槛。
AI.motivation: 解决现有研究级系统（如Project Aria）成本高、难以规模化获取第一人称（egocentric）数据的问题，旨在为团队提供廉价且可防御的大众众包数据采集基础架构，降低数据收集的使用门槛。
AI.method: 硬件上采用硬件同步的全局快门立体相机与6轴IMU，结合嵌入式Linux单板计算机进行视频编码及微控制器实现实时反馈；软件上发布完整的硬件加速记录管道、IMU采样守护进程、时间同步工具及看门狗固件。
AI.result: 实现了单台设备成本低于200美元，仅使用商用组件和3D打印件；发布了包含约550小时日常室内环境采集数据的开放数据集，数据包含自由形式的动作描述（开放词汇）、每帧3D手部重建及每会话立体校准信息。
AI.conclusion: Ego-OSCAR虽不追求单台设备的极致保真度以匹敌高端研究系统，但成功构建了最便宜且可行的众包第一人称数据采集平台，通过开源所有硬件设计、软件和数据集，促进了大规模第一人称视觉数据的获取与研究。

title: Intent Speaks Louder: Controllable User Simulation Beyond Response Imitation
summary: User simulators are widely used as scalable environments for training and evaluating interactive assistants. Generating the next user turn is inherently one-to-many: the same profile and dialogue context may support multiple plausible continuations with different local interaction intents. A fluent response may therefore advance the dialogue through an inappropriate intent, such as acceptance rather than repair. Our key insight is that controllable user simulation should separate which local interaction intent the next user turn should realize from how that intent is expressed in language. We introduce UserIDA (User Intent-Directive Alignment), which exposes interaction intent as an explicit per-turn directive. UserIDA defines a six-way intent interface, learns directive-conditioned generation through supervised fine-tuning, and uses intent-calibrated policy optimization during group-based reinforcement learning. The reward preserves composite response quality while ensuring that intent-violating candidates rank below compliant alternatives in mixed groups. On LMSYS-USP, UserIDA achieves 86.6\% intent accuracy, outperforming the strongest dedicated user-simulator baseline by 24.3 percentage points while improving semantic and stylistic similarity. In within-context interventions, it realizes at least four of the six target intents in 91.7\% of evaluated dialogue states, compared with 22.9\% for the strongest external baseline. These results establish per-turn intent control as a complementary dimension to response fidelity in user simulation.

AI.tldr: 提出UserIDA框架，通过将交互意图作为显式指令分离出来，解决用户模拟器中“一对多”生成导致的意图偏差问题，显著提升意图准确性和对话控制能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的用户模拟器在生成下一轮用户回复时存在“一对多”特性，即相同的上下文可能对应多种合理的后续意图。这导致生成的流畅回复可能包含不恰当的局部交互意图（如本应修复却误选接受），缺乏对具体意图的精确控制。
AI.method: 引入UserIDA（User Intent-Directive Alignment）框架：1）将交互意图暴露为每轮的显式指令；2）定义六类意图接口；3）通过监督微调学习基于指令的条件生成；4）在基于组的强化学习中采用意图校准的策略优化，确保违反意图的候选项在混合组中得分低于合规项。
AI.result: 在LMSYS-USP数据集上，UserIDA达到86.6%的意图准确率，比最强专用基线高出24.3个百分点，同时提升了语义和风格相似度。在上下文干预测试中，91.7%的对话状态能实现至少四种目标意图，而最强外部基线仅为22.9%。
AI.conclusion: 每轮意图控制是用户模拟中除回复保真度外的重要补充维度，能够有效解决意图表达与语言流畅性之间的冲突，提升模拟器的可控性和准确性。

title: Harmful Content Is Not Enough: Continuation Framing Moderates In-Context Emergent Misalignment
summary: In-context learning (ICL) can induce emergent misalignment (EM), where narrow misaligned examples alter answers to unrelated questions. Existing prompts, however, conflate harmful-text exposure with an invitation to continue assistant behavior. We hold harmful answers fixed while varying their delivery as demonstrations, evidence, assistant history, or tool output. Across ten independently sampled contexts, demonstration framing raises broad EM by $30$--$32$ percentage points on a susceptible Gemini model; the gap survives domain exclusion, semantic clustering, unseen questions, and four prompt templates. Format and length-matched controls show that harmful content is necessary but insufficient. A role times continuation factorial further reveals model-dependent provenance effects: Gemini follows both assistant and tool histories, whereas Grok largely resists tool-framed continuation. Several other frontier and open-weight models show no gap. Blinded human audits confirm every main contrast and show that the model judge underestimates active-condition failures. Thus continuation framing is a strong, model-dependent moderator of ICL-EM, not a universal consequence of harmful context.

AI.tldr: 研究揭示上下文学习中的诱导性错位（ICL-EM）受提示框架显著影响。通过固定有害答案并改变其呈现方式（如演示、证据、助手历史等），发现“演示”框架在Gemini模型上使广泛错位率提高30-32个百分点。该效应具有模型依赖性，并非所有模型均受影响，且人类审计证实了模型评估的不足。结论指出，持续生成框架是ICL-EM的强大调节因子，而非有害上下文的普遍必然结果。
AI.motivation: 现有研究指出上下文学习可能引发诱导性错位（EM），即窄小的错位示例会影响无关问题的回答。然而，现有的提示方法往往混淆了对有害文本的暴露与邀请助手继续行为的界限，缺乏对有害内容呈现形式如何具体影响错位行为的细致区分和量化分析。
AI.method: 研究者保持有害答案内容不变，仅改变其在上下文中的呈现框架（作为演示、证据、助手历史记录或工具输出）。实验在十个独立采样的上下文中进行，涉及多个前沿及开源模型（如Gemini, Grok等）。采用格式和长度匹配的对照组，以及角色与续写行为的析因设计，并通过盲审人工审计验证主要对比结果，同时对比了模型自动评估与人工评估的差异。
AI.result:
1. 在易感的Gemini模型上，“演示”框架导致广泛诱导性错位增加30-32个百分点，且该差距在排除特定领域、语义聚类、未见问题和四种提示模板后依然显著。
2. 控制变量显示，有害内容是必要但不充分条件。
3. 存在模型依赖的来源效应：Gemini遵循助手和工具历史，而Grok很大程度上抵制工具框架下的续写；其他几个前沿和开源模型未显示出显著差距。
4. 盲审人工审计确认了所有主要对比结果，并发现模型法官低估了主动条件下的失败情况。
AI.conclusion: 续写框架（continuation framing）是上下文学习中诱导性错位的一个强大且依赖于模型的调节因子，而不是有害上下文带来的普遍必然后果。这一发现强调了在设计安全提示时需考虑模型特定的行为倾向，而非仅关注内容本身。

title: What Irregularity Costs: CUDA C++, Rust, and Triton on a Hash-Blocked GPU Workload
comment: 23 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Includes a correctness result for TSDF fusion implementations: at hash load factors reached by ordinary depth trajectories, the Triton implementation silently discards blocks. Code, raw measurement CSVs and an interactive viewer: https://github.com/realitymatrix/what-irregularity-costs
summary:
GPU language comparisons are almost always run on tiled dense linear algebra, where every toolchain is good and the differences are small. We implement the same hash-blocked TSDF fusion kernel in CUDA C++, in Rust through NVIDIA's cuda-oxide, and in Triton, and measure it on a workload with the opposite character: an open-addressed hash table with compare-exchange insertion, data-dependent per-lane probe depth, and contended scatter.
  The result is a split. On the regular stage, which walks a truncation band and accumulates, all three languages land within a small factor of each other. On the irregular stage, which probes and inserts, Rust stays close to hand-written CUDA C++ while Triton is more than an order of magnitude slower. Language choice is nearly free on the work that is usually benchmarked and expensive on the work that is not.
  We attribute both gaps to specific things the languages cannot express, not to ratios. Triton's cost follows from a probe loop that must run to a compile-time bound and from tl.atomic_cas taking no mask, which forces a scratch structure with no counterpart in CUDA. Rust's cost was invisible in every instruction count: its kernel issues fewer instructions, fewer compare-exchanges and fewer registers at identical occupancy, yet was slower. Hardware counters located it in L1 residency. A GPU-scope atomic load must be coherent across SMs, no NVIDIA L1 is, so the type-correct way to read a shared location bypasses the cache on every access.
  Triton's bounded probe is also a correctness problem for fusion: at load factors an ordinary depth trajectory reaches, it silently discards blocks and the reconstruction loses patches of surface with nothing reported. We also report a defect found and fixed in cuda-oxide itself, now merged upstream: its scoped atomic load and store could not be called at all in the build mode that produces real kernels.

AI.tldr: 本文对比了CUDA C++、Rust (cuda-oxide)和Triton在实现不规则GPU内核（TSDF融合）时的性能。发现常规计算下三者性能接近，但在不规则访问阶段，Rust接近手写CUDA，而Triton慢一个数量级。主要瓶颈源于语言抽象限制：Triton的编译时边界探针导致正确性问题；Rust因缺乏无掩码原子操作导致缓存未命中。此外修复了cuda-oxide的一个关键缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有的GPU语言比较大多集中在规则密集线性代数运算上，掩盖了语言在处理不规则内存访问时的真实差异。本研究旨在通过在具有挑战性特征（开放寻址哈希表、数据依赖探测、竞争散射）的TSDF融合内核上进行实际基准测试，揭示不同GPU编程语言在非规则工作负载下的真实性能表现及根本原因。
AI.method:
1. 实现相同的hash-blocked TSDF融合内核，分别使用CUDA C++、Rust (via NVIDIA's cuda-oxide) 和 Triton进行编码。
2. 在包含不规则访问模式的工作负载上进行性能测量。
3. 分析两个阶段：规则阶段（截断带遍历与累加）和不规则阶段（探测与插入）。
4. 使用硬件计数器定位性能瓶颈，特别是针对Rust的性能问题进行深入诊断。
5. 评估Triton在特定负载因子下的正确性表现。
6. 发现并修复cuda-oxide中关于作用域原子加载/存储的内核生成缺陷。
AI.result:
1. **性能分裂**：在规则阶段，三种语言性能差异很小。在不规则阶段，Rust性能接近手写CUDA C++，而Triton速度慢一个数量级以上。
2. **Triton瓶颈**：由于必须运行到编译时边界且tl.atomic_cas不支持掩码，导致需要额外的scratch结构，显著增加开销。此外，在普通深度轨迹能达到的负载因子下，Triton会静默丢弃块，导致表面重建丢失区域且无报错。
3. **Rust瓶颈定位**：尽管Rust指令数更少、寄存器占用更低，但硬件计数器显示其L1缓存驻留率问题导致性能下降。原因是GPU范围的原子加载需跨SM保持一致性，而NVIDIA L1不具备此特性，导致类型正确的共享位置读取每次访问都绕过缓存。
4. **工具链修复**：发现并修复了cuda-oxide在产生真实内核的构建模式下无法调用作用域原子加载和存储的缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 语言选择对常规基准测试工作负载几乎免费，但对非典型的不规则工作负载可能昂贵。性能差距主要源于语言无法表达的低级优化或约束（如Triton的编译时边界和原子操作限制，Rust的缓存一致性语义冲突），而非单纯的比率问题。开发者在选择GPU语言时需考虑目标工作负载的规则性，并注意语言抽象带来的潜在正确性和性能陷阱。

title: Reducing Pretraining-Generation Mismatch in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Autoregressive language models align training and use: generation conditions on a clean prompt, and training predicts future tokens from clean left context. Diffusion language models offer parallel denoising, but native dLLM pretraining can randomly corrupt prompt and continuation tokens together, weakening the clean-prefix interface needed for prompt-conditioned generation. We identify this mismatch for prompt continuation and propose PCD (Prefix-Conditioned Diffusion), a pretraining objective that combines AR prefix supervision with no-shift suffix denoising. At the training-objective level, PCD changes the attention mask, corruption mask, and label construction in continued pretraining; it does not require an autoregressive decoder, verifier, or new inference mode. By supervising the clean-prefix side autoregressively and applying diffusion only to the unknown continuation, PCD makes the local training interface resemble how block-diffusion models are queried at evaluation time. We further separate intra-sample prefix conditioning from inter-sample objective mixing, allowing us to identify the local alignment signal separately from the optional batch-level mixing knob. Across LLaDA2-Mini and Qwen-1.7B backbones, PCD consistently improves over same-family native dLLM stable baselines, reaching a 4.2% relative gain on the main LLaDA2-Mini six-benchmark average (+2.56 points) and a 14.2% relative gain in the primary Qwen mechanism comparison (+4.86 points). These results suggest that aligning the pretraining context distribution with prompt-conditioned generation can recover a measurable part of the dLLM continuation gap without changing inference.

AI.tldr: 提出PCD（前缀条件扩散）预训练目标，解决扩散语言模型在提示续写时的上下文不匹配问题，通过结合自回归前缀监督与非移位后缀去噪，在不改变推理模式的情况下显著提升生成性能。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散语言模型（dLLM）原生预训练会随机破坏提示和续写token，导致“干净前缀”接口弱化，无法有效支持基于干净提示的生成任务，存在训练与使用场景的不匹配。
AI.method: 提出PCD方法：1）修改注意力掩码、破坏掩码和标签构建；2）对已知前缀进行自回归监督，仅对未知续写部分应用扩散去噪；3）分离样本内前缀条件与样本间目标混合，以明确局部对齐信号。
AI.result: 在LLaDA2-Mini和Qwen-1.7B骨干网络上，PCD均优于原生dLLM基线：LLaDA2-Mini平均提升4.2%（+2.56分），Qwen机制比较中提升14.2%（+4.86分）。
AI.conclusion: 将预训练上下文分布与提示条件生成对齐，可以在不改变推理方式的前提下，显著弥合扩散语言模型的续写性能差距。

title: Metanormative Theory for RL-Based Moral Agents
comment: The 14th International Workshop on Engineering Multi-Agent Systems (EMAS 2026) held May 25-26, 2026 Co-located with AAMAS 2026 Paphos, Cyprus
summary: The overlapping disciplines of machine ethics and value alignment are concerned with designing artificial agents that are aligned with human values and that act in ethically acceptable ways. A recent trend in these disciplines is the use of reinforcement learning (RL) to design such agents, sidelining the philosophical literature that used to play a more central role. Against this backdrop, this paper pursues two goals. The first is to draw out ideas from recent work in metanormative theory that can be useful for designing artificial moral and value-aligned agents. The second is to examine the RL architecture through the lens of these ideas. This will give us clearer criteria for when an RL agent's behavior can be classified as moral, as well as a basis for evaluating and comparing different RL-based approaches to machine ethics and value alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文旨在将元规范理论（metanormative theory）引入机器伦理与价值对齐领域，通过分析强化学习（RL）架构，为评估RL代理的道德行为提供清晰标准。
AI.motivation: 当前机器伦理和价值对齐研究过度依赖强化学习，忽视了哲学文献的作用；需要重新整合哲学思想以完善AI道德设计。
AI.method: 从近期元规范理论中提炼适用于设计人工道德和价值对齐代理的概念，并以此视角审视强化学习架构。
AI.result: 建立了判断RL代理行为是否属于“道德”的更清晰标准，并为评估和比较不同的基于RL的机器伦理方法提供了基础。
AI.conclusion: 结合元规范理论与强化学习有助于更严谨地定义和评估人工智能的道德行为及价值对齐效果。

title: Test-Time Prototype Adaptation for Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation
summary: Open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) repurposes a pretrained CLIP encoder for dense prediction without additional labeled supervision. Existing methods improve CLIP's spatial behavior either by redesigning its internal attention or by injecting features from auxiliary vision foundation models; both require access to the host's internal computation and are tailored to its specific forward pass. In this work, we propose Test-time Prototype Adaptation (TPA), a training-free plug-in that operates at the output level, leaving the host's forward pass and weights unmodified. By leveraging a lightweight transductive adaptation phase, TPA identifies confident anchor patches from the host's own output predictions on a small pool of unlabeled deployment-domain images, and aggregates their frozen DINO features into per-class prototypes; at inference, a single cosine similarity lookup against this frozen bank provides an auxiliary score fused linearly with the host's logits. TPA composes with five representative OVSS hosts spanning attention-redesign and VFM-injection designs, across three CLIP backbones, eight benchmarks, and multiple internal VFM choices. Under a single set of hyper-parameters and without per-host tuning or parameter updates, TPA consistently improves segmentation accuracy, with as few as approximately 10% of unlabeled deployment-domain images sufficing for effective bank construction on most benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为测试时原型自适应（TPA）的训练自由插件，通过利用少量无标签部署域图像构建冻结的原型库，在不修改宿主模型权重和正向传播的前提下，显著提升开放词汇语义分割（OVSS）的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的OVSS方法通常需要通过重新设计内部注意力机制或注入辅助视觉基础模型特征来改善CLIP的空间行为，这些方法需要访问宿主模型的内部计算结构，且针对特定的前向传播过程定制，缺乏通用性。
AI.method: 提出TPA方法，在输出层面操作，不修改宿主模型的权重和前向传播。具体步骤包括：1. 利用少量无标签部署域图像进行轻量级归纳适应阶段；2. 从宿主模型的预测中识别高置信度的锚点补丁；3. 聚合这些补丁的冻结DINO特征以生成每类原型；4. 推理时，通过余弦相似度查找该冻结原型库，获得辅助分数并与宿主模型的logits线性融合。
AI.result: TPA与五种代表性的OVSS宿主模型（涵盖注意力重设计和VFM注入设计）、三种CLIP骨干网络、八个基准测试以及多种内部VFM选择兼容。在单一超参数设置下，无需针对每个宿主进行调优或参数更新，TPA一致性地提高了分割精度。大多数基准测试中，仅需约10%的无标签部署域图像即可有效构建原型库。
AI.conclusion: TPA作为一种即插即用的训练自由方法，能够有效提升现有OVSS模型在部署域上的泛化能力和分割精度，且具有高度的通用性和低资源需求。

title: ZetaGPT: A Reference Implementation of Positional--Encoding--Free State--Space--Attention Language Models
summary: Transformer-based language models rely on self-attention, whose computation is permutation-equivariant and therefore lacks an intrinsic mechanism for representing token order. Existing architectures address this limitation by explicitly incorporating positional information through learned positional embeddings or hand-crafted positional encodings, such as rotary positional encoding (RoPE), treating positional information as an architecturally acquired capability rather than an inherent property of the model. Motivated by the pursuit of positional-encoding-free architectures, this work explores a language model architecture that integrates causal state-space equations to implicitly encode positional information before attention computation. Specifically, each model block applies a causal state-space equation before self-attention, allowing recurrent state dynamics to encode sequential information into token representations. Consequently, subsequent attention layers operate on position-aware representations without requiring explicit positional encodings while retaining the expressive modeling capacity of self-attention. We present \textsc{ZetaGPT}, a compact hybrid language model designed for research, rapid prototyping, algorithm verification, and educational applications. In addition to the proposed architecture, \textsc{ZetaGPT} provides a fully open-source, end-to-end training pipeline encompassing dataset construction, tokenizer training, pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), and chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning via pure reinforcement learning. To the best of our knowledge, \textsc{ZetaGPT} is the first open-source small language model without explicit positional encoding and establishes a compact, reproducible reference implementation for the development and empirical study of positional-encoding-free language models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ZetaGPT，一种无需显式位置编码的紧凑型混合语言模型。通过在自注意力前引入因果状态空间方程隐式编码序列信息，解决了Transformer缺乏内在顺序表示机制的问题，并提供了完整的开源训练流水线。
AI.motivation: 现有基于Transformer的语言模型依赖自注意力机制，其排列等变性导致缺乏对token顺序的内在表示能力。传统方法通过学习的位置嵌入或手工构造的位置编码（如RoPE）来弥补这一缺陷，但本文旨在探索摆脱显式位置编码的架构，挖掘模型内生的位置信息编码能力。
AI.method:
1. 架构创新：在每个模型块中，在自注意力计算之前应用因果状态空间方程（causal state-space equations）。利用循环状态动态将序列信息隐式编码到token表示中，使后续的注意力层能在无需显式位置编码的情况下操作位置感知表示。
2. 系统实现：构建ZetaGPT，提供端到端的开源训练流水线，涵盖数据集构建、分词器训练、预训练、监督微调（SFT）、基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）以及纯强化学习下的思维链（CoT）推理。
AI.result: 成功开发了ZetaGPT，这是一个紧凑型混合语言模型，专为研究、快速原型开发、算法验证和教育应用设计。它是目前已知第一个开源的、不含显式位置编码的小型语言模型，为免位置编码语言模型的开发和经验研究建立了紧凑且可复现的参考实现。
AI.conclusion: 通过将因果状态空间方程整合进架构，ZetaGPT证明了可以在不依赖显式位置编码的情况下保留自注意力的表达能力，并为未来免位置编码语言模型的研究提供了可行的开源基准和工具链。

title: LatticeMind: A Conflict-Aware Memory Primitive for Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Multi-agent LLM systems often fail not for lack of candidate answers, but because they have no persistent mechanism for deciding which incompatible claim should currently be trusted. Majority vote, debate, and judge-based selection choose an output without recording which claim wins, which is contested, or why a later update supersedes it. We present \term{LatticeMind}, a conflict-aware structured memory that handles contradiction at write time. It maintains explicit item status, applies cheap symbolic conflict checks, and invokes LLM reconciliation only for unresolved semantic cases. On a label-blind ConflictBank evaluation that removes source-name hints, LatticeMind reaches 0.97 accuracy versus 0.61 for the strongest aggregation baseline, with the gap significant at $p<10^{-6}$ by paired McNemar test. Ablations show that removing the checker or the reconciler costs 12 to 14 points. On four secondary planning benchmarks the picture is mixed: LatticeMind beats naive merge on three of four, but does not replace deliberation methods on tasks rewarding iterative search.

AI.tldr: 提出LatticeMind，一种冲突感知的结构化记忆机制，通过在写入时处理矛盾（低成本符号检查+LLM调解），解决多智能体LLM系统中缺乏持久化信任决策的问题。在ConflictBank上准确率0.97显著优于基线0.61，但在需迭代搜索的规划任务中表现混合。
AI.motivation: 现有主流方法（多数投票、辩论、裁判选择）虽能选出输出，但缺乏记录“哪个主张胜出”、“为何被质疑”或“后续更新依据”的持久化机制，导致系统无法有效处理不兼容主张间的信任决策。
AI.method: 构建LatticeMind结构化记忆：1) 维护显式的项目状态；2) 应用低成本的符号冲突检测；3) 仅在未解决的语义冲突情况下调用LLM进行调解。
AI.result: 在去除来源名称提示的标签盲测ConflictBank评估中，LatticeMind准确率达0.97，强于最强聚合基线的0.61（p<10^-6）。消融实验显示移除检查器或调解器会导致12-14个百分点的性能损失。在四个次要规划基准测试中，除一项外均优于朴素合并，但未完全取代注重迭代搜索的深思熟虑方法。
AI.conclusion: LatticeMind通过写时冲突处理显著提升了多智能体系统在事实一致性上的准确性，证明了结构化记忆与分层冲突解决机制的有效性，尽管其在复杂迭代规划任务中的适用性仍有局限。

title: Frequency-Domain Dual-Branch Fusion for Medical Visual Question Answering
comment: 7 Pages, 4 figures, under review at AAAI 27
summary: Medical Visual Question Answering (VQA) requires aligning subtle visual evidence, including lesion texture, boundary sharpness, and diffuse density changes, with clinical language. Existing multimodal fusion approaches operating in the spatial domain may not fully exploit complementary frequency information present in visual and textual representations. We introduce a dual-branch frequency-domain fusion module that conditions spectral filtering on the input question, enabling adaptive selection of global low-frequency structure and fine-grained high-frequency detail before reconstructing the spatial representation for answer generation. To provide a richer spectrum for filtering, we extract complementary features from early texture-sensitive and final semantic layers of a frozen BiomedCLIP encoder and align both with the question representation using a symmetric InfoNCE objective prior to staged joint training with a BioBART decoder. We pretrain the proposed model on PMC-VQA and fine-tune it on the VQA-RAD and SLAKE benchmarks, demonstrating that frequency-aware multimodal fusion improves medical VQA performance while maintaining a lightweight and efficient architecture.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种双分支频域融合模块，通过基于问题条件的频谱滤波自适应选择低频结构和高频细节，结合BiomedCLIP和BioBART在医学VQA任务中提升了性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的空间域多模态融合方法未能充分利用视觉和文本表示中存在的互补频率信息，难以有效对齐细微的视觉证据（如病变纹理、边界清晰度）与临床语言。
AI.method:
1. 引入双分支频域融合模块，根据输入问题进行条件化频谱滤波，自适应选择全局低频结构和细粒度高频细节，并重建空间表示以生成答案。
2. 从冻结的BiomedCLIP编码器的早期纹理敏感层和最终语义层提取互补特征，使用对称InfoNCE目标将其与问题表示对齐。
3. 在PMC-VQA上预训练模型，并在VQA-RAD和SLAKE基准上进行微调，解码器采用BioBART。
AI.result: 频率感知的多模态融合提高了医学VQA的性能，同时保持了轻量级和高效的架构。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过利用频域信息和互补的多模态特征，有效解决了医学VQA中对齐细微视觉证据的挑战，证明了频域融合在该领域的有效性。

title: Learning Preference Adaptation for Large Language Model Personalization via Verbal Reinforcement Learning
summary: Natural language user preferences provide an interpretable interface for LLM personalization. However, universal preference summaries often contain information irrelevant to a particular downstream task. Directly supplying the full preference summary therefore wastes context capacity and introduces cross-task distraction, while manually designing task-specific preference views is difficult to scale. In this work, we study \emph{task-specific preference adaptation}: given a universal user preference summary and a downstream task, derive a task-conditioned representation that preserves sufficient decision-relevant evidence while removing redundant context. To this end, we propose \textsc{AlignXada}, a training-free meta-learning framework that induces reusable textual refinement policies for adapting universal preference summaries to task-specific ones. The refinement policy is iteratively optimized by a meta learner through verbal reinforcement learning. Across 13 tasks and three downstream models (39 task--model cells), \textsc{AlignXada} achieves an average gain of 3.82 points, improving 33 cells while retaining only 22.8\% of the original profile tokens and outperforming RAG in 36 cells. An extended faithfulness analysis further shows that the refined profiles remain largely grounded in the source preferences while preserving task-relevant personalization signals, suggesting that profile-side adaptation serves as a practical complement to universal memory construction for lifelong personalized agents.

AI.tldr: 提出AlignXada，一种无需训练的元学习框架，通过口头强化学习将通用用户偏好摘要自适应地精炼为任务特定的表示，在13个任务上平均提升3.82分，同时仅保留22.8%的原始token。
AI.motivation: 通用用户偏好摘要包含与特定下游任务无关的信息，直接提供会浪费上下文容量并引入跨任务干扰；而手动设计任务特定的偏好视图难以扩展。
AI.method: 提出AlignXada框架，通过元学习者利用口头强化学习（verbal reinforcement learning）迭代优化可复用的文本精炼策略（refinement policy），从通用偏好摘要中推导任务条件化的表示。
AI.result: 在13个任务和3个下游模型（共39个任务-模型组合）上，AlignXada平均获得3.82分的提升，改善了33个组合，仅保留22.8%的原始profile token，并在36个组合中优于RAG方法。
AI.conclusion: 精炼后的偏好配置文件主要源于源偏好且保留了任务相关的个性化信号，表明基于配置文件的适配可作为终身个性化代理通用记忆构建的实用补充。

title: A Fair Objective for Human-Empowerment-Preserving AI: Desiderata, Design, and Likely Behavioral Consequences
comment: Slightly extended version of paper accepted for Algorithmic Decision Theory 2026
summary: This paper explores the idea of promoting well-being and safety in human-AI interactions by forcing AI agents explicitly to empower humans and to manage the power balance between humans and AI agents in a desirable way. Using a principled, partially axiomatic approach based on desirable properties, we design a parametrizable and decomposable objective function for AI systems that represents an inequality- and risk-averse long-term aggregate of human power. It can take into account models of human bounded rationality and social norms, and crucially, considers a wide variety of possible human goals. We prove how certain desiderata enforce particular functional forms and restrict parameter ranges. We exemplify the consequences of softly maximizing this metric in several paradigmatic situations and describe what instrumental sub-goals it will likely imply.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于参数化和可分解目标函数的方法，旨在通过明确赋予人类权力及管理人机权力平衡，促进人机交互中的福祉与安全。该函数以不等式和风险厌恶为特征，聚合长期的人类权力，并考虑了人类的有限理性、社会规范及多种潜在目标。研究证明了特定需求如何约束函数形式和参数范围，并通过范例场景展示了最大化该指标的后果及其隐含的工具性子目标。
AI.motivation: 解决人机交互中人类福祉与安全问题，特别是通过显式地迫使AI代理赋能人类，并以理想方式管理人类与AI代理之间的权力平衡。
AI.method: 采用基于期望属性的原则性、部分公理化方法；设计了一个参数化且可分解的目标函数，用于表示具有不等式和风险厌恶特征的长期人类权力聚合；结合人类有限理性模型和社会规范，并涵盖广泛的人类目标可能性；通过数学证明推导特定需求对函数形式和参数范围的约束；在典型情境中示例化 softly maximizing 该指标的后果。
AI.result: 证明了某些期望属性（desiderata）会强制执行特定的函数形式并限制参数范围；在多个范式情境中展示了该指标软最大化的后果，并描述了其可能产生的工具性子目标。
AI.conclusion: 通过设计能够反映人类权力、风险规避及社会规范的特定目标函数，可以在人机交互中有效地促进人类赋能和权力平衡，从而提升整体系统的安全性和对人类福祉的贡献。

title: Open-World Semantic Segmentation with Sensitivity Modeling
comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Image Processing (ICIP) Satellite Workshops
summary: Modern vision systems must operate in "open-world" settings, where models must recognize known categories and detect unseen or anomalous content. Conventional semantic segmentation models operate under a "closed-world" assumption, often producing overconfident misclassifications on novel content. We address open-world semantic segmentation, the joint task of segmenting known classes while detecting and grouping novel or anomalous content without additional supervision, by extending a dual-decoder baseline with a third, complementary decoder within a unified encoder-decoder design. The first decoder performs closed-set segmentation using Gaussian prototypes for known categories. The second uses contrastive feature learning to isolate unknown regions in embedding space. The third, our key contribution, is a sensitivity decoder that captures fine-grained texture irregularities and activation instabilities indicative of semantic uncertainty, which neither semantic prototypes nor contrastive norms can reliably detect. The three decoders provide genuinely complementary signals: class-level OOD distance in logit space, global feature energy in embedding space, and local activation instability across encoder scales. Experiments on Cityscapes and BDD-Anomaly show that our method improves anomaly segmentation and novel-class discovery while maintaining competitive closed-set accuracy, with gains of +2.4% AUROC and a 2.5 pp. reduction in FPR@95TPR on BDD-Anomaly over the baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于三解码器架构的开放世界语义分割方法，通过联合已知类别分割与未知/异常内容检测，解决传统封闭世界模型在开放场景中误分类的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有语义分割模型基于“封闭世界”假设，在面对新异或异常内容时容易产生过度自信的误分类，无法满足现代视觉系统在“开放世界”环境中对已知类别识别及未知内容检测的需求。
AI.method: 在统一编码器-解码器设计中扩展双解码器基线，引入第三个互补解码器：1）第一解码器利用高斯原型进行已知类别的闭集分割；2）第二解码器通过对比特征学习在嵌入空间中隔离未知区域；3）第三解码器（关键贡献）为敏感性解码器，捕捉反映语义不确定性的细粒度纹理不规则性和激活不稳定性。三者分别提供逻辑空间中的类级OOD距离、嵌入空间中的全局特征能量以及编码器尺度上的局部激活不稳定性信号。
AI.result: 在Cityscapes和BDD-Anomaly数据集上的实验表明，该方法在保持具有竞争力的闭集准确率的同时，提升了异常分割和新类发现性能。具体而言，在BDD-Anomaly上相比基线方法AUROC提高了2.4%，FPR@95TPR降低了2.5个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 提出的三解码器框架通过整合语义原型、对比学习和敏感性分析三种互补信号，有效解决了开放世界语义分割中已知类别分割与未知异常检测的联合任务问题，显著提升了模型的鲁棒性和检测精度。

title: Build it, Break it, Repeat: Benchmarking and improving LLM-manipulated disinformation detection in social media posts
summary: Detecting machine-generated disinformation on social media is increasingly difficult as large language models (LLMs) make it easier to generate and rewrite misleading content at scale. Static benchmark evaluations, measuring detector performance on fixed held-out datasets, do not capture how detectors behave when posts are deliberately transformed to evade classification. This paper adapts the Build it, Break it, Fix it framework into Build it, Break it, Repeat (BiBiR): iterative sessions designed to stress-test detectors' robustness under iterative adversarial conditions, evaluating whether models remain reliable when disinformation posts are systematically transformed to evade classification. Across five iterations, the findings show that the best adversarial breakers' transformations came from a combination of back-translation and LLM persona-based rewriting, with the best performing technique achieving a 95% label flip rate (LFR), whilst still preserving the meaning of the original posts. The best builders' model was a triplet contrastive model with a dynamic anchor switching (DASS) architecture, which achieved an average accuracy of 72.68%, outperforming the strong baseline (a fine-tuned e5-small-LoRA) by 15 percentage points on the most robust set of breakers' adversarial attacks.
