The results demonstrate that an iterative framework best exposes detector weaknesses and pushes robustness improvements; however, it may still require semantic preservation analysis to distinguish valid adversarial evasion from transformations that changed the original disinformation claims' meaning.

AI.tldr: 提出BiBiR框架，通过迭代对抗攻击测试检测器鲁棒性，发现组合翻译与重写技术可实现95%标签翻转率，提出的DASS架构检测器在对抗环境下准确率提升15个百分点。
AI.motivation: 静态基准评估无法捕捉检测器在面对刻意变换以逃避分类的社交媒体帖子时的实际表现，需研究检测器在迭代对抗条件下的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 将“构建-破坏-修复”框架改编为“构建-破坏-重复”(BiBiR)，进行五轮迭代会话；使用反向翻译结合LLM人设重写的攻击策略，以及带有动态锚点切换(DASS)架构的三元组对比模型作为检测器。
AI.result: 最佳攻击者通过组合技术实现95%的标签翻转率(LFR)且保持原意；最佳检测器(DASS架构)在最强的对抗攻击集上平均准确率达72.68%，比基线高出15个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 迭代框架能有效暴露检测器弱点并推动鲁棒性改进，但需结合语义保留分析来区分有效的对抗规避与改变原意的变换。

title: FemWear: A Specialized Wearable Foundation Model for Women's Health
summary: General wearable foundation models are pretrained across broad sensor streams and populations, but are not designed around women's-health tasks. We introduce FemWear, a specialized wearable foundation model that parameter-efficiently repurposes a pretrained multimodal wearable backbone. FemWear retains the patch projection and Transformer encoder, training 239,236 parameters (1.11% of a 21.54M-parameter encoder) through low-rank residual adapters and causal task-family heads. It learns one shared longitudinal representation for menstrual, symptom, affective, sleep/recovery, autonomic, activity, and pregnancy-related outcomes. We evaluate six cohorts with 63 comparable primary metrics, including 33 from women's-health cohorts, while retaining the 32-task OpenMHC ability-retention benchmark. On a fixed participant split over three seeds, FemWear improved cycle-phase macro-F1 by 8.15% and reduced mean absolute error for cramps, mood symptoms, and sleep problems by 9.32%, 5.80%, and 9.43%, respectively. In a stricter 42-participant nested leave-one-participant-out audit, 24-hour onset, 72-hour onset, and cramps retained positive changes of 2.87%, 6.35%, and 2.19%; phase, mood, and sleep were neutral or negative, and no endpoint had a strictly positive corrected confidence interval. Capacity-matched experiments outperformed a latest-day multilayer perceptron but not shared-GRU or multi-gate mixture-of-experts baselines. Train-only calibration reduced onset expected calibration error by 84.2--88.2% with zero temporal-nesting violations. FemWear enables targeted transfer and coherent probability outputs for women's-health research, but does not establish universal performance dominance or clinical validity.

AI.tldr: FemWear是一个专为女性健康任务设计的可穿戴基础模型，通过参数高效微调（仅训练1.11%的参数）复用预训练的多模态骨干网络。它在多个女性健康指标上优于基准模型，显著降低了预测误差并改善了校准效果，但未能确立普遍的性能优势或临床有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有的通用可穿戴基础模型虽然广泛预训练，但未针对女性健康任务进行专门设计，缺乏对该领域特定需求的支持。
AI.method: 提出FemWear模型，保留预训练多模态可穿戴骨干网络的patch投影和Transformer编码器，利用低秩残差适配器和因果任务族头，仅训练239,236个参数（占编码器总参数的1.11%）。该模型学习月经、症状、情绪、睡眠/恢复、自主神经、活动和妊娠相关结果的共享纵向表示。在六个队列的63项可比主要指标及OpenMHC基准上进行评估。
AI.result: 在固定参与者划分中，FemWear将周期阶段宏观F1提高了8.15%，并将痛经、情绪问题和睡眠问题的平均绝对误差分别降低了9.32%、5.80%和9.43%。在更严格的留一参与者交叉验证中，部分指标保持正向改进，但其他指标无严格正向置信区间。与最新的全连接多层感知机相比表现更好，但不如共享GRU或多门混合专家基线。训练时校准使预期校准误差减少84.2%-88.2%，且无时间嵌套违规。
AI.conclusion: FemWear实现了针对女性健康研究的定向迁移和一致的概率输出，为相关研究提供了有效工具，但并未建立普遍的性能主导地位或临床有效性。

title: Three Necessary Principles for Self-Supervised Visual Representation Learning
comment: Accepted at the 19th European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV 2026) Workshops
summary: We argue that learning visual representations without labels requires a training signal jointly complete across three non-overlapping objectives: semantic invariance across augmented views, patch-level spatial prediction, and representational non-degeneracy. We formalize these as the observation, prediction, and regularization principles and prove (i) that combining observation and prediction without regularization admits the constant encoder as a global minimizer under negative-free alignment; (ii) that the two objectives are gradient-complementary and structurally non-conflicting at the encoder output; and (iii) that the momentum encoder converges to the same fixed point as the online encoder and provides no collapse guarantee at convergence. Contrastive alignment provides only self-limiting collapse resistance, formalized via an explicit gradient-decay argument. Dropping prediction withholds the spatial training signal by construction; dropping observation forfeits cross-view semantic invariance by construction; at the scale we study, no pair substitutes for the third. Every major self-supervised method is a special case of a single unified energy decomposition. We pair every theoretical claim with a controlled experiment, including a patch-retrieval evaluation for the spatial consequence of prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出无标签视觉表示学习需同时满足语义不变性、空间预测和表征非退化三个目标，证明三者缺一不可，并将主流自监督方法统一为能量分解框架。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决自监督学习中缺乏统一理论指导的问题，明确各组件（如对比学习、掩码建模）在表示学习中的具体作用及其相互关系，解释为何单一或双重目标无法有效防止模型崩溃并实现高质量表示。
AI.method: 通过形式化观察、预测和正则化三大原则，进行理论推导证明：(1) 仅结合观察与预测会导致常数编码器成为全局最小值；(2) 两大目标在梯度上互补且结构上无冲突；(3) 动量编码器收敛性质分析。结合控制实验验证理论主张，包括用于评估空间后果的补丁检索任务。
AI.result: 证明了三个非重叠目标（语义不变性、空间预测、非退化）对于训练信号完整性是共同必需的；任何两个目标的组合都无法替代第三个目标的作用；对比对齐仅提供有限的抗崩溃能力；主流自监督方法均可视为单一统一能量分解的特例。
AI.conclusion: 完整的自监督视觉表示学习必须联合优化语义不变性、空间预测和表征非退化三个目标，缺失任一目标都会导致性能下降或理论上的缺陷，该研究为自监督学习提供了统一的理论基础和设计准则。

title: TCS-BENCH: Benchmarking State-of-the-Art Generative AI Theoretical Computer Science Research Ability
summary: We introduce TCS-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs) on research-level Theoretical Computer Science (TCS) proof generation. TCS-Bench consists of theorem-proving tasks from papers published at top theoretical computer science venues (STOC, FOCS, and SODA). Each task provides the necessary context to derive a self-contained proof for a target result. We evaluate state-of-the-art models on this benchmark. We verify the correctness of generated proofs via a verification agent, and further benchmark the verifier against human-expert proof judgements on a set of target statements and generated proofs pairs. Our reference verifier achieves over 90% accuracy on the expert labeled set.

AI.tldr: 提出TCS-Bench基准，用于评估大语言模型在理论计算机科学（TCS）研究级证明生成方面的能力。该基准包含来自STOC、FOCS和SODA等顶级会议的任务，并通过验证代理验证生成证明的正确性，其参考验证器在专家标注集上准确率超过90%。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决现有基准难以全面评估大语言模型在高水平理论计算机科学证明生成任务中表现的问题，提供一个专注于研究级TCS证明生成的标准化评估框架。
AI.method: 构建TCS-Bench基准，收集来自STOC、FOCS和SODA顶级会议的定理证明任务，提供推导目标结果所需的上下文。使用当前最先进的大语言模型在该基准上进行评估，并开发验证代理来验证生成证明的正确性，同时通过与人类专家判断的对比来校准验证器性能。
AI.result: 成功构建了TCS-Bench基准；对最新大语言模型进行了评估；开发的参考验证器在人类专家标注的目标陈述与生成证明对上实现了超过90%的准确率。
AI.conclusion: TCS-Bench为评估LLMs在复杂TCS证明生成任务中的能力提供了有效手段，且所提出的验证方法具有高精度，能够可靠地辅助评估生成证明的质量。

title: Your VLM Already Knows When: Training-Free Temporal Grounding by Asking Yes or No
summary: Multimodal LLMs that recognise events reliably still fail to say when they happen. Prompted for timestamps, strong VLMs reach as little as $3.8\%$ R@0.5 on Charades-STA, and $77$ to $80\%$ of their wrong predictions carry low output entropy: the models are confidently wrong, and entropy-based error detection stays below a random classifier. We show that this failure lives in the task interface, not in perception. Holding the weights fixed, replacing timestamp regression with a coarse-to-fine scan of binary questions, whose first-token probabilities are consumed only as a ranking, raises R@0.5 by $28$ to $50$ points across four frozen backbones. The residual failures decompose into two measurable axes: a perception axis that moves with the backbone, and a geometry axis that is analytically predictable from the ratio of the output-window and event widths. FV-Action, the training-free method built on this analysis, reaches $56.8\%$ R@0.5 on Charades-STA, above the same backbone's native grounding pipeline and the strongest training-free result on this benchmark; it surpasses every TVG-trained model evaluated zero-shot on TACoS, and improves over direct prediction on ActivityNet Captions and QVHighlights, with no temporal supervision at any stage.

AI.tldr: 针对多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在时间戳定位任务中“自信地错误”的问题，提出了一种无需训练的FV-Action方法。该方法将时间戳回归替换为基于二元问题的粗到细扫描，仅利用首词概率进行排序。实验显示，该方法在冻结骨干网络的情况下显著提升了性能，并在多个基准测试中超越了现有的训练和无监督方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态大模型虽然能可靠识别事件，但在预测具体时间戳时表现极差。研究发现，强视觉语言模型（VLMs）的错误预测往往具有低输出熵，即模型“自信地犯错”，导致基于熵的错误检测失效。研究旨在解决这一接口层面的失败问题，而非感知能力本身的问题。
AI.method: 提出FV-Action，一种无需训练的方法。核心创新在于替换任务接口：保持权重固定，不再直接进行时间戳回归，而是采用粗到细的二元问题扫描策略。该策略仅消耗首词概率作为排序依据，从而避免模型因自信但错误的回归而产生偏差。
AI.result:
1. 在Charades-STA数据集上，R@0.5指标提升28至50分（跨越四个冻结骨干网络）。
2. FV-Action达到56.8%的R@0.5，优于同一骨干网络的原始定位流水线及该基准上最强的无训练结果。
3. 在TACoS数据集上零样本评估中，超越了所有已评估的TVG训练模型。
4. 在ActivityNet Captions和QVHighlights上也优于直接预测方法，且全程无需时间监督。
AI.conclusion: 多模态模型的时间定位失败主要源于任务接口设计而非感知缺陷。通过引入基于概率排序的粗到细二元扫描机制，可以在不重新训练模型的情况下显著提升时间定位精度，证明了该方法的通用性和有效性。

title: Mawqif-v2: An Arabic Benchmark Dataset for Cross-Target Stance Detection
summary: Publicly available Arabic datasets for target-specific stance detection remain limited, particularly for evaluating cross-target generalization. This paper presents the Mawqif-v2 Extension, consisting of 996 manually annotated Arabic tweets collected from three public targets: Women Driving, E-Cars, and Trimester System. Each tweet is annotated with stance, sentiment, and sarcasm labels following the original Mawqif annotation scheme. The released extension is intended as a held-out evaluation set for assessing model generalization to both semantically related and previously unseen targets, while the original Mawqif dataset is used for training and development. In addition, we establish baseline results using several Arabic and multilingual transformer models, as well as zero-shot large language models (LLMs), to facilitate reproducible evaluation. Together with the original Mawqif dataset, the Mawqif-v2 Extension provides a benchmark for evaluating cross-target generalization in Arabic stance detection.

AI.tldr: 本文发布了Mawqif-v2 Extension数据集，包含996条手动标注的阿拉伯语推文，旨在解决目标特定立场检测中跨目标泛化评估数据稀缺的问题。该扩展集与原始Mawqif数据集结合，为阿拉伯语立场检测提供了新的基准，并建立了多种模型（包括Transformer和LLMs）的基线结果。
AI.motivation: 公开可用的阿拉伯语目标特定立场检测数据集有限，特别是在评估跨目标泛化能力方面存在不足。
AI.method: 从三个公共目标（女性驾驶、电动汽车、孕期系统）收集了996条手动标注的阿拉伯语推文作为Mawqif-v2 Extension扩展集。每条推文均按照原始Mawqif标注方案标注了立场、情感和讽刺标签。使用原始Mawqif数据集进行训练和开发，将扩展集作为保留的外部评估集。同时，使用多种阿拉伯语和多语言Transformer模型以及零样本大语言模型（LLMs）建立基线结果。
AI.result: 发布了Mawqif-v2 Extension数据集，确立了多个模型的基线性能，验证了其在评估对语义相关及全新目标的泛化能力方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: Mawqif-v2 Extension与原始Mawqif数据集共同构成了一个用于评估阿拉伯语立场检测中跨目标泛化能力的基准测试平台，有助于促进可复现的评估研究。

title: Your Prompt Is Not the Only Prompt: How Much Do LLMs Weight Structured-Output Schema Descriptions?
summary: Structured output, where an LLM populates a predefined JSON schema, has become a default mechanism for data labeling and information extraction, but it also introduces a second instruction channel through schema descriptions. We tested whether classification-label definitions are better placed in the system prompt, user prompt, or schema description using a single-field classification task with nonce labels across ten model configurations from two vendors. Schema descriptions did not consistently outperform prompt-based placement; for GPT-4.1 and GPT-5.4 without reasoning, schema placement underperformed system prompts by 11-13 percentage points. Yet schemas are not inert metadata: when prompts and schemas conflicted, incorrect schema instructions caused accuracy drops of 5-45 points, with Claude Haiku 4.5 falling from 52.5% to 7%, indicating that schema instructions can override prompt instructions, and GPT-5.5 falling from 100% to 73%. Further, adding a required intermediate reasoning field before the label field improved schema-only accuracy by 15-24 points when headroom existed, exceeding system-prompt-only performance in every case tested. The effect held even for Claude Sonnet 4.6 at medium reasoning, where extended thinking alone did not produce a comparable gain. This suggests that schema design can affect how effectively models use information encoded in field descriptions. Overall, these results indicate that schema influence is model-dependent. In practice, the system prompt remains a safe default for definitions, but the bigger discipline is maintaining a single source of truth and preventing prompt/schema drift. More importantly, schema design itself may be a stronger lever than instruction placement. Practitioners should treat prompts and schemas as a unified instruction surface and empirically validate both placement and field design for their target model.

AI.tldr: 研究探讨了LLM结构化输出中JSON Schema描述与提示词（Prompt）在信息传递上的效力差异。发现Schema并非被动元数据，其指令可覆盖提示词；引入中间推理字段能显著提升准确率。结论是Schema设计比单纯的指令放置位置更具影响力，建议将提示词和Schema视为统一指令面进行实证优化。
AI.motivation: 结构化输出已成为数据标注和信息提取的默认机制，但JSON Schema的描述引入了第二指令通道。目前尚不清楚分类标签定义放在系统提示词、用户提示词还是Schema描述中效果更佳，且Schema对模型行为的具体影响机制不明确。
AI.method: 使用两个供应商的十种模型配置，进行单字段分类任务（使用非通用标签）。测试了标签定义在不同位置（系统提示词、用户提示词、Schema描述）的表现，分析了提示词与Schema冲突时的准确性变化，并评估了在Schema中添加中间推理字段对性能的影响。
AI.result:
1. Schema描述并未始终优于基于提示词的放置方式；在某些模型（如GPT-4.1/5.4无推理模式）中，Schema表现低于系统提示词11-13个百分点。
2. Schema具有强影响力：当提示词与Schema冲突时，错误的Schema指令导致准确率大幅下降（5-45点），例如Claude Haiku 4.5从52.5%降至7%，表明Schema指令可覆盖提示词指令。
3. 在Schema中添加必需的中间推理字段，在有余量时可提升准确率15-24点，且在所有测试案例中均超过仅使用系统提示词的性能。该效应在Claude Sonnet 4.6中等推理模式下依然成立。
AI.conclusion: Schema的影响力取决于具体模型。虽然系统提示词作为定义的默认设置较为安全，但更关键的纪律是保持单一事实来源并防止提示词与Schema漂移。Schema设计本身是影响模型利用字段描述信息效率的关键杠杆。从业者应将提示词和Schema视为统一的指令表面，并针对目标模型实证验证两者的放置和字段设计。

title: A continually expandable foundation model for brain MRI
summary: Brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is central to neuroscience and clinical assessment, but models are commonly developed for individual diseases, populations or imaging protocols. Foundation models promise more general representations, yet they are usually pretrained once and can lose earlier capabilities when updated with new data. Here we show that Alcmaeon, a three-dimensional brain MRI foundation model pretrained without manual labels on more than 425,000 volumes and derived imaging maps, can be expanded sequentially across clinical domains. Alcmaeon combines volumetric encoding and latent diffusion generation with Graph-Blueprint Pruning (GBP), which protects network modules important to earlier domains while leaving the remaining capacity trainable. Across expansion from healthy ageing and neurodegeneration to developmental, psychiatric and tumour imaging, GBP showed less forgetting than sequential adaptation and elastic weight consolidation across voxel-level reconstruction measures, with its largest advantage after adaptation to tumour imaging. The blueprints provided an inspectable record of how model capacity was protected and reused. Representations from different model levels supported image synthesis, disease classification, survival modelling and postoperative prediction, although no single representation was optimal for every task. These findings provide a route towards brain MRI foundation models that can grow with emerging data while retaining earlier capabilities.

AI.tldr: 提出Alcmaeon，一种基于图蓝图剪枝（GBP）的3D脑部MRI基础模型，支持在不遗忘旧知识的前提下，通过增量学习扩展至多个临床领域。
AI.motivation: 解决现有脑部MRI模型通常针对单一疾病或协议开发的问题，以及传统基础模型在更新数据时容易丢失早期能力（灾难性遗忘）的局限性。
AI.method: 利用超过425,000个无标签体积及衍生图像图进行预训练；结合体素编码、潜在扩散生成与图蓝图剪枝（GBP）技术，以保护对早期领域重要的网络模块，同时保留剩余容量用于新领域训练。
AI.result: 在从健康衰老到肿瘤成像的多领域扩展中，GBP在体素级重建指标上表现出比顺序适应和弹性权重巩固更少的遗忘现象；模型表征支持图像合成、疾病分类、生存建模及术后预测等多种任务。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为构建能够随新兴数据增长而持续扩展并保留早期能力的脑部MRI基础模型提供了一条可行路径。

title: ELBench: A Multi-Dimensional Benchmark for Education-Facing Large Language Models
summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed in education as tutors, teaching assistants, and content generators. These roles place demands that ordinary question answering does not: a usable education-facing model is supposed to be accurate, safe under sensitive prompts, instructionally useful, and aligned with pedagogical goals at the same time. Existing benchmarks evaluate these requirements largely in isolation, so none assesses education-facing suitability as an integrated profile. We introduce ELBench, the first benchmark to evaluate all four requirements (General Capability, Safety and Trustworthiness, Basic Education, and High-Level Cultivation) on the same models under a common protocol, combining curated public sources with newly synthesized safety and cultivation data. We evaluate nine models, seven frontier general-purpose systems and two education-specialized variants, and report three findings. First, module-level profiles are more informative than a single aggregate: the top six models are statistically indistinguishable on overall score, yet their module leaders differ substantially, and safety is anti-correlated with practical teaching (r = -0.83). Second, the Chinese-developed models lead the safety module, the most discriminative in the suite; this advantage is largest on region-specific normative content and narrows, but does not vanish, on universal-harm content. Third, the two education-specialized models lead neither education module, and on High-Level Cultivation all models share a systematic blind spot: on the structured judgment task they converge on the same non-reference option, favoring pedagogical style over fit to the stated goal, so the module scores uniformly low and does not separate models. This raises, but does not resolve, whether domain post-training keeps pace with frontier systems on education tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出首个综合评估大语言模型教育适用性的基准测试ELBench，涵盖通用能力、安全可信、基础教育和高阶培养四个维度。研究发现模块级分析比总分更具信息量，中文模型在安全性上领先，但所有模型在高阶培养任务中存在系统性盲点，且安全教育与实用教学呈负相关。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试主要孤立地评估大语言模型的单一要求（如准确性或安全性），缺乏对教育面向适用性的整体综合评估。由于教育场景对模型的准确性、安全性、教学有用性及教学目标对齐有复合需求，亟需一个能同时评估这些维度的统一框架。
AI.method: 构建ELBench基准测试，整合公开数据源与新合成的安全及培养数据，制定统一协议评估9个模型（7个前沿通用模型和2个教育专用变体）。评估维度包括：通用能力、安全可信、基础教育和高阶培养。
AI.result: 1. 模块级画像比单一总分更具洞察力：前六名模型总体得分无显著差异，但各模块优势不同；安全性与实用教学能力呈强负相关（r = -0.83）。2. 中文开发模型在安全性模块领先，尤其在区域特定规范内容上优势明显，但在普遍危害内容上优势缩小。3. 两个教育专用模型并未在教育模块领先；所有模型在高阶培养的“结构化判断任务”中均出现系统性盲点，倾向于教学法风格而非目标契合度，导致该模块分数普遍偏低且无法区分模型。
AI.conclusion: 当前领域后训练（domain post-training）可能尚未跟上前沿系统在复杂教育任务上的表现。单一总分掩盖了模型在不同教育维度上的权衡，模块化评估更能揭示模型的真实教育适用性局限。

title: OBLIVION: Workflow-Level Operational Skill Unlearning for Deployed Agents
summary: Large language model agents are becoming operational interfaces to files, memories, registries, and external tools. This deployment shift creates a new skill revocation problem: after a skill is removed from an explicit registry, an agent may still reconstruct it from residual carriers such as archives, transcripts, schemas, or memory entries. We study this problem as operational skill unlearning, where the goal is not parameter-level forgetting, but preventing a deployed agent from rebuilding a revoked skill through primitive tools. We introduce OBLIVION, a controlled benchmark and defense harness for revoked-skill resurrection. OBLIVION models each episode as a source-to-sink workflow, applies Cross-Surface Coherent Erasure to reduce residual carriers, and uses frozen workflow remediation near dangerous sinks. On the locked 88 attack episodes, the no-defense arm reaches formal attack success rate 1.0. OBLIVION reduces the rate to 0.114 and impact-weighted exposure to 0.115 while keeping locked utility at 1.0 and benign block rate at 0. In a separate skill-attack-derived sandbox, OBLIVION reduces attack success from 1.0 to 0.2 and impact-weighted exposure from 1.0 to 0.213 while preserving all utility controls. These results support workflow-level evaluation beyond checking explicit skill entries.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OBLIVION，一种针对大语言模型智能体“操作技能遗忘”问题的基准测试与防御框架。旨在防止智能体在技能从显式注册表移除后，通过档案、记忆等残留载体重建该技能。实验表明，OBLIVION能有效降低攻击成功率及影响加权暴露度，同时保持正常功能不受影响。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型智能体成为文件、记忆和外部工具的接口，出现了一种新的“技能撤销”问题：即使从显式注册表中删除了某项技能，智能体仍可能通过档案、转录记录、模式或记忆条目等残留载体重构该技能。现有的参数级遗忘方法无法解决此部署层面的风险，因此需要研究如何阻止已部署的智能体重建被撤销的技能。
AI.method: 引入OBLIVION，这是一个受控的基准测试和防御框架。该方法将每个场景建模为源到汇的工作流（source-to-sink workflow），应用跨表面相干擦除（Cross-Surface Coherent Erasure）技术以减少残留载体，并在接近危险汇点时采用冻结的工作流修复策略。
AI.result: 在88个锁定攻击场景中，无防御组的正式攻击成功率为1.0。应用OBLIVION后，攻击成功率降至0.114，影响加权暴露度降至0.115，同时保持锁定效用为1.0且良性阻断率为0。在另一个基于技能攻击的沙盒中，OBLIVION将攻击成功率从1.0降至0.2，影响加权暴露度从1.0降至0.213，并保留了所有效用控制。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果支持超越检查显式技能条目的工作流层面评估方法，证明了OBLIVION在防止智能体重建被撤销技能方面的有效性，同时未损害其正常功能。

title: Circuit Fine-Tuning for Compute-Efficient Transformer Adaptation
summary: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) has become the de facto standard for adapting Vision Transformers (ViTs) to downstream tasks. While parameter count has been the dominant efficiency metric in PEFT, it does not imply \textit{compute efficiency}: parameter-sparse methods can still incur full-model training cost per step, and typically need long schedules to reach peak accuracy. We introduce Circuit Fine-Tuning (CFT), a compute-efficient framework that uses circuit discovery---conventionally used to explain trained models---to select modules for fine-tuning before training. Whereas attribution is conventionally formulated against a trained task head, we formulate it against a near-zero-initialized probe head, which isolates the response of the backbone to the target distribution rather than the preferences of a particular classifier. CFT then fine-tunes only the recovered subgraph. CFT needs no learning-rate warmup and reaches peak accuracy in ${\sim}20$ epochs on average---versus $44$--$96$ for strong PEFT baselines---yielding $2.3$--$6.6\times$ fewer training FLOPs and up to $16\times$ less wall-clock time, while adding zero parameters and no inference operations. Experiments across a standard visual transfer benchmark (VTAB-1k), hierarchical backbones (Swin), domain-shifted medical imaging (CBIS-DDSM), and a vision-language model (Gemma-3 on CUB-200) demonstrate the effectiveness of CFT. Code is available at https://github.com/UriKialy/CFT

AI.tldr: 提出CFT框架，利用电路发现技术在训练前筛选关键模块进行微调，无需增加参数即可显著降低计算成本（FLOPs减少2.3-6.6倍，时间缩短至1/16），并在更少的epoch内达到峰值精度。
AI.motivation: 现有的参数高效微调（PEFT）方法虽减少了参数量，但未解决计算效率问题：稀疏参数方法仍面临全模型训练成本，且需要漫长的训练周期才能达到最高精度。
AI.method: 引入电路微调（CFT），通过针对近零初始化探针头部的归因分析来隔离主干网络对目标分布的响应，从而在训练前发现并选择关键子图进行微调，无需学习率预热。
AI.result: 在VTAB-1k、Swin、CBIS-DDSM及Gemma-3等基准上验证了有效性；平均仅需约20个epoch达到峰值精度（对比基线44-96 epoch），训练FLOPs减少2.3-6.6倍，Wall-clock time最多减少16倍，且不增加推理开销。
AI.conclusion: CFT是一种计算高效的微调框架，通过预训练前的电路发现机制实现了极高的训练效率和性能，证明了基于归因分析的模块选择优于传统的参数计数优化。

title: Pragmatic Attack Surface: Vulnerabilities of Implicit Context in Large Language Models
summary: In the era of large language models (LLMs), attackers often manipulate natural language to elicit unsafe or harmful outputs, creating a new natural language attack surface unique to LLM-based systems, where attacks directly exploit explicit linguistic cues in user prompts to bypass the safety mechanism of LLMs. However, such attacks can often be mitigated by existing safety alignment algorithms. On the other hand, human language is inherently grounded in pragmatics, necessitating typical context to interpret language, e.g., world knowledge, social norms. However, such contexts are often implicit because they are not directly expressed in human language and are not sufficiently leveraged in safety alignment, creating a fundamental mismatch between human language interpretation and safety alignment approaches. In this paper, we demonstrate that this mismatch exposes vulnerabilities in LLMs. We refer to this vulnerability as the pragmatic attack surface, which can be exploited to achieve high attack success rates. The experimental results demonstrate that our proposed approach outperforms baseline attack methods across various open-source and closed-source models by a substantial margin.

AI.tldr: 揭示了大型语言模型（LLM）中因安全对齐算法忽视语用学上下文而导致的“语用攻击面”漏洞，并提出了一种利用该漏洞的高效攻击方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM安全对齐算法主要依赖显式的语言线索来防御攻击，但人类语言本质上依赖于隐含的语用学上下文（如世界知识、社会规范）。这种显式安全机制与隐式语言理解之间的根本性不匹配，导致LLM存在未被充分利用的安全漏洞。
AI.method: 提出并验证了“语用攻击面”（pragmatic attack surface）的概念，通过利用用户提示中隐含的语用学上下文而非显式语言线索来绕过LLM的安全机制，从而生成不安全或有害的输出。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法在多个开源和闭源模型上均取得了极高的攻击成功率，且性能显著优于现有的基线攻击方法。
AI.conclusion: LLM的安全对齐需要解决显式指令与隐式语用语境之间的不匹配问题，否则将面临被基于语用学的新型攻击所利用的风险。

title: Exploring LLM Capabilities for Situational Understanding and COLREG compliance on real-world maritime navigation scenarios
comment: Submitted and accepted to the IFAC WC 2026 as an invited session paper for track 7.2 Transportation and Vehicle Systems - Marine Systems
summary: Recently, Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown considerable capability for situational understanding, reasoning, and decision making in different domains, most notable in the automotive sector. Therefore, we explore current state-of-the-art LLMs as a tool for maritime navigation, which includes both codified rules in the Collision Regulations (COLREGs) and uncodified best practices summarized in the concept of ``Good Seamanship''. We construct a dataset consisting of 50 diverse, real-world navigation scenarios from AIS data, label scenarios with applicable COLREG rules, recommended actions, and the reasoning for the action. We explore a variety of different LLM architectures and sizes to determine their understanding of maritime navigation tasks as well as evaluate their reasoning capabilities in this domain. The results obtained indicate that the maritime navigation task remains difficult to solve without fine-tuning, even for larger online models.

AI.tldr: 研究探索了大型语言模型（LLMs）在海上导航中的应用潜力，通过构建包含50个真实AIS场景的数据集来评估其对《国际海上避碰规则》（COLREGs）和“良好船艺”的理解。结果表明，即使对于较大的在线模型，在不进行微调的情况下，解决海上导航任务仍然非常困难。
AI.motivation: 鉴于LLMs在汽车等领域的情境理解、推理和决策方面表现出色，本研究旨在探索其作为海上导航工具的能力，涵盖成文的避碰规则和不成文的良好船艺实践。
AI.method: 1. 从AIS数据中构建包含50个多样化真实世界导航场景的数据集；2. 对场景进行标注，包括适用的COLREG规则、推荐动作及推理过程；3. 测试多种不同架构和大小的LLM，评估其在海上导航任务中的理解能力和推理能力。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，目前的LLM在海上导航任务上表现不佳，即便使用较大的在线模型，若未经过专门微调，也难以准确解决此类复杂任务。
AI.conclusion: 虽然LLMs在其他领域展现了强大的能力，但在缺乏领域特定微调的情况下，目前尚不足以直接应用于复杂的 maritime navigation 任务，需要进一步的技术优化或领域适配。

title: Tropical Cyclone Forecasting via Latent Rectified Flow using Satellite Imagery and Atmospheric Fields
summary: Tropical cyclones are growing more destructive in a changing climate, and efficient forecasting of their structure and track has become a necessity. Deep generative models promise an alternative to computationally expensive numerical weather prediction (NWP), yet current systems produce either satellite imagery or atmospheric fields, never both; they need many sampling steps, putting them out of reach of modest hardware; and their storm tracks come from regression heads with no physical link to the generated atmosphere. This work presents a single-pass model that jointly forecasts GRIDSAT-B1 infrared imagery and four ERA5 atmospheric fields (U-wind, V-wind, air temperature, and surface pressure) out to nine hours. A five-channel variational autoencoder compresses each 5 x 256 x 256 frame to a 4 x 64 x 64 latent, and a conditional rectified-flow UNet with a factorized temporal-attention module predicts the next three frames from three past frames, their best-track coordinates, and timestamps. The model is then reward-fine-tuned (DRaFT) against a differentiable track error derived from the predicted winds through a steering-flow calculation. On held-out 2022 storms the model reaches 16.35 dB PSNR and 0.759 SSIM, ahead of a reproduced cascaded-diffusion baseline at every lead time (+0.84 dB at +9 h) while sampling ~30x faster (56 ms vs. 1673 ms). Track error at +9 h is 62.4 km, 15% below the baseline, and a reward fine-tuning study demonstrates a further 8-11% track-error reduction across sampler budgets.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种单次通过的深度生成模型，联合预测热带气旋的卫星红外图像和大气场。该模型通过条件整流流UNet实现快速采样（比基线快30倍），并结合可微轨迹误差进行奖励微调（DRaFT），显著提升了预测速度和轨迹精度。
AI.motivation: 应对气候变化下热带气旋破坏力增强的挑战，解决现有数值天气预报计算昂贵的问题。同时克服当前深度生成模型的局限：无法同时生成图像和大气场、采样步骤多导致硬件要求高、以及生成的风暴轨迹缺乏与生成大气的物理联系。
AI.method: 构建一个单次通过模型，联合预测GRIDSAT-B1红外图像和ERA5四个大气场（U风、V风、气温、地表气压）。使用五通道变分自编码器压缩数据，采用带有因子化时间注意力模块的条件整流流UNet，基于过去三帧及其最佳跟踪坐标和时间戳预测未来三帧。最后，利用通过转向流计算得出的可微轨迹误差对模型进行奖励微调（DRaFT）。
AI.result: 在2022年独立测试风暴中，模型达到16.35 dB PSNR和0.759 SSIM，优于级联扩散基线（+9小时领先0.84 dB）。采样速度提升约30倍（56毫秒 vs 1673毫秒）。+9小时的轨迹误差为62.4公里，比基线低15%；奖励微调研究进一步显示轨迹误差减少了8-11%。
AI.conclusion: 该单次通过模型通过联合生成图像和大气场，结合快速采样技术和物理一致的奖励微调，实现了高效且高精度的热带气旋结构与轨迹预测，为替代计算昂贵的数值天气预报提供了可行的深度学习方案。

title: Se-DPO: Self-Evolving Token Credit for Direct Preference Optimization
summary: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) aggregates token-level log-probability ratios via uniform summation, implicitly treating all tokens as contributing equally to the preference signal. However, the contribution of individual tokens to the preference signal varies. We introduce token credit, which modulates each token's KL regularization based on its contribution to the preference outcome. We derive that effective token credit is proportional to the magnitude of each token's implicit reward, and observe that this quantity evolves substantially during training. This implies that static token credit becomes increasingly misaligned as training progresses. In this work, we propose Se-DPO (Self-Evolving Token Credit for DPO), a live mechanism that derives token credit from the model's own evolving internal signals during DPO training. Since the reward signal varies in reliability across positions, Se-DPO calibrates token credit based on both the strength and the confidence of each token's contribution. Se-DPO requires no external models, adding only a lightweight calibration network with minimal computational overhead. Experiments show that Se-DPO improves over DPO by up to 9.8 points on AlpacaEval~2 and 12.2 points on Arena-Hard.

AI.tldr: 提出Se-DPO，一种通过模型内部动态信号实时调整Token信用权重的DPO改进方法，无需外部模型即可显著提升对齐效果。
AI.motivation: 传统DPO假设所有Token对偏好信号的贡献相等（均匀求和），但实际上不同Token的贡献度存在差异且随训练动态变化，导致静态信用分配逐渐失效。
AI.method: 提出Se-DPO（Self-Evolving Token Credit for DPO），利用模型在训练过程中产生的内部信号，根据每个Token隐含奖励的大小及其贡献的置信度，动态计算并校准Token信用权重。该方法仅引入一个轻量级校准网络。
AI.result: 在AlpacaEval 2上提升9.8分，在Arena-Hard上提升12.2分，显著优于原始DPO方法。
AI.conclusion: Se-DPO通过自进化的Token信用机制解决了DPO中Token贡献评估不均的问题，以极低的计算开销实现了更优的大语言模型对齐性能。

title: Fair on the Surface? Benchmarking Hidden-Output Fairness Gaps in LLM Recommenders
summary: Fairness audits for LLM-based recommenders have largely focused on observable outputs, implicitly assuming that stable recommendations reflect stable internal processing. We challenge this assumption with FairGap, the first benchmark to jointly evaluate recommendation fairness at two levels: observable output shift (OBS) and hidden representation shift (IBS), measured through controlled counterfactual identity probes across gender, age, and race. Their relationship is summarized via Representation-Output Alignment (ROA), with quadrant diagnostics for identifying user-level hidden-output mismatch. Applied to six open-weight LLM families across three domains, FairGap reveals pervasive hidden-output decoupling: ROA rarely exceeds 0.22, and a non-negligible user population shows stable outputs despite substantial internal shifts, a mode that output-only audits cannot detect by design. Further, activation steering that reduces IBS by up to 8x simultaneously worsens OBS, demonstrating a fundamental tension between internal and output-level fairness that existing frameworks are unequipped to diagnose.

AI.tldr: 提出FairGap基准，首次联合评估LLM推荐系统在可观察输出(OBS)和隐藏表征(IBS)两个层面的公平性。研究发现内部表征与外部输出存在广泛解耦（ROA<0.22），且减少内部偏差可能恶化输出偏差，揭示了现有单一层面审计的局限性及内外公平性的根本张力。
AI.motivation: 挑战“稳定推荐反映稳定内部处理”的隐含假设，指出当前LLM推荐系统的公平性审计主要局限于可观察输出，忽略了内部处理过程的潜在不公平性，导致无法检测“输出稳定但内部偏移”的情况。
AI.method: 构建FairGap基准，通过针对性别、年龄和种族的受控反事实身份探针，同时测量可观察输出偏移(OBS)和隐藏表征偏移(IBS)。引入表示-输出对齐(ROA)指标总结二者关系，并使用象限诊断法识别用户级别的隐藏-输出不匹配。在三个领域的六个开源LLM家族上应用该基准，并测试激活引导技术对公平性的影响。
AI.result: 1. 普遍存在隐藏-输出解耦：ROA极少超过0.22；2. 存在大量用户表现出输出稳定但内部表征大幅偏移的现象，这种模式是仅基于输出的审计无法检测到的；3. 使用激活引导技术将IBS降低高达8倍的同时，反而使OBS恶化，证明内部公平性与输出公平性之间存在根本张力。
AI.conclusion: 现有的公平性框架无法诊断内部与输出层面公平性之间的根本张力，因为两者可能存在背离。需要同时考虑可观察输出和隐藏表征的联合评估方法，才能更全面地理解和解决LLM推荐系统中的公平性问题。

title: VOICE: A Vision-Omics Foundation Model Integrating Direct and Retrieval-Based Prediction of In-situ Single-Cell Gene Expression
summary: Spatial transcriptomics can resolve gene expression at single-cell resolution, but it is costly, limited to targeted panels of a few hundred to a few thousand genes, and applicable to only a small number of samples. H&E imaging, by contrast, is cheap and collected routinely at scale. This makes predicting single-cell expression directly from morphology a practical way to bring molecular analysis to large tissue archives. We therefore present VOICE, a multimodal foundation model that predicts single-cell gene expression from H&E images using paired Xenium data. VOICE first aligns cell centered H&E morphology from a pathology foundation model with single-cell expression embeddings from a transcriptome foundation model, trained using contrastive learning over 23 million cells. Next it predicts expression through two branches. One branch directly regresses expression from morphology. The other branch retrieves measured expression from similar reference cells, recovering genes that do not have morphological signal. Because genes vary in morphological predictability, VOICE fuses the two branches with a per-gene weight. After training, VOICE generalizes to heldout patients, slides, and partially overlapping gene panels from Xenium, and it consistently outperforms prior single-cell expression prediction methods on seven metrics.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为VOICE的多模态基础模型，能够利用常规H&E染色图像预测单细胞基因表达，解决了空间转录组学成本高、通量低的问题。该模型通过对比学习对齐形态学与转录组特征，并结合直接回归与参考检索两种分支，在多个指标上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 空间转录组学虽能实现单细胞分辨率的基因表达分析，但存在成本高、仅针对有限基因面板、样本数量受限等缺点；相比之下，H&E成像成本低且可大规模常规采集。因此，直接从形态学预测单细胞表达是将分子分析扩展至大型组织档案的实用途径。
AI.method:
1. 数据对齐：使用配对Xenium数据，通过对比学习在2300万个细胞上训练，将来自病理学基础模型的细胞中心H&E形态学特征与来自转录组基础模型的单细胞表达嵌入进行对齐。
2. 双分支预测架构：
   - 分支一：直接从形态学回归预测基因表达。
   - 分支二：从相似参考细胞中检索已测量的表达，以恢复缺乏形态学信号的基因。
3. 动态融合：根据基因在形态学上的可预测性差异，对两个分支的结果进行逐基因加权融合。
AI.result:
1. VOICE能够泛化到未见过的患者、切片以及部分重叠的Xenium基因面板。
2. 在七项评估指标上，VOICE一致地优于先前的单细胞表达预测方法。
AI.conclusion: VOICE作为一种多模态基础模型，成功实现了从低成本H&E图像到高保真单细胞基因表达的预测，为大规模组织档案的分子分析提供了高效且准确的新工具。

title: MDB-Link: Hierarchical Schema Linking for Multi-Database Text-to-SQL
summary: Traditional Text-to-SQL research and benchmarks assume a known target database, overlooking settings in which a query must be routed within a large, heterogeneous database collection. We therefore study schema linking in a multi-database setting, where the system must first locate the target database and then construct a compact, SQL-relevant schema for generation. We propose MDB-Link, a hierarchical schema-linking framework that retrieves question-relevant columns from a global index, aggregates retrieval evidence to shortlist databases, and uses a budget-aware large language model (LLM) for database reranking, table selection, and column grounding. With Qwen2.5-14B, MDB-Link outperforms LinkAlign on MMQA, Spider2-Snow, and BIRD-dev in database localization and column selection while producing schema subsets close in size to the gold schemas. Exact match improves from 16.88 to 51.41 on MMQA, 2.50 to 9.17 on Spider2-Snow, and 12.52 to 38.01 on BIRD-dev. MDB-Link also runs faster than LinkAlign and AutoLink, demonstrating the effectiveness of hierarchical schema reduction for downstream SQL generation.

AI.tldr: 提出MDB-Link框架，解决多数据库环境下的Schema Linking问题，通过分层检索和LLM重排序实现高效数据库定位与列选择。
AI.motivation: 传统Text-to-SQL研究假设目标数据库已知，忽略了在实际场景中需在大规模异构数据库集合中路由查询的需求。
AI.method: 提出MDB-Link分层Schema Linking框架：从全局索引检索相关列，聚合证据短名单候选数据库，利用预算感知的大语言模型（LLM）进行数据库重排序、表选择和列接地。
AI.result: 在MMQA、Spider2-Snow和BIRD-dev数据集上，使用Qwen2.5-14B模型的MDB-Link在数据库定位和列选择上优于LinkAlign；精确匹配率显著提升（MMQA: 16.88→51.41, Spider2-Snow: 2.50→9.17, BIRD-dev: 12.52→38.01），且生成的Schema子集大小接近黄金标准，运行速度也快于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 分层Schema缩减策略有效提升了下游SQL生成的效率与准确性。

title: Mitigating Over-Personalization in LLMs via Structured Memory
summary: Conversational assistants increasingly rely on persistent long-term memory to personalize responses across sessions. However, when stored user information is reintroduced into the model context, it can also influence responses in inappropriate or unrelated settings. We study two such failure modes in memory-augmented LLMs: cross-domain leakage, where memories from one life domain affect responses in another, and memory-induced sycophancy, where stored user beliefs make models more likely to agree with the user rather than respond truthfully. We apply a simple inference-time modification to how memories are presented to the model, without changing the model or the memory contents. Across seven models on PersistBench, we compare the commonly used all-in context format, where memories are injected as an unstructured list, with structured formats that partition memories by domain. This simple modification consistently reduces cross-domain leakage while preserving utility, with our strongest method reducing leakage by $8.8\%$ on average relative to the baseline.

AI.tldr: 研究指出，在对话助手中引入长期记忆时，存在“跨域泄露”和“记忆诱导的阿谀奉承”两种失效模式。本文提出一种无需修改模型或记忆内容的推理时结构化呈现方法，将记忆按领域分区。实验表明，该方法在PersistBench上显著降低了跨域泄露（平均降低8.8%），同时保持了效用。
AI.motivation: 随着对话助手越来越多地依赖持久化长期记忆来个性化响应，当存储的用户信息被重新引入模型上下文时，可能会在不适当或不相关的场景中影响模型的响应行为，导致隐私泄露或回答不真实等问题。
AI.method: 提出一种简单的推理时修改策略，通过改变记忆的呈现方式而非修改模型本身或记忆内容来解决问题。具体而言，对比常用的“全量上下文格式”（将记忆作为非结构化列表注入）与“结构化格式”（按领域对记忆进行分区）。在PersistBench数据集上对七种模型进行了评估。
AI.result: 结构化记忆呈现方法一致性地减少了跨域泄露现象，同时保留了模型的效用能力。最强的方法相较于基线，平均将跨域泄露降低了8.8%。
AI.conclusion: 通过对记忆信息进行结构化和领域分区呈现，可以在不改变模型架构的情况下有效缓解记忆增强型大语言模型中的跨域泄露问题，提升响应的安全性和准确性。

title: PARAGraph: Pathology-Anatomy-Aware Hierarchical Graph for Diabetic Retinopathy Grading
summary: Diabetic retinopathy (DR) remains a leading cause of vision loss among working-age adults worldwide, making reliable severity grading clinically important. Despite strong performance, most deep models formulate DR grading as image-level classification and do not explicitly model clinically grounded evidence, such as lesion types and spatial relations. In this paper, we propose PARAGraph, a Pathology-Anatomy-Aware Hierarchical Graph framework for DR grading. PARAGraph represents each image as a three-level hierarchical graph with lesion-level nodes, intermediate category and region nodes, and global anatomical and semantic nodes. To incorporate medical priors into nodes, we construct an optic disc-fovea-anchored coordinate frame that provides a scale- and rotation-normalized retinal reference system. Within this frame, lesion nodes are encoded with category, normalized area, and anatomical coordinates. To mitigate noisy lesion segmentation, PARAGraph uses a dual-fusion strategy that introduces global visual context into a graph semantic node and a decision-level prediction branch, improving robustness when lesion evidence is unreliable. Extensive experiments on Messidor-2, APTOS, and DDR show that PARAGraph achieves consistent DR grading performance over state-of-the-art methods. Interpretability and robustness analyses further demonstrate that its predictions are clinically grounded, closely associated with lesion evidence and robust to lesion segmentation noise.

AI.tldr: 提出PARAGraph框架，通过构建病理-解剖感知的三层层次化图结构及视盘-黄斑锚定坐标系，将糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）分级从图像级分类转化为基于病灶证据的推理，显著提升了模型在噪声环境下的鲁棒性及临床可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习模型虽性能强劲，但多将DR分级视为图像级分类任务，缺乏对临床依据（如病灶类型及其空间关系）的显式建模，导致可解释性不足且易受分割噪声影响。
AI.method: 1. 构建三层层次化图：包含病灶级节点、中间类别/区域节点及全局解剖/语义节点；2. 建立视盘-黄斑锚定的坐标系，提供尺度与旋转归一化的视网膜参考系统，用于编码病灶的类别、面积及解剖坐标；3. 采用双融合策略，将全局视觉上下文引入图语义节点和决策预测分支，以缓解病灶分割噪声干扰。
AI.result: 在Messidor-2、APTOS和DDR数据集上的广泛实验表明，PARAGraph的性能持续优于当前最先进方法（SOTA），且在可解释性和抗噪鲁棒性分析中表现优异。
AI.conclusion: PARAGraph通过将医学先验融入图结构，实现了具有临床依据的DR分级，证明了其预测结果紧密关联病灶证据，并对病灶分割噪声具有强鲁棒性。

title: Measuring the Wrong Thing: Internal Harmfulness Scores Anti-Rank Successful Jailbreaks
summary: Internal safety scores judge a prompt before any text is generated, and they are validated by how well they separate harmful prompts from benign ones. That separation is then read as evidence that the score will also catch the attacks that succeed. Harmful intent is a property of the prompt. Jailbreak success is an outcome produced later by a particular target model, decoding policy, and judge. A filter tuned on a score that measures the wrong quantity spends its false positive budget on attacks that would have failed anyway. In this paper we audit that inference. Attention based measurements are usually read from prompt dependent locations, so a wrapper changes both the content being judged and the place the signal is taken from. We therefore introduce Active Attention Probing, which supplies a fixed content independent measurement coordinate. We pair every base goal with a plain and a wrapped version and generate real completions from the target models. On Llama, wrapping raises harmful generation from 0.05 to 0.27 while harmful intent AUROC falls from 0.936 to 0.803, so the attacks grow more dangerous while the prompts look safer to the score. Among wrapped harmful prompts the outcome AUROC is 0.220, which places the attacks that succeeded below the attacks that failed. Rare token, passive, and detector derived channels reproduce the reversal on the same matched design, and the reversal itself persists across three target models, seven attack families, and two independent judges. Distribution shift then degrades calibration and threshold transfer before it degrades ranking.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了基于提示词（Prompt）内部安全评分的防御机制存在严重缺陷：包装攻击（Wrapping）能同时提高有害内容的生成率并降低安全评分的可区分性，导致“攻击更危险但评分更安全”的反转现象。
AI.motivation: 现有的内部安全评分主要评估提示词的有害意图，而忽略了模型解码策略和特定目标模型对最终输出结果的影响。这种将“意图”等同于“成功攻击”的推断缺乏实证支持，且可能因误判导致防御资源浪费在注定失败的攻击上。
AI.method: 提出“主动注意力探测”（Active Attention Probing），使用固定且独立于内容的位置进行测量，以消除包装操作对信号提取位置的干扰。通过在Llama等模型上对比原始与包装版本的提示词，生成真实完成文本，并评估不同攻击家族、目标模型及裁判下的性能变化。
AI.result: 1. 在Llama模型上，包装使有害生成率从0.05升至0.27，同时有害意图AUROC从0.936降至0.803。2. 在包装后的有害提示中，结果AUROC仅为0.220，表明成功的攻击在评分上反而低于失败的攻击。3. 该反转现象在三种目标模型、七种攻击家族和两个独立裁判中均复现。4. 分布偏移先于排序能力下降，破坏了校准和阈值迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 仅依赖提示词层面的内部安全评分无法有效检测经过包装的攻击，因为此类攻击会扭曲评分信号与实际危害结果之间的相关性。防御机制需考虑模型输出端的实际风险，而非仅关注输入端的意图分类。

title: Query-Only Backdoor Attacks on Self-Evolving Skills via Trajectory Poisoning
summary: Agentic skills improve large language model (LLM) agents by encoding reusable procedures for complex tasks. However, manually authored skills often adapt poorly to long-horizon tasks and changing environments. To address the limitation, self-evolving skill systems have been developed to automatically construct and update skills from execution trajectories, shifting skill acquisition from external marketplaces to a trusted evolution pipeline. By replacing external skill acquisition with trusted internal construction, self-evolving skill systems reduce exposure to skill injection attacks that rely on direct skill manipulation. However, this skill evolution pipeline may introduce a new attack surface in which an attacker can indirectly steer skill evolution by inducing compromised trajectories through agent interactions. To demonstrate the threat, we propose Trajectory Backdoor Attack (TBA), a query-only attack that steers a trusted skill-evolution pipeline toward producing a backdoored skill. Specifically, we craft attacker-submitted queries to lead the agent to perform the target action and explicitly state the corresponding activation condition in the trajectory. We repeat the same condition-action pattern across diverse triggered tasks, while leaving clean queries unchanged, encouraging the evolver to consolidate the pattern as a reusable trigger-dependent rule into the evolved skill. Experiments on three benchmarks across two skill-evolution systems using four open- and closed-source backbone models demonstrate that TBA reliably implants conditional backdoors while preserving clean-task utility, matching or even surpassing direct skill injection. The results reveal a critical vulnerability in trajectory-driven skill evolution.

AI.tldr: 提出轨迹后门攻击（TBA），通过诱导智能体生成包含特定触发条件的执行轨迹，间接污染自进化技能系统，植入条件后门。
AI.motivation: 现有的自进化技能系统虽减少了对外部技能的依赖从而降低直接注入攻击风险，但其依赖执行轨迹进行技能进化的机制引入了新的攻击面：攻击者可通过操纵智能体的交互轨迹来间接操控技能进化过程。
AI.method: 提出轨迹后门攻击（Trajectory Backdoor Attack, TBA）。该方法仅通过查询接口，构造特定输入引导智能体执行目标动作并记录相应的激活条件；在多个不同任务中重复此“条件-动作”模式，同时保持干净查询不变，促使进化系统将这种模式固化为可复用的、依赖触发的规则。
AI.result: 在两个技能进化系统和三个基准测试上，使用四种开源和闭源基础模型进行的实验表明，TBA能可靠地植入条件后门，同时保持干净任务的性能，其效果匹配甚至优于直接的技能注入攻击。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了基于轨迹驱动的技能进化机制存在关键漏洞，即攻击者无需直接访问技能库，即可通过操纵执行轨迹间接实现技能投毒。

title: Gated Spatial Redundancy Projection for Pathology Transformer Attentions
summary: Transformer models are increasingly used for whole-slide image analysis in computational pathology. Yet, WSIs differ fundamentally from natural images: neighbouring patches often contain highly similar tissue type, stain, texture, and cellular composition. We identify this local spatial redundancy as a pathology-specific failure mode of self-attention, where dominant neighbourhood features can be repeatedly mixed into patch-tokens and weaken subtle diagnostic or prognostic deviations. We propose Gated Spatial Redundancy Projection (Gated SRP), a lightweight drop-in correction module for self-attention layers. For each patch token and attention head, Gated SRP estimates a local redundancy axis from neighbouring value vectors, projects the attention output onto this axis, and applies a learned signed gate to correct the redundancy-aligned component geometrically. Across five TCGA survival cohorts, Gated SRP obtains the highest mean C-index among the compared attention variants in all cohorts, with an average improvement over the base attention, while adding only +0.02% parameters. Across five slide-level classification datasets, it improves the base attention on 12 of 16 reported metrics and achieves the best AUC on three datasets. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/AtlasAnalyticsLab/GatedSRP.

AI.tldr: 针对全切片图像(WSI)分析中Transformer自注意力机制因局部空间冗余导致的问题，提出轻量级模块Gated SRP。该模块通过估计局部冗余轴并应用学习到的符号门控来校正注意力输出，在TCGA生存队列和分类数据集中均显著提升了性能，且仅增加0.02%参数量。
AI.motivation: Transformer模型虽广泛用于计算病理学的全切片图像(WSI)分析，但WSI与自然图像存在本质差异：相邻patch通常具有高度相似的组织类型、染色、纹理和细胞组成。这种“局部空间冗余”会导致自注意力机制的失效模式，即主导的邻域特征被反复混合进patch-token中，从而削弱了细微的诊断或预后偏差信号。
AI.method: 提出门控空间冗余投影（Gated Spatial Redundancy Projection, Gated SRP），这是一种用于自注意力层的轻量级即插即用校正模块。具体流程为：对于每个patch token和注意力头，Gated SRP从相邻的值向量中估计局部冗余轴，将注意力输出投影到该轴上，并应用一个学习到的带符号门控（learned signed gate）对与冗余对齐的分量进行几何校正。
AI.result:
1. 在五个TCGA生存队列中，Gated SRP在所有队列中的平均C-index均高于其他对比的注意力变体，相比基础注意力机制有显著提升。
2. 在五个幻灯片级别分类数据集中，它在16个报告指标中的12个上优于基础注意力机制，并在三个数据集上取得了最佳的AUC。
3. 该方法仅增加了0.02%的参数。
4. 代码已公开。
AI.conclusion: Gated SRP有效解决了WSI分析中由局部空间冗余引起的自注意力缺陷，以极低的参数代价显著提升了生存预测和分类任务的性能，证明了其作为标准注意力层有效补充的价值。

title: How Do Large Language Models Judge Social Attraction? Evidence from Theory-Grounded Persona Ratings Across Multiple LLMs and Humans
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Includes technical supplement
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to perform subjective evaluations traditionally made by humans, yet their validity as social judges remains unclear. This paper examines whether LLMs can assess social attraction from theory-grounded persona profiles constructed from ten psychological and relational constructs and organized into three tiers: socially attractive, socially mixed, and socially unattractive. We examine LLM ratings in two studies and compare them with human judgments in a third study. In Study 1, 34 LLMs rated 12 profiles across three repeated runs. Although some models tended to give higher or lower ratings overall, they showed strong stability across runs, consistent three-tier ordering, and high agreement in relative profile ordering. Study 2 examined sensitivity to gender presentation using six matched name-and-pronoun profile pairs and a separate pronoun-only test with a gender-neutral name, finding no significant effects in either analysis. In Study 3, 198 human participants evaluated the six matched profiles from Study 2. Their ratings reproduced the three-tier structure and followed a profile ordering consistent with that of the LLMs. However, LLMs rated attractive profiles more positively and unattractive profiles more negatively than humans, while neither group showed a significant overall effect of gender presentation.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过三项实验评估大语言模型（LLM）在基于心理学构念构建的社会吸引力人格档案上的评价能力。结果显示，LLM具有高度的内部稳定性和层级排序一致性，且与人类判断在总体结构上相符，但在评分极值上存在差异（LLM更极端），且两者均未表现出对性别呈现的显著偏见。
AI.motivation: 尽管LLM被广泛用于替代人类进行主观评估，但其在作为“社会法官”方面的有效性尚不明确。本研究旨在验证LLM是否能基于理论支撑的人格档案准确评估社会吸引力。
AI.method:
1. 构建包含十个心理和关系构论、分为三个层级（有社交吸引力、混合、无社交吸引力）的人格档案。
2. Study 1：34个LLM对12个档案进行三次重复评分，分析稳定性与一致性。
3. Study 2：利用性别匹配的名词-代词档案对及中性名称测试，检查LLM对性别呈现的敏感性。
4. Study 3：198名人类参与者对Study 2中的档案进行评分，并与LLM结果对比。
AI.result:
1. LLM在多次运行中表现稳定，遵循一致的三层级排序，相对顺序 agreement 高。
2. LLM未显示出对性别呈现的显著影响。
3. 人类评分复现了三层级结构，且与LLM的排序一致。
4. LLM对有吸引力的档案评分更积极，对无吸引力的档案评分更消极（相比人类）。
5. 人类同样未显示出对性别呈现的显著整体效应。
AI.conclusion: LLM能够以与人类相似的方式对社会吸引力进行结构化评估，具备良好的稳定性和一致性，但在评分极端程度上与人类存在偏差。此外，LLM和人类在此任务中均未表现出显著的性别偏见。

title: StructReward: Efficient Structured Process Rewards for Self-Correcting Multimodal Reasoning
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures. Yifan Li and Ruxin Sun contributed equally
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has emerged as an effective approach for improving multimodal reasoning. However, most existing methods evaluate an entire response using a binary reward based only on final-answer correctness, thereby discarding the supervision available in intermediate reasoning steps. Process reward models offer finer-grained feedback, but they typically rely on separately trained verifiers, costly chain-of-thought annotations, or online judging by large language models (LLMs). In this work, we introduce StructReward, a compute-efficient framework that provides dense reinforcement signals through structured step-level reward alignment. StructReward represents each generated solution as a sequence of reasoning steps and aligns them with process-labeled reference steps using lightweight numerical, symbolic, and lexical matching rules. The aligned labels are aggregated into a dense process reward and combined with final-answer consistency and output-validity rewards through a gated Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) objective. We further recycle policy rollouts into complementary supervision for response comparison and reflective self-correction, rather than discarding them after policy updates. Separately, we use a strong LLM to rewrite sampled correct trajectories into reflection-oriented training instances, further strengthening the policy's ability to evaluate and refine its reasoning. Since reward computation is performed online without an additional learned verifier or external LLM judge, StructReward substantially reduces the computational overhead of multimodal reinforcement learning. Experimental results show that structured process supervision and rollout recycling provide an efficient path toward self-improving multimodal reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出StructReward框架，通过结构化步骤级奖励对齐和在线计算，实现高效的多模态推理强化学习，避免昂贵的验证器或LLM裁判开销。
AI.motivation: 现有基于最终答案正确性的二元奖励忽略了中间推理步骤的监督信息；而过程奖励模型通常依赖单独训练的验证器、昂贵的思维链标注或在线LLM判断，计算成本高。
AI.method: 1. 将生成解表示为推理步骤序列，通过轻量级的数值、符号和词汇匹配规则与参考步骤对齐，聚合为密集过程奖励。2. 结合最终答案一致性和输出有效性奖励，使用门控组相对策略优化（GRPO）目标。3. 回收策略 rollout 用于响应比较和反思性自我校正。4. 利用强LLM将正确轨迹重写为反思导向的训练实例，增强策略的评估与 refine 能力。5. 在线计算奖励，无需额外学习验证器或外部LLM裁判。
AI.result: 实验表明，结构化过程监督和rollout回收为自改进多模态推理提供了高效路径；StructReward显著降低了多模态强化学习的计算开销。
AI.conclusion: StructReward是一种计算高效的框架，通过结构化步骤级奖励对齐和rollout回收，有效提升了多模态推理能力，同时大幅减少了计算资源消耗。

title: DoRF++: Spherical Representation Learning over Doppler Radiance Fields for Robust Wi-Fi Sensing
summary: Motivated by the IEEE 802.11bf effort to standardize advanced WLAN sensing, interest in Wi-Fi Channel State Information (CSI) for passive, device-free, and privacy-preserving activity and gesture recognition has grown rapidly. Recent studies have shown that Doppler velocity projections extracted from CSI, which directly reflect human-motion velocity, enable more robust human activity recognition (HAR) and stronger generalization across users and unseen conditions. Nevertheless, reliable generalization under real-world variability remains a major challenge, hindering the adoption of Wi-Fi sensing in real-world applications. To address this challenge, we introduce Doppler Radiance Fields (DoRF), bringing the concept of neural radiance fields (NeRF) from computer vision into Wi-Fi sensing. DoRF models Doppler velocity projections extracted from Wi-Fi CSI as sparse and diverse virtual-camera views of human motion. It then infers a latent 3D motion sequence whose projections along learned effective Doppler directions explain the CSI-derived Doppler observations. The recovered motion is subsequently projected onto an equiangular grid of directions on the unit sphere, producing a spherical representation of the underlying motion. Since DoRF naturally defines the Doppler representation on spheres, we further introduce DoRF++, a spherical-learning design that applies spherical Transformers for activity classification. Experiments on our collected hand-gesture dataset show that DoRF++ significantly outperforms state-of-the-art Wi-Fi-based HAR methods in cross-user generalization accuracy, especially for difficult gestures in settings with a single multi-antenna receiver access point (AP).

AI.tldr: 提出DoRF和DoRF++框架，利用神经辐射场（NeRF）思想将Wi-Fi CSI中的多普勒速度投影建模为虚拟相机视角，通过球面Transformer实现跨用户手势识别的鲁棒泛化。
AI.motivation: 解决现有Wi-Fi传感在真实世界多变条件下，基于CSI的多普勒速度投影进行人体活动识别（HAR）时面临的泛化能力不足问题。
AI.method: 1. 提出Doppler Radiance Fields (DoRF)：将CSI提取的多普勒速度投影视为稀疏的虚拟相机视图，推断潜在3D运动序列并重建球面运动表示；2. 提出DoRF++：在DoRF基础上引入球面Transformer进行活动分类。
AI.result: 在手势数据集实验中，DoRF++在单多天线路由器接入点场景下，显著优于最先进的Wi-Fi HAR方法，特别是在跨用户泛化准确率方面表现突出，能有效处理困难手势。
AI.conclusion: 将计算机视觉中的NeRF概念引入Wi-Fi传感，结合球面学习设计，有效提升了无源、隐私保护型人体活动识别在复杂现实环境中的鲁棒性和通用性。

title: REFRAMED: Towards Realistic Audio Description Generation for Movies
summary: Audio Description (AD) is a verbal narration of key visual content in videos, enabling access for visually impaired audiences. Unlike standard video captioning, AD is a structured editorial task: descriptions must be inserted into gaps in dialogue and must convey only what is needed to understand the narrative being told. However, existing approaches formulate AD generation in an artificial setting where both the content and timing of descriptions are pre-specified, reducing the task to clip-level captioning. They further rely on noisy transcription and alignment pipelines, and lack the rich parallel data required for modeling narrative context. We introduce a new formulation of AD generation in which models must jointly decide what to describe and when to do it. To support this, we present REFRAMED, a high-quality dataset of 2,023 videos that span 3,302 scenes from 206 movies, with professional AD transcripts (both American and British versions), professional subtitles and aligned screenplays. We also provide a manually curated challenge set that pairs full movies with multiple AD references, together with evaluation protocols that leverage dialogue gaps and multi-reference comparisons. Experiments with state-of-the-art AD systems and multimodal LLMs show that they outperform trivial baselines but fall far short of expert human performance. Our dataset and benchmark establish a new foundation for research on video understanding.

AI.tldr: 提出新的音频描述（AD）生成任务，要求模型同时决定“描述什么”和“何时描述”，并发布REFRAMED数据集及评估基准。
AI.motivation: 现有AD研究将内容与时序预设为人工设定，简化为片段级字幕任务；且依赖噪声转录、缺乏叙事上下文数据，无法真实反映AD作为结构化编辑任务的复杂性。
AI.method: 构建REFRAMED数据集，包含206部电影、3302个场景的专业AD转录（美/英版）、字幕和对齐剧本；设计利用对话间隙和多参考比较的新评估协议；测试SOTA AD系统及多模态大语言模型。
AI.result: 现有先进系统和多模态LLM虽优于平凡基线，但远未达到专家人类水平；新数据集与基准为视频理解研究奠定基础。
AI.conclusion: 该工作重新定义了AD生成任务，提供了高质量数据与评估框架，揭示了当前模型在复杂叙事语境下的不足，推动了面向真实场景的视频理解研究。

title: LLMVisor: A Real-Time Latency Attribution Model for Multi-Tenant LLM Serving
summary: As LLM inference shifts to multi-tenant GPU clusters, co-batching improves throughput but obscures per-tenant usage and limits control. Enabling fractional sharing of the inference engine requires a real-time, per-request attribution primitive that is accurate and light enough to run inside the scheduling loop. We present LLMVisor, a roofline-guided latency attribution model that captures the memory-bound and compute-bound phases via a concise piecewise-linear form over features proportional to FLOPs and memory I/O traffic. LLMVisor decomposes batch latency into additive, per-request shares and runs efficiently at microsecond scale. We evaluate LLMVisor across Llama 3.1-8B and Qwen 2.5-14B/32B on A100/H100 GPUs under varying tensor parallelism and workload mixes. Compared to a token-count baseline, LLMVisor attains near-perfect R-squared and reduces relative error by up to 2.5x and 3.3x at p90 and p99, respectively, for prefill, and by up to 3.5x and 4.4x for decode, despite batching variability and sequence divergence.

AI.tldr: 提出LLMVisor，一种基于屋顶线模型的延迟归因工具，用于在多租户GPU集群中实现推理引擎的细粒度、实时请求级资源分配与监控。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型（LLM）推理转向多租户GPU集群，传统的co-batching技术虽然提高了吞吐量，但掩盖了每个租户的具体使用情况，限制了对资源的精细控制。现有的粗粒度统计无法支持实时的、按请求的资源归属划分。
AI.method: LLMVisor采用基于屋顶线（roofline-guided）的延迟归因模型，通过简洁的分段线性形式捕捉内存受限和计算受限阶段。该模型利用与FLOPs（浮点运算次数）和内存I/O流量成正比的特征，将批次延迟分解为可加的、每个请求的份额，并在微秒级尺度上高效运行以嵌入调度循环。
AI.result: 在A100/H100 GPU上对Llama 3.1-8B和Qwen 2.5-14B/32B进行了评估。相比基于Token计数的基线方法，LLMVisor实现了接近完美的R-squared值；在预填充（prefill）阶段，p90和p99相对误差分别降低2.5倍和3.3倍；在解码（decode）阶段，误差分别降低3.5倍和4.4倍，且能应对批处理变化和序列分歧。
AI.conclusion: LLMVisor提供了一种准确且轻量级的实时请求级归原原语，有效解决了多租户环境下LLM推理的资源隔离与控制问题，显著提升了延迟预测的精度。

title: Anatomically Consistent Cross-Contrast Super-Resolution of Anisotropic Brain T2w MRI
summary: T2-weighted (T2w) brain MRI provides fluid-sensitive soft-tissue contrast that is important for neuro-oncology and radiotherapy planning. However, T2w scans are acquired with anisotropic voxels and appear blurred or stair-stepped on coronal and sagittal views, which obscures small structures and weakens any downstream 3D analysis. We propose VIPP-SR (View-Independent Patched Projection Super-Resolution), a cross-contrast guided super-resolution framework that restores the inter-plane resolution of an existing anisotropic T2w volume without an isotropic ground-truth T2w. VIPP-SR first trains a view-independent patched generator (VIP-GAN) to learn local T1c-to-T2w anatomical correspondence from high-resolution axial slices. The trained generator is then applied to axial, coronal, and sagittal views of the T1c volume to generate three orthogonal T2w estimates. Shape-preserving patching and deepest-skip removal reduce view-specific shortcuts, thereby constraining the generator to learn patch-local representations and enabling the zero-shot inter-plane transfer. Central to VIPP-SR, a projection-based optimization then enforces anatomical consistency across the three view-specific volumes, fusing them by balancing inter-plane self-consistency against per-view data fidelity. The generator is trained on BraTS-MET and evaluated on both the held-out BraTS-MET testing set and the BraTS-GLI cohort without retraining, assessing the cross-cohort generalizability. The results validate that VIPP-SR improves downstream segmentation over the real anisotropic T2w baseline, raising mean-label Dice from 0.330 to 0.465 on BraTS-MET and, zero-shot, from 0.473 to 0.563 on BraTS-GLI and ablation studies identify inter-plane self-consistency as the main source of the gain.

AI.tldr: 提出VIPP-SR框架，通过T1c引导的超分辨率技术，无需各向同性真值即可恢复各向异性T2w MRI的平面间分辨率，显著提升下游分割性能。
AI.motivation: T2w脑部MRI在神经肿瘤学和放疗规划中至关重要，但其各向异性体素导致冠状面和矢状面图像模糊或呈阶梯状，阻碍了小结构的观察及后续3D分析。
AI.method: 提出VIPP-SR（视图独立补丁投影超分辨率）框架：1) 训练VIP-GAN学习高分辨率轴向切片中T1c到T2w的解剖对应关系；2) 将生成器应用于T1c体积的三个正交视图以生成T2w估计值，并通过形状保持补丁和最深跳跃连接移除减少视图特异性捷径；3) 基于投影的优化强制三个视图体积间的解剖一致性，融合时平衡平面间自一致性与单视图数据保真度。
AI.result: 在BraTS-MET测试集上，平均标签Dice系数从0.330提升至0.465；在零样本情况下，在BraTS-GLI队列上从0.473提升至0.563。消融研究表明平面间自一致性是性能提升的主要来源。
AI.conclusion: VIPP-SR能有效改善下游分割任务，且具有良好的跨队列泛化能力，证明了利用多视图一致性进行超分辨率重建的有效性。

title: Cultivar: A Contrastive and Locale-Oriented Translation Benchmark for Investigating Contamination and Localisation Robustness
summary: Multilingual translation benchmarks are typically sourced in English and translated into other languages, treating language pairs as the unit of evaluation---a design that is prone to contamination over time and overlooks locale and cultural considerations. We therefore advocate for source-contrastive evaluation and instantiate it with Cultivar, a localised subset of FLORES, which enables locale-specific translation evaluation. When paired with unlocalised counterparts, performance discrepancy allows the probing of data contamination and localisation robustness. We benchmark 32 open-weight models and find that MT-specialised models are less robust, a few models potentially overfit FLORES, and models tend to translate US content better than that of other locales, regardless of language.

AI.tldr: 提出Cultivar数据集，通过对比本地化与未本地化翻译评估，揭示多语言模型在文化适应性和数据污染方面的不足。
AI.motivation: 传统多语言翻译基准以英语为源语言且将语言对作为评估单元，易受时间污染并忽视地域和文化差异。
AI.method: 提出“源对比评估”方法，构建本地化子集Cultivar（基于FLORES），通过对比本地化与非本地化模型的绩效差异来探测数据污染和本地化鲁棒性，并对32个开源权重模型进行基准测试。
AI.result: 发现MT专用模型鲁棒性较差，部分模型可能存在对FLORES数据的过拟合现象，且无论目标语言为何，模型对美国内容的翻译表现普遍优于其他地区。
AI.conclusion: 现有的多语言翻译模型在地域和文化适应性上存在显著偏差，亟需更细致的本地化评估标准以检测数据污染和提升模型鲁棒性。

title: Agentic AI-powered flexible fiber-bundle endoscopy for high-resolution NIR-II fluorescence imaging in vivo
summary: Fiber-bundle endoscopy offers a compact and flexible route for clinical fluorescence imaging through natural human orifices, but since its first report in the 1950s, it has remained limited by low spatial resolution, honeycomb artifacts, and inter-core crosstalk. The crosstalk becomes more pronounced at near-infrared-II wavelengths (NIR-II, 1000-3000 nm), a spectral window that offers superior contrast, resolution, and tissue penetration depth for biomedical imaging. Here, we present an AI-powered flexible endoscopy platform that overcomes these constraints through optical-computational co-design: optimizing ultrathin fiber bundles to mitigate crosstalk-induced image blur and enable high-fidelity image transmission across the visible-to-NIR-II spectral range, and developing an Agent-Guided Mixture-of-Experts (GAME) pipeline for honeycomb-artifact removal and image restoration. GAME provides a single restoration entry point for diverse biomedical images acquired with our endoscope, spanning cell, mouse and human samples. It dynamically routes each input to suitable restoration experts via a vision-language model, facilitating image reconstruction with a fourfold resolution improvement beyond the NyquistShannon sampling limit. The utility of our endoscope is demonstrated through in vivo NIR-II imaging of anatomical structures in mice, as well as imaging of the digital micromirror device (DMD)-projected human gastric tube and lymphatic system, paving the way for future clinical translation.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于AI的柔性内窥镜平台，通过光学-计算协同设计解决光纤束内窥成像中的串扰和蜂窝伪影问题。该平台利用超细光纤束优化和GAME（Agent-Guided Mixture-of-Experts）图像恢复管道，实现了可见光至NIR-II波段的高保真成像，分辨率超越奈奎斯特-香农极限四倍，并在小鼠活体及人体组织样本中验证了其临床转化潜力。
AI.motivation: 光纤束内窥镜虽具有紧凑灵活的优势，但长期受限于低空间分辨率、蜂窝伪影和核间串扰。特别是在近红外二区（NIR-II, 1000-3000 nm），虽然该波段在生物医学成像中具有更高的对比度、分辨率和组织穿透深度，但串扰效应更为显著，严重阻碍了其在高性能成像中的应用。
AI.method: 采用光学-计算协同设计策略：1. 优化超薄光纤束以减轻串扰引起的图像模糊，实现可见光至NIR-II波段的高保真图像传输；2. 开发Agent-Guided Mixture-of-Experts (GAME) 管道用于去除蜂窝伪影和图像恢复。GAME利用视觉语言模型动态将输入图像路由至合适的恢复专家，为不同生物医学样本提供统一的恢复入口。
AI.result: 成功实现了跨越细胞、小鼠和人类样本的多尺度高分辨率成像。图像重建分辨率超越了奈奎斯特-香农采样极限的四倍。在活体小鼠中成功进行了NIR-II解剖结构成像，并实现了对数字微镜器件（DMD）投影的人体胃管和淋巴系统的清晰成像。
AI.conclusion: 该AI驱动的柔性内窥镜平台有效克服了传统光纤束内窥镜的技术瓶颈，显著提升了NIR-II波段的成像质量与分辨率，为未来临床转化提供了有力的技术支撑和应用前景。

title: Structured Phonological Representations for Audio-Articulatory rtMRI Speech Classification
summary: Real-time MRI makes it possible to observe vocal-tract articulation during speech, but mapping these articulatory patterns to phonetic and phonological categories remains challenging. We investigate whether PhonoQ, an audio-based model trained to recognize structured phonological features, provides useful information for audio--articulatory modeling. Specifically, we extract representations from PhonoQ's Conformer module, whose training is shaped by supervision for manner, place, voicing, and vowel features. Using articulatory contours with synchronized audio-derived features, we compare WavLM-large and HuBERT-large baselines with models that incorporate PhonoQ-derived representations. Across unseen-speech and unseen-subject settings, these features improve macro-F1 for phonological targets including manner, place, voicing, vowel height, and vowel backness, and also improve fine-grained 39-phoneme classification. In a contour-only inference setting, audio-derived teacher supervision yields modest but consistent gains over contour-only training, indicating that phonological information from synchronized audio can be partially transferred to articulatory models. Finally, posterior analyses show interpretable surface-sensitive patterns consistent with flapping-like /t/ realizations, /t/-/r/ retraction or affrication, and nasal place assimilation.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了将基于音频的PhonoQ模型提取的语音学特征整合到实时MRI发音建模中，发现这些特征能显著提升音位分类准确率，并揭示了与发音生理相关的可解释模式。
AI.motivation: 实时MRI虽能观察言语时的声道构音过程，但将这些构音模式映射到音系类别仍具挑战性；旨在验证音频驱动的音系模型（PhonoQ）能否为音频-构音建模提供有用信息。
AI.method: 从PhonoQ的Conformer模块提取表征（该模块受发音方式、部位、清浊及元音特征的监督训练），将其与同步的音频衍生特征结合，对比WavLM-large和HuBERT-large基线，在未见语音和未见受试者设置下评估模型性能。
AI.result: 引入PhonoQ衍生特征后，在多种音系目标（如方式、部位、清浊、元音高度和后缩）上的宏观F1分数提升，39个音素的细粒度分类精度也提高；在仅使用构音轮廓推理时，音频教师监督带来了稳定增益；后验分析显示出符合发音生理的可解释模式（如/t/闪音化、/t/-/r/缩回或塞擦化、鼻音同化）。
AI.conclusion: 同步音频中的音系信息可以部分迁移至构音模型，PhonoQ提供的特征有助于改进音频-构音映射任务，并为理解发音生理提供了可解释的视角。

title: CAP: A Scalable Benchmark for Evaluating Cross-Site Browser Agents with Complex Actions and Perception
summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents that interact with the web through browsers. While recent progress has been driven by benchmarks that evaluate end-to-end task success, these evaluations largely overlook two fundamental sources of difficulty in real web browsing: complex actions over rich user interfaces and visual perception of dynamically rendered content, especially in workflows that span multiple websites. We introduce CAP, a scalable benchmark for evaluating browser agents on cross-site, human-like web tasks that require non-trivial UI interactions and visual understanding. Specifically, we adopt a decomposition-and-recomposition pipeline that first abstracts each website into a structured site card capturing user-facing functions, complex execution operations, and perceptual requirements, and then recomposes these components into realistic cross-site workflows. Each task is therefore grounded in multiple specific operations on each website, enabling fine-grained diagnosis. Built on this framework, we construct 420 tasks across 108 real-world websites and 24 domains under careful quality control. Experiments on state-of-the-art browser agents using our verifiable agent-as-a-judge evaluation framework show low success rates and reveal that perception-heavy interactions remain a major bottleneck, exposing substantial gaps between current agents and real-world web browsing demands.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CAP基准，旨在评估浏览器代理在跨网站、需复杂UI交互和视觉理解的真实网页任务中的表现，揭示了当前模型在感知密集型交互方面的重大瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有的浏览器代理评估基准主要关注端到端任务成功率，忽视了真实网页浏览中两个核心难点：丰富用户界面上的复杂操作以及对动态渲染内容的视觉感知，特别是在涉及多个网站的流程中。
AI.method: 采用“分解-重组”流水线：首先将每个网站抽象为包含用户功能、复杂执行操作和感知需求的结构化“站点卡片”，然后将其重组为真实的跨网站工作流。基于此构建了涵盖108个真实网站、24个领域的420个任务，并使用可验证的“代理即裁判”框架进行评估。
AI.result: 在最新状态的浏览器代理上进行的实验显示，整体成功率较低。分析表明，依赖感知的交互仍然是主要瓶颈，暴露出当前代理能力与现实世界网页浏览需求之间存在显著差距。
AI.conclusion: CAP基准通过细粒度的诊断框架，有效揭示了当前大型语言模型作为自主代理在跨网站复杂任务和视觉理解方面的不足，为未来提升浏览器代理的实用性提供了关键评估标准。

title: Learning Deep Modality-Shared Self-Expressiveness for Image Clustering with Textual Information
summary: Leveraging textual information for image clustering has emerged as a promising direction, largely owing to the powerful representations learned by Vision-Language Models (VLMs). Existing approaches typically retrieve a textual counterpart for each image and then refine multimodal representations by directly enforcing cross-modal agreement, e.g., maximizing image-text similarity inherited from pretrained VLMs. However, such a strategy aligns heterogeneous representations across modalities without explicitly modeling the intrinsic structure within each modality and thus might yield unreliable alignment or distort modality-specific structures that are crucial for clustering. In this paper, we propose a simple but principled approach, termed deep modality-shared self-expressive model (DeepMORSE), which discovers cross-modal structures via a modality-shared self-expressive model and simultaneously learns structured representations that conform to a union of modality-specific subspaces. Moreover, we theoretically justify that the modality-shared self-expressive coefficients suppress inter-class noise towards a subspace-preserving solution, and show that mini-batch optimization procedure introduces an implicit regularization onto the self-expressive model. We evaluate our DeepMORSE on six widely used image clustering benchmarks and observe performance improvements exceeding 3% on the UCF-101, DTD-47, and ImageNet-Dogs datasets. In addition, we demonstrate the strong transferability of the learned representations by achieving state-of-the-art performance on downstream tasks such as image retrieval and zero-shot classification---without requiring any task-specific losses or post-processing. The code is available at: https://github.com/mengxianghan123/DeepMORSE.

AI.tldr: 提出DeepMORSE方法，通过模态共享的自表达模型发现跨模态结构并学习符合模态特定子空间并集的结构化表示，解决现有VLM图像聚类中跨模态对齐不可靠及扭曲模态特定结构的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有利用视觉-语言模型(VLMs)进行图像聚类的做法通常直接强制跨模态一致性，忽略了各模态内部的内在结构，可能导致不可靠的对齐或破坏对聚类至关重要的模态特定结构。
AI.method: 提出深度模态共享自表达模型(DeepMORSE)，利用模态共享的自表达模型发现跨模态结构，同时学习符合模态特定子空间并集的结构化表示；理论证明该系数能抑制类间噪声以保留子空间特性，且小批量优化引入了隐式正则化。
AI.result: 在六个广泛使用的图像聚类基准上评估，UCF-101、DTD-47和ImageNet-Dogs数据集性能提升超过3%；在图像检索和零样本分类等下游任务中实现最先进(SOTA)性能，且无需特定任务损失或后处理。
AI.conclusion: DeepMORSE通过显式建模模态内结构和跨模态一致性，有效提升了图像聚类性能及表征的迁移能力，证明了模态共享自表达模型在多模态学习中的有效性。

title: PragMatch: Separating Pragmatic Incongruity from Cross-Modal Mismatch in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have demonstrated strong performance on multimodal benchmarks, yet it remains unclear whether they genuinely reason about relationships between images and text or rely on superficial correlations, known as shortcut learning. This question is particularly important for multimodal sarcasm detection, where successful prediction depends on recognizing pragmatic incongruity rather than treating sarcasm as simple image-text mismatch. We introduce PragMatch, a controlled benchmark of 3,000 image-text pairs derived from MMSD2.0, including original sarcastic examples and constructed literal and hard-negative pairs. We identify influential shortcut cues through systematic masking and evaluate their impact through targeted injection experiments. Our results show that LVLM predictions are sensitive to lexical, OCR-derived and stylistic cues, with injected surface signals causing substantial changes in model predictions despite unchanged underlying image-text relationships. Our findings reveal limitations in current LVLMs while PragMatch provides a systematic testbed for evaluating multimodal pragmatic reasoning beyond surface-level image-text alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建PragMatch基准测试，揭示了大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）在多模态讽刺检测中依赖表面线索而非真正理解语用关系的局限性。
AI.motivation: 尽管LVLMs在多模态基准上表现优异，但其是否具备真正的图像-文本关系推理能力尚不明确，特别是在需要识别语用不一致性的讽刺检测任务中，模型可能仅依赖浅层的相关性（捷径学习）。
AI.method: 从MMSD2.0衍生出包含3,00个图像-文本对的受控基准PragMatch，包括原始讽刺样本及构造的字面义和难负样本；通过系统性掩码识别有影响力的捷径线索，并通过定向注入实验评估其对预测的影响。
AI.result: LVLM的预测对词汇、OCR衍生及风格线索敏感，即使底层图像-文本关系未变，注入的表面信号也会导致模型预测发生显著变化。
AI.conclusion: 当前LVLMs在超越表层图像-文本对齐的多模态语用推理方面存在局限，PragMatch为评估此类推理能力提供了系统化的测试平台。

title: Estimating Uncertainty in Galaxy Morphology Classification
summary: Astronomers classify galaxy morphology to investigate cosmic evolution. While deep foundation models are increasingly utilized in Galaxy Morphology Classification (GMC), little work has been done on evaluating the uncertainty of GMC results. Uncertainty evaluation is important because astronomical data are inherently noisy due to instrumental and environmental limitations. Also, the continuous evolution of galaxies creates intrinsic morphological ambiguity. However, current foundation models operate as deterministic point estimators, failing to quantify the uncertainty. To overcome this limitation, we propose UEGMC, a post-hoc framework of Uncertainty Estimation for Galaxy Morphology Classification. It categorizes uncertainty in GMC into distinct types by model parameters, astronomical data, reference standards, or intrinsic physical ambiguities, thereby facilitating better classification. Our framework can directly predict uncertainties from representations extracted from the frozen backbones of foundation models, without computationally expensive sampling, therefore enabling fine-grained uncertainty evaluations. Our experimental results demonstrate that UEGMC provides competitive uncertainty quantification performance compared with previous methods.

AI.tldr: 提出UEGMC框架，用于星系形态分类（GMC）的事后不确定性估计。该框架无需昂贵采样，直接从预训练模型特征中提取不确定性，有效应对天文数据噪声及星系演化带来的形态模糊问题，性能优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 尽管深度基础模型广泛应用于星系形态分类，但缺乏对结果不确定性的评估。由于仪器和环境限制导致的数据噪声，以及星系连续演化造成的内在形态歧义，确定性点估计模型无法量化不确定性，限制了其在天文学研究中的可靠性。
AI.method: 提出UEGMC（Galaxy Morphology Classification Uncertainty Estimation），这是一种事后不确定性估计框架。它将GMC中的不确定性根据模型参数、天文数据、参考标准或内在物理歧义进行分类。该方法利用冻结的基础模型骨干网络提取的特征，直接预测不确定性，避免了计算昂贵的采样过程。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，UEGMC在不确定性量化方面具有竞争力，其性能与之前的方法相当或更优，能够提供更细粒度的不确定性评估。
AI.conclusion: UEGMC通过高效的事后不确定性估计机制，解决了基础模型在星系形态分类中无法量化不确定性的问题，为处理含噪天文数据和形态歧义提供了可靠工具。

title: FreCast: Refining Radar Echo Intensity via Phase-Preserving Amplitude Residual Diffusion for Precipitation Nowcasting
summary: Precipitation nowcasting predicts the spatiotemporal evolution of future radar echoes from historical radar echo sequences, thereby estimating the occurrence, development, and movement of precipitation over the near term. In recent years, deep learning has become an important approach to precipitation nowcasting. Although state-of-the-art models can generally capture the overall spatial distribution of future precipitation, their predictions still exhibit substantial biases in radar echo intensity at individual locations. This observation motivates a more targeted strategy for reducing forecast errors. Instead of regenerating an entire radar echo sequence without spatial constraints, the predicted precipitation structure can be used to guide the refinement of echo intensities at individual locations. This structure-guided refinement directly targets echo intensity biases. Accordingly, we propose FreCast, a two-stage framework for radar echo prediction. The first stage generates an initial forecast of future radar echoes. The second stage uses the spatial structure of the initial forecast as a constraint to further correct intensity biases at individual locations in the first-stage prediction. Experiments on three datasets demonstrate that FreCast achieves consistent improvements across forecast skill metrics. Qualitative results further show that FreCast better preserves rainband continuity and intense precipitation structures at longer lead times.

AI.tldr: 提出FreCast，一种两阶段雷达回波预报框架。第一阶段生成初始预报；第二阶段利用初始预报的空间结构作为约束，修正单点强度的偏差，从而减少预测误差并保留降水结构连续性。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习模型虽能捕捉整体空间分布，但在单个位置的雷达回波强度预测上存在显著偏差。旨在通过针对性策略减少预报误差，而非无约束地重新生成整个序列。
AI.method: 提出FreCast两阶段框架：1）生成未来雷达回波的初始预报；2）以初始预报的空间结构为约束，对第一阶段的预测结果进行逐点强度偏差校正。
AI.result: 在三个数据集上的实验表明，FreCast在各项预报技巧指标上均取得一致改进。定性结果显示，在更长预报时效下，该方法更好地保持了雨带连续性和强降水结构。
AI.conclusion: 基于结构引导的细化策略能有效降低雷达回波强度预测偏差，提升短临降水预报的整体性能和结构保持能力。

title: KGCaRe: Explainable Complex Conditional Question Answering using Automatic Knowledge Graph Construction and Context Retrieval with LLMs
summary:
Answering complex conditional questions using Large Language Models (LLMs) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) remains a challenge, particularly in domain-specific contexts where general-purpose LLMs and RAG tend to underperform. We hypothesize that augmenting RAG with unstructured and structured knowledge, extracted from both documents and knowledge graphs (KGs), can improve reasoning and answer accuracy for such tasks.
  To test this, we propose KGCaRe, a hybrid approach that combines neural retrieval with symbolic reasoning over LLM-generated KGs. KGCaRe constructs a KG from documents using a multi-prompt extraction strategy and stores it in a graph database. Simultaneously, the documents are embedded into a vector store to enable neural retrieval. KGCaRe performs innovative iterative graph traversal guided by the LLM to extract relevant triples, prune irrelevant information, and uses additional clue entities to traverse the graph again if the initial traversal does not provide satisfactory context to generate the answer. The relevant triples extracted from the KG in path form, along with semantically retrieved text passages, are then fed into custom KGCaRe prompts to generate answers to the complex conditional questions with explanations.
  We evaluate KGCaRe on two complex conditional QA datasets. Our results on these datasets show that KGCaRe consistently outperforms existing baselines, including Vanilla LLM, Code Prompt, Text Prompt, Think-on-Graph, Vanilla RAG, and HybridContextQA, across multiple LLMs such as Mistral, Mixtral, GPT-3.5, and GPT-4o. We publicly release the software pipeline that we developed to implement the proposed KGCaRe approach.

AI.tldr: 提出KGCaRe，一种结合神经检索与符号推理的混合方法，通过从文档构建知识图谱并进行迭代图遍历，显著提升大型语言模型在领域特定复杂条件问答任务中的准确率。
AI.motivation: 通用大语言模型（LLM）和检索增强生成（RAG）在领域特定的复杂条件问答任务中表现不佳，难以处理需要深层推理的场景。
AI.method: 提出KGCaRe框架：1) 使用多提示提取策略从文档构建知识图谱（KG）并存入图数据库；2) 将文档嵌入向量存储以支持神经检索；3) 利用LLM引导进行迭代图遍历，提取相关三元组、剪枝无关信息，并在必要时利用线索实体重新遍历；4) 将结构化三元组路径与非结构化文本段落结合，输入自定义提示生成带解释的答案。
AI.result: 在两个复杂条件问答数据集上，KGCaRe在Mistral、Mixtral、GPT-3.5和GPT-4o等多个LLM上均显著优于Vanilla LLM、Vanilla RAG、HybridContextQA等基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 结合非结构化文本与结构化知识图谱的混合检索与推理机制能有效解决领域内复杂条件问答难题，且该方法已开源实现。

title: Forgotten History or Test-of-Time? Retrospect and Prospect on RAG from an IR Perspective
summary:
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is widely regarded as a novel paradigm born from the limitations of large language models (LLMs)--a mechanism to ground their outputs in external knowledge. This view, however, is incomplete when considered within a broader historical context. In this paper, we argue that the core ideas underlying RAG are not new: foundational concepts such as integrating retrieval and language generation, knowledge augmentation, answer verification, and iterative query (or prompt) refinement had already been studied and instantiated in information retrieval (IR) and question answering (QA) research dating back to the early 2000s, well before the emergence of LLMs.
  We make this case by systematically tracing the intellectual lineage of modern RAG and Agentic RAG back to their classical IR and QA antecedents, and examining why this continuity has gone under-recognized -- a consequence of community fragmentation, shifting terminology, and the recency bias endemic to fast-moving fields. Rather than treating LLMs as the origin point of retrieval-augmented intelligence, we propose viewing them as a new interface layer atop a decades-old QA architecture. This reframing is not merely historical: by situating RAG within the longer trajectory of IR research, we surface underutilized prior work -- on user modeling, answer validation, and query refinement -- that can directly inform next-generation RAG design, reducing unintentional rediscovery and fostering genuine cross-community integration.

AI.tldr: 本文反驳了RAG是LLM时代全新范式的观点，指出其核心思想源于2000年代初的信息检索（IR）和问答（QA）研究。通过追溯历史渊源，作者主张将LLM视为传统QA架构的新接口，并建议利用过往在用户建模、答案验证等方面的成熟技术来优化现代RAG设计，避免重复发明轮子。
AI.motivation: 纠正当前社区对RAG起源的片面认知（即认为其完全诞生于LLM的局限性），揭示因社区割裂、术语变迁和近期偏见导致的知识断层，旨在促进跨领域的真正整合并利用被忽视的先验工作。
AI.method: 系统梳理现代RAG及Agentic RAG与经典IR和QA研究的智识谱系联系；分析为何这种连续性未被广泛认可；提出将LLM重构为长期存在的QA架构之上的新接口层的理论框架。
AI.result: 证明了检索增强生成的核心概念（如集成检索与生成、知识增强、答案验证、迭代查询细化）早在LLM出现前就已存在；指出了现有RAG设计中可借鉴的未充分利用的先前工作领域（用户建模、答案验证、查询细化）。
AI.conclusion: 不应将LLM视为检索增强智能的起点，而应将其置于更长的IR研究轨迹中理解。这种重新定位有助于减少无意的重复发现，并通过整合经典IR/QA的研究成果来指导下一代RAG的设计与发展。
