The first stage uses automatic speech recognition (ASR) transcriptions as explicit semantic anchors to temporally align, compress, and fuse audio tokens, significantly reducing the initial KV cache while elevating token information density. To further improve the compression ratio, the second stage employs a dynamic filtering strategy based on temporally decayed accumulated attention to evict non-essential tokens while mitigating early-token bias. Comprehensive evaluations on Qwen3-Omni across six diverse audio benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of our approach. VoxZip excels in long-audio reasoning and consistently maintains high-fidelity perception on short-form tasks. Notably, it sustains over 90\% of the uncompressed baseline performance even under an aggressive 20x KV cache compression in long-context scenarios. Furthermore, at a 4x compression ratio, VoxZip yields a 1.9x increase in inference throughput alongside a 3.3x reduction in peak memory overhead. Code and models will be available at https://github.com/MM-Speech/VoxZip.

AI.tldr: 提出VoxZip，一种无需训练的、基于语义锚点的两阶段KV缓存压缩框架，通过ASR转录本对齐和动态注意力过滤，在保持长音频推理性能的同时显著降低内存占用并提升推理速度。
AI.motivation: 解决语音大语言模型在处理长上下文时面临的KV缓存内存需求过高问题，克服现有文本中心压缩方法破坏语音连续性或丢弃关键语义线索的缺陷。
AI.method: 1. 第一阶段：利用自动语音识别（ASR）转录作为显式语义锚点，对音频token进行时间对齐、压缩和融合，减少初始KV缓存并提高信息密度；2. 第二阶段：采用基于时间衰减累积注意力的动态过滤策略，剔除非必要token，缓解早期token偏差，进一步提升压缩率。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-Omni模型的六个音频基准测试中表现优越。在长语境场景下，即使压缩比高达20x，仍能保持未压缩基线90%以上的性能；在4x压缩比下，推理吞吐量提升1.9倍，峰值内存开销降低3.3倍。
AI.conclusion: VoxZip有效解决了语音大模型长上下文推理的内存瓶颈，实现了高保真感知与高效推理的平衡，为长音频处理提供了高效的KV缓存压缩方案。

title: RobustDefect-LLM: Explainable and Robustness-Aware Industrial Surface Defect Classification with Decision Support and AI-Assisted Reporting
comment: 27 pages, 11 figures, 16 tables, preprint manuscript, the source code is publicly available
summary: This paper presents RobustDefect-LLM, an industrial surface-defect inspection framework integrating deep-learning classification, operator-facing visual evidence, confidence-aware decision support, controlled AI-assisted reporting, traceable storage, and mobile interaction in a unified quality-control workflow. Here, robustness-aware denotes explicit evaluation under controlled image degradation and confidence-aware review routing, not an intrinsic robustness guarantee. Four transfer-learning-based convolutional neural networks, ResNet50, EfficientNet-B0, DenseNet121, and MobileNetV3-Large, were evaluated on 1,799 images from the six-class NEU-DET dataset using fixed training, validation, and held-out in-domain test partitions. MobileNetV3-Large achieved the highest numerical test accuracy (99.26%) and macro F1-score (0.9926), with a bootstrap 95% accuracy CI of 0.9815-1.0000. An exact paired McNemar test found no significant difference from DenseNet121 (p = 1.000). The selected model averaged 0.060 s per CPU forward pass (16.66 FPS). Under combined synthetic degradation, accuracy fell to 87.78% at mild intensity and below 40% at stronger intensities, revealing sensitivity to severe image-quality deterioration. Grad-CAM supplied visual evidence, while predictions with confidence below 0.90 or a top-2 margin below 0.10 were routed to HUMAN REVIEW. This conservative policy provided 12.22% automatic coverage and 100% observed selective accuracy among 33 eligible cases (95% CI: 89.43%-100.00%), while routing both observed classification errors to review. Under nominal controlled conditions, all 100 generated reports passed deterministic consistency checks, with a mean latency of 1.66 s. Results support the feasibility of the integrated workflow while emphasizing the need for calibration, repeated evaluation, and real-world industrial validation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RobustDefect-LLM工业表面缺陷检测框架，集成深度学习分类、可视化证据及人工审核路由。在NEU-DET数据集上，MobileNetV3-Large表现最佳（准确率99.26%），但模型对图像严重退化敏感。系统通过置信度阈值将低确信度预测路由至人工审核，实现了100%的选中案例准确率，验证了集成工作流的可行性，同时强调了实际工业环境验证的必要性。
AI.motivation: 构建一个统一的工业质量控制工作流，整合深度学习的自动检测能力与人类专家的监督机制，以解决单一自动化系统在复杂工业场景下可能存在的鲁棒性不足和可信度问题。
AI.method:
1. 框架设计：集成CNN分类、Grad-CAM可视化、基于置信度的决策支持（低于0.90或top-2差距小于0.10时路由至人工）、AI辅助报告生成及移动交互。
2. 模型评估：使用ResNet50, EfficientNet-B0, DenseNet121, MobileNetV3-Large四种迁移学习CNN，在NEU-DET数据集（1,799张图像）上进行测试。
3. 鲁棒性测试：通过受控的合成图像退化来评估模型性能下降情况。
4. 统计验证：使用McNemar检验比较模型差异，计算Bootstrap置信区间，并执行确定性一致性检查。
AI.result:
1. 性能指标：MobileNetV3-Large取得最高测试准确率（99.26%）和Macro F1-score（0.9926），与DenseNet121无显著差异（p=1.000）。推理速度为0.060秒/次（16.66 FPS）。
2. 鲁棒性局限：在轻度合成退化下准确率降至87.78%，重度退化下低于40%，显示对图像质量恶化敏感。
3. 人机协作效果：保守的人工审核策略实现了12.22%的自动覆盖率，且在33个被路由案例中实现100%观察准确率，成功拦截所有观测到的分类错误。
4. 报告生成：在受控条件下，100%生成的报告通过一致性检查，平均延迟1.66秒。
AI.conclusion: 该集成工作流在技术上可行，能有效结合自动化效率与人工审核的准确性。然而，模型对图像质量退化较为敏感，且当前结果主要基于受控条件。未来需进行校准、重复评估以及在真实工业环境中的验证，以提升系统的实际应用鲁棒性。

title: FailForge: Distilling Procedural Competence from Persistent Failures into Code Agents
summary: Rejection sampling fine-tuning (RFT) is widely used to train code agents by generating trajectories on verifiable software engineering tasks, retaining those that pass the tests, and fine-tuning on the successful rollouts. However, even strong code agents repeatedly fail on a substantial fraction of such tasks, and standard RFT simply discards these failures. The discarded samples are precisely the hardest and most informative ones, drawn from verifiable instances that are costly to curate. Stronger base models may reduce the number of failures, but the remaining hard cases still define the frontier for further improvement. We propose FailForge, an agentic framework that converts failed rollouts into training signal. For each failed instance, an agent diagnoses the failure from error feedback and execution traces, distills the diagnosis into a concise and actionable skill, and injects the skill into the agent context for a guided second attempt. Trajectories that succeed under skill guidance are folded back into the RFT corpus. Crucially, the skill is removed at training time, so the model internalizes the recovered behavior rather than relying on external hints at inference. FailForge recovers over 26% of previously failed instances at marginal additional cost, and training Qwen3.5-4B on the augmented corpus improves the SWE-bench Verified resolve rate by 6.6 points over a strong RFT baseline, with gains concentrated on the hardest problems.

AI.tldr: 提出FailForge框架，将拒绝采样微调（RFT）中被丢弃的失败轨迹转化为训练信号。通过智能体诊断错误并提炼技能指导重试，成功轨迹加入训练集且移除外部提示以强化模型内化能力，显著提升了代码智能体在难题上的表现。
AI.motivation: 标准RFT方法直接丢弃了未能通过测试的失败轨迹，而这些样本恰恰是最难且最具信息量的。尽管使用更强基座模型可减少失败，但剩余困难案例仍是进一步改进的关键瓶颈，且这些来自可验证任务的样本收集成本高昂，不应被浪费。
AI.method: 提出FailForge框架：1) 针对每个失败实例，智能体利用错误反馈和执行轨迹诊断失败原因；2) 将诊断结果提炼为简洁、可操作的“技能”；3) 将该技能注入智能体上下文进行引导性第二次尝试；4) 若二次尝试成功，则将轨迹回收到RFT语料库中进行微调。关键在于训练时移除该技能，迫使模型内化恢复的行为而非依赖推理时的外部提示。
AI.result: FailForge以边际额外成本恢复了超过26%先前失败的实例。在Qwen3.5-4B模型上，基于增强语料库的训练使SWE-bench Verified解决率相比强RFT基线提升了6.6分，且性能增益主要集中在最困难的问题上。
AI.conclusion: FailForge有效利用了被传统RFT忽略的失败数据，通过技能蒸馏和引导重试机制挖掘高价值样本，显著提升了代码智能体在复杂软件工程任务上的鲁棒性和解决能力，证明了从失败中学习的重要性。

title: Goal-oriented Navigation Instruction Generation with Tour Video Priors
summary: Navigation Instruction Generation (NIG) aims to produce step-by-step natural language instructions for navigation guidance. Existing studies primarily treat NIG as an auxiliary task for vision-andlanguage navigation (VLN), focusing on data augmentation or multi-task learning. However, generating navigation instructions from compact environmental priors requires meticulous spatial reasoning, especially when the target route does not simply follow the demonstrated tour, and remains challenging for current multimodal models. In this work, we introduce VideoNIG, a goal-oriented video-grounded NIG task that generates navigation instructions from ego-centric tour videos, an initial observation, and a textual or visual goal, without relying on intermediate representations such as graphs and maps. We instantiate VideoNIG in a controlled simulator benchmark with 60K tour videos across continuous indoor environments and 37K multimodal prompts with progressive difficulty levels. We further introduce a diagnostic evaluation protocol that combines text similarity, choice-based spatial consistency tests, and downstream navigation execution. To address this task, we propose a two-stage Curriculum Learning framework that decomposes the learning into foundational motion perception and long-horizon navigation reasoning. Specifically, we first employ Action Warmup for spatial action-view alignment, followed by Complexity Progression using trajectories with increasing exploratory difficulty. Extensive experiments show that existing MLLMs struggle with VideoNIG, while our approach significantly improves instruction quality across complementary diagnostic metrics. Finally, integrating VideoNIG-generated instructions with a VLN agent demonstrates the executability of this task formulation for end-to-end navigation.

AI.tldr: 提出VideoNIG任务，利用第一人称视频和视觉/文本目标生成导航指令，无需中间地图表示。通过两阶段课程学习框架提升大模型性能，并在模拟器基准上验证了其有效性及端到端导航的执行能力。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要将导航指令生成（NIG）作为视觉-语言导航（VLN）的辅助任务。然而，从紧凑的环境先验中生成指令需要精细的空间推理，特别是当目标路线不遵循演示路径时，当前多模态模型在此方面仍面临挑战。
AI.method:
1. 定义VideoNIG任务：基于第一人称游览视频、初始观察和目标（文本或视觉）生成指令，摒弃图或地图等中间表示。
2. 构建基准：在连续室内环境的控制模拟器中建立包含60K游览视频和37K多模态提示（具渐进难度）的基准。
3. 诊断评估协议：结合文本相似度、基于选择的空间一致性测试和下游导航执行进行综合评估。
4. 两阶段课程学习框架：第一阶段采用“动作预热”实现空间动作-视角对齐；第二阶段通过“复杂度推进”利用探索难度增加的轨迹进行长程导航推理训练。
AI.result: 实验表明，现有的多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在VideoNIG任务上表现困难，而提出的方法在互补的诊断指标上显著提高了指令质量。
AI.conclusion: VideoNIG生成的指令与VLN智能体集成后，证明了该任务 formulation 在端到端导航中的可执行性。

title: SDDBMs: Soft Denoising Diffusion Bridge Models
summary: Diffusion bridge models leverage Doob's \(h\)-transform to construct stochastic transports between arbitrary endpoint distributions, and have shown strong potential in image-to-image translation and restoration. However, most existing bridge models rely on hard endpoint conditioning, which forces the terminal state to match a prescribed target exactly. This hard constraint induces terminal-boundary singularities: the terminal law collapses to a Dirac measure, and the resulting drift coefficients become ill-conditioned near the endpoint. In this paper, we propose Soft Denoising Diffusion Bridge Models (SDDBMs), a generalized framework that regularizes diffusion bridges directly at the level of their terminal constraints. Instead of imposing an exact endpoint, SDDBMs prescribe a non-degenerate Gaussian terminal marginal under the transformed path measure, with a flexible terminal center and variance. Starting from this prescribed marginal, we develop a complete closed-form construction of the soft bridge, including the Gaussian terminal reweighting and soft \(h\)-function, the induced Gaussian forward marginals and \(\mathbf{x}_0\)-free dynamics. Theoretically, SDDBMs provide a unified probabilistic perspective that encompasses existing diffusion bridge models, including DDBMs, GOUB, and UniDB, as special cases under specific parameter choices. Extensive experiments on image restoration tasks demonstrate that SDDBMs achieve improved numerical stability and superior generation quality over existing bridge-based methods.

AI.tldr: 提出软去噪扩散桥模型（SDDBMs），通过正则化终端约束解决硬边界奇异问题，实现更稳定的图像修复和生成。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散桥模型依赖硬性端点条件，导致终端边界奇异性（漂移系数病态），影响数值稳定性和生成质量。
AI.method: 提出SDDBMs框架，在变换路径测度下规定非退化高斯终端边缘分布（具有灵活的均值和方差），推导闭合形式的软桥构造、高斯终端重加权及无x0动力学。
AI.result: 理论上涵盖DDBMs、GOUB等现有模型为特例；实验表明在图像修复任务中，SDDBMs具有更好的数值稳定性和优于现有方法的生成质量。
AI.conclusion: SDDBMs通过软化终端约束有效解决了扩散桥模型的奇异性问题，提升了性能并提供了统一的概率视角。

title: Population-Scalable Multi-Agent World Modeling
comment: Technical report. Project page: https://rhos.ai/research/khora. Online demo: https://ophilus.ai/khora
summary: World models have recently achieved impressive progress in visual prediction and interactive generation, but extending them to multi-agent environments introduces a fundamental scalability challenge. Existing methods generally assume a fixed number of agents during training and inference, which ties the model to a pre-determined agent population and limits inference-time scalability. Our key insight is that cross-view consistency should arise from a shared world state whose evolution does not assume a predefined number of agents, while agent-specific observations should be generated by querying this state through a unified rendering interface. Based on this insight, we propose Khora, a scalable multi-agent world model that supports inference-time expansion to arbitrary numbers of agents without retraining. Our framework decouples world-state evolution from visual rendering and introduces a population-agnostic rendering mechanism for incorporating other agent information. This design maintains cross-view consistency through the shared world state rather than through dense interactions among observation streams inside the expensive video generator, enabling approximately linear practical scaling with the number of queried views. Qualitative experiments demonstrate that our approach generalizes to unseen numbers of agents while maintaining visual quality and multi-agent consistency. We further implement a real-time interactive system to demonstrate scalable open-world simulation.

AI.tldr: 提出Khora模型，通过解耦世界状态演化与视觉渲染，实现多智能体环境下的无限扩展推理，无需重训练即可支持任意数量的智能体。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型在多智能体环境中面临可扩展性挑战，通常假设训练和推理时智能体数量固定，限制了推理时的扩展能力。
AI.method: 提出Khora框架，基于共享世界状态演化而非预设智能体数量，引入与人口无关的渲染机制，通过统一渲染接口查询状态以生成特定智能体的观察结果，保持跨视图一致性。
AI.result: 该方法实现了近似线性的实际扩展性，能够在未见过的智能体数量下保持视觉质量和多智能体一致性，并展示了实时交互式可扩展开放世界模拟系统。
AI.conclusion: Khora成功解决了多智能体世界模型的可扩展性问题，证明了通过共享状态和独立渲染机制可以有效支持动态数量的智能体交互与生成。

title: Unaccountable Delegation, Fading Skills: Mapping the Risks of Workplace AI Agents
summary: To anticipate socio-technical risks from AI agents, organizations need taxonomies to classify them. However, existing AI risk taxonomies focus on broad risks and do not capture job-specific risks introduced by agents. To address this gap, we make three main contributions. First, we developed a multi-layer framework from a literature review of AI agents. The framework models three core components and their interactions: agents, goals, and environment. Second, we embedded this framework in a structured prompt and applied it to descriptions of 2,078 job tasks from the O*NET database, producing 8,356 risk scenarios labeled by severity and deployment mode (automation or augmentation). We validated these scenarios with 45 workers across 10 job roles and an independent LLM judge, confirming their plausibility and alignment with job tasks. Finally, we extended an existing taxonomy to create a 15-category taxonomy of workplace AI agent risks that covers all our risk scenarios. Our analysis highlights four findings. First, augmentation is not inherently safe because overreliance on agents can gradually erode workers' skills and oversight. Second, Erroneous Agent Actions accounts for the largest share of risk scenarios and has the highest concentration of severe risks. Many arise at the human-agent boundary. Third, automation is associated mainly with organizational risks, while augmentation is associated mainly with risks to workers. Fourth, workers found our taxonomy easier to use for a risk classification task than two other taxonomies and preferred it in 64% of non-tied comparisons with a recent generative AI risk taxonomy. These findings show that workplace AI agent risks do not arise from agents alone; they also depend on how people work with agents and how agents are deployed. Safer workplaces require not only safer agents but also carefully designed human-AI agent collaboration.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对现有AI风险分类法忽略具体工作场景风险的不足，构建了一个基于“智能体-目标-环境”交互的多层框架。通过分析2078项工作任务，生成了8356个风险场景，并扩展出包含15类的职场AI智能体风险分类法。研究发现：增强型应用并非绝对安全（存在技能退化风险）；“错误智能体行为”是主要且严重的风险源；自动化主要引发组织风险，而增强主要影响工人个体。该分类法在易用性和偏好度上优于其他现有分类法，强调需通过精心设计的人机协作来提升职场安全性。
AI.motivation: 现有的AI风险分类法主要关注广泛的风险类别，未能捕捉由AI智能体引入的特定于工作岗位的风险。组织需要更精细的分类体系来预测和管理这些社会技术风险。
AI.method:
1. 文献综述：开发了一个包含智能体、目标和环境三个核心组件及其交互的多层框架。
2. 数据生成与验证：将该框架嵌入结构化提示词，应用于O*NET数据库中的2,078项工作任务描述，生成8,356个风险场景（标注了严重程度和部署模式：自动化或增强）。通过与45名跨10种职业角色的工人及独立LLM裁判进行验证，确认了场景的合理性与匹配度。
3. 分类法构建：基于上述分析，将现有分类法扩展为涵盖所有风险场景的15类职场AI智能体风险分类法。
AI.result:
1. 增强了安全性误区：增强型应用（Augmentation）并非天生安全，过度依赖会导致工人技能和监督能力逐渐丧失。
2. 风险分布特征：“错误智能体行为”占据最大比例的风险场景，且严重风险集中度高，许多发生在人机边界处。
3. 部署模式差异：自动化主要关联组织层面的风险，而增强主要关联对工人个体的风险。
4. 用户反馈：工人在风险分类任务中发现该新分类法比另外两种分类法更易用，并在64%的非平局比较中优于近期的生成式AI风险分类法。
AI.conclusion: 职场AI智能体风险不仅源于智能体本身，还取决于人与智能体的协作方式以及部署策略。实现更安全的职场不仅需要更安全的智能体，还需要精心设计的人机协作机制。

title: REVEAL: A Rubric-Guided Agent for Explicit Evidence Sufficiency Verificationin Long-Video Question Answering
summary: Recently, retrieval-augmented and memory-augmented methods have emerged as two promising paradigms for long-video question answering. However, existing methods typically rely on rigid, fixed-length temporal chunking (e.g., 10s) and static offline memory banks, which not only fragment coherent continuous events but also fail to adapt during real-time reasoning. Moreover, whether using multi-scale summaries or multimodal knowledge graphs, current approaches prioritize retrieval relevance while overlooking evidence sufficiency, often stopping to answer once only semantically relevant clues are retrieved, even when key temporal, causal, or fine-grained action evidence is still missing. To tackle these challenges, we propose REVEAL, a rubric-guided agent framework. As a foundation, we introduce an adaptive visual-similarity-based preprocessing pipeline that groups visually coherent adjacent frames into natural event units to construct an offline-online video memory---capturing global video context offline while dynamically maintaining question-conditioned memory online. Built upon this structured memory, REVEAL uses an automatically constructed rubric library to explicitly verify whether retrieved evidence satisfies sufficiency criteria, pinpoints missing clues upon verification failure, and directs targeted re-retrieval for complementary information. Without any extra training, REVEAL consistently outperforms both closed-source and open-source state-of-the-art methods across extensive experiments. These results show that explicitly verifying evidence sufficiency, rather than stopping at semantic relevance, retrieves the decisive clues that prior methods miss and yields more reliable long-video reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出REVEAL框架，通过自适应视觉预处理构建离线-在线视频记忆，并利用自动生成的评分库显式验证检索证据的充分性，从而解决长视频问答中事件碎片化和证据缺失问题，无需额外训练即超越现有SOTA方法。
AI.motivation: 现有长视频问答方法依赖固定的时间分块和静态内存，导致连贯事件被割裂且无法适应实时推理；同时，当前方法过于关注检索的相关性而忽视证据的充分性，常在关键的时间、因果或细粒度动作证据缺失时过早停止回答。
AI.method: 提出REVEAL（基于评分规则的代理框架）：1. 引入基于自适应视觉相似度的预处理管道，将视觉上连贯的相邻帧分组为自然事件单元，构建捕获全局上下文的离线记忆和动态维护问题条件记忆的在线记忆；2. 利用自动构建的评分库库显式验证检索证据是否满足充分性标准，在验证失败时定位缺失线索并指导针对性重新检索以获取互补信息。
AI.result: 在不进行任何额外训练的情况下，REVEAL在大量实验中一致优于闭源和开源的最先进（SOTA）方法。
AI.conclusion: 显式验证证据充分性而非仅停留在语义相关性上，能够检索到先前方法遗漏的决定性线索，从而产生更可靠的长视频推理结果。

title: ForestBench: A Unified Graph Framework for Evaluating Multi-Agent Collaboration
summary: Multi-agent systems (MAS) built on Large Language Models (LLMs) are proliferating rapidly, but their heterogeneous execution traces provide no common basis for evaluation across methods. Outcome-only benchmarks discard collaborations, whereas LLM-as-Judge evaluation requires additional, model-dependent inference and can vary with the LLM and rubric. We introduce a generalizable evaluation framework that maps native MAS traces into a shared space of unified collaboration graphs, enabling different methods to be evaluated under the same representation, reference set, and metric panel. Candidate graphs are compared with a query-specific reference forest. Each forest is a benchmark-provided collection of verified-success graphs: it records diverse ways in which representative MAS methods can complete the task, rather than prescribing a unique optimal process. Instantiating the framework as ForestBench, we filter $844$ collaboration-necessary queries from seven public datasets, precompute ten successful target-conditioned reference graphs per query, and evaluate six representative MAS frameworks. Controlled backbone, reference-construction, and perturbation studies test the stability and scope of evaluation. Once the benchmark forests are built, ForestBench scores a trace in milliseconds without further LLM inference, providing a reusable structural basis for comparing diverse MAS collaboration traces.

AI.tldr: 提出ForestBench框架，将多智能体系统（MAS）的异构执行轨迹映射为统一的协作图，通过预计算的参考森林进行毫秒级评估，无需额外LLM推理，解决了现有评估方法缺乏统一基准的问题。
AI.motivation: 当前基于大语言模型的多智能体系统（MAS）发展迅速，但缺乏统一的评估标准：仅关注结果的基准测试忽略了协作过程，而“LLM-as-Judge”方法依赖特定模型和规则，导致评估结果不稳定且不可比。
AI.method: 构建一个通用评估框架，将原生MAS轨迹映射到统一的协作图空间；针对每个查询预计算由验证成功的协作图组成的“参考森林”，通过对比候选图与参考森林来评估性能；实例化为ForestBench，从7个公开数据集中筛选844个必需协作的查询，为每个查询预计算10个目标条件参考图，并对6种代表性MAS框架进行评估。
AI.result: 成功构建了包含844个查询和预计算参考图的基准；在控制骨干网络、参考构建和扰动实验中验证了评估的稳定性和适用范围；实现了对不同MAS方法的毫秒级评分，无需后续LLM推理。
AI.conclusion: ForestBench提供了一个可重用、高效的结构性基础，使不同的多智能体协作轨迹能够在相同的表示、参考集和指标面板下进行公平比较，克服了现有评估方法的局限性。

title: VADER: Adaptive Debiasing for Hallucination Mitigation in Video Large Language Models
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have demonstrated strong performance in open-ended video understanding, yet they remain prone to fluent responses unsupported by video evidence. Existing training-free methods typically apply a globally fixed visual intervention or construct a contrastive branch through input perturbation. The former cannot accommodate video-dependent fusion paths, while the latter can be compensated by cross-frame redundancy. We therefore propose Video-Adaptive Debiasing via Evidence Reweighting (VADER), a training-free framework with two complementary modules. Visual Focus Reallocation (VFR) automatically instantiates an intervention policy for each video-question input: it diagnoses layer-wise visual-to-text evidence flow, determines where to intervene, and derives how strongly to reallocate pre-softmax attention from system-token to video-token blocks. Selective Evidence Erasure (SEE) independently masks high-importance visual tokens in every frame, constructing a prior-biased branch that is difficult to compensate through neighboring frames. Contrastive decoding then down-weights predictions that remain confident after selective evidence erasure. Across multiple VideoLLMs, VADER yields substantial improvements on event-level grounding and temporal consistency; on LLaVA-Video-7B, it reaches 72.60% accuracy on EventHallusion.

AI.tldr: 提出VADER框架，通过视觉焦点重分配和选择性证据擦除两种无训练模块，解决大视觉语言模型在视频理解中产生缺乏视频证据支持的回答的问题，显著提升事件级 grounding 和时序一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有无训练方法存在局限：全局固定视觉干预无法适应视频依赖的融合路径，而通过输入扰动构建对比分支的方法易被跨帧冗余补偿，导致模型仍可能生成流畅但无证据支持的错误回答。
AI.method: 提出视频自适应去偏证据重加权（VADER）框架，包含两个互补模块：1. 视觉焦点重分配（VFR）：诊断层间视觉到文本的证据流，动态确定干预位置及强度，将预softmax注意力从系统token重分配至视频token；2. 选择性证据擦除（SEE）：独立掩码每帧中高重要性视觉token，构建难以通过邻帧补偿的先验偏差分支，并通过对比解码降低那些在擦除后仍自信的预测权重。
AI.result: 在多个VideoLLMs上验证，VADER显著提升了事件级 grounding 和时序一致性；在LLaVA-Video-7B模型上，EventHallusion准确率提升至72.60%。
AI.conclusion: VADER作为一种无训练框架，能有效纠正大视觉语言模型在视频理解中的幻觉问题，提供更可靠、基于证据的视频问答能力。

title: Walking through Discussions: A Mobile Visual Analytics System for In-Situ Group Discussion Analysis
summary: Group discussion-based teaching is widely used to foster collaborative learning, yet teachers in physical classrooms often struggle to simultaneously monitor multiple groups and quickly diagnose a target group before intervening. Existing visual analytics tools primarily support post-hoc analysis on desktop, providing limited support for in-situ walk-around teaching. To address this gap, we present MobileGroupVis, a mobile visual analytics system for in-situ analysis of classroom group discussions. MobileGroupVis integrates multi-group monitoring, single-group diagnosis, and instructional intervention into a concise analytical workflow tailored for small-screen touch interaction. The system is powered by a lightweight streaming analysis pipeline that converts group audio into structured discussion data and further extracts interaction patterns, topic progression, and topic deviation through a dialogue analysis module. To enable both glanceable overview and traceable diagnosis, we design six coordinated views, including a compact glyph that visually encodes word count, interaction intensity, and topic deviation for efficient cross-group comparison and anomaly localization, along with detailed views for opinion evolution, interaction dynamics, topic coverage, and dialogue records. We evaluate MobileGroupVis through two case studies and expert interviews. The results provide preliminary evidence that MobileGroupVis supports teachers in understanding discussion processes, identifying groups in need of attention, and facilitating in-class intervention.

AI.tldr: 提出MobileGroupVis，一款面向课堂小组讨论的移动端可视化分析系统，支持教师实时监测多组、诊断单组并快速干预。
AI.motivation: 传统实体课堂中，教师难以同时监控多个小组并迅速诊断目标小组以进行干预；现有可视化工具主要支持桌面端的事后分析，缺乏对现场走动式教学（in-situ walk-around teaching）的支持。
AI.method: 构建基于轻量级流式分析管道的MobileGroupVis系统：1. 通过对话分析模块将小组音频转化为结构化数据，提取互动模式、话题进展及话题偏离度；2. 设计六个协同视图，包括编码词频、互动强度和话题偏离度的紧凑字形（glyph），以及展示意见演变、互动动态、话题覆盖和对话记录的详细视图；3. 针对小屏幕触控交互优化工作流程。
AI.result: 通过两个案例研究和专家访谈进行评估，初步证据表明该系统能支持教师理解讨论过程、识别需要关注的小组，并促进课堂内的即时干预。
AI.conclusion: MobileGroupVis有效填补了现有工具在现场教学支持方面的空白，为教师提供了从概览到可追溯诊断的一体化移动端分析解决方案。

title: VLZip: Unified Visual and Textual Compression for Interleaved Long-Context Modeling
summary: Vision Language Models (VLMs) face significant challenges with ultra-long, interleaved image-text sequences due to the quadratic complexity of self-attention. Current solutions either resort to aggressive token pruning, risking irreversible information loss, or adopt efficient but less precise architectures, while largely ignoring the equally vital textual component. We introduce VLZip, a framework that unifies visual and textual compression for high-fidelity reasoning within a pure Transformer. At its core, VLZip hierarchically distills visual and textual segments into compact, layer-specific "soft prefixes" and injects them into each decoder layer's hidden states, drastically shortening the attention sequence while preserving fine-grained global context. To address deficient evaluations in the field, we also introduce LongVLBench, a new benchmark derived from video narratives that demands holistic, narrative-level reasoning. Extensive experiments show VLZip achieves leading performance on long-context multimodal reasoning, enabling training up to 120K tokens, a 6x increase over the baseline, and inference beyond 280K tokens with significantly reduced memory, while demonstrating the memory scalability to handle up to 2M tokens. By excelling at extreme context lengths where existing methods collapse, VLZip establishes an efficient and powerful new standard for long-context multimodal AI. Code is available at https://github.com/ShareLab-SII/VLZip.

AI.tldr: VLZip通过分层蒸馏视觉和文本片段为“软前缀”，实现高效压缩与长上下文推理，支持高达2M token的处理能力。
AI.motivation: 解决VLMs在处理超长交错图文序列时因自注意力机制二次复杂度带来的挑战，避免激进剪枝导致的信息丢失或现有架构精度不足的问题。
AI.method: 提出VLZip框架，在纯Transformer中统一压缩视觉和文本，将段落层次化蒸馏为层特定的“软前缀”并注入解码器隐藏状态；同时发布LongVLBench基准测试。
AI.result: VLZip在长上下文多模态推理上表现领先，训练可达120K token（基线6倍），推理超280K token，显存显著降低，具备处理2M token的扩展性。
AI.conclusion: VLZip在极端上下文长度下优于现有方法，确立了高效、强大的长上下文多模态AI新标准。

title: Business Arena: Benchmarking LLM Agents in a Realistic Marketplace
summary: Running a business is a challenging form of intelligent work. Operators must infer opportunities from partial signals, commit capital under uncertainty, adapt to delayed outcomes in a changing market, and satisfy regulatory obligations before trading legally. Frontier LLM agents can increasingly complete complex workflows, yet business-related capabilities are rarely evaluated in existing agent benchmarks. We introduce \textbf{Business Arena}, a controlled environment where an AI agent runs a cross-border shop, buying from suppliers and selling to buyers over a long horizon. We ground the arena in real Alibaba.com sourcing data and market conditions calibrated from authoritative sources. Delayed and coupled consequences make individual business decisions difficult to judge, but their combined outcome is measurable through profit. Because profit alone cannot explain why an agent succeeds or fails, we compare agents with human-designed strategies to estimate available opportunity, use skill-level metrics to reveal underlying strengths and weaknesses, and trace realized gains and losses to the actions that produced them. We use mechanism ablations to establish that strong results reflect genuine business intelligence rather than neglect or simulator-specific shortcuts. We evaluate 15 frontier models and find a ninefold difference in mean final net worth. Even the best model falls behind human-designed strategies, indicating that business operation remains challenging for LLM agents. Skill-level analysis reveals operating styles, from margin-focused premium sellers to high-turnover wholesalers and customer-service specialists, while action-level attribution identifies the sourcing, pricing, and recovery decisions that create or destroy value. Together, Business Arena takes a first step toward a realistic and trustworthy testbed for evaluating end-to-end business agents.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Business Arena，一个基于真实阿里巴巴国际站数据构建的AI代理跨境电商模拟环境。通过评估15个前沿大模型，发现其盈利能力存在9倍差异，且最佳模型仍落后于人类策略，揭示了当前LLM在复杂商业决策中的局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体基准测试极少评估与业务相关的能力，而现实商业运营涉及从部分信号中推断机会、在不确定性下投资及适应市场变化等复杂挑战，亟需一个逼真的测试环境来评估前沿LLM智能体的端到端商业智能。
AI.method: 构建了Grounded于真实Alibaba.com采购数据和权威市场条件的Business Arena环境；通过对比人类设计策略估算机会空间，利用技能级指标分析强弱项，并通过行动级归因追踪盈亏来源；采用机制消融实验验证结果源于真正的商业智能而非模拟器捷径。
AI.result: 评估了15个前沿模型，发现最终净资产均值存在9倍差异；最佳模型表现仍不及人类设计策略；技能分析识别出不同的运营风格（如利润导向型、高周转批发型等），行动归因明确了影响价值的关键采购、定价和恢复决策。
AI.conclusion: Business Arena作为一个真实且可信的测试平台，为评估端到端商业智能体迈出了第一步，证实了当前LLM智能体在复杂商业运营方面仍面临巨大挑战。

title: Agentic Visual Reasoning in Whole-Slide Pathology Images via Active Perception
summary: Whole-slide visual reasoning requires identifying sparse diagnostic evidence in gigapixel pathology slides and integrating observations across spatial scales. Existing WSI methods either compress densely sampled patches into global representations or use pretrained vision-language models with heuristic region selection, weakening links between predictions and morphology or lacking pathology-trained observation policies. We present AdaptivePath, an active-perception framework that formulates WSI evidence acquisition as sequential decision making. The Navigator learns question-agnostic abnormality-driven navigation from pathologist-reviewed labels to select observation locations and spatial extents, avoiding costly question-specific trajectory annotations. We train this policy through alternating representation learning and proximal policy optimization, followed by fine-tuning with geometric and appearance consistency objectives to stabilize focus trajectories. During inference, the Navigator hierarchically acquires sparse observations from low to high magnification under a limited ROI budget. A Morphology Interpreter converts observations into question-conditioned evidence, while the Deliberator evaluates evidence and revises intermediate answers across magnifications. The Arbiter integrates deliberation history to produce final answers. AdaptivePath achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot performance on WSI and region pathology VQA benchmarks and reaches 80.14% accuracy for cancer subtype classification across six TCGA cohorts. In a blinded diagnostic-utility study, pathologists using AdaptivePath-selected observation sequences achieve 82.9% accuracy. These results demonstrate that learned active perception enables effective and traceable visual reasoning over gigapixel pathology slides.

AI.tldr: 提出AdaptivePath，一种基于主动感知的全切片图像（WSI）视觉推理框架。通过Navigator进行稀疏证据的序列获取，结合Morphology Interpreter和Deliberator进行多尺度证据整合与答案修正，在WSI VQA和癌症亚型分类任务上达到SOTA性能，并经病理学家验证具有诊断效用。
AI.motivation: 现有WSI方法存在局限：密集压缩丢失细节或依赖启发式区域选择导致预测与形态学联系减弱，且缺乏经过病理训练的观察策略。需要一种能高效识别稀疏诊断证据并跨空间尺度整合观察的方法。
AI.method:
1. **框架**：AdaptivePath，将证据获取建模为序列决策问题。
2. **Navigator**：基于病理医生标注标签学习异常驱动的导航策略，选择观测位置和范围；通过交替表示学习和近端策略优化（PPO）训练，并用几何和外观一致性目标微调以稳定轨迹。
3. **推理过程**：在有限ROI预算下，从低倍到高倍镜层级获取稀疏观测。
4. **组件协同**：Morphology Interpreter将观测转化为条件化证据；Deliberator评估证据并跨倍率修正中间答案；Arbiter整合历史生成最终答案。
AI.result:
1. 在WSI和区域病理VQA基准测试中实现零样本性能SOTA。
2. 在六个TCGA队列的癌症亚型分类中准确率达到80.14%。
3. 盲法诊断效用研究显示，使用AdaptivePath选定观测序列的病理学家准确率达82.9%。
AI.conclusion: 学习的主动感知机制能够实现对吉字节级病理切片的有效、可追溯的视觉推理，证明了该方法在计算病理诊断中的潜力和价值。

title: MedCalc-R1: Knowledge-Guided Reward Framework for Medical Mathematical Reasoning
summary: In Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) frameworks for mathematical reasoning tasks, floating-point results are typically evaluated using a tolerance-based reward. However, this strategy suffers from challenges such as difficulty in threshold calibration, unstable training dynamics, and limited accuracy, especially in clinical scenarios. To address these limitations, we propose a knowledge-guided hybrid reward framework (\textsc{MedCalc-R1}). Specifically, we introduce a knowledge verification reward mechanism that enforces explicit generation of computational formulas, which are further validated by an external verifier to enhance interpretability and reasoning reliability. Furthermore, we design a hybrid soft-hard reward scheme combining a hard constraint based on clinical safety thresholds with a soft, precision-sensitive reward that progressively guides learning within the acceptable range. Experimental results demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms existing baselines in both reasoning accuracy and generalization capability, validating the effectiveness and applicability in safety-critical domains.

AI.tldr: 提出MedCalc-R1框架，通过知识验证奖励和软硬结合的混合奖励机制，解决临床场景中浮点结果评估的阈值校准难、训练不稳定及精度低问题，显著提升推理准确性和泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有基于容差的浮点结果评估策略在临床场景中面临阈值校准困难、训练动态不稳定以及精度有限等挑战。
AI.method: 提出知识引导的混合奖励框架（MedCalc-R1）：引入知识验证奖励机制，强制生成由外部验证器验证的计算公式以增强可解释性；设计结合临床安全阈值硬约束与精度敏感软奖励的混合奖励方案，逐步引导学习过程。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在推理准确性和泛化能力方面显著优于现有基线模型。
AI.conclusion: 该框架有效解决了临床安全关键领域中的评估难题，证明了其在提升模型可靠性和适用性方面的有效性。

title: JSGS: JPEG State-Guided Supervision for 3D Gaussian Splatting from Mixed-Quality Views
summary: Standard 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) assumes that every input image faithfully samples scene radiance. However, mixed-quality JPEG images violate this assumption because compression-induced blocking and ringing artifacts can corrupt updates to Gaussians shared across views. To address this problem, we propose JPEG State-Guided Supervision for 3D Gaussian Splatting from Mixed-Quality Views (JSGS). JSGS uses luminance and chrominance quantization tables stored in each JPEG file to construct a view-specific JPEG observation operator. This operator encodes and decodes each rendered view for domain-matched comparison with the corresponding decoded input image. The luminance quantization table supplies continuous weights within a fixed middle frequency band. A loss in the low frequency band anchors coarse structure, while the weighted middle frequency loss redistributes supervision among the selected DCT coordinates. The resulting block disagreement also guides the Gaussian Controller to regularize small primitives with high opacity in disagreement regions. Across seven scenes and three mixed-quality schedules, JSGS achieves the lowest mean LPIPS and the highest mean SSIM under every schedule while rendering at approximately 150 FPS. Code: https://github.com/Jayden-Cui/JSGS.

AI.tldr: 提出JSGS方法，利用JPEG量化表构建观测算子，解决混合质量JPEG图像对3D高斯泼溅重建的干扰，显著提升重建质量与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 标准3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）假设输入图像忠实采样场景辐射度，但混合质量的JPEG图像因压缩导致的块效应和振铃伪影会破坏跨视图共享的高斯更新。
AI.method: 提出JPEG状态引导监督（JSGS）。利用JPEG文件中的亮度和色度量化表构建视图特定的JPEG观测算子，对渲染视图进行编解码以匹配输入图像。通过低频损失锚定粗结构，加权中频损失重新分配监督，并利用块不一致性指导高斯控制器正则化不匹配区域的高透明度小图元。
AI.result: 在七个场景和三种混合质量调度下，JSGS取得了最低的平均LPIPS和最高的平均SSIM指标，渲染速度约为150 FPS。
AI.conclusion: JSGS有效解决了混合质量JPEG图像对3DGS重建的负面影响，在保持高渲染速度的同时显著提升了重建精度和视觉质量。

title: UniMoMo: Expert Merging-Based MoE Acceleration for Large Recommendation Models
summary: Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) layers expand recommendation capacity through conditional computation, yet a trained checkpoint still stores and routes over its full expert bank. We study a deployment problem: convert that checkpoint to a smaller standard MoE under an explicit expert budget, without adding a compression-specific online module. To address this, we introduce UniMoMo, a post-training compression framework formulated as a constrained graph coarsening problem. Rather than relying on parameter distance, UniMoMo groups experts based on their functional similarity, using an unlabeled calibration set to measure how similarly experts respond to shared recommendation states. To prevent performance degradation, we introduce a layer-adaptive protection mechanism that restricts the merging of high-traffic experts based on their routing exposure. Across Amazon Beauty, KuaiRec, and TenRec with 2, 4, and 6 MoE blocks, the final four-expert checkpoints obtain source-relative five-run mean NDCG@10 ratios of 99.92%--102.30% and measured A100 speedups of 1.28$\times$--1.63$\times$. An aggressive two-expert, top-1 operating point obtains ratios of 98.36%--104.24% and speedups of 1.47$\times$--2.21$\times$. These endpoint results evaluate the complete conversion-and-adaptation workflow and show that a trained recommendation MoE can be exported at multiple serving budgets.

AI.tldr: UniMoMo是一种后训练压缩框架，通过图粗化方法将大型推荐MoE模型转换为符合专家预算的小型标准MoE模型，在保持性能的同时显著提升推理速度。
AI.motivation: 稀疏混合专家（MoE）层虽然通过条件计算扩展了推荐容量，但在部署时仍需存储和路由整个专家库。现有的挑战在于如何在有限的专家预算下，将训练好的检查点转换为更小的标准MoE，且无需添加特定的在线压缩模块。
AI.method: 提出UniMoMo框架，将其形式化为受约束的图粗化问题。该方法不依赖参数距离，而是利用未标记的校准数据集，基于专家对共享推荐状态的响应相似性进行功能分组。此外，引入层自适应保护机制，根据路由暴露程度限制高流量专家的合并，以防止性能下降。
AI.result: 在Amazon Beauty、KuaiRec和TenRec数据集上进行了评估。对于四专家检查点，NDCG@10比率为99.92%--102.30%，A100加速比为1.28x--1.63x；对于激进的两位专家配置，NDCG@10比率为98.36%--104.24%，加速比为1.47x--2.21x。
AI.conclusion: 训练好的推荐MoE模型可以根据不同的服务预算导出，UniMoMo证明了该转换与适应工作流的有效性，能够在大幅减少模型规模的同时维持甚至略微提升推荐性能，并带来显著的推理加速。

title: Degradation-Guided Underwater Image Restoration with Task-Oriented Latent Control
summary: Degradation information in underwater images plays a dual role: its spatial and spectral cues can guide adaptive restoration, while degradation-entangled features may be propagated without explicit regulation during decoding. Existing methods largely overlook this dual role, either underexploiting degradation cues or directly forwarding encoder features through skip connections. To address this issue, we propose PROTEUS, which couples degradation-guided feature adaptation with task?oriented latent control. PROTEUS tackles this problem from two complementary perspectives. At the feature level, the Guided Dynamic Feature Modulation Block exploits spatially varying degradation cues to adapt feature processing across network stages. At the representation level, the task-oriented latent controller learns a structured control code under discriminative regularisation and uses it for channel-wise modulation of skip features, without requiring the code to form a metrically cleaner embedding. Extensive experiments on five paired and four non-reference underwater benchmarks demonstrate that PROTEUS achieves highly competitive restoration performance, with a favourable balance between restoration quality and computational cost.

AI.tldr: 提出PROTEUS模型，通过耦合退化引导的特征适应与任务导向的潜在控制，解决水下图像复原中忽略退化信息双重作用的问题，在多个基准上实现高性能且低计算成本的复原效果。
AI.motivation: 现有方法往往忽视水下图像中退化信息的双重角色：既包含可指导自适应恢复的空间和光谱线索，又可能在解码过程中无监管地传播退化纠缠特征。现有方法要么未充分利用退化线索，要么直接通过跳跃连接转发编码器特征。
AI.method: 提出PROTEUS框架，从两个互补视角解决问题：1）特征层面：利用“引导动态特征调制模块”（Guided Dynamic Feature Modulation Block），利用空间变化的退化线索适应网络各阶段的特征处理；2）表示层面：设计“任务导向潜在控制器”，在判别性正则化下学习结构化控制码，用于跳跃特征的通道级调制，无需控制码形成度量更干净的嵌入。
AI.result: 在5个配对和4个非参考水下基准数据集上进行广泛实验，证明PROTEUS具有极具竞争力的复原性能，并在复原质量和计算成本之间取得了良好的平衡。
AI.conclusion: PROTEUS有效解决了退化信息利用不足或传播失控的问题，为水下图像复原提供了一种兼顾性能与效率的新范式。

title: A QUBO-Inspired Computational Framework for Airport Landside Bottleneck Diagnosis and Dynamic Dispatch Optimization
summary: Airport landside traffic centers connect terminal arrivals with taxis, ride-hailing vehicles, private cars, buses, metro services, parking facilities, and terminal-area roadways. Peak arrivals can create coupled congestion across passenger queues, vehicle queues, pickup berths, storage areas, and access roads. This study proposes a QUBO-inspired computational framework for bottleneck diagnosis and dynamic dispatch in this setting. Shanghai Pudong International Airport and Hangzhou Xiaoshan International Airport serve as case airports. A five-minute state model links passenger arrivals, vehicle supply, pickup berth service, vehicle storage, and road capacity. Bottleneck diagnosis uses service intensity, road demand saturation, bottleneck frequency, queue severity, shadow-price leverage, and a composite congestion severity index. Two dispatch schemes are tested under consistent demand inputs: finite-action model predictive control and quadratic-unconstrained-binary-optimization-inspired simulated annealing. In the strong-peak baseline scenario, the QUBO-inspired method reduces the final passenger queue from 3445 to 2477 passengers at Shanghai Pudong and from 2053 to 1482 passengers at Hangzhou Xiaoshan. Case results indicate different dominant bottlenecks. Shanghai Pudong is more affected by road saturation, whereas Hangzhou Xiaoshan is more affected by pickup berth service. Robustness tests under demand, supply, service, road-capacity, modal-share, and random-noise perturbations show retained queue-reduction benefits under the tested uncertainty levels.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种基于二次无约束二进制优化（QUBO）的计算框架，用于机场陆侧交通瓶颈诊断与动态调度。以上海浦东和杭州萧山机场为例，通过仿真证明该方法能有效降低高峰时段的乘客排队长度，并揭示了不同机场的主导瓶颈差异（浦东受道路饱和影响大，萧山受接机口服务能力影响大），且方案具有良好的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 解决机场陆侧交通中因到达高峰导致的乘客队列、车辆队列、接机泊位、存储区及接入道路等多环节耦合拥堵问题，实现更高效的瓶颈诊断与动态资源调度。
AI.method: 构建了一个5分钟状态模型，关联乘客到达、车辆供应、接机泊位服务、车辆存储及道路容量；采用服务强度、道路需求饱和度等指标进行瓶颈诊断；测试了两种调度方案：有限动作模型预测控制（MPC）和受QUBO启发的模拟退火算法。
AI.result: 在强峰值基准场景下，QUBO启发式方法在上海浦东机场将最终乘客队列从3445人降至2477人，在杭州萧山机场从2053人降至1482人。研究表明浦东机场主要瓶颈为道路饱和，而萧山机场主要为接机泊位服务能力不足。
AI.conclusion: 提出的QUBO启发式框架能有效缓解机场陆侧交通拥堵，显著减少乘客排队长度。该方案在面对需求、供应、服务、道路容量及随机噪声等多种扰动时表现出良好的鲁棒性，且能识别出不同机场的关键瓶颈以指导差异化治理。

title: FiRe: Fixed-Noise Refinement for Visual Counterfactual Explanations
comment: Accepted at the British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC) 2026
summary: Visual counterfactual explanations aim to change classifier decisions through realistic and localized edits while preserving decision-irrelevant content. Existing DDPM-based methods typically perform classifier-guided editing along a long reverse denoising trajectory. The changing noise levels make semantic editability and spatial control difficult to balance, and the editable state is noisy, whereas the target classifier is trained on clean images. As a result, these methods require either costly recursive denoising or low-quality one-step estimates to obtain classifier-facing clean images. We propose FiRe, a Fixed-noise Refinement framework for visual counterfactual explanations. Rather than following a reverse denoising trajectory, FiRe maps the input to a fixed noise level and iteratively refines the noisy state at that level. To provide clean images for classifier guidance, FiRe first adapts Pixel Mean Flow to visual counterfactual explanation, enabling direct clean-image prediction from noisy states. To make fixed-noise refinement produce minimal and localized counterfactual edits, FiRe introduces three FiRe-specific controls: a dynamic dual-mask strategy, adaptive guidance, and early stopping, which determine where edits accumulate, which changes become visible, and when refinement stops. Experiments on five tasks across three datasets show that, compared with the strongest recent baseline, FiRe achieves about 3$\times$ faster online inference and 8$\times$ fewer FLOPs while obtaining comparable or state-of-the-art counterfactual quality.

AI.tldr: 提出FiRe框架，通过固定噪声级别迭代优化而非长轨迹去噪，结合像素均值流预测干净图像及三种控制策略，实现高效、高质量的视觉反事实解释。
AI.motivation: 现有基于DDPM的方法在反向去噪轨迹中受噪声水平变化影响，难以平衡语义可编辑性与空间控制，且目标分类器需干净图像指导，导致需要昂贵的递归去噪或低质量单步估计。
AI.method: 提出FiRe（Fixed-noise Refinement）框架：1. 将输入映射至固定噪声级别并迭代细化；2. 适配Pixel Mean Flow直接从噪声状态预测干净图像以提供分类器指导；3. 引入动态双掩码策略、自适应引导和早停机制以实现最小化、局部化的反事实编辑。
AI.result: 在三个数据集的五个任务上，相比最强基线方法，FiRe在线推理速度提升约3倍，计算量（FLOPs）减少8倍，同时保持相当或最先进的反事实解释质量。
AI.conclusion: FiRe框架有效解决了传统DDPM方法在反事实解释中的效率与质量平衡问题，提供了更快速、低计算成本的解决方案。

title: UniSpace: Unified Visual Representation and Scalable Multimodal Modeling
summary: Semantic vision encoders have become a central visual interface for multimodal understanding and semantic conditioning in image generation. However, their final tokens discard fine-grained visual details, leading to poor pixel reconstruction and limiting their use in reconstruction-sensitive tasks such as image generation and editing. In this work, we ask whether understanding, generation, and editing can be modeled in a single visual representation space built from a pretrained semantic ViT. We show that the frozen Transformer blocks of a semantic ViT are not intrinsically unable to preserve visual details. Instead, the original patch parameterization drives the representation toward semantic abstraction, making fine-grained information difficult to recover from the final tokens. Based on this observation, we introduce \emph{Patch Reparameterization}, which preserves the original semantic pathway while adding a reconstruction-aware patch embedding that provides fine-grained visual information to the same frozen ViT blocks. The resulting unified representation preserves multimodal understanding while enabling high-fidelity image reconstruction and a favorable reconstruction--generation trade-off. We further scale this representation into \emph{UniSpace}, an 8B Mixture-of-Transformer-Experts model that performs understanding, generation, and editing in the same visual space without a separate VAE pathway. System-level evaluations demonstrate practical text-to-image generation and instruction-based image editing, showing that a reparameterized pretrained ViT can serve as a unified visual interface for scalable multimodal modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种通过“补丁重参数化”技术，将预训练语义ViT转化为统一视觉接口的方法（UniSpace），在保持多模态理解能力的同时，实现了高保真图像重建、生成和编辑，无需单独的VAE路径。
AI.motivation: 现有的语义视觉编码器在最终token中丢弃了细粒度视觉细节，导致像素重建质量差，限制了其在图像生成和编辑等对重建敏感任务中的应用；旨在探索是否能在单一视觉表示空间中同时建模理解、生成和编辑。
AI.method: 引入“补丁重参数化”（Patch Reparameterization）方法，在保留原始语义通路的同时，增加一个感知重建的补丁嵌入，为冻结的ViT块提供细粒度视觉信息；并在此基础上扩展为8B参数的混合专家模型（MoTE）UniSpace。
AI.result: UniSpace模型能够在同一视觉空间中执行理解、生成和编辑，系统级评估显示其具备实用的文本到图像生成能力和基于指令的图像编辑能力，实现了重建与生成的良好权衡。
AI.conclusion: 经过重参数化的预训练ViT可以作为可扩展的多模态建模的统一视觉接口，证明了冻结的Transformer块本身具备保留视觉细节的能力，关键在于表示形式的调整。

title: Smart Compaction: Predicting Compaction Utility from Lakehouse Table Metadata
summary: Open lakehouse table formats accumulate small data files over time, which degrades query performance. Deciding when compaction is worthwhile remains threshold-driven, but which metadata features actually determine compaction utility is not well understood. We present an open simulation framework that generates 2,376 Apache Iceberg tables spanning three orders of magnitude in file size, extracts 17 metadata features from manifest files without reading data, and trains XGBoost to predict the continuous file-reduction ratio (R2 = 0.998, RMSE= 0.013). The binary compaction decision turns out to be trivially separable by a single partition-level threshold max_files_per_partition> 4, requiring no learned model. Cross-schema validation on 96 TPC-H tables confirms generalisation without retraining (R2 = 0.976). A query benchmark reveals that compaction benefits metadata-heavy queries but can slow full-scan aggregations by reducing task parallelism. All code and data are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出一个开源模拟框架，通过提取17个元数据特征并训练XGBoost模型来预测Apache Iceberg表的压缩收益（R²=0.998）。研究发现二值化压缩决策实际上非常简单，仅需基于每个分区文件数超过4的单一阈值即可确定，无需复杂模型。跨模式验证证实了该结论的泛化能力，且基准测试显示压缩虽提升元数据密集型查询性能，但可能因降低任务并行度而减缓全扫描聚合查询。
AI.motivation: 开放湖仓表格式随时间积累小数据文件导致查询性能下降，但目前关于何时进行压缩（compaction） worthwhile 仍依赖阈值驱动，且哪些元数据特征真正决定压缩效用尚不明确。
AI.method: 构建开源模拟框架生成2,376个Apache Iceberg表，从清单文件中提取17个不读取数据的元数据特征；使用XGBoost回归模型预测连续的文件减少比率；并在96个TPC-H表上进行跨模式验证以确认泛化能力；最后通过查询基准测试评估压缩对不同类型查询的影响。
AI.result: XGBoost模型在预测文件减少比率上表现极佳（R²=0.998, RMSE=0.013）；然而，二值化的压缩决策被证明可以通过单一分区级阈值（max_files_per_partition > 4） trivially separable（极易分离），无需学习模型；跨Schema验证显示模型具有良好泛化性（R²=0.976）；基准测试表明压缩有利于元数据密集型查询，但可能因减少任务并行度而减慢全扫描聚合查询的速度。
AI.conclusion: 虽然机器学习模型能高精度预测压缩带来的文件减少比例，但实际的压缩决策逻辑极其简单，仅依赖于简单的文件数量阈值。研究强调了理解元数据特征的重要性，并揭示了压缩对不同查询类型的权衡影响。所有代码和数据已公开。

title: Semi-Dense Matching Uncertainty Is Not Just Local Confidence
summary: Reliable semi-dense matching is essential for modern geometric vision systems. Designed under a coarse-to-fine paradigm, it achieves an optimal balance between performance and computational cost. However, existing methods often struggle to provide well-quantified uncertainties, where catastrophic coarse-assignment failures are ignored, leading to truncated error distributions and severely misjudged geometric estimations. In this paper, we propose a lightweight, post-hoc overall uncertainty estimation framework that introduces a two-component calibrated Laplace mixture model with only 9 learnable parameters. The objective is to explicitly capture both the sharp local refinement noise and the broader tail of coarse-assignment failures. We introduce the Coarse-success posterior Refit (CoRe) method, a geometric refitting module that utilizes the posterior probability of coarse-assignment success as soft correspondence weights. Extensive experiments show that our method consistently improves downstream geometric accuracy across various pretrained-only matchers and robust estimators with minimal computational overhead. Our code is available at https://github.com/khoavpt/Probabilistic-matching.

AI.tldr: 提出一种轻量级、事后整体不确定性估计框架，通过双分量校准拉普拉斯混合模型和CoRe几何重拟合模块，解决现有半密集匹配方法中粗分配失败被忽略的问题，显著提升下游几何估计精度。
AI.motivation: 现有的半密集匹配方法虽然采用由粗到细范式平衡性能与计算成本，但往往缺乏量化的不确定性评估，导致粗分配灾难性失败被忽视，进而产生截断的错误分布和严重的几何估计误判。
AI.method: 1. 构建一个仅含9个可学习参数的轻量级双分量校准拉普拉斯混合模型，以显式捕捉局部细化噪声和粗分配失败的长尾分布；2. 引入粗成功后验重拟合（CoRe）模块，利用粗分配成功的后验概率作为软对应权重进行几何重拟合。
AI.result: 在多种预训练匹配器和鲁棒估计器上进行的广泛实验表明，该方法在几乎不增加计算开销的情况下，一致性地提高了下游几何估计的准确性。
AI.conclusion: 该不确定性估计框架能有效处理粗分配失败带来的误差，为现代几何视觉系统提供了更可靠且高效的匹配解决方案。

title: SkillReason: Reasoning-Enhanced Agent Skill Retrieval for Implicit User Requests
summary: Large language model agents increasingly rely on reusable skills to extend their capabilities beyond parametric knowl- edge. However, retrieving the appropriate skill from a large- scale library remains challenging because realistic user re- quests are often concise and underspecified, stating only the task goal while leaving the required capabilities and execu- tion steps implicit. Existing benchmarks provide limited cov- erage of such requests. To address this gap, we introduce SkillReason-Bench, a large-scale cross-domain benchmark containing 3,729 queries and a retrieval corpus of 61,228 skills spanning nine domains. We further propose SkillRea- son, a two-stage framework that uses chain-of-thought rea- soning as training-time supervision for skill retrieval. In Stage I, capability reasoning traces generated by a stronger teacher provide explicit supervision through contrastive learning, re- trieval distribution alignment, and language modeling, en- couraging the retriever to internalize capability reasoning in its query representation. In Stage II, a retrieval-guided GRPO objective encourages the model to explore reasoning trajecto- ries better suited to its own capabilities and more effective for retrieval. At inference, SkillReason directly encodes the orig- inal query without autoregressive CoT generation, preserv- ing efficient query-only retrieval. Extensive experiments on SkillReason-Bench, SkillRet, and SRA-Bench show that Skill- Reason achieves state-of-the-art performance across all three benchmarks, demonstrating that reasoning-enhanced training better bridges the semantic gap between high-level task goals and skill capabilities.

AI.tldr: 提出SkillReason-Bench基准和SkillReason框架，通过思维链推理监督解决大语言模型智能体在大规模技能库中检索技能的难题，实现SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有用户请求通常简洁且未明确说明所需能力和执行步骤，导致从大规模技能库中检索合适技能具有挑战性；现有基准对此类请求覆盖有限。
AI.method: 1. 构建SkillReason-Bench：包含3,729个查询和61,228个跨域技能的基准。2. 提出SkillReason两阶段框架：Stage I利用强教师生成的能力推理轨迹进行对比学习、分布对齐和语言建模以增强检索器；Stage II采用检索引导的GRPO目标优化推理路径。3. 推理时仅编码原始查询，避免自回归CoT生成以保持效率。
AI.result: 在SkillReason-Bench、SkillRet和SRA-Bench三个基准上均达到最先进水平（SOTA），证明推理增强的训练能有效弥合高层任务目标与技能能力之间的语义鸿沟。
AI.conclusion: 引入的大规模基准和两阶段推理增强框架显著提升了技能检索效果，为智能体扩展非参数化知识提供了有效解决方案。

title: CUPA-T2*: Covariance-Aware Uncertainty Propagation and Alignment for T2* Mapping in Accelerated MRI
comment: Accepted at the 2nd workshop on: Reconstruction and Imaging Motion Estimation (RIME) MICCAI. This is the submitted manuscript with added link to GitHub repo, funding acknowledgements, disclosure of interests, and authors' names and affiliations. No further post submission improvements or corrections were integrated
summary: Quantitative T2* maps have strong potential for biomarker discovery but are limited by long scan times, rendering them impractical in clinical settings. Significant acceleration can be achieved through undersampling in k-space combined with learning-based reconstruction. However, reconstruction artifacts and noise can propagate into downstream T2* fitting, degrading its accuracy. We introduce CUPA-T2*, a framework that explicitly propagates voxel-wise inter-echo uncertainty from stochastic Monte Carlo dropout reconstructions to downstream T2* fitting via covariance-aware sampling. T2* fitting is performed with a heteroscedastic MLP and a correlation-based regularizer that encourages alignment between predicted variance and reconstruction uncertainty. Experiments on accelerated brain MRI data show tissue-dependent behavior: CUPA-T2* achieves competitive overall T2* fitting performance and improves white-matter performance at higher accelerations. Compared with a heteroscedastic baseline, the proposed framework substantially increases alignment between reconstruction uncertainty and predicted T2* variance, while also revealing a trade-off with calibration (ECE) and selective prediction performance (AURC). CUPA-T2* enables reconstruction uncertainty-aware T2* fitting and delivers voxel-wise uncertainty maps to support the interpretation of quantitative T2* estimates.

AI.tldr: 提出CUPA-T2*框架，通过蒙特卡洛dropout重建传播体素级不确定性至T2*拟合，利用异方差MLP和相关性正则化提高高加速下白质拟合精度及不确定性校准。
AI.motivation: 定量T2*映射虽具生物标志物发现潜力，但扫描时间长限制临床应用；现有基于学习的加速重建方法中，重建伪影和噪声会传播至下游T2*拟合，降低其准确性。
AI.method: 引入CUPA-T2*框架，从随机蒙特卡洛dropout重建中显式传播体素级回声间不确定性至下游T2*拟合（通过协方差感知采样）；采用异方差多层感知机（MLP）进行T2*拟合，并加入基于相关性的正则化器以促使预测方差与重建不确定性对齐。
AI.result: 在加速脑MRI数据实验中，CUPA-T2*实现具有竞争力的整体T2*拟合性能，并在高加速条件下提升白质性能；相比异方差基线，显著增加了重建不确定性与预测T2*方差的对齐度，但在校准（ECE）和选择性预测性能（AURC）方面揭示了权衡关系。
AI.conclusion: CUPA-T2*实现了重建不确定性感知的T2*拟合，并提供体素级不确定性图，支持定量T2*估计的可解释性。

title: The Scaffolding Matters More Than the Interface: A Controlled Comparison of MCP and CLI Tool Use Across Seven Agent Scaffoldings, Five Language Models, and One Software Task
comment: 29 pages, 4 figures, 8 tables. Companion methodology paper: arXiv:2606.11869. Dataset and measurement harness (open source, GPL-3.0): https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21851992
summary:
How much an AI coding agent costs to run can depend more on the agent scaffolding that drives it than on the interface through which it
  reaches its tools. We set out to measure the cost of tool use over the Model Context Protocol (MCP) against tool use over an ordinary
  command-line interface (CLI), a difference on which published estimates disagree by more than an order of magnitude while resting on
  practitioner reports that cannot be reproduced. We ran one fixed software task -- six operations against a private online git repository --
  across seven agent scaffoldings and five language models, and we verified completion by inspecting the repository state rather than trusting
  the agent's self-report. The dominant effect was the scaffolding. Two of the seven ship no MCP support at all; they completed every run using
  only the CLI, which shows that MCP is unnecessary for this class of work, and they were 5.0x to 28x cheaper than the five scaffoldings that
  do support MCP, comparing CLI runs alone with no MCP server attached anywhere. The effect was largest for a small 27-billion-parameter model
  running locally, whose cost varied 139x across scaffoldings while it completed the task under all of them. The comparison we set out to make
  proved unstable: thirteen strictly paired MCP-to-CLI ratios span 0.43x to 29x, with outliers on both sides. The two interfaces separate on
  the cost of failure, where 12.9 per cent of the money spent on MCP runs bought no completed work against 2.2 per cent on CLI runs, but not on
  its frequency: failures were equally common in both, in the original runs and in their repetitions alike. Agents frequently ignored the
  interface they were assigned, so comparisons that do not verify actual behaviour measure an unknown mixture. The harness, the task, the
  verification and the complete dataset are released as open source.

AI.tldr: 研究证实AI编程代理的成本主要取决于底层架构而非接口。CLI比MCP便宜5-28倍，且在小模型上成本差异高达139倍。MCP并未提高效率，反而增加了失败成本，且代理常忽略指定接口。
AI.motivation: 解决业界关于通过Model Context Protocol (MCP)与命令行界面 (CLI) 进行工具使用的成本估算存在巨大分歧（相差一个数量级以上），且现有从业者报告无法复现的问题。
AI.method: 在7种代理架构和5种语言模型下，执行针对私有Git仓库的6项固定软件操作。通过检查仓库状态而非依赖代理自报来验证任务完成情况，并对比MCP与CLI的运行成本及成功率。
AI.result:
1. 架构是成本的主导因素：不支持MCP的架构仅使用CLI，成本比支持MCP的低5.0至28倍；小参数本地模型在不同架构间成本波动达139倍。
2. MCP-to-CLI成本比率极不稳定（0.43x至29x）。
3. MCP失败成本更高：12.9%的资金投入未产生成果，而CLI仅为2.2%，尽管两者失败频率相同。
4. 代理经常忽略分配的接口，导致基于非行为验证的比较失真。
AI.conclusion: 对于此类工作，MCP并非必要，且引入MCP显著增加了无效工作的资金浪费。研究强调必须验证实际行为而非信任自我报告，并已开源所有数据、工具和验证方法以确保可复现性。

title: OccAnyScene: Towards Unified Indoor-Outdoor 3D Occupancy Predictio
summary: 3D occupancy prediction is fundamental to scene understanding, yet existing 3D semantic occupancy methods are typically specialized to fixed scene types and occupancy protocols. We introduce Cross-Scene 3D Semantic Occupancy Prediction, a new task setting which requires a single model to handle heterogeneous indoor and outdoor scenes with varying cameras, spatial ranges, voxel specifications, and semantic taxonomies. This setting poses a fundamental challenge: achieving metric-consistent yet scene-adaptive image-to-3D lifting across varying camera configurations and scene scales. To address this challenge, we propose OccAnyScene, a pixel-frustum-centered Gaussian framework built upon a pretrained depth foundation model. Specifically, the framework employs Pixel-Aligned Frustum Feature Aggregation to construct a camera-aware frustum query for each feature pixel, and Frustum-Parameterized Gaussian Construction to decode each query into multiple Gaussians whose positions and sizes are constrained by the predicted pixel depth and corresponding frustum geometry. OccAnyScene sets new state-of-the-art results, achieving 59.92% mIoU on the indoor Occ-ScanNet and 23.06% mIoU on the outdoor SurroundOcc-nuScenes.

AI.tldr: 提出OccAnyScene框架，解决跨场景3D语义占据预测任务，通过像素视锥中心的高斯方法实现室内外异构场景的统一处理，在ScanNet和nuScenes数据集上取得SOTA结果。
AI.motivation: 现有3D语义占据方法通常局限于固定场景类型和协议，缺乏处理异构室内/外场景、不同相机配置及语义体系的能力。为解决这一局限，提出了跨场景3D语义占据预测新任务，旨在构建能自适应不同空间范围和尺度的一致性模型。
AI.method: 提出OccAnyScene，一种基于预训练深度基础模型的像素视锥中心高斯框架。核心包括：1) 像素对齐视锥特征聚合（PAFFA），为每个特征像素构建相机感知的视锥查询；2) 视锥参数化高斯构建（FPGC），根据预测像素深度和视锥几何约束，将查询解码为多个高斯分布，以确定位置和大小。
AI.result: 在室内Occ-ScanNet数据集上达到59.92% mIoU，在户外SurroundOcc-nuScenes数据集上达到23.06% mIoU，均创下新的最先进水平（SOTA）。
AI.conclusion: OccAnyScene成功实现了度量一致且场景自适应的图像到3D提升，证明了单一模型处理异构多场景占据预测的可行性与有效性。

title: Branch2Skill: Efficient Skill Evolution Through Reasoning Trees
summary: Skill evolution improves agent skills through feedback over time, with failed trajectories often providing informative signals by revealing incomplete or misleading behaviors. However, existing methods mainly rely on single trajectories, where early reasoning errors can propagate through subsequent steps and weaken the feedback available for skill refinement. Consequently, improving skills requires repeated cycles of rollout, diagnosis, and update, incurring substantial token costs. To address this challenge, we introduce Branch2Skill, an efficient framework that transforms a single reasoning tree into dense supervision for skill evolution. For each task or problem, Branch2Skill performs Monte Carlo tree search under a fixed budget to obtain diverse reasoning trajectories, then compares an elite path with sibling alternatives sharing the same prefixes to extract step-wise evidence about which reasoning patterns to retain, revise, or avoid. Finally, Branch2Skill distills multi-step evidence into reusable updates, allowing one reasoning tree to provide supervision across multiple reasoning steps and reducing the need for repeated rollout-update cycles. Across six benchmarks covering reasoning and agentic tasks, Branch2Skill consistently improves task performance while enhancing skill evolution efficiency. For example, with GPT 5.5 as the target model, Branch2Skill uses 73.2% fewer tokens than SkillOpt, while achieving superior performance. These results demonstrate that reasoning trees can support not only more effective trajectory search, but also richer supervision for more efficient skill improvement. Code will be published.

AI.tldr: 提出Branch2Skill框架，利用蒙特卡洛树搜索生成的推理树，通过对比精英路径与兄弟路径提取逐步证据，将单棵推理树转化为密集监督信号，从而在显著降低Token消耗的同时提升智能体的技能进化效率和任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有技能进化方法主要依赖单一轨迹，早期推理错误易传播并削弱反馈质量，导致需要反复进行 rollout（ rollout）、诊断和更新循环，产生高昂的Token成本。
AI.method: 引入Branch2Skill框架：1) 在固定预算下对每个任务执行蒙特卡洛树搜索以获取多样化的推理轨迹；2) 比较共享相同前缀的精英路径与兄弟替代路径，提取保留、修改或避免特定推理模式的逐步证据；3) 将多步证据蒸馏为可复用的更新指令，实现一棵推理树提供多步骤监督。
AI.result: 在涵盖推理和智能体任务的六个基准测试中，Branch2Skill consistently 提升了任务性能并提高了技能进化效率。例如，使用GPT-5.5作为目标模型时，相比SkillOpt，其Token消耗减少了73.2%，同时实现了更优越的性能。
AI.conclusion: 推理树不仅支持更有效的轨迹搜索，还能提供更丰富的监督信号，从而实现更高效、低成本的技能改进。

title: SRE-FER: Regional residual evidence learning for mitigating local evidence dilution in fine-grained facial expression recognition
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures.Accepted at the 9th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Pattern Recognition (AIPR 2026)
summary: Fine-grained facial expression recognition (FER) hinges on capturing subtle muscular cues that distinguish adjacent emotions. Yet capturing these cues presents a dilemma. Detector-based methods depend on fragile landmark pipelines, whereas we find that directly transferring foundation models such as DINOv3 under conventional global readouts can cause local evidence dilution: early global aggregation washes out sparse muscular signals and leaves persistent confusion between categories such as fear/surprise and sad/neutral. To recover this evidence, we propose SRE-FER, a readout-level regional residual evidence learning framework. Its core module, RERA, adds zero-initialized residual logits that refine class boundaries while preserving the backbone's global prediction. Training-time action unit (AU) guidance steers regional features toward expression-relevant areas using Facial Action Coding System (FACS)-based anatomical priors, without requiring an external facial pipeline at inference. An optional Full setting further routes sample-specific non-redundant tokens. On three benchmarks, SRE-FER attains 92.76% on RAF-DB, 91.32% on FERPlus, and 67.78% on AffectNet-7, demonstrating highly competitive performance compared to existing FER methods.

AI.tldr: 提出SRE-FER框架，通过区域残差证据学习解决基础模型在细粒度表情识别中局部信号稀释问题，无需外部地标管线即可提升分类精度。
AI.motivation: 现有检测器依赖脆弱的地标管线；直接应用基础模型（如DINOv3）的全局读出会导致局部肌肉信号被稀释，造成恐惧/惊讶、悲伤/中性等类别间的持续混淆。
AI.method: 提出SRE-FER框架，核心模块RERA添加零初始化残差logits以细化类别边界并保留全局预测；利用基于FACS解剖先验的动作单元(AU)引导进行训练；可选Full设置路由样本特定的非冗余token。
AI.result: 在RAF-DB上达到92.76%，FERPlus上达到91.32%，AffectNet-7上达到67.78%，性能具有高度竞争力。
AI.conclusion: SRE-FER有效恢复了局部证据，解决了全局聚合导致的信号丢失问题，在多个基准测试中展现了优于或持平现有方法的性能。

title: Automated Generation of Complexity-Validated Decision Scenarios Using Large Language Models
summary: Cognitive decision-making research depends on diverse scenarios with carefully controlled complexity, yet manual production is slow, inconsistent, and biased. We developed an automated pipeline that uses LLms to generate structured decision scenarios and validates their complexity through a composite framework rooted in established task-complexity theory. We evaluated 4,238 scenarios across multiple domains and complexity tiers. Measurement validation met rigorous psychometric standards. Agreement among five independent model families was nearly perfect, with an intraclass correlation coefficient of 0.997 and a kappa of 0.971. Known-groups validity demonstrated large separation between tiers, with an eta-squared of 0.587 and all pairwise comparisons significant at p less than .001. Factor analysis revealed a dominant complexity construct, with loadings between 0.87 and 0.96 across three frameworks, while interactivity formed a weaker secondary dimension at 0.34. Discriminant validity was limited by a strong relationship between complexity and text length that persisted after controlling for tier, yielding a partial correlation of 0.86. This constrains construct purity but does not undermine the instrument's tier-grading function. Model analyses showed a negative association between throughput and schema pass rate (r = -0.967, p = .007, n = 5), suggesting a speed-quality trade-off, though largely driven by one high-throughput model. Llama 4 Maverick generated scenarios fastest at 134 per minute versus 25 for DeepSeek Chat V3.2, but underproduced complex-tier scenarios, whereas DeepSeek Chat V3.2 balanced domain coverage with high schema compliance. The system demonstrated strong psychometric properties, enabling reliable classification into Simple, Moderate, and Complex tiers and providing the measurement infrastructure needed for downstream cognitive assessment of AI systems

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种利用大语言模型（LLMs）自动化生成结构化认知决策场景的流水线，并通过基于任务复杂度理论的复合框架验证其复杂性。该工具成功将场景分类为简单、中等和复杂三个层级，具备可靠的心理测量学属性，旨在解决传统手动生产场景速度慢、不一致且有偏差的问题，为AI系统的下游认知评估提供基础设施支持。
AI.motivation: 现有的认知决策研究依赖于精心控制复杂度的多样化场景，但手动生产这些场景存在效率低下、一致性差以及存在偏见等局限性。因此，需要一种自动化、标准化且可验证的方法来生成高质量的研究场景。
AI.method: 研究团队开发了一个自动化流水线，使用LLMs生成结构化的决策场景。通过一个基于既定任务复杂度理论的复合框架对生成的场景进行复杂性验证。评估了4,238个跨多个领域和复杂度层级的场景，采用心理测量学标准进行效度检验，包括计算独立模型间的一致性、已知群体效度、因子分析以及判别效度。此外，还分析了不同模型在吞吐量与模式通过率之间的权衡关系。
AI.result:
1. **高信度**：五个独立模型家族间的同意率近乎完美，组内相关系数（ICC）为0.997，Kappa值为0.971。
2. **良好效度**：已知群体效度显示各层级间存在显著差异（eta-squared = 0.587，所有成对比较p < .001）。因子分析揭示了一个主导的复杂度构念（载荷0.87-0.96），交互性为较弱的次要维度（0.34）。
3. **局限性与发现**：复杂度与文本长度之间存在较强的部分相关（r = 0.86），限制了构念纯度，但不影响分级功能。模型分析显示吞吐量与模式通过率呈负相关（r = -0.967），表明存在速度-质量权衡，但这主要受单个高通量模型驱动。Llama 4 Maverick生成速度最快（134个/分钟），但在复杂场景生成上不足；DeepSeek Chat V3.2则在领域覆盖率和模式合规性之间取得了平衡。
AI.conclusion: 该系统展现了强大的心理测量学特性，能够可靠地将场景分类为简单、中等和复杂层级。这一工具不仅解决了场景生产的效率和一致性问题，还为AI系统的下游认知评估提供了必要的基础设施支持。尽管存在复杂度与文本长度的相关性限制，但其作为分级仪器的功能依然有效。

title: A Structural Dynamics Graph World Model: Unified Modeling, Constrained Rollout, and Interpretable Calibration
summary: The state evolution of a complex system arises jointly from object laws, relational propagation, domain conservation, and unmodeled error. Forcing all sources into one black box makes mechanism attribution and constraint preservation unauditable; forcing every mechanism into one equation family discards mature domain solvers. We propose SD-GWM, a Structural Dynamics Graph World Model as an executable structural contract: nodes declare self-dynamics S, edges declare neighbor graph-coupled dynamics N---both fixed-form mechanism assets (rules, ODEs, solvers) calibrating only authorized parameters. An optional bounded residual R concentrates learnability, while a global projection maps states to feasibility, enforcing constraints without guaranteeing accuracy gains. On eight pre-registered research questions, SD-GWM delivers (i) heterogeneous integration: rules and solvers plug in natively; (ii) semantic fidelity: disabling R preserves source semantics bit-for-bit, with four theory properties under explicit proof/empirical boundaries; (iii) auditable governance: stepwise traces enable counterfactual fault localization (top-1 = 1.0) without post-hoc approximations. On a semi-synthetic flood testbed and USGS streamflow, SD-GWM reduces constraint violations to floating-point tolerance in analytical tests and to zero in semi-synthetic and real-data cases. Persistence matches SD-GWM in calm periods, but during a 254-day extreme-flood shift persistence and all neural baselines collapse (90-min RMSE 892-3007 cfs) while SD-GWM holds at 108 cfs (8-28x gain). The bounded residual cuts RMSE ~50% only under backbone bias. We position SD-GWM not as a universally superior forecaster, but as a verifiable substrate for auditable, constraint-safe spatiotemporal mining.

AI.tldr: 提出SD-GWM（结构化动力学图世界模型），通过将自动力学、邻居耦合动力学和残差分离，实现复杂系统建模的可审计性、约束保持与异构求解器集成。在洪水预测任务中显著优于传统方法，尤其在极端事件下表现稳定。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将复杂系统的多重来源（对象定律、关系传播、领域守恒、未建模误差）强行合并为黑箱或单一方程族，导致机制归因不可审计、成熟领域求解器无法复用。需要一种既能保留语义完整性，又能支持可验证治理的建模框架。
AI.method: 构建SD-GWM：节点声明自动力学S，边声明邻居图耦合动力学N，二者作为固定形式的机制资产（规则/ODEs/求解器），仅校准授权参数；可选有界残差R集中可学习部分；全局投影映射状态至可行域以强制约束。整体作为“可执行结构契约”，支持反事实故障定位与语义保真。
AI.result: 1. 异质集成：规则与求解器原生接入；2. 语义保真：禁用R时源语义逐位保留，四项理论性质获证明/实证边界；3. 可审计治理：逐步追踪实现反事实故障定位（top-1准确率1.0）；4. 性能优势：在USGS真实水流数据上，极端洪水期间RMSE仅108 cfs，比基线低8–28倍；约束违反降至浮点容差或零；残差仅在骨干存在偏差时降低约50% RMSE。
AI.conclusion: SD-GWM并非追求普遍最优预测精度，而是提供可验证、约束安全、可审计的时空数据挖掘基础架构，适用于需机制透明与合规性的复杂系统建模场景。

title: Resolution Meets Reduction: Efficient Visual Context for 3D Radiology Report Generation
summary: Vision-language models offer a promising path toward automating radiology report generation, but applying them to full 3D CT volumes poses substantial computational challenges. Modern foundation vision encoders (VEs) can produce tens of thousands of vision tokens per scan, making the visual sequence passed to the large language model (LLM) a primary computational bottleneck. Vision-to-language projectors can compress this sequence to reduce computation, but may discard clinically relevant detail; conversely, effective compression can accommodate higher-resolution inputs while keeping the downstream token count fixed. How this vision-token budget should be allocated across input field of view, spatial resolution, and vision-to-language projection therefore remains an open design question. We systematically evaluate four heterogeneous VEs (CNN- and ViT-based), five token-reducing projectors at up to 64x compression alongside a non-reducing MLP projector baseline, and five instruction-tuned LLMs (1.7B--4B) on two large-scale CT report datasets (CT-RATE and Merlin). At matched LLM token budgets, anatomy-guided region of interest cropping is the most consistent strategy, improving clinical macro F1 in 19 of 20 settings by +3.7 points on average for the 3D ViT Primus encoder and +1.1 for the slice-based 2D ViT Curia encoder. Increasing input resolution further is strongly projector-dependent: the PerceiverResampler, paired with higher-resolution Curia features, yields the strongest configuration in the resolution study on both datasets. Our best configurations achieve state-of-the-art clinical macro F1 on the test sets, reaching 49.5 on CT-RATE and 49.0 on Merlin. Code and models will be published upon publication.

AI.tldr: 本研究系统评估了视觉-语言模型在3D CT影像自动报告生成中的性能，重点分析视觉编码器、令牌压缩投影器及输入分辨率对计算瓶颈和临床指标的影响。研究发现，基于解剖学的感兴趣区域（ROI）裁剪是最稳健的策略，而结合PerceiverResampler与高分辨率输入能实现最佳性能，达到了当前最先进（SOTA）的临床宏观F1分数。
AI.motivation: 将视觉-语言模型应用于全3D CT体积自动生成放射学报告面临巨大的计算挑战。现代基础视觉编码器产生的视觉令牌数量巨大，导致视觉序列成为大型语言模型（LLM）的主要计算瓶颈。现有的视觉到语言投影器虽可压缩序列以减少计算，但可能丢弃临床相关细节；反之，有效的压缩允许使用更高分辨率的输入同时保持下游令牌数量固定。目前关于如何在这几个维度间分配视觉令牌预算仍是一个开放的设计问题。
AI.method: 研究系统地评估了四种异构视觉编码器（基于CNN和ViT）、五种令牌减少投影器（最高64倍压缩）及一种非减少MLP投影器基线，并结合五种指令微调的LLM（1.7B--4B参数）。实验在两个大规模CT报告数据集（CT-RATE和Merlin）上进行，对比了不同视野裁剪、空间分辨率和投影策略的组合效果。
AI.result: 在匹配的LLM令牌预算下，基于解剖学的感兴趣区域（ROI）裁剪是最一致的优化策略，在20种设置中有19种提升了临床宏观F1分数（3D ViT Primus编码器平均提升+3.7分，基于切片的2D ViT Curia编码器平均提升+1.1分）。提高输入分辨率的效果强烈依赖于投影器的选择：PerceiverResampler配合更高分辨率的Curia特征在两个数据集的分辨率研究中表现最强。最佳配置在测试集上达到了最先进的临床宏观F1分数：CT-RATE为49.5，Merlin为49.0。
AI.conclusion: 通过系统评估视觉令牌预算分配策略，确定了基于解剖学的ROI裁剪和特定的投影器（如PerceiverResampler）组合是实现高效且高精度的3D CT报告生成的关键。该研究为平衡计算效率与临床细节保留提供了实证指导，并取得了当前的最佳性能。

title: Theory-Guided Deception Detection: A RAG-Based Artificial Intelligence Exploration
summary: The current work developed seven Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) models based on leading deception theories and compared how deception judgments were made relative to baseline models. Across 700 statements drawn from five published deception datasets, four large language models (gpt-4o, claude-sonnet-4-6, ollama/llama3, deepseek-v4-flash), and two run-types (RAG vs. baseline), a total of 39,200 deception judgments were rendered. Detection accuracies were consistent with typical human accuracies and not statistically different across RAG (54.5%) and baseline models (54.6%). RAG-based models (57.0%) were less truth-biased than baseline models (59.7%), but the effect size was quite small. Theoretical perspective mattered little for accuracy yet mattered substantially for response bias, which ranged from highly lie-biased (the verifiability approach, 32.2%) to highly truth-biased (truth-default theory, 88.1%). Content effects and model effects further moderated the results. Theory-guided AI judgments are unreliable with current parameters, yet they might show promise with additional datasets, model testing, and theory-to-data matching.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了七种基于欺骗理论的检索增强生成（RAG）模型，并与基线模型进行了对比。结果显示，RAG模型在检测准确率上与基线模型无显著差异，但理论视角对响应偏差有显著影响。总体而言，当前参数下的理论引导AI判断不可靠，但未来仍有潜力。
AI.motivation: 旨在评估基于主要欺骗理论开发的检索增强生成（RAG）模型在欺骗判断中的表现，并将其与基线模型进行比较，以探索理论指导对AI判断的影响。
AI.method: 从五个已发表的欺骗数据集中抽取700条陈述，使用四种大型语言模型（gpt-4o, claude-sonnet-4-6, ollama/llama3, deepseek-v4-flash），在RAG和基线两种运行模式下共生成39,200次欺骗判断。
AI.result: 1. RAG模型（54.5%）与基线模型（54.6%）的检测准确率一致且无统计学差异，符合人类典型准确率水平。2. RAG模型（57.0%）的真理偏见低于基线模型（59.7%），但效应量很小。3. 理论视角对准确率影响不大，但对响应偏差影响显著，范围从高度说谎偏向（可验证性方法，32.2%）到高度真实偏向（默认真实理论，88.1%）。4. 内容效应和模型效应进一步调节了结果。
AI.conclusion: 在当前参数下，基于理论的AI判断是不可靠的；然而，通过增加数据集、进行更多模型测试以及优化理论与数据的匹配，该方法可能展现出潜力。

title: EnergyBridge: Benchmarking Household Energy Management, User Participation, and Grid Flexibility
summary: Residential virtual power plants (VPPs) can provide grid flexibility by shifting household demand, but physical flexibility becomes dependable capacity only when residents authorize a plan and the promised response is delivered. Existing benchmarks evaluate control but omit event-specific authorization. We present EnergyBridge, a benchmark and agent framework connecting capacity reporting, household authorization, and physical execution. It combines region-specific EnergyPlus environments for Tianjin and Berlin with an LLM-based User Participation Simulator. Against 584 persona- and event-matched human role-play judgments, the LLM-based User Participation Simulator preserves method ordering with a 5.3-point mean absolute acceptance error. Across conventional controllers and agent baselines, EnergyBridge achieves the highest simulated authorization, lowest event-window energy, and the most reliable capacity commitment in both regions. We release human data and codes for reproducible human-centered grid-flexibility research: https://github.com/Agentic-Intelligence-Lab/EnergyBridge.

AI.tldr: 提出EnergyBridge基准和智能体框架，通过LLM用户参与模拟器连接容量报告、家庭授权与物理执行，解决现有基准忽略事件特定授权的问题，在天津和柏林场景中实现最高的模拟授权率和最可靠的容量承诺。
AI.motivation: 现有的虚拟电厂（VPP）基准主要评估控制能力，但忽略了居民对具体计划的事件特定授权这一关键环节，导致物理灵活性无法真正转化为可靠容量。
AI.method: 构建EnergyBridge框架，结合天津和柏林的区域特异性EnergyPlus环境以及基于大语言模型（LLM）的用户参与模拟器。该模拟器旨在模拟居民授权行为，并通过584个人性化角色扮演的判断数据进行验证，确保其保留方法排序且平均绝对接受误差仅为5.3分。
AI.result: 与传统控制器和智能体基线相比，EnergyBridge在两个地区均实现了最高的模拟授权率、最低的事件窗口能耗以及最可靠的容量承诺。同时发布了人类数据和代码以支持可复现的人本电网灵活性研究。
AI.conclusion: EnergyBridge通过整合授权机制，有效提升了虚拟电厂中居民侧灵活性的可靠性和真实性，为人本导向的电网灵活性研究提供了新的基准和工具。

title: High-Quality Exposure Correction with Diffusion-Based Image Generation Priors
comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Multimedia (TMM)
summary: Although most existing exposure correction methods achieve high fidelity, they often place excessive focus on overall pixel-wise accuracy, making it challenging to effectively model extreme exposure regions, which results in suboptimal perceptual quality. Recently, diffusion models have received significant attention due to their remarkable performance in the realm of image generation. However, their successful application to exposure correction remains a challenging and open question. The key challenge lies in generating accurate image structures and maintaining high image fidelity during stochastic diffusion processes. In this paper, we propose DPEC (Diffusion Prior-based Exposure Correction), a novel framework for image exposure correction that utilizes diffusion-based image generation priors encapsulated in pre-trained large-scale diffusion models. Specifically, we first propose an efficient fine-tuning strategy to derive an exposure corrector from pre-trained models, enabling the generation of enhanced images in a single-step denoising process. Moreover, we seamlessly combine the strengths of diffusion models and regression models, and design a joint cross-attention module to integrate multi-scale diffusion prior features, thereby effectively preserving high-frequency details and minimizing random artifacts. The diffusion model focuses on dealing with low-frequency content rather than all the intricate texture details. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed DPEC method consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods on multiple exposure correction datasets, whether in terms of fidelity, perceptual quality, or visual effects.

AI.tldr: 提出DPEC框架，利用预训练扩散模型的先验知识，通过单步去噪和联合交叉注意力模块解决曝光校正中结构生成和保真度难题，显著提升感知质量和视觉效果。
AI.motivation: 现有曝光校正方法过度关注像素级精度，难以有效处理极端曝光区域，导致感知质量不佳；虽然扩散模型在图像生成中表现优异，但其在曝光校正中的应用面临生成准确结构和保持高保真度的挑战。
AI.method: 1. 提出高效微调策略，从预训练大尺度扩散模型中提取曝光校正器，实现单步去噪增强图像生成；2. 设计联合交叉注意力模块，融合多尺度扩散先验特征，结合扩散模型（处理低频内容）与回归模型（处理高频细节）的优势，以保留高频细节并减少随机伪影。
AI.result: 在多个曝光校正数据集上，DPEC方法在保真度、感知质量和视觉效果方面均一致优于现有的最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 基于扩散先验的DPEC框架能有效解决极端曝光区域的校正问题，平衡了结构准确性与图像保真度，为曝光校正提供了新的有效解决方案。

title: PluginEval: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Fine-Grained Error Attribution in Function Calling
summary: Reliable evaluation of tool routing is critical as Large Language Models increasingly operate as autonomous agents. Current benchmarks face three structural limitations: data distributions that follow a power law leave rare scenarios underrepresented; the absence of adversarial hard negatives obscures performance differences across models; and annotation pipelines depend on LLM judgments that have not been validated through execution. In this paper, we introduce PluginEval, a benchmark constructed through a two-stage framework that systematically mitigates these limitations. First, we formulate tool routing as a sequence of three decisions and separate generation from verification. LLMs propose candidate calls, while deterministic validation and real API execution provide reliable quality signals. Second, we decompose each plugin by capability, intent, and boundary to identify trigger and exclusion scenarios. We then generate queries at different difficulty levels to fill coverage gaps, including adversarial negatives targeting three failure modes, and return them to the first stage for annotation. This process creates a closed loop that iterates until coverage converges. For evaluation, we move beyond aggregate accuracy. An LLM judge anchored to gold annotations classifies failures as missed calls, spurious calls, or parameter errors, producing a detailed error profile for each model. We evaluate five model families, including proprietary models and models with open weights, analyze their performance across difficulty levels and error categories, and validate the judge through agreement with human annotations.

AI.tldr: 提出PluginEval基准，通过两阶段框架解决工具路由评估中的数据分布不均、缺乏对抗性负样本及验证不可靠问题，实现更精准的大模型工具调用能力评估。
AI.motivation: 现有工具路由评估基准存在三大结构性局限：1）数据呈幂律分布导致罕见场景代表性不足；2）缺乏对抗性难负样本，难以区分模型性能差异；3）标注依赖未经执行验证的LLM判断，可靠性低。
