By providing both reliable spatial anchors and explicit semantic intent, SI-Data uniquely enables collaborative spatial-semantic learning. Building upon this, we propose a collaborative framework called **SI-Edit** that integrates semantic instructions with precise geometric constraints. Furthermore, to address the lack of standardized evaluation, we establish a comprehensive set of metrics designed to measure both structural fidelity (e.g., sketch-to-edge alignment) and semantic adherence. Experimental results demonstrate that SI-Edit provides more reliable structural control than baselines for sketch-based image editing, and achieves precise, pixel-level local refinements aligned with user intent. The data and code are released on the [project page](https://github.com/ywxsuperstar/SIEdit).

AI.tldr: 提出SI-Data数据集和SI-Edit框架，解决基于草图的图像编辑中缺乏高质量基准和像素级精度控制的问题。
AI.motivation: 当前生成模型在基于草图的图像编辑中难以实现像素级精度，尤其是细粒度局部变形；主要瓶颈在于缺乏同时提供几何约束和语义指令的高质量公开基准数据集。
AI.method: 1. 构建SI-Data数据集：利用多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）自动化合成包含原图、局部几何草图、语义指令和编辑后图像的完整四元组数据。2. 提出SI-Edit框架：协同整合语义指令与精确几何约束进行图像编辑。3. 建立新评估指标体系：衡量结构保真度（如草图到边缘的对齐）和语义一致性。
AI.result: SI-Edit在基于草图的图像编辑任务中提供了比基线方法更可靠的结构控制，并实现了符合用户意图的精确、像素级局部细化。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入高质量的SI-Data数据集和协同学习框架SI-Edit，结合新的评估标准，有效提升了基于草图的图像编辑在几何控制和语义理解方面的性能。

title: Agentic Router: An Execution-Grounded Continual Learning Approach With Memory
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents provide a promising interface for command-line-based network operations, but a plausible command may still fail or introduce operational risk after execution. Existing approaches mainly focus on command generation or final configuration correctness, and do not use execution-grounded experience to jointly improve candidate coverage and action selection. We propose an execution-grounded dual-path consequence-aware agent for CLI-based SONiC operations, which generates multiple complete actions, predicts their execution consequences, and selects the final action through utility- and risk-aware reranking. The proposal-side path abstracts reusable operational lessons into retrievable guidance to improve feasible-action coverage without modifying the proposal LLM, while the selection-side path adapts the consequence predictor through session-level LoRA updates using real SSH feedback to improve conditional selection quality. Experiments over multi-turn SONiC operation sessions with different Qwen3 proposal models show that the framework improves feasible-action coverage and top-1 execution success, and that the two adaptation paths provide complementary gains over interaction.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于执行反馈的双路径后果感知智能体，用于CLI网络操作。通过生成多个动作并预测后果，利用可检索的操作经验和LoRA微调提升候选覆盖率和选择成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体在命令行网络操作中，虽能生成合理命令，但仍存在执行失败或引入操作风险的问题。现有方法多关注命令生成或最终配置正确性，缺乏利用执行落地经验来共同提升候选覆盖率与动作选择能力的机制。
AI.method: 提出“执行落地的双路径后果感知智能体”，针对SONiC CLI操作：1）提议侧路径：将可复用的操作经验抽象为可检索指导，无需修改提议LLM即可提升可行动作覆盖率；2）选择侧路径：利用真实SSH反馈进行会话级LoRA更新，适配后果预测器以提升条件选择质量。整体流程包括生成多个完整动作、预测执行后果、并通过效用和风险感知的重排序选择最终动作。
AI.result: 在多轮SONiC操作会话实验中（使用不同Qwen3提议模型），该框架显著提升了可行动作覆盖率和Top-1执行成功率。两条适应路径在交互过程中提供了互补的收益。
AI.conclusion: 结合执行反馈的双路径机制能有效解决CLI网络操作中的风险与成功率问题，通过分离提议改进与选择优化，实现了更稳健和高效的自动化网络运维。

title: Contrastive Mask Fidelity: Reference-Free Auditing of Ground-Truth Masks in Remote Sensing Semantic Segmentation
summary: Semantic segmentation models are trained and evaluated against human-drawn masks, yet remote-sensing annotations are often coarse, incomplete, or misaligned; high overlap scores may then reflect agreement with imperfect labels rather than faithfulness to the image, creating an evaluation paradox. We introduce Contrastive Mask Fidelity (CMF), a training-free, reference-free metric that scores competing class masks directly against image evidence. CMF composites keep and erase counterfactual views of each mask and asks a frozen vision-language judge whether class evidence is concentrated inside the mask and absent outside. We validate CMF on controlled mask corruptions, then audit 10,731 image-class pairs across ten remote-sensing benchmarks using candidate masks from Seg-Probe, a training-free open-vocabulary probe built on SegEarth-OV3 that outperforms prior baselines on nine of ten datasets. The audit reveals systematic, class-dependent annotation distortion: man-made classes such as buildings, roads, and cars favor the candidate mask on 62-85% of pairs, whereas ambiguous land cover more often favors human annotations. On a blinded three-annotator consensus, CMF matches expert judgment on 81% of pairs, exceeding keep-only scoring, model confidence, and a trained label-quality baseline. Finally, conservative class-wise arbitration yields supervision that improves cross-domain transfer over raw annotations and matched replacement controls, positioning CMF as a scalable tool for auditing ground truth rather than presuming it infallible.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为对比掩码保真度（CMF）的训练无参考指标，用于评估遥感语义分割中掩码与图像证据的一致性，解决了因标注粗糙导致的评估悖论。该方法通过冻结的视觉-语言模型判断类证据是否集中在掩码内，并在多个基准测试中验证了其有效性和对专家判断的高匹配度，可作为大规模审计地面真实值的新工具。
AI.motivation: 遥感图像的标注通常存在粗糙、不完整或不对齐的问题，导致传统的高重叠分数可能反映的是与不完美的标签一致，而非对图像本身的忠实度，从而产生评估悖论。需要一种能直接基于图像证据评估掩码质量的方法。
AI.method: 引入对比掩码保真度（CMF），这是一种无需训练且无参考的指标。它通过合成每个掩码的反事实视图（保留和擦除部分），并利用一个冻结的视觉-语言模型作为“法官”，判断类别证据是否集中在掩码内部且在外部缺失，从而对竞争性的类别掩码进行评分。此外，还构建了一个基于SegEarth-OV3的无训练开放词汇探针Seg-Probe以生成候选掩码。
AI.result: 1. 在受控掩码损坏实验中验证了CMF的有效性；2. 在十个遥感基准测试中的10,731个图像-类别对上进行了审计；3. 发现系统性、类别依赖的标注失真：人造类（如建筑物、道路、汽车）更倾向于支持候选掩码（62-85%的情况），而模糊的土地覆盖更倾向于人类标注；4. CMF在三 annotator 盲审共识中与专家判断的匹配度达到81%，优于仅保留得分、模型置信度和训练过的标签质量基线；5. 保守的类别级仲裁产生的监督信号改善了跨域迁移性能。
AI.conclusion: CMF提供了一种可扩展的工具来审计地面真实值（ground truth），而不是假设其完美无缺。它能够有效识别标注中的偏差，并通过提供改进的监督信号来提升模型在跨域任务中的表现，证明了基于图像证据评估掩码质量的可行性与价值。

title: Structure-Preserving Uncertainty Propagation in First-Order Proof Search
comment: 79 pages, 6 figures. Executable binaries, documentation, examples, and public samplers: https://github.com/tammet/gkreasoner
summary:
GK is a query-directed first-order prover that extends ordinary resolution-based proof search with explicit positive and negative claims, numerical confidence values, and prioritized default rules with exceptions. It works directly with non-ground clauses, including equality and function terms. Candidate proofs are found by bounded first-order proof search; exception conditions of defaults are checked by further bounded searches, recursively when exceptions themselves depend on defaults. This avoids requiring a finite global grounding, while allowing incomplete searches to be reported as such.
  This paper adds structure-preserving quantitative reporting to that framework. Retained proof histories are used in two calculations. The first reconstructs the uncertain ground premises used by each proof and computes the probability that at least one retained proof is available, without counting shared premises independently. The second resolves positive and negative support at intermediate atoms before that support is propagated through later rules; the same calculation evaluates uncertain exception conditions for individual rule applications. Reports separate positive support, negative support, conflict, and ignorance and identify detected incomplete calculations or fallbacks. The implementation performs bounded reconstruction and dependency traversal after proof search and still requires no global grounding. Analytic examples and independent simulators reproduce the reference calculations on their stated fragments. Comparisons with probabilistic logic, probabilistic ASP, default logic, and goal-directed ASP identify cases of agreement, semantic difference, unsupported translation, and incomplete computation.

AI.tldr: 本文在GK一阶定理证明器基础上，引入结构保持的定量报告机制。通过保留证明历史，计算不确定前提的概率支持及冲突/无知状态，无需全局基址化即可处理非基子句、等式和函数项，并与多种逻辑系统进行了对比分析。
AI.motivation: 现有的GK框架虽能处理非基子句和默认规则例外，但缺乏对证明过程中不确定性、正负支持度及冲突状态的定量描述和结构化报告。旨在增强该框架以提供精确的概率支持和语义区分能力。
AI.method:
1. 扩展GK框架：保留证明历史，用于重构不确定基前提并计算至少存在一个可用证明的概率（避免重复计数共享前提）。
2. 中间原子解析：在支持传播前解析中间原子的正负支持，评估单个规则应用的不确定例外条件。
3. 报告生成：分离报告正支持、负支持、冲突和无知状态，并标识不完整的计算或回退情况。
4. 实现优化：在证明搜索后进行有界重建和依赖遍历，无需全局基址化。
5. 验证与对比：通过解析示例和独立模拟器复现参考计算，并与概率逻辑、概率ASP、默认逻辑和目标导向ASP进行对比。
AI.result: 实现了无需全局基址化的有界重建和依赖遍历；成功复现了参考计算；在与概率逻辑、概率ASP等系统的对比中，明确了各系统在语义差异、不支持的翻译以及不完整计算方面的具体表现。
AI.conclusion: 提出的结构保持定量报告机制有效增强了GK定理证明器的表达能力，能够在不进行全局基址化的情况下，精确量化证明的支持度、冲突和不确定性，并为不同逻辑范式间的比较提供了清晰的语义依据。

title: View-Adaptive Renderer for View-Consistent 2D-to-3D Generation
summary: Reconstructing 3D shapes from a single image remains a fundamental yet challenging problem in computer vision. Traditional monocular 3D generation pipelines typically synthesize multiple views from a single input image before applying Neural Radiance Field (NeRF)-based reconstruction. However, inherent projective ambiguities often produce visual discontinuities across generated viewpoints, leading to inaccuracies in reconstructed 3D models. Current solutions either incur significant additional computational burdens or fail to adequately resolve practical inconsistencies between synthesized views. To address these limitations, we propose a novel viewpoint-adaptive neural rendering framework that enables robust 3D reconstruction even when given partially inconsistent multi-view inputs. Our approach introduces view-adaptive neural renderers that independently correct viewpoint-dependent errors while simultaneously sharing a global feature backbone to preserve structural coherence. Furthermore, we propose a self-attention fusion module that adaptively integrates multi-view information, ensuring geometric consistency without relying heavily on indirect regularizations or computationally intensive methods. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that our method consistently improves 3D reconstruction fidelity. Importantly, our approach achieves near state-of-the-art performance without diffusion-based SDS supervision, relying primarily on photometric rendering loss with lightweight attention regularizers. This balance between accuracy and efficiency makes the proposed framework highly practical for real-world applications.

AI.tldr: 提出一种视点自适应神经渲染框架，通过独立校正视点误差并共享全局特征骨干，结合自注意力融合模块，解决单图3D重建中的视图不一致问题，实现高精度、低计算成本的3D重构。
AI.motivation: 传统单目3D生成管线在从单张输入图像合成多视图后应用NeRF重建时，因固有的射影歧义导致生成视角间出现视觉不连续，进而造成3D模型重建不准确；现有解决方案要么计算负担重，要么无法有效解决合成视图间的实际不一致性。
AI.method: 1. 设计视点自适应神经渲染器（view-adaptive neural renderers），独立校正依赖于视点的错误，同时共享全局特征骨干以保留结构连贯性；2. 提出自注意力融合模块（self-attention fusion module），自适应地整合多视图信息，确保几何一致性，避免依赖间接正则化或计算密集型方法；3. 主要依赖光度渲染损失（photometric rendering loss）和轻量级注意力正则化器，而非基于扩散模型的SDS监督。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法一致提高了3D重建的保真度；在不使用扩散模型SDS监督的情况下，实现了接近最先进（state-of-the-art）的性能，同时在准确性和效率之间取得良好平衡。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的视点自适应神经渲染框架能够有效处理部分不一致的多视图输入，显著提升3D重建质量，且具备高实用性，适用于现实世界应用。

title: Signature-Guided Capacity Occupancy for Dense Expert Merging
summary: Dense expert merging combines domain-specialized language models into one single checkpoint, typically by admitting task-vector support in weight space. However, this admission is governed by three decisions that existing methods answer only partially: where to open layer capacity from cross-expert conflict, who should occupy that capacity based on domain demand, and how to admit the resulting support without relying on costly recipe search. To tackle these issues, we propose SigMerge (Signature-Guided Capacity Occupancy), a structured capacity assignment framework for dense expert merging. Starting from a dense base merge, conflict signatures set each layer's capacity from cross-expert conflict, positive base-merge deficits set each domain's share of that capacity, and a sequential occupancy rule admits each expert delta up to the resulting layer-domain budget. Across 21 paired settings spanning seven dense base merges and three model pools, SigMerge improves every one (by 15.0% on average) and achieves the best average rank (1.67) among six merging methods, outperforming three categories of merging baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出SigMerge框架，通过冲突签名、基础合并赤字和顺序占用规则解决密集专家合并中的容量分配问题，显著提升多任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有密集专家合并方法在解决跨专家冲突的层容量开启、基于领域需求的容量占用以及无需昂贵搜索的权重支持 admit 这三个关键决策上仅提供了部分解决方案。
AI.method: 提出SigMerge（签名引导的容量占用），这是一种结构化容量分配框架：1) 利用冲突签名确定每层的容量；2) 基于正的基础合并赤字设定每个领域的容量份额；3) 采用顺序占用规则将每个专家增量纳入层-领域预算中。
AI.result: 在涵盖7种密集基础合并和3个模型池的21个配对设置中，SigMerge在所有设置中均有所提升（平均提升15.0%），并在6种合并方法中获得最佳平均排名（1.67），优于三类合并基线。
AI.conclusion: SigMerge通过结构化的容量分配机制有效解决了密集专家合并中的关键挑战，实现了比现有基线方法更优的性能表现。

title: Visual Distortion Detection in UGC Images Using Large Multimodal Models
summary:
The localized depiction of perceptual quality has long been a crucial, yet underexplored, challenge in image quality assessment (IQA). Existing approaches based on large multimodal models (LMMs) predominantly rely on text-driven supervised fine-tuning (SFT).
  However, this training paradigm exhibits notable limitations in detection accuracy. Moreover, synthetically distorted images, which are often used as the primary training data source,
  show a significant generalization gap when deployed in real-world scenarios; thus, the \textbf{synthetic-to-authentic (\textit{S2A})} problem represents a critical challenge. Motivated by these issues, we propose \textbf{\textit{VIGIL}}, which leverages the LMM architecture for precise visual distortion detection. From a candidate pool of over 1000K samples, we construct the \textbf{\textit{VIGIL-140K}} training set, which consists of over 140K distorted images. These images are obtained through rigorous quality filtering and carefully crafted distortion injection, covering 8 major synthetic distortion categories.
  Our model leverages different layers of the large language model (LLM) decoder, treating them as \textit{multiple detectors} that perform synchronous distortion detection using multi-level features. Additionally, we retain distortion cues from predictions assigned to the non-distortion class, which helps mitigate the ambiguous foreground-background (\textit{FG-BG}) separation commonly encountered in the \textit{S2A} problem.
  After post-processing, our model consistently outperforms strong baselines on both in-domain synthetic distortion detection and \textit{S2A} tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出VIGIL模型，利用大语言模型（LLM）解码器的多层特性进行视觉失真检测。通过构建包含14万张图像的VIGIL-140K数据集，并结合保留非失真类预测线索以缓解合成到真实场景泛化差距，在域内检测和S2A任务上均优于基线模型。
AI.motivation: 现有基于大型多模态模型（LMMs）的图像质量评估方法依赖文本驱动的监督微调，存在检测精度不足的问题；且主要使用合成失真图像训练，导致在真实场景中部署时出现显著的“合成到真实（S2A）”泛化差距。
AI.method:
1. 构建VIGIL-140K训练集：从超100万候选样本中筛选出14万张经过严格质量过滤和精心设计的失真注入图像，覆盖8大类合成失真。
2. 利用LLM解码器多层结构：将不同层视为多个检测器，利用多级特征同步进行失真检测。
3. 处理前景-背景模糊问题：保留分配给非失真类的预测中的失真线索，以缓解S2A问题中常见的前景-背景分离歧义。
AI.result: VIGIL模型在域内合成失真检测和合成到真实（S2A）任务上，一致性地超越了强大的基线模型。
AI.conclusion: VIGIL通过改进训练数据质量和利用LLM多层特征及特定预测策略，有效解决了局部感知质量描绘中的检测精度和S2A泛化难题，提升了图像质量评估的性能。

title: CRUISE: Vision-Language Model-Guided Uncertainty-Aware Cross-Modal Sensor Fusion for Robust Autonomous Driving
summary: Modern autonomous vehicles are equipped with multiple sensors, such as cameras, LiDAR, and radar, for comprehensive environmental perception. However, robust cross-modal feature fusion remains a critical challenge, as the reliability of each sensor varies significantly across diverse real-world driving conditions, including poor visibility and adverse weather. While uncertainty quantification (UQ) mitigates this issue by allowing models to prioritize reliable signals, existing uncertainty-aware fusion methods typically rely on simple feature-level uncertainty estimates and thus often fail to generalize effectively in complex, out-of-distribution scenarios. To address this limitation, we propose CRUISE, a novel uncertainty-aware cross-modal sensor fusion framework. CRUISE integrates a vision-language model (VLM)-guided UQ module that generates fine-grained, pixel-level uncertainty estimates. By leveraging the VLM's rich prior knowledge and superior contextual reasoning, our approach provides a highly informative guide for the fusion process. Furthermore, we introduce a dynamic adaptive mechanism that explicitly models and captures cross-modal dependencies, ensuring the framework fully exploits the inherent complementary nature of multi-sensor inputs.

AI.tldr: 提出CRUISE框架，利用视觉语言模型(VLM)引导的不确定性量化(UQ)模块生成细粒度像素级不确定性估计，并结合动态自适应机制解决多传感器融合在复杂场景下的泛化问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于不确定性的跨模态特征融合方法通常依赖简单的特征级不确定性估计，难以在恶劣天气、低能见度等分布外(OOD)复杂场景中有效泛化，导致融合可靠性不足。
AI.method: 提出CRUISE框架：1）集成VLM引导的UQ模块，利用VLM的丰富先验知识和上下文推理能力生成细粒度像素级不确定性估计；2）引入动态自适应机制，显式建模并捕捉跨模态依赖关系，充分利用多传感器输入的互补性。
AI.result: 该框架通过提供更信息丰富的融合指导，能够更有效地处理不同传感器在不同驾驶条件下的可靠性差异，提升了复杂场景下的环境感知鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: CRUISE通过结合VLM引导的细粒度不确定性量化和动态跨模态依赖建模，显著改善了自主车辆在多样化现实驾驶条件下的跨模态传感器融合性能。

title: When Latents Forget Pixels: Restoring Fidelity in Diffusion Transformer Super-Resolution
summary: Image super-resolution (SR) with large generative models has recently achieved remarkable perceptual quality, yet maintaining fidelity to the LR observation remains challenging. In particular, we observe that diffusion transformers (DiTs) built on latent representations suffer from a critical limitation: the compression bottleneck of the VAE weakens fine-grained spatial information, leading to hallucinated details that are weakly grounded in the input image. In this work, we revisit generative SR from a representation perspective and propose a pixel-grounded super-resolution (PGSR) framework that preserves LR-observed pixel evidence before VAE compression and reuses it throughout restoration. Instead of relying solely on the compressed latent condition, PGSR extracts pre-VAE pixel evidence from the upsampled LR image and reuses it at two stages. First, Condition-Side Trajectory Guidance fuses LR-derived pixel evidence with the latent LR condition to guide the latent restoration trajectory. Second, Decoder-Side Pixel Grounding injects multi-scale pixel features into the frozen VAE decoder to ground the final rendering with LR-observed cues. To efficiently adapt large pretrained DiT models, we keep the latent autoencoder and main flow-matching backbone frozen, and train only lightweight restoration modules. We further study an efficient local-window attention variant for improved high-resolution efficiency and scalability. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PGSR improves the realism--fidelity trade-off and produces more faithful, visually convincing results than existing latent generative SR approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出PGSR框架，通过保留VAE压缩前的像素证据并融合到扩散Transformer中，解决潜在生成超分辨率中的保真度问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于潜在表示的扩散Transformer（DiT）受限于VAE的压缩瓶颈，导致细粒度空间信息丢失和幻觉细节，难以保持与低分辨率观测的高保真度。
AI.method: 提出像素接地超分辨率（PGSR）框架：1) 在VAE压缩前提取LR像素证据；2) 条件侧轨迹引导融合像素证据与潜在条件以指导恢复轨迹；3) 解码器侧像素接地将多尺度像素特征注入冻结的VAE解码器以 grounding 最终渲染；4) 仅训练轻量级恢复模块，冻结主干网络，并采用局部窗口注意力提升效率。
AI.result: 实验表明PGSR改善了真实性-保真度的权衡，相比现有潜在生成SR方法产生了更忠实、视觉上令人信服的結果。
AI.conclusion: 从表示视角重新审视生成式SR，通过保留和利用LR观测到的像素证据，有效解决了潜在生成模型在保真度方面的局限，提升了超分辨率性能。

title: Omni2LoRA: Coherence-Preserving Parametric Memory for Efficient Omni Language Models
summary: Omnimodal language models (OLMs) enable unified audio-visual understanding, but processing long joint token sequences makes inference computationally prohibitive. While recent token compression methods attempt to alleviate this burden, compressing modalities in isolation often destroys the temporal cross-modal anchors necessary for coherent reasoning. We introduce Omni2LoRA, a two-stage framework for efficient parametric memory compression via coherence-preserving context distillation that bypasses the token bottleneck entirely. First, a Perceiver hypernetwork processes intermediate representations from a frozen OLM to encode the multimodal context into a full-rank Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) adapter in a single forward pass. To prevent the resulting parameter footprint from scaling linearly with recording length, we optimize a discrete rank allocation policy via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) that uses a modality-ablated counterfactual reward to explicitly penalize the loss of audio-visual coherence, forcing the model to allocate its fixed sub-linear rank budget to synergistic cross-modal anchors rather than isolated visual features. Across three omnimodal backbones, Omni2LoRA operating at a 30% rank budget outperforms direct full-context inference and strong token-compression baselines (OmniZip, OMAC, O-MARC) on four audio-visual question answering benchmarks, improving average accuracy by 8-12% over the strongest baseline and remaining stable under compression ratios as tight as 75%, where token-pruning methods degrade sharply. By converting multimodal memory into a fixed-budget, reusable parameter state, our method drives answer-time multimodal-token load to zero, cutting per-query Time to First Token (TTFT) by up to 12x relative to full-context inference and amortizing to under 0.5s after a handful of queries.

AI.tldr: 提出Omni2LoRA框架，通过相干性保持的上下文蒸馏将多模态记忆压缩为可复用的低秩适配器（LoRA），在30%秩预算下显著提升准确率并降低推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 解决全模态语言模型在处理长联合token序列时推理计算成本高昂的问题；现有token压缩方法因孤立压缩各模态而破坏了对连贯推理至关重要的跨模态时间锚点。
AI.method: 引入两阶段框架：1）使用Perceiver超网络从冻结的OLM中间表示中编码多模态上下文，生成全秩LoRA适配器；2）利用基于组相对策略优化（GRPO）的离散秩分配策略，通过模态消融反事实奖励惩罚音频-视觉相干性损失，强制模型将固定亚线性秩预算分配给协同跨模态锚点。
AI.result: 在三个全模态骨干网络上，Omni2LoRA在30%秩预算下优于直接全上下文推理及主流token压缩基线（OmniZip, OMAC, O-MARC），在四个音频-视觉问答基准上平均准确率提升8-12%；在75%高压缩率下表现稳定，而剪枝方法性能急剧下降；将首字时间（TTFT）降低高达12倍，摊销后单次查询耗时低于0.5秒。
AI.conclusion: 通过将多模态记忆转换为固定预算、可复用的参数状态，该方法实现了零多模态token负载的答案生成，有效突破了token瓶颈，兼顾了高精度与高效推理。

title: Bright-Channel Retinex Enhancement with a Conditional Overdispered-Noise Analysis
summary: I present a training-free low-light enhancement method that combines local bright-channel illumination estimation, Retinex division, and edge-preserving denoising. For a fixed illumination estimate, a conditional Negative -Binominal psueduo-count method characterises the heteroscedastic noise amplified by division. The unconstrained reflectance ratio is the pixelwise maximum-likelihood estimate, with a boundary solution for zero-valued observations; the implemented estimate additionally applies illumination filtering and range clipping. The NB model is a diagnostic noise analysis rather than a calibrated sensor model, and the final fixed-bandwidth bilateral filter is an empirical approximation rather than the exact Bayesian solution. On the LOL-v1 dataset, the methodobtains mean PSNR/SSIM of 17.74dB/0.739, the highest values among the evaluated with conventional methods. A 400X600 image is processed at approximately 43 FPS on an Apple M2 Pro CPU.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需训练的暗光增强方法，结合局部亮通道光照估计、Retinex除法及边缘保持去噪。在LOL-v1数据集上取得最高PSNR/SSIM指标（17.74dB/0.739），并在Apple M2 Pro CPU上实现约43 FPS的处理速度。
AI.motivation: 针对暗光图像增强问题，旨在开发一种无需训练的高效方法，通过结合传统图像先验与统计噪声建模来解决光照不均和噪声放大问题。
AI.method: 该方法结合局部亮通道光照估计、Retinex除法和边缘保持去噪。使用条件负二项式伪计数模型表征除法放大的异方差噪声；将无约束反射率比作为像素级最大似然估计，并辅以光照滤波和范围裁剪。最终采用固定带宽的双边滤波器进行近似去噪。
AI.result: 在LOL-v1数据集上，该方法获得平均PSNR为17.74dB，SSIM为0.739，优于所评估的传统方法。处理一张400x600分辨率的图像在Apple M2 Pro CPU上耗时约对应43 FPS。
AI.conclusion: 该训练-free方法通过诊断性噪声分析和经验性滤波近似，实现了高性能且高效的暗光图像增强，证明了传统先验与统计模型结合的有效性。

title: SafeSceneReason: A Multimodal Reasoning Benchmark Connecting Industrial Hazards with Accident Knowledge
summary: Industrial-safety understanding requires more than detecting workers, equipment, and personal protective equipment. Models must also assess compliance, identify hazardous interactions, explain potential accident mechanisms, and recommend preventive actions. Existing safety datasets primarily focus on visual perception or isolated violation recognition and provide limited supervision for evidence-grounded reasoning. We introduce SafeSceneReason, a multimodal industrial-safety reasoning benchmark and companion training corpus that connects workplace scenes with knowledge from occupational accident investigations. SafeSceneReason combines two complementary data-construction pipelines. The scene-centric pipeline converts annotated workplace images into executable safety scene graphs and generates deterministic answers through program execution over objects, relations, and safety rules. The report-centric pipeline extracts figures and contextual evidence from accident reports and constructs multimodal questions using evidence graphs, explicit information boundaries, multi-step reasoning paths, and iterative verification. The resulting resource contains 110,581 verified scene-centric question--answer pairs and 13,114 refined report-centric question--answer pairs, covering perception, spatial and quantitative reasoning, compliance assessment, evidence synthesis, causal analysis, and mitigation-oriented decision making. Evaluation of representative proprietary and open-source vision--language models reveals substantial performance differences and persistent weaknesses in comparative, technical, and multi-evidence reasoning, demonstrating that strong general visual understanding does not yet guarantee reliable industrial-safety reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出SafeSceneReason，一个连接工作场所场景与事故调查报告的多模态工业安全推理基准和训练语料库，旨在解决现有数据集缺乏证据支撑推理的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的安全数据集主要关注视觉感知或孤立的违规识别，缺乏对基于证据的推理的有效监督，无法全面评估合规性、危险交互及事故机制解释等深层安全理解需求。
AI.method: 构建双流水线数据生成方法：1）以场景为中心，将标注图像转换为可执行的安全场景图并通过程序执行生成确定性答案；2）以报告为中心，从事故报告中提取图表和上下文证据，构建包含多步推理路径和迭代验证的多模态问题。最终形成涵盖感知、空间/定量推理、合规评估等多维度的12万余条问答对。
AI.result: 建立了包含110,581个场景中心问答对和13,114个报告中心问答对的资源库。评估显示，当前主流闭源和开源视觉-语言模型在比较性、技术性和多证据推理方面存在显著性能差异和持续弱点。
AI.conclusion: 强大的通用视觉理解能力并不能保证可靠的工业安全推理，现有模型在复杂的安全逻辑推理任务中仍有巨大提升空间。

title: CodecArena: Codec Quality Assessment via Visual Reinforcement Learning
summary: Video coding is advancing into the low and ultra-low bitrate regime, driven by end-to-end codecs that replace the hand-crafted pipeline with jointly optimized neural networks and generative codecs that exploit the priors of video generation models. Yet the dominant metrics, LPIPS and DISTS, measure feature and texture similarity rather than content fidelity: a reconstruction that hallucinates a wrong face or blurs text into convincing strokes can still score well, even when a human rejects it instantly. To address this, we propose CodecArena, the first vision-language framework for video coding quality assessment, casting codec evaluation as source-conditioned comparative reasoning between a reference and its reconstructions. We optimize CodecArena with Facet-GRPO, a visual reinforcement learning scheme that aligns pairwise codec preferences while grounding the verdict in five fidelity facets: identity, objects, text, texture, and temporal consistency. Its facet-anchored reward uses automatically derived facet directions as weak anchors, rather than human per-facet labels, to prevent any single sub-score from dominating the holistic preference and to yield interpretable fine-grained quality judgments. To support training and evaluation in this underexplored regime, we construct two complementary resources: CodecArena-1K, a fully automatic preference dataset of 1,500 comparison groups built from traditional, neural, and generative codec reconstructions with fused vision-language and objective supervision; and CodecArena-Bench, a human-ranked benchmark with source-disjoint videos for fair out-of-domain evaluation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CodecArena achieves state-of-the-art agreement with human judgments on source-disjoint content across diverse codecs and bitrates, surpassing perceptual metrics and prior vision-language evaluators.

AI.tldr: 提出CodecArena，首个基于视觉-语言的视频编码质量评估框架，通过强化学习对齐人类对重建视频在身份、物体、文本等五个维度的偏好，解决现有指标忽视内容保真度的问题。
AI.motivation: 低比特率视频编码中，主导指标（LPIPS/DISTS）仅衡量特征/纹理相似性，无法识别“幻觉”错误（如错误的脸或模糊文本），导致与人类感知严重不符。
AI.method: 构建CodecArena框架，将编码评估转化为源条件比较推理；使用Facet-GRPO视觉强化学习方案，利用自动衍生的“维度方向”作为弱锚点优化奖励函数，避免单一样本主导，实现可解释的细粒度质量判断。
AI.result: 构建了CodecArena-1K（1500组自动偏好数据集）和CodecArena-Bench（人工排名基准）；实验显示其在源外内容上与人类判断的一致性达到SOTA，超越感知指标及 prior 视觉-语言评估器。
AI.conclusion: CodecArena有效解决了低比特率下视频编码质量评估的内容保真度缺失问题，提供了更准确、可解释且符合人类直觉的评价体系。

title: An Explainable GNN Framework for Component-Level Anomaly Diagnosis
summary: Industrial processes are complex systems composed of multiple interacting sensors that generate multivariate time series (MTS). Detecting anomalies in such systems is critical for reliability and safety, yet understanding their origin is equally important. Existing Graph Neural Network (GNN)based methods for anomaly detection primarily focus on sensor-level deviations and either attribute anomalies directly to the deviating sensors. When diagnosis is attempted, generally, the most deviated sensor is identified as a root cause of a system fault. However, in many industrial systems, anomalies do not arise from faulty sensors but from disruptions in the influences governing the system dynamics. We propose an explainable GNN-based anomaly detection framework that shifts the perspective from sensor-level anomalies to component-level diagnosis, hypothesizing that anomalous measurements are symptoms of altered inter-sensor influences. Experiments show that the method effectively identifies and prioritizes the true faulty components, providing interpretable insights into system failures.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种可解释的GNN异常检测框架，从传感器级偏差转向组件级诊断，通过识别异常的传感器间相互作用来定位根本原因，而非仅依赖最偏离的传感器。
AI.motivation: 现有基于GNN的方法主要关注传感器级别的偏差，并将故障归因于偏差最大的传感器；但在许多工业系统中，异常并非源于传感器本身故障，而是源于支配系统动态的相互影响（inter-sensor influences）受到干扰。理解异常根源对于可靠性和安全性至关重要。
AI.method: 构建一个可解释的基于图神经网络（GNN）的异常检测框架，假设异常测量值是传感器间相互作用改变的症状，从而将分析视角从单一传感器偏差转移到组件级别的相互作用诊断上。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法能有效识别并优先排序真正的故障组件，为系统故障提供可解释的洞察。
AI.conclusion: 通过关注传感器间的相互作用而非单一传感器读数，该框架能更准确地诊断工业系统中的复杂故障根源。

title: UniMoFlow: Grounding Instruction-Driven 3D Human Motion Editing in Generation
comment: 18 pages, including supplementary material; 8 figures and 7 tables. Code: https://github.com/Yilei-Hua/UniMoFlow. Submitted to AAAI 2027
summary: Instruction-driven editing of 3D human motion requires precise spatiotemporal localization, rich semantic grounding, and strict preservation of unmodified content. Existing methods either resort to training-free adaptation of generative models or rely solely on triplet supervision; however, adaptation often yields suboptimal control, and manually curated triplet datasets remain severely limited in scale and semantic diversity. To overcome this bottleneck, we ground motion editing directly within text-to-motion generation across data, architecture, and inference. At the data level, we develop a closed-loop synthesis-and-verification pipeline that produces Omni-MoEdit, a large-scale dataset spanning body-part, amplitude, temporal, action, and style edits. At the architectural level, we introduce UniMoFlow, a unified latent flow-matching model that shares broad semantic and kinematic knowledge between generation and editing. At the inference level, SAFE (Source-Anchored Flow Editing) complements UniMoFlow with controllable, source-anchored refinement. Furthermore, we augment standard evaluations with semantics-aware metrics to account for valid edits that inherently deviate from a single ground-truth reference. Extensive experiments demonstrate improved target-text alignment, edit effectiveness, and cycle consistency, while maintaining competitive source fidelity and text-to-motion generation quality.

AI.tldr: 提出UniMoFlow框架，通过闭环数据合成、统一流匹配架构及源锚定推理优化，解决3D人体运动指令驱动编辑中的定位与语义难题。
AI.motivation: 现有3D人体运动编辑方法存在控制力不足或受限于小规模三元组数据集的瓶颈，缺乏大规模、高语义多样性的训练数据及有效的生成-编辑统一机制。
AI.method: 1. 数据层：构建闭环合成与验证流程，生成Omni-MoEdit大规模多粒度编辑数据集；2. 架构层：设计UniMoFlow统一潜在流匹配模型，共享生成与编辑知识；3. 推理层：引入SAFE（源锚定流编辑）实现可控细化；4. 评估层：采用语义感知指标评估编辑有效性。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法显著提升了目标文本对齐度、编辑有效性和循环一致性，同时保持了具有竞争力的源内容保真度和文本到运动生成质量。
AI.conclusion: 通过将运动编辑直接嵌入文本到运动生成过程，在数据、架构和推理三个层面实现了更精确的时空定位、丰富的语义 grounding 及对未修改内容的严格保留。

title: Emotion2Skill: Model-Internal Emotion Signals for Adaptive Skill Selection and Evolution
summary: Skill-based LLM agents select reusable procedures from an external library to solve complex tasks, yet their routing decisions rely entirely on text-level signals such as task descriptions, verbal reflections, and experience-derived rules, while the model's own internal representational state remains unobserved. Recent interpretability work has shown that LLMs maintain linear emotion representations that causally influence behavior; however, these representations have been exploited only for post-hoc analysis or direct output steering, and have not been used to inform agent-level decision-making. We propose Emotion2Skill, a framework that extracts LLM-internal emotion vectors and incorporates them into both skill selection and skill evolution. At each decision step, a 27-dimensional emotion state is extracted from the residual stream and mapped to a confidence-gated summary injected into the routing prompt. Beyond online selection, emotion trajectories are analyzed for abrupt internal-state shifts to pinpoint problematic skill invocations, guiding targeted SOP rewriting that replaces the coarse binary outcome signal of prior methods. On WebShop and ALFWorld, Emotion2Skill with Qwen3-8B improves over the Zero-Shot baseline by +26.9% success rate and +25.5% average success respectively, outperforming all baselines on both benchmarks with consistent gains on Qwen3-14B. Co-activation analysis further reveals semantically coherent emotion--skill pairings, confirming that the routing improvements reflect meaningful internal-state signals rather than opaque statistical correlations. These results establish LLM-internal emotion representations as an effective decision-level signal for orchestrating agent skill systems, extending their utility beyond interpretability and output steering. The code is available at https://github.com/BoHan-LIN04/Emotion2Skill.

AI.tldr: 提出Emotion2Skill框架，利用LLM内部情感向量优化智能体的技能选择与演化，显著提升WebShop和ALFWorld基准测试成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于技能的LLM智能体仅依赖文本信号进行路由决策，忽略了模型内部表征状态；尽管已知LLM存在线性情感表征并影响行为，但此前仅用于事后分析或输出控制，未用于智能体层面的决策制定。
AI.method: 从残差流中提取27维情感状态，映射为置信度门控摘要注入路由提示；通过分析情感轨迹中的内部状态突变来定位问题技能调用，指导标准作业程序（SOP）的重写，替代传统的二元结果信号。
AI.result: 在WebShop和ALFWorld上，结合Qwen3-8B的Emotion2Skill相比Zero-Shot基线成功率提升+26.9%，平均成功率提升+25.5%，且在Qwen3-14B上表现一致优异；共激活分析证实了情感-技能配对的语义一致性。
AI.conclusion: LLM内部情感表征可作为有效的决策级信号来编排智能体技能系统，将其效用从解释性和输出控制扩展至核心决策过程。

title: Right Answer, Wrong Heat: Explanation-Aware Evaluation and Thermal-Grounded Feedback for MLLMs on Infrared Images
comment: This manuscript is currently under peer review. Copyright may subsequently be transferred to the publisher, after which the availability of this version may be subject to the publisher's policy
summary: General-purpose multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly applied to infrared images, where they are commonly scored by answer accuracy alone. However, a correct answer does not ensure that the model's explanation is grounded in infrared thermal evidence. We introduce an explanation-aware evaluation framework that separates answer correctness, output-level explanation groundedness, and thermal grounding for infrared visual questions. Using a Dual-LLM Consensus Judge with a preliminary human-anchor calibration check, we find that correct answers can still rely on weak or visible-light evidence; withholding the original infrared image and showing only a visible-like rendering erodes thermal grounding with little accuracy change; and this erosion is observed most strongly for more capable models but disappears when infrared remains available. We further propose Thermal-Grounded Feedback (TGF), a training-free feedback loop that diagnoses explanation-side failures and revises the explanation while preserving the selected answer. On local paired-input validation, TGF improves explanation-side grounding without changing answers. These findings suggest that future trustworthy MLLMs for infrared scene understanding should be evaluated and developed to produce thermally grounded explanations rather than merely accurate answers.

AI.tldr: 针对红外图像多模态大模型（MLLMs）仅以答案准确性评估的不足，提出解释感知的评估框架和热接地反馈机制。研究发现正确回答可能依赖非红外证据，且能力越强的模型在缺乏红外信息时“热接地”能力下降越明显。提出的训练无反馈循环TGF能在保持答案不变的情况下提升解释的热接地性，强调未来MLLM应注重产生基于热证据的解释而非仅追求答案准确。
AI.motivation: 现有通用多模态大语言模型应用于红外图像时，通常仅通过答案准确性进行评分。然而，正确的答案并不能保证模型的解释是基于红外热证据的，导致对模型真实感知能力的评估存在偏差，缺乏对解释可信度和证据基础的深入考量。
AI.method:
1. 构建解释感知评估框架：将答案正确性、输出级解释的接地性（groundedness）和红外热接地性分离评估。
2. 使用双LLM共识裁判（Dual-LLM Consensus Judge）并结合初步人工锚点校准检查进行评估。
3. 设计消融实验：对比保留原始红外图像与仅提供可见光风格渲染图像对模型表现的影响。
4. 提出热接地反馈（Thermal-Grounded Feedback, TGF）：一种无需训练的反馈循环，用于诊断解释侧失败并修正解释，同时保留所选答案。
AI.result:
1. 正确回答仍可能依赖微弱或可见光证据；移除原始红外图像仅展示可见光风格渲染会显著削弱热接地性，但答案准确率变化不大。
2. 这种热接地性的侵蚀在更强大的模型中表现最为强烈，但当红外图像可用时该现象消失。
3. TGF在本地配对输入验证中，能够在不改变答案的情况下显著提升解释侧的热接地性。
AI.conclusion: 未来用于红外场景理解的可靠多模态大模型（MLLMs）应在评估和开发中侧重于生成具有热接地性的解释，而不仅仅是提供准确的答案。这要求模型真正理解红外热证据，而非仅仅匹配表面特征。

title: SkillSentry: Reliable Skill Execution for LLM Agents via Runtime Assurance
summary: LLM agents are increasingly equipped with skills to perform complex tasks through multi-step reasoning and tool use. Although skills provide reusable procedural knowledge, agents may still execute them unreliably. Even when an agent has demonstrated the capability to complete tasks under the guidance of a skill, it may fail to do so consistently across similar tasks or repeated runs due to deviations from the skill procedure or incorrect execution of individual steps. Such instability limits the practical reliability of LLM agents. To address this problem, we propose SkillSentry, a skill-oriented runtime assurance framework built upon a new domain-specific language (DSL) for representing runtime guidance for skill execution. SkillSentry initializes the runtime guidance by combining a skill specification extracted from the corresponding skill document with execution experience mined from historical successful and failed traces. It then wraps around the agent execution loop to monitor and guide skill execution under the current guidance, while iteratively refining the guidance using newly collected traces. We evaluate SkillSentry on 15 skills across two LLM agents, each paired with two backbone models, i.e., Claude Code with Claude-Haiku-4.5 and Claude-Opus-4.6, and Codex with GPT-5.2 and GPT-5.4. Our results show that SkillSentry improves the task success rate of LLM agents by 24.1% across skills, on average, while exhibiting lower variability across repeated runs.

AI.tldr: 提出SkillSentry框架，通过领域特定语言(DSL)和运行时指导，解决LLM智能体在执行技能时因步骤偏差导致的不稳定问题，显著提升任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 尽管LLM智能体具备多步推理和工具使用能力，但在执行可复用技能时存在不稳定性：即使曾成功完成任务，也常因偏离技能流程或单步执行错误而在相似任务或重复运行中失败，限制了其实际可靠性。
AI.method: 提出SkillSentry，一种基于新领域特定语言(DSL)的技能导向运行时保证框架。该方法从技能文档提取规范，并结合历史成功/失败轨迹挖掘的执行经验初始化运行时指导；随后包裹智能体执行循环以监控和指导执行，并利用新收集轨迹迭代优化指导策略。
AI.result: 在15个技能、2种LLM智能体（Claude Code, Codex）及4种基础模型组合上进行评估。结果显示，SkillSentry平均将LLM智能体的任务成功率提高了24.1%，并在重复运行中表现出更低的变异性。
AI.conclusion: SkillSentry通过动态运行时指导和迭代优化，有效提升了LLM智能体在执行复杂技能时的稳定性和成功率，增强了其在实际应用中的可靠性。

title: Multi-Submap Implicit Neural SLAM with Local-to-Global Loop Closure for Large-Scale Scene Reconstruction
summary: Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF)-based SLAM has demonstrated impressive results in small-scale scene reconstruction, yet scaling these methods to extensive, complex environments remains challenging due to catastrophic forgetting and accumulated trajectory drift. This paper presents a robust, large-scale neural SLAM system featuring a multi-submap architecture and a dual-tier loop closure mechanism. Specifically, we propose a progressive mapping strategy that dynamically allocates neural submaps to maintain high-fidelity representations without memory explosion. For robust pose estimation, an optical-flow-based tracking module is integrated to handle aggressive motions. To address global consistency, we introduce a local-to-global loop closure framework leveraging the foundation model for high-performance global descriptor extraction, significantly enhancing relocalization accuracy under varying viewpoints. Furthermore, an inter-submap online distillation algorithm is designed during back-end optimization to enforce geometric and appearance consistency across overlapping submap boundaries. To validate the system, we developed a customized handheld mechatronic platform and conducted extensive evaluations on both public benchmarks and our large-scale indoor-outdoor datasets. Experimental results, including direct deployment on an onboard computing unit, demonstrate that our approach outperforms state-of-the-art neural SLAM methods in reconstruction quality and localization robustness, providing a scalable solution for real-world robotic perception and digital twinning. We will release the code publicly on \href{https://github.com/dtc111111/MSN-SLAM}{https://github.com/dtc111111/MSN-SLAM} .

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于多子图架构和双层回环检测的大规模神经SLAM系统，通过渐进式映射、光流跟踪、基础模型全局描述符及子图间蒸馏算法，解决了大规模场景重建中的灾难性遗忘和轨迹漂移问题，实现了高精度重建与鲁棒定位。
AI.motivation: 现有基于NeRF的SLAM方法在小规模场景中表现优异，但在扩展到广泛复杂环境时，面临灾难性遗忘（catastrophic forgetting）和累积轨迹漂移（accumulated trajectory drift）的挑战，难以维持高保真表示且易导致内存爆炸。
AI.method: 1. **多子图架构与渐进式映射**：动态分配神经子图以维持高保真表示并避免内存溢出；2. **光流跟踪模块**：集成用于处理剧烈运动下的鲁棒位姿估计；3. **局部到全局回环框架**：利用基础模型提取高性能全局描述符，提升不同视角下的重定位精度；4. **子图间在线蒸馏算法**：在后端优化中强制执行重叠子图边界处的几何和外观一致性。
AI.result: 在公共基准测试及自建的大规模室内外数据集上进行了广泛评估，并在机载计算单元上直接部署。实验结果表明，该方法在重建质量和定位鲁棒性方面优于最先进（SOTA）的神经SLAM方法。
AI.conclusion: 该系统为现实世界的机器人感知和数字孪生提供了一种可扩展的解决方案，证明了其在大规模复杂环境中进行高效神经SLAM的可行性。

title: RefineAny3D: Depth Refinement as Semantic Alignment for Monocular 3D Detection
summary: Monocular 3D object detection spans two regimes: closed-set detectors operating within a fixed category vocabulary, and open-vocabulary detectors that localize arbitrary categories by leveraging depth foundation models for 3D geometry. We find that current depth foundation models, despite their strong zero-shot generalization, lack the object-level precision 3D detection demands: substituting a state-of-the-art depth foundation model for a strong detector's predicted depth degrades accuracy, even falling below the detector's own prediction. Rather than pushing detectors or depth models to be more accurate end-to-end, we treat object-level depth refinement as a stand-alone task and present RefineAny3D, a vision-language model that corrects depth without ever predicting a numerical value. Our key insight is that depth error has a direct visual signature in image space: when projected onto the image, a correctly placed box tightly encloses the object, while a too-far box projects too small and a too-close box projects too large. Depth refinement thus reduces to a visual alignment problem rather than a metric regression problem, which we instantiate by extending the VLM's vocabulary with action tokens that replace numerical depth output with categorical decisions, and by supervising the model on a large-scale chain-of-thought dataset that grounds each decision in explicit visual evidence. Applied as a single post-hoc step, RefineAny3D delivers consistent gains across closed-set detectors, open-vocabulary detectors, and 3D auto-labeling tools, and generalizes to novel categories, scenes, and cameras without retraining.

AI.tldr: 提出RefineAny3D，一种无需预测具体数值、通过视觉对齐修正单目3D检测深度的视觉语言模型。
AI.motivation: 现有深度基础模型在零样本泛化上表现良好，但缺乏物体级别的3D检测精度；直接替换检测器预测的深度反而导致准确率下降。
AI.method: 将深度细化视为独立任务，利用“正确框紧密包围物体，过远框投影过小，过近框投影过大”的视觉特征，扩展VLM词汇表以包含动作令牌，替代数值输出为分类决策，并通过基于视觉证据的大规模思维链数据集进行监督训练。
AI.result: 作为单一的后期处理步骤，RefineAny3D在封闭集检测器、开放词汇检测器和3D自动标注工具上均带来一致的精度提升，且无需重新训练即可泛化至新类别、场景和相机。
AI.conclusion: 深度细化可简化为视觉对齐问题而非度量回归问题，该方法有效提升了3D检测性能并具备强大的泛化能力。

title: Privileged Likelihood Is Not Automatically Value: Three Checks for Token Credit in On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: Outcome verifiers score completed reasoning traces but do not assign credit to intermediate tokens. Privileged self-distillation attempts to fill this gap by rescoring a model's own rollout with training-only information. A token likelihood change, however, is not automatically outcome credit. We separate three questions: whether the score tracks better actions, whether feedback construction changes what is compared, and what behavior the training loss reinforces. We establish these distinctions formally. When a rollout is scored using hindsight feedback written about that same rollout, its content determines both the tokens and the scoring context, creating direct self-dependence. Using feedback from another rollout of the same problem removes this dependence but does not guarantee a useful score. In matched experiments with a 20B model on AIME 2025, the implemented additive score is near chance (AUC=0.505) and slightly favors incorrect traces after length adjustment. In the paired comparison, the outcome-only control records 64.2\%, versus 24.2\%--33.9\% for five token-score variants. The results motivate validating score meaning, feedback construction, and training behavior separately before calling a likelihood signal credit.

AI.tldr: 研究指出，仅凭结果验证器无法为中间推理步骤分配信用。通过形式化分析发现，使用自身回放的 hindsight feedback 会导致直接自依赖，而使用其他回放虽消除依赖但不保证评分有效。实验显示，在20B模型上，所实现的加法评分接近随机水平（AUC=0.505），且配对比较中基于结果的对照组表现显著优于五种令牌评分变体。结论强调需单独验证评分意义、反馈构建和训练行为，才能确认似然信号是否真正代表信用分配。
AI.motivation: 解决结果验证器无法为推理过程中的中间令牌分配信用的问题，并纠正特权自蒸馏中“令牌似然变化即等于结果信用”的错误假设。
AI.method:
1. 形式化区分三个核心问题：评分是否追踪更优动作、反馈构建如何改变比较对象、训练损失强化了何种行为。
2. 分析两种反馈场景：使用同一回放的 hindsight feedback（导致自依赖）与使用同问题不同回放的 feedback（消除依赖但有效性不确定）。
3. 在 AIME 2025 数据集上使用 20B 模型进行匹配实验，对比基于结果的对照组与五种令牌评分变体的性能。
AI.result:
1. 在长度调整后，实施的加法评分接近随机水平（AUC=0.505），且略微偏向错误轨迹。
2. 在配对比较中，仅基于结果的对照组胜率为 64.2%，而五种令牌评分变体的胜率仅为 24.2%–33.9%。
AI.conclusion: 令牌似然的变化并不自动等同于结果信用。在使用基于似然的信号作为信用分配之前，必须分别严格验证评分的含义、反馈的构建方式以及训练损失所强化的具体行为。

title: OGG-FR: Orthogonal Gradient Gaming and Frequency Rectification for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Infrared Image Super-Resolution
comment: This manuscript is currently under peer review. Copyright may subsequently be transferred to the publisher, after which the availability of this version may be subject to the publisher's policy
summary: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) infrared image super-resolution aims to recover weak thermal structures for deployment on resource-constrained platforms; lightweight models are therefore preferred, but multi-loss training can be unstable. A common strategy combines pixel-domain and frequency-domain objectives; however, low contrast, limited high-frequency content, and sensor-specific noise often make their gradients weakly aligned or conflicting. To address this optimization ambiguity, we propose Orthogonal Gradient Gaming and Frequency Rectification (OGG-FR), a plug-and-play optimization framework that decomposes the frequency gradient into a redundant parallel component and an orthogonal innovation component relative to the pixel gradient. In the conflict regime, OGG-FR computes a safe base gradient using the Multiple Gradient Descent Algorithm (MGDA) and adds a variance-rectified orthogonal innovation; in the compatible regime, it discards redundant parallel information and injects the orthogonal innovation according to a confidence score estimated from the high-frequency residual. Experimental results on the UAV thermal benchmark show broad gains under BI and BD degradations at $\times 4$ and $\times 8$ scales, while gradient analyses support the effectiveness of the proposed conflict-aware update rule.

AI.tldr: 提出OGG-FR框架，通过分解频率梯度为平行和正交分量，解决无人机红外图像超分辨率中多损失训练不稳定的问题。
AI.motivation: 无人机红外图像超分辨率需在资源受限平台上部署轻量级模型，但常见的像素域与频域联合训练因低对比度、高频内容有限及传感器噪声导致梯度弱对齐或冲突，造成优化不稳定。
AI.method: 提出正交梯度博弈与频率校正（OGG-FR）框架：将频率梯度分解为相对于像素梯度的冗余平行分量和正交创新分量。在冲突模式下，使用MGDA计算安全基础梯度并添加方差校正的正交创新；在兼容模式下，丢弃冗余平行信息，根据高频残差估计的置信度注入正交创新。
AI.result: 在UAV热基准测试上，BI和BD退化条件下，×4和×8缩放比例均取得显著性能提升，梯度分析验证了该冲突感知更新规则的有效性。
AI.conclusion: OGG-FR通过解耦和优化梯度方向，有效解决了多损失训练中的优化歧义，提升了无人机红外图像超分辨率的性能和稳定性。

title: Entropy-based Code Adversarial Translation for Real-world Repository Migration
summary: LLMs have demonstrated strong capabilities in code generation and automated program repair, but migrating an entire repository rarely produces a runnable application because long-horizon translation challenges LLM-based agents' ability to maintain repository-level migration objectives. In this work, we propose Entropy-based Code Adversarial Translation (ECAT), a multi-agent framework for automated Android-to-HarmonyOS repository migration. ECAT formulates repository migration as adversarial entropy minimization through a generator-discriminator architecture. The discriminator measures migration quality using a unified metric called Code Entropy and produces text gradients that specify both file-level generation directives and the skills needed to execute them. Guided by these optimization signals, the generator iteratively updates the repository, and each update is accepted only if it reduces Code Entropy. Repeated generator--discriminator interactions progressively drive the migration from an initial template toward a functionally complete HarmonyOS repository. Successful low-entropy trajectories are further distilled into a self-evolving memory tree, enabling transferable migration knowledge across repositories. We also introduce A2H-RepoBench, the first real-world benchmark for Android-to-HarmonyOS repository migration, covering applications from tens of thousands to hundreds of thousands of lines of code. Evaluated by node alignment and an agent-based functional judge, ECAT achieves 74.7% overall migration quality and consistently outperforms existing agent-based methods across repositories of different scales.

AI.tldr: 提出ECAT多智能体框架，通过对抗性熵最小化解决Android到HarmonyOS代码库迁移难题，实现高成功率的全仓库自动化迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型在代码生成方面表现强劲，但在整个代码库迁移时难以维持长期目标，导致生成的应用无法运行。
AI.method: 构建生成器-判别器架构的ECAT框架：判别器利用“代码熵”统一指标评估质量并生成文本梯度；生成器根据优化信号迭代更新代码，仅当代码熵降低时才接受更新；最终将成功轨迹蒸馏为自进化记忆树以转移知识。
AI.result: 在首个真实世界基准测试A2H-RepoBench上，ECAT实现了74.7%的整体迁移质量，并在不同规模的代码库中一致优于现有的基于智能体的方法。
AI.conclusion: ECAT通过对抗性熵最小化有效解决了长周期代码库迁移中的连贯性问题，为跨平台应用迁移提供了高效、可迁移的自动化解决方案。

title: LightAIR: Lightweight Action Inversion and Riemannian Rectification for Text-based Person Anomaly Search
summary: Traditional Text-based Person Search (TPS) is typically limited to matching static appearance attributes, severely neglecting dynamic action information. The Text-based Person Anomaly Search (TPAS) task bridges this gap, requiring models to locate micro-level specific abnormal behaviors while matching macro-level appearance of pedestrians. However, current TPAS methods face fundamental limitations: external explicit pose estimators are fragile in unconstrained surveillance scenarios, and implicit learning encounters visual decoupling failure under pixel-level entanglement, causing dominant appearance information to easily swallow and contaminate subtle action features. Furthermore, performing contrastive optimization on hard negative samples (``same appearance, different actions'') in conventional Euclidean spaces induces severe shortcut learning. To address these, we propose the Lightweight Action Inversion and Riemannian rectification network (LightAIR). First, it introduces textual semantic priors as anchors via a lightweight action inversion operator to extract pure action features, thereby overcoming visual-inherent coupling. Subsequently, it employs orthogonal null-space projection to constrain appearance features within the orthogonal complement space of action features, guaranteeing strict forward decoupling. Finally, we designed a gradient rectification module that computes the Riemannian gradient to constrain the backpropagation trajectory, forcing the gradient flow to update strictly along the tangent space that preserves decoupling properties, thereby cutting off harmful shortcuts. Extensive experiments on the widely used TPAS and TIPR datasets demonstrate that LightAIR significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods. Codes are available at https://github.com/rainy-london/LightAIR

AI.tldr: 提出LightAIR网络，通过文本先验锚点提取纯动作特征、正交零空间投影解耦外观与动作、黎曼梯度修正切断捷径学习，解决TPAS任务中动态行为匹配难题。
AI.motivation: 传统基于文本的行人搜索(TPS)忽视动态动作信息；现有基于文本的行人异常搜索(TPAS)方法存在显式姿态估计器在非受限场景下脆弱、隐式学习在像素级纠缠下发生视觉解耦失败（外观淹没动作）、以及欧氏空间中硬负样本对比优化导致严重捷径学习等根本性局限。
AI.method: 提出轻量级动作逆反与黎曼修正网络(LightAIR)：1. 利用轻量级动作逆反算子引入文本语义先验作为锚点，提取纯动作特征以克服视觉固有耦合；2. 采用正交零空间投影将外观特征约束在动作特征的正交补空间中，确保严格的前向解耦；3. 设计梯度修正模块计算黎曼梯度，约束反向传播轨迹沿保持解耦性质的切空间更新，切断有害捷径。
AI.result: 在TPAS和TIPR数据集上的广泛实验表明，LightAIR显著优于现有的最先进(SOTA)方法。
AI.conclusion: LightAIR有效解决了TPAS任务中的动作-外观耦合及优化捷径问题，实现了更精准的微细异常行为定位与宏观外观匹配。

title: P$^{3}$: Joint Program-and-Proof Planning for Verified Code Generation
summary: Verified code generation asks a large language model (LLM) to generate both an executable program and a machine-checkable proof that the program meets a formal specification, promising software that is correct by construction. The de facto workflow decouples the two halves of the problem: first synthesize a program, then attempt to prove it correct. We observe that this sequential pipeline can be both ineffective and inefficient in practice. A program generated without anticipating its proof can be subtly incorrect or structurally difficult to verify, forcing the LLM into brittle repair loops that alternate between patching the code and patching the proof. Inspired by Dijkstra's view that a program and its correctness argument should be developed hand in hand, we propose $P^3$, an LLM-based agentic workflow that first derives a unified program-and-proof plan from the specification, then elaborates the implementation and proof scaffold under this shared plan. To evaluate verified code generation in realistic settings, we further introduce Lean4Commit0, a repository-derived, library-level benchmark built by extracting core APIs from real-world software repositories and translating their requirements, including relational specifications across APIs, into Lean tasks. Using four frontier LLM backends, we evaluate $P^3$ on Verina, AlgoVeri, and our Lean4Commit0 benchmark, where it achieves the highest solve rate in every benchmark--model setting. Compared with the stronger baseline, it improves solve rates by 4.6--11.2 percentage points and reduces per-task API cost by up to roughly 40\% and wall-clock time by up to roughly 37\% on the difficult subset of each benchmark. A targeted ablation further shows gains of 3.3--8.3 points over implementation-only planning, isolating the benefit of planning the program and proof jointly.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为$P^3$的大语言模型智能体工作流，通过先制定统一的程序与证明计划，再分别细化实现和证明脚手架，解决了传统“先生成代码后验证”流程中因缺乏前瞻性导致的低效和脆弱修复循环问题。该方法在多个基准测试上显著提高了正确率，并降低了成本和时间消耗。
AI.motivation: 传统的已验证代码生成工作流程将程序合成与正确性证明解耦（即先生成程序，再尝试证明其正确性）。这种顺序流水线在实践中既无效又低效：未预见证明需求的程序往往存在细微错误或结构难以验证，迫使大语言模型陷入在修补代码和修补证明之间反复交替的脆弱修复循环中。受Dijkstra关于程序与其正确性论证应协同开发的观点启发，旨在解决这一痛点。
AI.method: 提出了$P^3$，一种基于LLM的智能体工作流。其核心步骤包括：1. 从规范中推导出统一的“程序与证明计划”；2. 在该共享计划的指导下，分别细化实现代码和证明脚手架。此外，为了在现实环境中评估已验证代码生成，构建了Lean4Commit0基准测试，该基准从真实软件仓库中提取核心API，并将其需求（包括跨API的关系规范）转化为Lean任务。
AI.result: 使用四个前沿LLM后端，在Verina、AlgoVeri和Lean4Commit0基准测试上对$P^3$进行评估。结果显示：1. $P^3$在所有基准-模型设置下均取得了最高的解决率；2. 相比更强的基线方法，解决率提高了4.6–11.2个百分点；3. 在困难子集上，每任务API成本降低约40%，耗时降低约37%；4. 消融实验表明，联合规划程序与证明比仅规划实现能额外带来3.3–8.3个百分点的提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过将程序与证明的规划统一进行，$P^3$工作流有效克服了传统分离式工作流的缺陷，实现了更高效率、更低成本和更优性能的已验证代码生成。同时，新提出的Lean4Commit0基准为评估现实场景下的形式化验证能力提供了重要工具。
